nusmp.skill.summoner.description: Unique. Call summon cards: a Beast Card wolf or a Stone Card golem fight beside you, Recall dismisses them. Mastery raises how many can answer.
nusmp.skill.faith.description: Unique. Pray to gather Faith, then spend it to bestow a skill upon a player you look at. Faith is kept when this skill evolves.
nusmp.skill.firebolt.description: Instant magic. A bolt of lightning-fire fired the moment you press, striking what you look at and scorching everything near it. Mastery doubles the damage.
nusmp.skill.argonaut.description: Unique. The wish to become a hero. Hold to charge with the chime of bells (up to five), release to strike everything in front of you.
nusmp.skill.liaris_freese.description: Unique. Passive. While your feelings remain, so does your growth: your kills can raise the mastery of all your skills.
nusmp.skill.airiel.description: Unique. Tempest: wrap yourself in wind for speed, power and protection from arrows, or ride it in a sudden dash that recovers faster while the wind blows.
nusmp.skill.hestia.description: Unique. Goddess of the Hearth. Heal and bless yourself and every ally around you; once mastered it also cleanses and wards off fire.
nusmp.skill.freya.description: Unique. Goddess of Beauty. Your Charm makes nearby monsters forget you and leaves your enemies dazed.
nusmp.skill.hephaestus.description: Unique. Goddess of the Forge. Restore the weapon in your hand, and your off-hand and armour once mastered.
nusmp.skill.loki.description: Unique. The Trickster. Vanish from sight and blink forward; monsters that were hunting you lose track of you.
nusmp.skill.wynn_fimbulvetr.description: Chanted magic (3 lines). A blizzard falls on the spot you look at: it freezes everything in it and keeps chilling whatever stays.
nusmp.skill.rea_laevateinn.description: Chanted magic (3 lines). Wave after wave of flame pillars erupt around you and burn every foe that comes close.
nusmp.skill.arcs_ray.description: Chanted magic (1 line). A piercing beam of light strikes everything in a line, and burns the undead even harder.
nusmp.skill.futsunomitama.description: Chanted magic (2 lines). A gravity field at the spot you look at crushes foes down, pulls them in and pins them.
nusmp.skill.uchide_no_kozuchi.descriptio: Chanted magic (3 lines). Level Boost: greatly raise the power of the ally you look at, or your own, for a time.
nusmp.skill.hell_walker.description: Unique. Toggle. The closer you are to death, the harder you hit: at ten percent health your blows deal about double.
nusmp.skill.hawk_eye.description: Toggle. Bird Card sight: night vision, and every hostile creature around you glows, even through walls.
nusmp.skill.spirit_card.description: Toggle. A healing aura for you and everyone near you; once mastered it also cleanses harmful effects.
nusmp.skill.unbreakable_will.description: Unique. Passive. Once in a long while, survive a killing blow and stand back up. Press to see whether your will is ready.
nusmp.skill.hati.description: Unique. Passive. Fire, lightning and magic hitting you are partly absorbed and turned into stacking Strength.
nusmp.skill.lord_of_summons.description: Ultimate. Evolved from Summoner. Twice the summons and far stronger cards: Beast Card calls three wolves, Stone Card is a colossus, Legion calls a pack of five and the Wraith Card a swarm of flying spirits.
nusmp.skill.goddess_of_faith.description: Ultimate. Evolved from Faith. Bestow for half the Faith and half the wait, pray for triple Faith, grant allies a Blessing, and work a Miracle that heals and protects them.
nusmp.skill.heros_argonaut.description: Ultimate. Evolved from Argonaut. Charge up to ten bells and strike with triple power, or release the charge as a piercing Hero's Beam.
nusmp.skill.hell_conqueror.description: Ultimate. Toggle. Evolved from Hell Walker. Near death your blows become devastating and heal you, and a hellfire aura burns the foes around you.
nusmp.skill.immortal_will.description: Ultimate. Evolved from Unbreakable Will. Rise from a killing blow at full health, far more often, with a shockwave; Rally heals and cleanses you on demand.
nusmp.skill.devils_footprints.descriptio: Unique. Flames burst from your feet: dash through the air or deliver a burning kick. Your own fire cannot hurt you.
nusmp.skill.adolla_burst.description: Ultimate. Evolved from Devil's Footprints. Move at the speed of light striking everything on the way, kick with far more force, and unleash the Adolla Burst around you.
nusmp.skill.book_maker.description: Unique. Pin your target with giant screws and drag it down to your level. Once mastered, Barrage pins every foe in front of you.
nusmp.skill.all_fiction.description: Ultimate. Make injuries, enemies and even your own death never have happened.
nusmp.skill.six_eyes.description: Unique. Toggle. See every living thing around you through walls and darkness, and read the health of whatever you look at.
nusmp.skill.limitless.description: Ultimate. Infinity stops every attack before it reaches you. Blue, Red and Hollow Purple bend space itself.
nusmp.skill.gold_experience.description: Unique. Give life to heal an ally, or overload a foe's senses with it; your blows leave enemies slowed.
nusmp.skill.gold_experience_requiem.desc: Ultimate. Return to Zero: attacks against you never reach their result. Life Burst floods your allies with life.
nusmp.skill.vector_manipulation.descript: Unique. Toggle. Reflect projectiles and turn part of every melee hit back on the attacker.
nusmp.skill.black_wings.description: Ultimate. Toggle. Total reflection of melee and projectiles, no fall damage, and wings that let you glide in the air while you sneak.
nusmp.skill.instant_death.description: Ultimate. Whatever you will to die, dies. Bosses and protected players lose a share of their health instead.
nusmp.skill.the_almighty.description: Ultimate. See every future and choose the one where you are never harmed.
nusmp.skill.the_visionary.description: Ultimate. Whatever you imagine becomes reality: a meteor, a void, a perfect body.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_magic.description: The magic of your grimoire. Hold your grimoire to cast. Four-leaf and five-leaf grimoires are stronger and cheaper to cast from.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_flame.description: Grimoire magic: Flame Magic. Hold your grimoire to cast. Four-leaf and five-leaf grimoires cast stronger and cheaper.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_explosion.descripti: Grimoire magic: Explosion Magic. Hold your grimoire to cast. Four-leaf and five-leaf grimoires cast stronger and cheaper.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_magma.description: Grimoire magic: Magma Magic. Hold your grimoire to cast. Four-leaf and five-leaf grimoires cast stronger and cheaper.

nusmp.skill.grimoire_storm.description: Storm Magic is a Fairy Tail magic of the Stormcaller Staff, not a grimoire magic. This grimoire is the old Storm book, kept so that old saves and grimoires still load; it is no longer given out (server config storm.staffOnly).
nusmp.skill.grimoire_earth.description: Grimoire magic: Earth Magic. Hold your grimoire to cast. Four-leaf and five-leaf grimoires cast stronger and cheaper.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_plant.description: Grimoire magic: Plant Magic. Hold your grimoire to cast. Four-leaf and five-leaf grimoires cast stronger and cheaper.

nusmp.skill.grimoire_dream.description: Grimoire magic: Dream Magic. Hold your grimoire to cast. Four-leaf and five-leaf grimoires cast stronger and cheaper.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_anti_magic.descript: Grimoire magic: Anti-Magic. Hold your grimoire to cast. Every page is paid in Tensura aura, not in magicules.
nusmp.skill.page_chrono_stasis.descripti: The page does not ask. It folds the seconds in front of you into a single held breath, and the one you chose is caught inside it: no step, no swing, no fall. Strike them as often as you like; every wound waits politely until their time resumes, and then it arrives all at once.
nusmp.skill.page_chrono_stasis_grigora.d: You stop asking the clock for single seconds and take the whole room. Inside the circle, arrows hang, hearts stall, and even falling gravel forgets which way is down. Only you still move. Hold your breath while casting to spare your companions. Every heartbeat the circle stands, the world collects its debt in magicule.
nusmp.skill.page_time_acceleration.descr: Your own clock runs ahead of everyone else's. Your feet land before the ground expects them and your blade arrives before the guard does. Arrows that come for you wade through honey, while you live a few heartbeats in the future.
nusmp.skill.page_time_reversal.descripti: Stone remembers being whole. You remind it. Walls broken in the last minute climb back into place, and wounded golems forget their wounds. The page refuses one thing: what has died stays dead. That kind of reversal is written on a page you should never find.
nusmp.skill.page_stolen_time.description: A slash that does not cut flesh so much as years. Those it touches wither, slow and grow brittle as their armor ages a lifetime in a breath. Time is never created, only moved; for a moment afterward, your own arms feel the theft.
nusmp.skill.page_time_hourglass_step.des: Fold a few paces out of the present and emerge farther along your line of sight, if the space is clear.
nusmp.skill.page_time_future_sight.descr: Borrow a brief glimpse of the next few seconds: your movement, work and strikes all quicken.
nusmp.skill.page_time_pendulum_ward.desc: A moving clock field drags hostile projectiles down and slows nearby enemies while you remain at its heart.
nusmp.skill.page_time_age_breaker.descri: A narrow time-shear races forward, wounding and slowing every foe it crosses.
nusmp.skill.page_time_moment_reprise.des: Return a nearby allied group to a healthier moment, restoring vitality and clearing fire and harmful effects.
nusmp.skill.page_time_hourglass_storm.de: Five golden strikes fall in sequence around the aimed point, damaging and slowing foes caught in each impact.
nusmp.skill.book_time.description: A grimoire that keeps its own clock. Its pages stop a single foe, still a small circle of the world, quicken your steps, mend broken stone and steal a moment back - and every one of them sends the bill in magicule. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Passive, Time Sense: enemy projectiles that close in are caught in a small stasis bubble and slowed, and part of every wound is rewound three seconds later.
nusmp.page.book_time.chrono_stasis: The page does not ask. It folds the seconds in front of one enemy into a single held breath: no step, no swing, no fall. Strike hard enough and the moment cracks open early.
nusmp.page.book_time.grigora: You stop asking for single seconds and take a small circle of the world. Arrows hang, hearts stall, and gravel forgets which way is down - but you must stand still to hold it.
nusmp.page.book_time.acceleration: Your own clock runs a little ahead of everyone else's. Not much. Enough that your feet land before the ground expects them.
nusmp.page.book_time.reversal: Stone remembers being whole, and you remind it. A handful of broken blocks climb back into place. What has died stays dead; that page is not written here.
nusmp.page.book_time.stolen_time: A cut that takes a moment from the enemy - and time is never created, only moved. For as long as they stumble, so do you.
nusmp.page.book_time.chrono_anastasis: A clock face as wide as the battlefield opens overhead and its hands run backwards. Broken stone climbs back into place, your allies' wounds close, and spells still in the air are uncast. The dead stay dead.
nusmp.page.book_time.hourglass_step: Fold a few paces out of the present and emerge farther along your line of sight, if the space is clear.
nusmp.page.book_time.future_sight: Borrow a brief glimpse of the next few seconds: your movement, work and strikes all quicken.
nusmp.page.book_time.pendulum_ward: A moving clock field drags hostile projectiles down and slows nearby enemies while you remain at its heart.
nusmp.page.book_time.age_breaker: A narrow time-shear races forward, wounding and slowing every foe it crosses.
nusmp.page.book_time.moment_reprise: Return a nearby allied group to a healthier moment, restoring vitality and clearing fire and harmful effects.
nusmp.page.book_time.hourglass_storm: Five golden strikes fall in sequence around the aimed point, damaging and slowing foes caught in each impact.
nusmp.skill.book_fire.description: A grimoire that runs hot to the touch. Its pages throw exploding fire, spear a line of enemies and raise pillars of flame - and if a Fire Spirit Lord has sworn to you, Salamander may answer. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_water.description: A grimoire that never quite dries. Its pages call the Sea Dragon to strike, to hunt and to cradle your allies - and those bound to a Water Spirit Lord may hear Undine sing. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_wind.description: A grimoire whose pages turn on their own. It cuts with crescents of air, opens lanes of gale and, at its height, raises a storm around you - Sylph listens to those a Wind Spirit Lord has chosen. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_earth.description: A heavy grimoire that smells of rain on stone. It raises spikes and walls, splits the ground beneath your enemies, wakes a Clay Guardian, swallows a foe in a sinkhole and forges the Gnome Plate over you - and Gnome stirs for those an Earth Spirit Lord has claimed. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_light.description: The grimoire of Light Magic after the Black Clover wiki: golden-white light, the fastest magic there is. Swords of light thrown at light speed, a whip, a lance of light that splits the sky, a column and a rain of arrows from the heavens, the blinding Lamp of Avior, a healing sphere and the giant Absolute Monarch of Divine Brilliance. Light ignores armour and cuts the spirit; only an Aura barrier holds it back. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_dark.description: A grimoire that drinks the lantern light. It cuts with cloaked darkness, opens a hungry hole in the world, and at its finest slices through dimensions themselves. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_spatial.description: A grimoire that is a little larger inside. It plucks what flies at you out of the air, and opens paired gates that make distance a suggestion. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_lightning.description: A grimoire that crackles when it opens. Its lightning jumps from foe to foe, and its boots carry you forward with a charge saved for your next blow. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_steel.description: A grimoire bound in iron. It fires molten-bright steel and throws a lance that always comes home. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_mirror.description: Gauche's grimoire. Real ornate mirrors you summon out of violet mana: they catch spells and turn them back, shatter in place of a killing blow, carry you from glass to glass, and let living Real Doubles step out of them. Its power grows with your EP and armour. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_thread.description: A grimoire stitched with red thread. It binds the one you choose - and a small red cat called Rouge watches the thread of your life for one day at a time. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_plant.description: A grimoire that blooms when nobody is looking. It guides healing like a flower guidepost, opens a dream world of a hundred flowers where friends mend and foes stumble, and calls blooms, a flower sprite, an ivy wall, a petal storm and a blossom armour. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_sealing.description: A grimoire with a clasp that never quite opens for strangers. It seals other grimoires shut and closes wounds the wrong way for your enemies. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_gravity.description: A grimoire too heavy to lift without magic. It slams a single foe into the ground and spreads the presence of a demon king around you - which weighs on you too. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_ice.description: A grimoire cold enough to frost your fingers. It stops whatever it touches, then shatters it. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_mercury.description: Nozel Silva's attribute: liquid metal, dense and able to take any shape - blades that float, spears that fall like rain, an eagle that carries you through the air, a cage that closes on your foes. Cast the Silver Guardian and the mercury coats you: chrome plates, a pair of eagle wings, a ripple of silver over your skin. It is poisonous, and weak against fire. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_fire.exploding_fireball: The first page every fire mage learns, and the last thing many enemies see. It flies, it lands, it blooms into flame.
nusmp.page.book_fire.sol_linea: A spear of spiraling sunfire that does not stop at the first body in its way. Nor the second.
nusmp.page.book_fire.calderos: Five circles bloom on the ground in the shape of a cross. A heartbeat later, they become pillars of fire.
nusmp.page.book_fire.leo_rugiens: The page roars before you do. A lion of living flame, big enough to ride, bounds from your side and runs your enemies down, then opens its jaws where it lands. (Fuegoleon and Leopold Vermillion's grimoires only.)
nusmp.page.book_water.waterball: A small sea dragon coils in your palm and leaves it hungry. It douses flames and knocks the breath out of whatever it hits.
nusmp.page.book_water.roar: The Sea Dragon wakes. It finds its prey on its own, and when it arrives the ground shakes with it.
nusmp.page.book_water.cradle: The water folds around you and those beside you. Inside, wounds close slowly and arrows forget how to fly.
nusmp.page.book_wind.kamaitachi: A crescent of wind sharp enough to cut through a line of enemies and lift them off their feet.
nusmp.page.book_wind.gust_lane: You open a corridor of gale. Enemies are thrown down it, arrows are torn apart in it, and your friends run faster through it.
nusmp.page.book_wind.spirit_storm: A storm wakes around you and refuses to let go of anything nearby. It lifts, it spins, it does not care who stands in it.
nusmp.page.book_earth.spike_line: Stone spears break the ground one after another, racing away from you like a crack in ice.
nusmp.page.book_earth.wall: Mud Wall Partition - the ground stands up to defend you. It remembers to lie back down eight seconds later.
nusmp.page.book_earth.mother_earth_split: Divided Mother Earth - the earth opens in a long scar. Those standing on it are wounded, and the ground holds their feet a moment longer.
nusmp.page.book_light.judgment: Light Sword of Judgment (審判の光剣, Shinpan no Kōken) - 4 to 8 shards of light with four lines running through each rise beside you and are thrown one after another at light speed, each ending in a golden-white cross-slash. 5 light damage each (more with EP); light ignores armour and cuts the spirit, only an Aura barrier halves it. Patolli's spell, copied by Rhya.
nusmp.page.book_light.divine_punishment: Light Shaft of Divine Punishment (神罰の光芒, Shinbatsu no Kōbō) - a ring of light marks the ground under the foe you look at (it follows the foe), then a giant column of light falls from the sky and pulses three times, hurting and lifting everything in it. Radius 2.6 to 4 blocks by EP. Patolli's strongest light spell.
nusmp.page.book_dark.avidya_slash: Dark Cloaked Avidya Slash - a flying wave of darkness, sharp as a blade, that swallows spells in mid-flight.
nusmp.page.book_dark.black_hole: Black Hole - a small black hole that swallows spells within 5 m and briefly paralyses whoever cast them.
nusmp.page.book_dark.dimension_slash: Dark Cloaked Dimension Slash - a downward slash of darkness that flies out and cuts mana, space and spells.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.domination: Sacred Mana Domination - the nearest enemy spell is erased from space, or else the target is pulled to you.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.fallen_angel_gat: Two gates, one hallway. Open the first, then the second, and for twenty seconds the distance between them is gone.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.chain: A bolt that refuses to stop at one. It leaps to the next foe, and the next.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunder_boots: Lightning in your heels: you are simply somewhere else, and the next thing you strike remembers the thunder.
nusmp.page.book_steel.steel_shot: Three bolts of white-hot steel, fired before you finish the word.
nusmp.page.book_steel.returning_lance: A lance thrown through everything in its path - and then, because it is yours, it comes back the same way.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.reflect_refrain: Reflect Refrain - a real mirror hangs before you for 4 s, catching 2-4 shots (by power), sending them back and jamming their casters' magic.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.real_double: Real Double - 1-3 living mirror doubles (by power) step out of mirrors, each costing a tenth of your max magicules, for 60 s. They wear your mirrored face, fight beside you, echo every spell you cast and draw enemies off you; a third of the blows aimed at you hit a double. Sneak-cast to trade places with the nearest one.
nusmp.page.book_thread.red_thread: A red thread ties the one you choose in place. It is thin. It does not break.
nusmp.page.book_thread.rouge: Red Thread of Fate: Rouge - a cat woven of red thread sits on your head for a day. If your thread is cut she ties it back to where you stood a few seconds before, and now and then she unravels to pull you out of a blow.
nusmp.page.book_plant.guidepost: Flowers bloom along a path from you to the one you look at (or to yourself) and their light mends what it touches: 20 percent of the maximum health.
nusmp.page.book_plant.hundred_flowers: A dream world of a hundred flowers opens round you for 8 seconds: friends rest in it and mend; enemies are tangled and cut by thorns.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal: A seal presses itself onto your target. A mage finds their grimoire shut; a monster finds its wounds closing the wrong way.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.grand_seal: Every enemy around you is sealed at once.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.heavy_infighting: One blow, and the ground rises to meet your enemy - then gravity forgets to let them go for a moment.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.demon_king: The weight of a demon king settles over everything near you. Your enemies sink and stagger - and so, a little, do you.
nusmp.page.book_ice.frost_lance: A lance of ice that slows what it pierces and leaves frost in the wound.
nusmp.page.book_ice.ice_prison: The target is sealed in ice. When it breaks, it breaks loudly.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_blade: Silver Blade - three double-edged blades of liquid mercury pour from your hand, hang in the air and fly at the target one after the other, hardening mid-flight. Mercury scales hard with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.mercury_shield: Silver Guardian - the mercury coats your whole body. The silver armour forges on and stays until you cast the page again, your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die; a fifth of every blow is turned aside, and the poison costs you half a hit point a second, never below six. The cast also raises a dome for eight seconds: shots sink into it, blows land at half strength (fire melts through); when it ends the dome flows back into spears and hurls them at everything near.
item.nusmp.communication_magic_device.de: Right-click another device holder to link. Start a chat message with % to speak through it.
item.nusmp.mana_method_rune_stone.desc: Use in the air to store your last grimoire page, then use on the ground to arm it as a 5-minute trap.
item.nusmp.spirit_charm.desc: First Spirit Dive: consumed when the spirit chooses you. At 100 Trust, rename a charm at an anvil (its True Name) and sneak-use it to incarnate your spirit. After that, sneak-use to call or dismiss it. Without a Black Clover bond it calls a Tensura-style spirit instead, a small floating orb: use to pick the element, sneak-use to call it.
item.nusmp.bond_thread.desc: Sneak-use on another player; if they do the same within 10 s, a red thread binds you. Heart grimoires become two hearts.
item.nusmp.fortune_die.desc: Roll it with a single-diamond grimoire: Good Fortune, or great misfortune.
item.nusmp.grimoire_chain.desc: While you carry it, nobody else can pick up your grimoire.
item.nusmp.anti_bird_charm.desc: A small black bird keeps you company. It does nothing useful at all.
item.nusmp.recovery_salve.desc: Heals a cracked heart or cracked diamond cover once, and clears a misfortune mark.
item.nusmp.written_consent.desc: Hold it to allow forbidden magic (such as Time Reversal on the Living) to be cast on you.
item.nusmp.devil_contract.desc: Signed in blood, forever binding, one at a time: the old bargain with a devil, or a Contract of Blood, Riches, Knowledge or Power. Whoever signs is Damned: death takes the soul into a crystal.
nusmp.skill.book_sword.description: Every page is an edge. Throw a flying blade, rain a thousand swords on one spot, or let a domain of blades circle you and cut whatever comes close. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_explosion.description: Magic that does not ask politely. Burst shots, chained detonations and, when you are ready to be very loud, a grand explosion. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_magma.description: The earth's blood in your hands. Magma bullets that set foes alight, a pool of molten rock, and an eruption that splits the ground. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_mist.description: You are never quite where they think. Blinding veils, a step through the fog, and a prison of mist that swallows sight. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_star.description: Small stars that do not miss. Star shots, a starfall, and a constellation that hunts down everyone it can see. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_storm.description: The old Storm grimoire, kept for old saves and the Kaiser Granvorka captain book: a storm lance, a ring of tempest, the eye of the storm. Storm Magic itself is a Fairy Tail magic: it belongs to the Stormcaller Staff and is no longer rolled for a soul (server config storm.staffOnly).
nusmp.skill.book_sand.description: The desert at your call. Sand spears, a blinding sandstorm and a quicksand tomb that holds your enemy in place. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_shadow.description: Darkness's quieter sibling. Step from one shadow to the one behind your enemy, bind them, then drown the area in shadow. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_poison.description: Patience, in liquid form. Venom bolts, a toxic cloud and a plague nova that eats away at everything near you. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_reinforcement.descripti: Mana poured into your own body. Iron fists, a reinforced body that hits harder, and a full-body reinforcement that makes you a weapon. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_beast.description: The beast inside answers. Charge, roar, and finally take on a beast's form. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_bone.description: The grimoire of Bone Magic after the Black Clover wiki: the user grows and shapes their own bones. Bone Bullets from the palm, countless Eternal Fangs pushed out of the body, the Demon Sword Dainsleif coated in Spatial Magic and the flying slashes of Spatial Rupture, besides Bone Armor, Rib Cage and Bone Rain. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_blood.description: Every spell costs you a little of yourself - and takes back more. Blood bullets, crimson rain and a blood pact. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_creation.description: Magic given shape. A created blade, a created wall, and an arsenal of weapons orbiting you. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_copy.description: You learn by being hit. Echo a bolt, or copy the last grimoire page that struck you in the last 20 seconds. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_illusion.description: Nothing here is real, and that is the danger. Phantom strikes, a decoy that steals your enemies' attention, and a mass illusion. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_dream.description: Dorothy Unsworth's magic. Dream World and Glamour World pull your foes out of reality into a dream dimension that is yours: say a thing inside it and it becomes real; the dream wears their minds down until they break. They escape only by breaking it from within (heavy damage, or Spatial, Time, Anti-Magic or a rival Dream mage) or by outlasting it. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_anti_magic.description: The magic that is not magic. It costs no mana: every page is paid in Tensura aura (2% to 15% of your maximum aura, shown on Tensura's own aura bar), and if the aura is short the page fails with "Not enough aura". It cuts spells out of the air and strips enemies of their protections. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.forbidden_magic.description: Pages written in blood by a devil. Every spell has a price, every price stacks, and everyone nearby knows what you did. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.devil_dive: The devil slides into your skin for eight seconds. Your spells cut a little deeper; your body pays every second.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.five_leaf_whi: Blank until a devil is bound. Then it is the devil's own spell, written in its own hand.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.life_exchange: Their wounds become yours - and you carry them worse than they did.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.reversal_livi: A consenting ally steps back four seconds into a healthier past. A sliver of your life stays behind as payment.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.underworld_ga: A rift opens for five seconds. The dead nearby are pulled toward it; the living inside are touched by darkness.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.mana_devour: Everything inside the circle starves - including you.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.curse_misfort: Misfortune, delivered by hand. A Diamond grimoire cracks under it; anyone else simply becomes unlucky.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.reincarnation: You write your soul into this place. Die within three days and you will return here - lighter by a page and some mana.
nusmp.page.book_sword.flying_blade: Origin Flash - a sword appears in your hand; one swing releases a giant slash that cuts everything in its path.
nusmp.page.book_sword.thousand_swords: Origin Flash Barrage - five giant slashes released at once, fanned out.
nusmp.page.book_sword.blade_domain: Demon-Dweller Sword: Conquering Eon - the sword drinks your allies' magic: one devastating slash that grows with every ally near you, and heals you.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.burst_shot: Burst Shot: a page of Explosion Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.chain_detonati: Chain Detonation: a page of Explosion Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.grand_explosio: Grand Explosion: a page of Explosion Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.heat_sphere: Heat Sphere: a page of Explosion Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_magma.magma_bullet: Magma Bullet: a page of Magma Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_magma.magma_pool: Magma Pool: a page of Magma Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_magma.eruption: Eruption: a page of Magma Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_mist.mist_veil: Mist Veil: a page of Mist Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_mist.mist_step: Mist Step: a page of Mist Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_mist.mist_prison: Mist Prison: a page of Mist Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_mist.steam_ball: Steam Ball: a page of Mist Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_star.star_shot: Star Shot: a page of Star Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_star.starfall: Starfall: a page of Star Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_star.constellation: Constellation: a page of Star Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_storm.storm_lance: Storm Lance: a page of Storm Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_storm.tempest_ring: Tempest Ring: a page of Storm Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_storm.eye_of_the_storm: Eye of the Storm: a page of Storm Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_storm.thunder_sphere: Thunder Sphere: a page of Storm Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_sand.sand_spear: Sand Spear: a page of Sand Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_sand.sandstorm: Sandstorm: a page of Sand Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_sand.quicksand_tomb: Quicksand Tomb: a page of Sand Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.shadow_step: Dark Garden Invitation - you sink into your shadow and rise from the shadow where you aim; allies at your side come along.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.shadow_bind: Kids' Playground - shadow hands rise round the place you aim and hold everything there.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.shadow_realm: Shadow Realm - the ground becomes shadow; foes in it are blind and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_poison.venom_bolt: Aufwachen Dachs - a badger of poison lunges at the foe.
nusmp.page.book_poison.toxic_cloud: Violett Schirm - a curtain of poison hangs in front of you; spells that cross it melt, foes that touch it sicken.
nusmp.page.book_poison.plague_nova: Basilisk's Breath - a cone of venom mist: burning poison and withering.
nusmp.page.book_poison.acid_ball: Acid Ball: a page of Poison Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.iron_fist: Iron Fist: a page of Reinforcement Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.mana_reinf: Mana Reinforcement: a page of Reinforcement Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.full_body: Full Body Reinforcement: a page of Reinforcement Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_beast.beast_charge: Beast Charge: a page of Beast Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_beast.lions_roar: Lion's Roar: a page of Beast Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_beast.beast_form: Beast Form: a page of Beast Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_spear: Bone Bullets (骨弾, Kotsudan) - 3 to 5 sharp bone fragments are fired one after another from a hole in your palm, spinning to bore through armour (half of it is ignored). Lucius Zogratis' Bone Magic. Replaces the Bone Spear.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_armor: Bone Armor (骨の鎧, Hone no Yoroi) - your bones grow into a shell that soaks damage (absorption) and bites back. Kept from the old book; Zenon's bones block nearly every blow.
nusmp.page.book_bone.ossuary: Eternal Fangs (無間骨牙, Mugen Kotsuga) - 16 to 24 countless bones are pushed out of your body in every direction, in three waves, too fast and too many to dodge: 9 blocks, three hits each, half the armour ignored, walls stop them. Zenon Zogratis' great spell. Replaces the Ossuary.
nusmp.page.book_blood.blood_bullet: Blood Bullet: a page of Blood Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_blood.crimson_rain: Crimson Rain: a page of Blood Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_blood.blood_pact: Blood Pact: a page of Blood Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_blade: Creation: Blade: a page of Creation Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_wall: Creation: Wall: a page of Creation Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_creation.arsenal: Creation: Arsenal: a page of Creation Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_copy.echo_bolt: Echo Bolt: a page of Copy Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_copy.copy: Copy: a page of Copy Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.phantom_strike: Phantom Strike: a page of Illusion Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.decoy: Decoy: a page of Illusion Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.mass_illusion: Mass Illusion: a page of Illusion Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_dream.dream_haze: Dream Haze: a page of Dream Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_dream.sweet_dream: Sweet Dream: a page of Dream Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_dream.dream_world: Dream World - pull the nearest two foes (8 blocks) into a small dream for 15 seconds. Inside, speak a thing (bear, feast, fire, ice, cage, stars, wall, sleep) and it becomes real.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.demon_slayer_: Demon-Dweller Sword: Black Slash - a flying anti-magic slash that cuts spells out of its path and knocks its target back. Costs 2% of your aura.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_divider: Demon-Slayer Sword: Black Divider - the flat of the blade bats spells back, then a huge sweep of condensed anti-magic strips magic from all it hits. Costs 4% of your aura.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_meteori: Black Meteorite - coated in anti-magic, you charge the target and cut; spells in the way are cut too. Costs 6% of your aura.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_hurrica: Black Hurricane - you spin, drawn toward the magic around you, and every spell and trap nearby is nullified. Costs 6% of your aura.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_form: Black Asta - anti-magic courses through your body: far stronger and faster, magic near you erodes. Costs 12% of your aura; twice a day, a third time costs you. Once you have become the Anti-Magic Lord this page is Black Form: a held state that costs 3% of your aura to enter and 1.5% of your maximum aura every second, ends with a message when the aura runs out, and ends at once when you cast it again.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunder_lance: A lance of thunder, hurled true and straight.
nusmp.page.book_dark.death_thrust: Death Thrust - with Black Moon up, the whole zone is crushed into one thrust. Without it, it is only a thrust.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.space_cut: A blade of folded space. Distance offers no protection from it.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.gravity_sphere: Gravity Sphere - a singularity orb flies from your hand: 11 x EP scale damage, a heavy slow and a pull down on what it hits, and a crush where it ends.
nusmp.page.book_steel.obsidian_shot: A cannonball of hardened steel, fired hard enough to knock giants back.
nusmp.page.book_earth.boulder_shot: The ground tears loose a boulder and throws it for you.
nusmp.skill.anti_magic_spirit_lord.descr: You have no mana, and so magic has no hold on you. Your body runs on Tensura aura. Toggle Black Form to let it pour out: magic cannot touch you, your blade cuts deeper, and the form drains your aura every second until you end it or the aura runs dry. Anti-Magic Power is still gathered from every spell that strikes you, but it is only a record now; it pays for nothing.
nusmp.page.book_fire.spirit_channeling: Press once to release a Spirit Nova that damages and pushes away nearby foes.
nusmp.page.book_water.spirit_channeling: Press once to release a Spirit Nova that damages and pushes away nearby foes.
nusmp.page.book_wind.spirit_channeling: Press once to release a Spirit Nova that damages and pushes away nearby foes.
nusmp.page.book_earth.spirit_channeling: Press once to release a Spirit Nova that damages and pushes away nearby foes.
item.nusmp.magic_key.tooltip: A physical key storing stolen magic. Consumed to open extra gates with Janus Abigail.
nusmp.skill.spirit_lord.description: A spirit lord has bound itself to you - no grimoire needed. Press Spirit Burst once for an immediate Nova. Your body takes less from physical blows and falls cannot hurt you. Earn your spirit's full trust, give it a True Name, and call it to your side.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.bull_thrust: Bull Thrust - swords pointed ahead, you hurl yourself forward; every spell in front is dispelled on contact. Costs 3% of your aura.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.infinite_slas: Demon-Slasher Katana: Infinite Slash - a large anti-magic slash from overhead that cuts a 24-block line. Costs 5% of your aura.
Demon-Slasher Katana: Infinite Slash Equinox - a massive slash that travels very far and never harms your allies. Costs 15% of your aura.
nusmp.page.book_sword.summon_demon_dwell: Sword Magic: draw Licht's white Demon-Dweller Sword from your grimoire for a minute.
nusmp.page.book_sword.summon_demon_destr: Sword Magic: draw Licht's white Demon-Destroyer Sword from your grimoire for a minute.
nusmp.page.book_dark.black_blade: Dark Cloaked Black Blade - darkness coats the sword and forms a longer blade: more reach and bite for 30 s.
nusmp.page.book_dark.avidya_wild_slash: Dark Cloaked Avidya Wild Slash - swing wildly: a spray of Avidya Slashes.
nusmp.page.book_dark.black_moon: Dark Cloaked Black Moon - Mana Zone: a black hole overhead swallows every enemy spell nearby for 10 s; allies' spells pass.
nusmp.page.book_dark.iai_slash: Dark Cloaked Iai Slash - the blade is drawn and you cut through the nearest foe. Deeper under Black Moon.
nusmp.page.book_dark.dimension_slash_equ: Dark Cloaked Dimension Slash: Equinox - with Mana Zone, the Dimension Slash reaches enormously far. (Yami Sukehiro's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_fire.spiral_flame: Spiral Flame - a vortex of flame drills forward, piercing and burning everything in its path, then bursts where it ends.
nusmp.page.book_fire.wild_bursting_flame: Wild Bursting Flame - flame bursts out of you in every direction, three waves, each one throwing your enemies back.
nusmp.page.book_fire.ignis_columna: Ignis Columna - a towering column of flame erupts where you aim and keeps burning, lifting whatever stands inside it.
nusmp.page.book_water.aqua_javelin: Aqua Javelin - a lance of high-pressure water, dense enough to pierce a whole line of enemies.
nusmp.page.book_water.sea_dragons_nest: Sea Dragon's Nest - a dome of whirling water rises over you: enemy spells inside are swallowed, foes are slowed and battered, allies heal.
nusmp.page.book_water.valkyrie_dress: Valkyrie Dress - Noelle's water becomes armour: pearl-white plate with a gold border, a halo and great wings of water feathers. In Noelle Silva's grimoire it is the Saint Valkyrie Dress: a second pair of wings, the aureole, a gold sash and a hovering lance of water. Cast it and the armour forges on; it stays until you cast the page again, your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die. While it is on you are faster, harder to hurt and hit harder. The cast also gives thirty seconds of Speed, Strength, Resistance and Jump. A little mana is paid every second.
nusmp.page.book_earth.witch_hunter_claws: Witch Hunter Claws - stone claws burst out of the ground round your target and clamp shut, crushing it and holding it in place.
nusmp.page.book_earth.rampaging_mother_e: Rampaging Mother Earth - the ground heaves in a rolling wave that tears eighteen blocks ahead, throwing everything in its way into the air.
nusmp.page.book_wind.towering_tornado: Towering Tornado - a huge tornado where you aim: it drags enemies in and up, shreds them and swallows their spells.
nusmp.page.book_wind.slicing_wind_empero: Slicing Wind Emperor - a vast crescent made of countless wind blades sweeps far ahead, cutting spells and everything else in its path.
nusmp.page.book_wind.spirit_of_zephyr: Spirit of Zephyr - the wind spirit wraps you for thirty seconds: very fast, light as air, and enemy spells are blown away before they reach you. (Yuno's grimoire only.)
nusmp.skill.book_transmutation.descripti: Grey's attribute: take a substance apart and put it back together as something else - ground into iron spikes, ground into sand, an enemy's spell into your own mana and a bed of flowers, a blessing into its curse. Cast it and the Alchemist's Gilded Plate forges over you: brass and iron engraved with glowing circles, a great circle turning behind your back. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_ash.description: A grimoire of Ash Magic, the cursed ash of Zora Ideale's Fire-derived magic. Bullets of ash that blind, a cloud to vanish in that leaves a trap behind, a ring of cursed ash that drinks the mana of whoever stands in it, the Revelation of the Cowardly whose traps spring on whoever strikes you, a shroud of charcoal and ash trees forged piece by piece, soldiers of ash and a curse on one foe. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_cotton.description: Charmy Pappitson's grimoire of two halves. When it binds it leans to Cotton (sheep that cook, bind and carry) or to Food (a glutton's maw that eats magic and turns it into your mana). Charmy's own book holds both. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_recombination.descripti: Henry Legolant's attribute: the magic house, and the town around it, is taken apart and put back together at your call - walls, swapped rooms, a drill of brick and mana, and the Raging Black Bull, a giant built of houses with tower horns and brick fists. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
item.nusmp.gauches_hand_mirror.desc: Sneak-use to leave a mirror where you stand; use it to step back through that mirror from anywhere in the same world (30 s cooldown).
nusmp.page.book_thread.arachnes_web: Arachne's Web - a web of thread spreads where you aim; everything caught in it is held fast and slowly cut.
nusmp.page.book_thread.dancing_doll: Dancing Doll - puppet threads take a foe: for three seconds it walks where you look, and a monster turns on its own side.
nusmp.page.book_thread.thread_mending: Thread Magic: Mending - you sew wounds shut: you and the allies near you heal, poison and withering are drawn out.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.sealing_chains: Seal Magic: Sealing Chains - rune chains bind one foe. It cannot move, and a mage cannot open their grimoire.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.trinity_seal: Trinity Seal Magic - three seals close on the foe and crystallise its mana: a third of it is gone, and it is sealed and weakened.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal_barrier: Seal Magic: Barrier - seal chains ring you for eight seconds; enemy spells that reach them are sealed away, allies inside are harder to hurt.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunder_fiend: Thunder Fiend - lightning wreathes your body. The lightning armour forges on and stays until you cast the page again (or Black Lightning Battle Fiend, or Raging Lightning), your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die. While it is on lightning cannot hurt you and you are faster and hit harder; the cast gives thirty seconds of very high speed and every blow arcs to a second foe. A little mana is paid every second. (Luck Voltia's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_lightning.pulsaranta: Pulsaranta - three balls of lightning that hunt the target and burst.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.rising_salim: God of Lightning Rising Salim - a pillar of lightning crashes down where you aim and throws everything up.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunderbird_ca: Thunderbird Cavalry: Sky-Splitting Magic Bow Armament - a volley of lightning arrows that seek their marks.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.black_lightnin: Black Lightning Battle Fiend - black lightning: the black armour forges on (it stays like Thunder Fiend's), the cast gives thirty seconds of higher speed and strength, and every blow arcs to two more foes. (Luck Voltia's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_spatial.unopening_red_ro: Unopening Red Room - the foe is shut in a room of folded space; walking out of it walks back in.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.myriad_black: Myriad Black - space is cut over and over in front of you.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.door_of_fate: Door of Fate - a dimensional gate opens beside you; three seconds later you and the allies by you step through to your spawn point.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.reflect_ray: Reflect Ray - a mirror opens and looses 3-5 rays of reflected light (by power) that wound the spirit; your doubles fire with you.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.large_reflect_ray: Large Reflect Ray - a great mirror and a great ray.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.full_reflection: Full Reflection - for 8 s a great mirror stands before you and follows you, turning back every shot and returning 60% of every blow to whoever struck.
nusmp.page.book_fire.calidos_brachium: Calidos Brachium - arms of flame smash everything in front of you. (Mereoleona Vermillion's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_plant.yggdrasil: World Tree Magic: Yggdrasil - a great tree of mana: allies heal and regenerate, foes are held by its roots. (William Vangeance's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_plant.briar_prison: Briar Magic: Briar Prison - a prison of thorny briars grows round the place you aim. (Charlotte Roselei's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_mercury.mercury_rain: Silver Rain - a cloud of mercury overhead lets fall a storm of needle-fine spears where you aim, and a pool of silver spreads below. (Nozel Silva)
nusmp.page.book_shadow.heavens_shadow_se: Heaven's Shadow Second Sight - every shadow is your eye: all living things within 32 blocks show through walls.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.unite_canis: Unite Mode: Canis - united with the dog devil: fast and relentless. (Nacht Faust's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_shadow.unite_gallus: Unite Mode: Gallus - united with the bird devil: leaping and gliding. (Nacht Faust's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_shadow.unite_canis_felis: Unite Mode: Canis x Felis - two devils at once: fast, strong and hard to hurt. (Nacht Faust's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_poison.curse_workers_nei: Curse-Worker's Neighbor - curses reworked: your side is cleansed, and the curses fall on your foes. (Gordon Agrippa's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_sword.ripper_cut: Slash Magic: Ripper Cut - blades on every limb, a storm of cuts in front of you. (Jack the Ripper's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_creation.painted_menager: Painting Magic: Painted Menagerie - painted beasts leap off the canvas and fight for you for thirty seconds. (Rill Boismortier's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_dream.glamour_world: Glamour World - a multi-hued mist drags up to eight foes (12 blocks) into your great dream for 30 seconds: a pastel world under an iridescent dome where your words become solid. Their dream load climbs until their minds break. (Dorothy Unsworth's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_storm.vortex_shield: Vortex Magic: Vortex Shield - the Kingdom's Ultimate Shield: a vortex wall round you that turns spells aside and pushes foes away. (Kaiser Granvorka's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.iron_spike: Transmutation: Iron Spikes - the ground ahead is turned to iron and thrust up in a line of spikes, each cutting and weakening what stands on it. The line is longer for a bigger spell; damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.magic_conv: Magic Convert - a transmutation circle in front of you for two seconds; every enemy shot that touches it bursts into flowers and becomes your mana (and a little Absorption).
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.quagmire: Transmutation: Quagmire - the ground where you aim turns to sand for five seconds; everything in it sinks, slows and is dragged down, with a little damage.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.grand_tran: Grand Transmutation - every blessing on the foes around you is turned into its curse and you take the blessings; the Alchemist's Gilded Plate forms for five seconds.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_bullets: Ash Bullets: a spray of six ash bullets, each hurting a little and blinding for a moment. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_cloud: Ash Cloud: you vanish in a cloud of ash for four seconds. Foes within five blocks are blinded and lose track of you, the cloud keeps blinding for three seconds, an ash trap stays armed under it for thirty seconds, and the ash shroud forms round you for five seconds.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_absorbing_format: Ash Absorbing Formation: a ring of cursed ash for eight seconds where you aim. It drinks three percent of the mana of every foe inside each second and pours it into you, withers them, and turns enemy shots to ash. Radius scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_ash.revelation_of_the_co: Revelation of the Cowardly: for thirty seconds the next three foes who strike you set off an ash trap (damage, blindness, wither, a glow), and everything hidden nearby glows. The ash shroud forms round you for five seconds.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.sleeping_sheep_st: Sleeping Sheep Strike - a cotton sheep bounds at the foe and puts it to sleep.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.sheep_cook: Sheep Cook - cotton sheep chefs cook for everyone near you: healing, filling, a lasting regeneration. (Cotton half.)
nusmp.page.book_cotton.sheep_bondage: Sheep Bondage - a cotton sheep wraps the foe in cotton and holds it. (Cotton half.)
nusmp.page.book_cotton.cotton_cloud: Cotton Cloud - cotton lifts you and your allies, then lets you float down. (Cotton half.)
nusmp.page.book_cotton.gourmets_bite: Gourmet's Bite - a mouthful of the foe's mana. (Food half.)
nusmp.page.book_cotton.gluttons_banquet: Glutton's Banquet - a giant maw eats every spell in front of you and bites the foes there, turning it all into your mana. (Food half.)
nusmp.page.book_recombination.mana_corks: Mana Corkscrew - a drill of compressed mana spirals out and bores through a line, pushing back everything it hits. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.bulwark: Recombination: Bulwark - the magic house folds a ring of walls round you for ten seconds, with a room standing at each corner, and you gain Absorption.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.room_swap: Recombination: Room Swap - two rooms change places: you and the target swap positions, a room rises at each place and the target is slowed for a second.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.raging_bla: The Raging Black Bull - the magic house rises out of the ground as a giant of stacked houses: a timber-framed belly, a chest of arched windows, roofs with a chimney and a small tree, two towers for horns, glowing eyes and fists of brick. It follows you, brings a fist down on the nearest foe and fires its cannons for a minute, and every step sends up a cloud of dust. It grows with your EP. (Henry Legolant's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_dream.imagination_manife: Imagination Manifestation - inside your own dream, the next thing you imagine becomes real at what you look at (a giant stuffed bear, a feast, a ring of fire, an ice prison, a bird cage, falling stars, a candy wall, a lullaby).
nusmp.skill.book_painting.description: Rill Boismortier's magic. Summoning the grimoire manifests a wooden palette (off hand) and a mana brush (main hand). Right-click the palette to change the paint (fire, water, ice, wind, earth, lightning or ink); sneak + right-click to answer the last element that hit you. Right-click the brush to paint with it (uses aura). What you paint comes to life, your mood feeds your imagination (joy boosts it, frustration stifles it), and your EP and gear make every painting stronger.
nusmp.page.book_painting.brushstroke: Brushstroke - fling a wet stroke in your current paint: it hurts, slows, carries the paint's element and leaves a sticky puddle where it lands.
nusmp.page.book_painting.spring_of_restr: Spring of Restriction - a spring of sticky paint wells up under the target and sets like lacquer, holding everything in it fast.
nusmp.page.book_painting.camouflage: Camouflage - paint yourself into the scenery: invisible for 15 seconds, until you strike.
nusmp.page.book_painting.souterrain_gian: Souterrain Giant's Strong Arm - a painted giant's arm bursts up from the ground and flings the target skyward.
nusmp.page.book_painting.deux_tempetes: Deux Tempêtes of Fire and Ice - two painted storms turn round you for five seconds: one burns, one freezes.
nusmp.page.book_painting.gods_game: God's Game - a painted world of your own rules for eight seconds: shots that reach you turn to paint, and you are hard to hurt.
nusmp.page.book_painting.elemental_quint: Elemental Quintet - five strokes of five elements at once (fire, water, wind, earth, lightning) on up to five foes.
nusmp.page.book_painting.master_of_valha: Master of Valhalla - a painted host of einherjar charges out ahead of you, cutting down everything in its path; four of them step off the canvas and stay to fight.
nusmp.page.book_painting.painted_menager: Painted Menagerie - three painted beasts leap off the canvas in your current paint and fight for you for thirty seconds. Their bites carry the paint's element. (Rill Boismortier)
nusmp.page.book_mirror.mirror_array: Mirror Array - 3-5 mirrors of every shape orbit you for 40 s. They catch enemy shots and send them back (jamming the shooter), and one shatters in place of any heavy or killing blow.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.mirror_step: Mirror Step - step into a mirror and out of another where you look, up to 32 blocks away.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.mirrors_slash: Mirrors Slash - blade-edged mirrors spin out in a wide arc in front of you, flying along their rays. The cut glass leaves your foes fragile.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.mirrors_meteorite: Mirrors Meteorite - a storm of blade-edged mirrors falls where you aim and bursts into blinding glare and razor glass.
nusmp.page.book_painting.living_illustra: Living Illustration - paint an einherjar on the ground before you (sneak: a giant); the drawing stands up as a solid, living construct of paint for thirty seconds. Up to three at once (four when you're happy).
nusmp.page.book_painting.counter_palette: Counter Palette - your paint turns into the element that answers the last one that hit you (water against fire, ice against water, fire against ice, earth against wind and lightning, wind against earth); for six seconds that element barely touches you.
item.nusmp.paint_brush.desc: Right-click: a sweep of your current paint (uses aura). Manifested by a Painting grimoire.
item.nusmp.paint_palette.desc: Right-click: change the paint. Sneak + right-click: answer the last element that hit you. Held, it softens the element its paint counters.
nusmp.page.book_light.healing_ray: Healing Ray of Light (癒やしの光粒, Iyashi no Kōryū) - a sphere of white light with a halo ring settles on the ally you look at (or you) and mends 5% of their health three times, burning away one affliction at the first pulse; allies within 3.5 blocks share half of it. Heals are capped by the healing law.
nusmp.page.book_light.lamp_of_avior: Lamp of Avior Gloria (アヴィオールの灯・栄光, Aviōru no Tomoshibi: Gloria) - a huge black-and-white manga-style burst of spikes swells over you for 1.3 seconds and goes off with a blinding flash over 14 blocks: heavy light damage that falls off with distance, blindness and a hard push, then a second weaker pulse. Lumiere's great spell.
nusmp.page.book_light.light_speed: Light Speed (光速移動, Kōsoku Idō) - become light and arrive up to 24 blocks ahead in an instant, cutting through what stands between. Uses aura. Kept from the old book: speed is the defining trait of Light Magic.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_eagle: Silver Eagle - a giant eagle of living mercury forms under you and carries you along your line of sight, cutting and scattering all it passes; you land where it dissolves. Its wingspan and bite grow with your EP.
nusmp.skill.book_world_tree.description: William Vangeance's magic: real trees grow at your word, from saplings to giant mega trees (bigger with your EP). Their roots bind foes, catch spells in mid-air and drink their mana, sharing it with you and your allies. The trees are taken back when the spell ends (a server setting can make them stay).
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.mistilteinn_s: Mistilteinn Seed - a seed of the world tree; where it strikes, roots burst out, bind the foe and drink its magicules into you, and a small tree takes root.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.root_bind: Root Bind - roots tear up under the foe you look at, hold it, drain it, then drag it toward you.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.magic_tree_de: Magic Tree Descent - a real great tree grows where you aim (fancy oak, then dark oak or mega spruce, then mega jungle as your EP grows) and stands for 20 seconds: its roots bind and drain foes around it, and what it drinks flows to you and your allies, who mend in its shade.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.budding_of_yg: Budding of Yggdrasil - a ring of real trees and great roots bursts up around you, with a giant tree in front: every foe inside is bound and drained for 5 seconds, and enemy shots are caught in mid-air.
nusmp.skill.book_dice.description: Dice whose power is the pips rolled. Elemental Dice rolls two etched d6 (fire, earth, water, wind, lightning, light); the Fate Die plays by D&D rules - a natural 1 fumbles and jams your magic, a natural 20 is a critical hit that ignores every resistance. Your EP is your modifier.
nusmp.page.book_dice.elemental_dice: Elemental Dice - roll 2d6: the higher face picks the element, the pips the power (sum / 7), and doubles resonate (x1.5).
nusmp.page.book_dice.fate_die: Fate Die - roll a d20 plus your modifier: under 10 the spell glances, higher it grows; a natural 1 is a critical fumble, a natural 20 a critical hit (maximum power, armour and resistances ignored, heavy spiritual damage).
nusmp.page.book_dice.gamblers_fallacy: Gambler's Fallacy - three d20s in a row on the same foe; every roll under 10 adds +3 to the next ones (it's due!). A natural 1 ends the streak.
nusmp.page.book_dice.loaded_dice: Loaded Dice - for 30 seconds every roll has advantage (roll twice, keep the higher) and a natural 1 is rerolled once.
nusmp.skill.book_slash.description: Jack the Ripper's magic: mana blades that can cut anything. Every cut on a defended foe reads its defence and marks it for good; ten marks and its armour, barriers and resistances no longer stop you.
nusmp.page.book_slash.slash_wave: Slash Wave - a jagged crescent of green mana flung from the forearm, cutting through everything in a line.
nusmp.page.book_slash.forearm_blades: Forearm Blades - the Ripper's armour forges on you for 20 seconds, a long green-edged blade along each forearm; every melee blow cuts harder and adapts. Held with aura.
nusmp.page.book_slash.ripper_dash: Ripper Dash - a burst of speed that carries you 10 blocks through your foes, cutting each one and leaving glass afterimages along the path. Uses aura.
nusmp.page.book_slash.death_scythe: Death Scythe - a vast scythe of slash magic reaps everything around you in one sweep.
nusmp.skill.book_compass.description: Letoile Becquerel's magic: brass compasses hover behind you. Their needles lock onto the strongest magicule signature in sight and follow it anywhere, and they can wrench enemy spells round onto a new heading.
nusmp.page.book_compass.useless_north: Useless North - the compasses turn to your target and loose needles that follow it wherever it goes.
nusmp.page.book_compass.willful_compass: Willful Compass - for 10 seconds the compasses wrench every incoming shot round and send it back at whoever fired it.
nusmp.page.book_compass.another_atlas: Another Atlas - chart a foe's magicule signature for 15 seconds: it glows, your needles always find it, and the array fires on it by itself.
nusmp.page.book_compass.compass_rose: Compass Rose - every needle swings at once: each foe within 20 blocks is locked and struck by two homing needles.
nusmp.skill.book_kotodama.description: Zagred's Word Soul: what you say becomes law. A God-class magic of astronomical magicule cost (Aura pays what magicules can't). Speak a command word alone in chat or cast its page. Creative only, or for one who has defeated Zagred.
nusmp.page.book_kotodama.halt: Halt - "Halt" / "Bind": everyone around you is paralysed in place and their magic jammed (Absolute Paralysis, Magic Jamming), their spirit struck.
nusmp.page.book_kotodama.shatter: Shatter - "Shatter" / "Return": every attack flying at you breaks apart and returns to magicules, a share of which flows back to you.
nusmp.page.book_kotodama.heal: Heal - "Heal": your health and Aura to full and every harmful effect gone, and your allies' nearby too.
nusmp.page.book_kotodama.underworld: Devour - "Devour" / "Underworld": underworld sludge floods out where you look, swallowing the ground; whoever wades in it is hurt, spiritually wounded and drained into you.
nusmp.page.book_kotodama.trident: Trident - "Trident": an otherworldly trident forms in your hand for 60 seconds: crushing blows that cut the spirit, and right-click hurls a void bolt.
nusmp.page.book_kotodama.demon_swords: Swords - "Swords": a storm of demon swords falls where you look, each blow cutting body and spirit.
item.nusmp.otherworld_trident.desc: Spoken into being by Kotodama. Right-click: hurl a void bolt. Fades after 60 s or if it leaves your hands.
gamerule.nusmpGodOfOrder: The God of Order may appear
gamerule.nusmpGodOfOrder.description: On by default. Off: the God of Order never appears (no visits, nothing is taken), a visit in progress ends, and /multiverse relic order summon refuses. The one-world list (/multiverse relic order unique ...) still decides what counts as a duplicate.
gamerule.nusmpZagredBoss.description: Lets an op summon the Zagred boss with /multiverse boss zagred (also on if zagredBossEnabled is on in the server config).
gamerule.nusmpKotodamaBossReward.descrip: Everyone who damaged the Zagred boss earns Kotodama Magic and its five-leaf grimoire.
gamerule.nusmpGriefBlocks.description: Grimoire explosions can break blocks, and Kotodama's sludge leaves the ground eaten.
gamerule.nusmpWorldTreeTreesStay.descrip: Trees grown by World Tree Magic are kept instead of being taken back.
gamerule.nusmpGodTierAffectsPlayers.desc: Instant Death, All Fiction and Hollow Purple can kill or erase players outright (otherwise players lose a share of max health).
gamerule.nusmpForbiddenStart.description: Five-leaf and triple-spade grimoires can be a starting roll.
gamerule.nusmpAnnounceThreeLeaf.descript: Tell the whole server when someone receives a three-leaf grimoire.
gamerule.nusmpGrimoireRolls.description: Players roll for a grimoire once they have a soul type (turning it off, or the config switch, stops new rolls).
gamerule.nusmpSkillEvolution.description: Mastered Unique skills evolve into their Ultimate automatically.
gamerule.nusmpAntiMagicEventOnly.descrip: Anti-Magic is never rolled; an op gives it with /multiverse event antimagic <player>. Turn off to let five-leaf rolls give it again.
gamerule.nusmpPvpHitCapPercent: PvP hit cap (% of max health)
gamerule.nusmpPvpHitCapPercent.descripti: The most one addon spell or weapon hit can take from a player, as a percent of their max health (default 40).
gamerule.nusmpSpellDamagePercent.descrip: Global damage factor for this addon's spells (default 100).
gamerule.nusmpSpellCooldownPercent.descr: Cooldown length for grimoire pages, magic weapons and Kotodama words (default 60 = 40% shorter than before 0.48).
%1$s was severed from existence by %2$s using %3$s
%1$s was severed from existence whilst fighting %2$s
nusmp.page.book_kotodama.seal: Seal - "Seal" / "Lock": every skill and spell of everyone around you is locked for a few seconds (forced cooldowns, Magic Jamming).
nusmp.page.book_kotodama.reject: Reject - "Reject" / "Dispel": every blessing on the foes around you is torn off and their barriers and spell constructs shatter.
nusmp.page.book_kotodama.fall: Fall - "Fall": everything flying around you is thrown to the ground, flight cut and a crushing burden laid on it.
nusmp.page.book_kotodama.reveal: Reveal - "Reveal": the hidden are dragged into the light for 20 seconds: glowing, invisibility gone, presence concealment off.
nusmp.page.book_kotodama.sleep: Sleep - "Sleep": everyone around you falls asleep (balance-law caps apply).
nusmp.page.book_kotodama.petrify: Petrify - "Petrify": everyone around you turns to stone for a moment, their spirit struck.
nusmp.page.book_kotodama.cower: Cower - "Cower" / "Fear": terror grips everyone around you; they weaken and monsters lose their target.
nusmp.page.book_kotodama.banish: Banish - "Banish": your foes' summoned beings are sent back (they can be called again) and everything else is hurled away.
nusmp.page.book_kotodama.reverse: Reverse - "Reverse" / "Reflect": for a few seconds half of every blow struck at you is turned back on the attacker.
nusmp.page.book_kotodama.drain: Drain - "Drain": a tenth of every foe's magicules flows into you and heals you, their spirit struck.
nusmp.skill.book_game.description: Gifso's magic: you oversee and bend everything that happens inside your game area. Prepare a Game Board first (magic poured into the place); on it your spells grow stronger and every piece rolls D&D saving throws for blessings or curses. Your EP is your modifier.
nusmp.page.book_game.game_board: Game Board - pour magic into the ground: a 16-block board of glowing squares for two minutes. Every 10 s each piece rolls a saving throw: foes who fail are cursed, allies who succeed are blessed. Spells on your board are 50% stronger.
nusmp.page.book_game.monster_toy: Monster Toy - a game-piece monster rises where you look, its size rolled on a d20: a random beast or chimera, or on a high roll a giant. It fights and casts spells for you.
nusmp.page.book_game.temple_shuffle: Temple Shuffle - every foe on your board is moved to a random square and your allies close in round you. Needs your Game Board.
nusmp.page.book_game.initiative: Initiative - you and every foe near roll a d20: those you beat lose their turn (slowed, magic jammed); beat them all and you move first (speed).
nusmp.page.book_game.dm_verdict: Dungeon Master's Verdict - every foe on your board makes a DC 12 saving throw; failures take 4d6 x your EP (a natural 1 doubles it). Roll a natural 20 yourself and everyone fails.
nusmp.page.book_game.trap_squares: Trap Squares - six hidden squares on your board for a minute; a foe who steps on one is snared and hurt. Needs your Game Board.
nusmp.page.book_magma.lava_lance: Lava Lance - a lance of molten rock that pierces and sets its target burning.
nusmp.page.book_magma.volcanic_bomb: Volcanic Bomb - a lobbed ball of magma that bursts where it lands, burning and flinging everything near.
nusmp.page.book_star.comet: Comet - a falling star that bursts on impact and hurls foes back.
nusmp.page.book_star.star_shield: Star Shield - starlight hardens round you: a thick absorption shield that cuts back at attackers.
nusmp.page.book_star.supernova: Supernova - you flare like a dying star: everyone around is hurled back and blinded.
nusmp.page.book_sand.sand_blast: Sand Blast - a cone of scouring sand that knocks back and blinds.
nusmp.page.book_sand.desert_coffin: Desert Coffin - sand swallows the ground where you look, crushing and nearly stopping everyone in it.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.palm_strik: Palm Strike - a reinforced palm blow that sends foes in front of you flying.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.titan_stom: Titan Stomp - a stomp that throws everyone around you into the air and slows them.
nusmp.page.book_beast.feral_claws: Feral Claws - a raking claw swipe in front of you that weakens what it tears.
nusmp.page.book_beast.pack_hunt: Pack Hunt - spectral beasts circle you and maul everything that comes close.
nusmp.page.book_bone.rib_cage: Rib Cage (肋骨の檻, Rokkotsu no Ori) - bones burst up round a target and lock it in place. Kept from the old book: bones that grow, merge and branch.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_rain: Bone Rain (骨雨, Kotsuu) - shards of bone rain down on an area for seconds. Kept from the old book.
nusmp.page.book_blood.blood_whip: Blood Whip - a long lash of blood; each foe it cuts feeds you.
nusmp.page.book_blood.hemorrhage: Hemorrhage - the blood of everyone in an area turns against them: they weaken and you drink.
nusmp.page.book_copy.mimic_volley: Mimic Volley - copies of a spell fly at your foes and home in.
nusmp.page.book_copy.reflection_double: Reflection Double - a copy of you draws the attention of everything near.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.false_step: False Step - you vanish behind your target, leaving it blinded.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.waking_nightmar: Waking Nightmare - everyone in an area sees their nightmare: darkness and weakness.
nusmp.page.book_ice.frost_ball: Frost Ball - Tensura's frost ball, chilling what it hits.
nusmp.page.book_ice.frozen_ground: Frozen Ground - the ground freezes over where you look: everyone on it slows and freezes.
nusmp.page.book_ice.blizzard_crown: Blizzard Crown - a ring of blizzard bursts out from you, freezing and pushing everyone back.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.gravity_well: Gravity Well - gravity crushes down on an area: everything in it is pinned and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.crushing_weight: Crushing Weight - a sudden weight falls on everyone where you look, almost stopping them.
nusmp.page.book_steel.steel_spikes: Steel Spikes - a line of steel spikes rips out of the ground and throws foes up.
nusmp.page.book_steel.iron_maiden: Iron Maiden - a cage of steel blades closes on a target, holding and weakening it.
item.nusmp.shroud_of_margins.desc: Carry it: three layers of barrier. Each absorbs one blow of up to 15% of your health and re-forms after 20 s. Spiritual damage is not stopped.
Carry it: grimoire page cooldowns -12%. Sneak and use for Overclock: 6 s of haste and speed (90 s cooldown).
item.nusmp.heart_of_words.desc: What is left of a sentence Zagred wrote and could not finish. A crafting material.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_barrier.description: Grimoire magic: Barrier Magic. Barrier Magic shapes honeycomb walls of hexagons that can be resized, moved and turned into weapons. Its pages fire homing hex shards, fold barrier into swords, axes, arrows and tridents, raise glass walls, turn shots back on their senders, wrap you in a protective skin, jam enemy casting and lock down spatial escapes, and finally raise the Voodoo Shangrila and Voodoo Kingdom domes that trap foes and shelter allies. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_barrier.description: The grimoire of Barrier Magic: twelve pages of hexagonal barriers. Starters throw hex shards and slide you forward on a barrier step; mid pages make voodoo weapons, a barrier cannon, a hexagon wall, a deflecting pane, a healing barrier skin and a spatial lock that jams casters; the zone and signature pages raise the Shangrila and Kingdom domes; the daily page draws spent barrier back into your body. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.barrier_strike: Barrier Strike - a hexagon of hard barrier is thrown in a straight line from the hand. It flies up to about 22 blocks, pierces through every foe in its path and deals 8 base damage to each (scaled by your EP).
nusmp.skill.grimoire_black_oil.descripti: Grimoire magic: Black Oil Magic. Sticky oil that slows and soaks, curse-filled nails, tar pits that trap, and an ignition that makes soaked enemies explode. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_black_oil.description: Black Oil Magic lets the mage draw a thick, iridescent black oil out of the grimoire. The oil clings and slows whatever it touches, soaks enemies so that any flame makes them burn and burst, traps them in tar, and carries curses through long fingernails of hardened oil. The pages run from oil bolts and sticky tar, through nails, a soaking spray, the ignition, a slide and a coat, to a tar pit, a candle ritual, the great eruption and a lake of oil. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.black_oil_stri: A fist of black oil thrown fast enough to run through a line of enemies. Fires a piercing oil bolt (8 damage, scaled by your EP) that bursts on impact and leaves every target hit gummed up (Slowness II for 3 seconds) and soaked in oil, which makes fire hurt it half again as much.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_body.description: Grimoire magic: Body Magic, the art of condensing, hardening and driving your own flesh. Muscle, bone and tendon are reinforced until a fist moves like a bullet, a forearm becomes a gun barrel and the whole body swells into a titan; torn tissue knits shut as fast as it breaks. Eleven pages cover strikes, a compressed-mana cannon, tendon cutting, bone hardening, healing, a spring leap, a quake stomp, Titan Form and a daily regrowth. Body buffs cost Aura on top of the page. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_body.description: The grimoire of Body Magic: eleven pages of bronze muscle and steam. Starters throw a piercing Titan Strike, lunge as a Bullet Fist and land five jabs in a Rapid Barrage; mid pages fire three compressed rounds from a forearm barrel, cut tendons, harden the frame, mend flesh, and spring high for a crushing landing; the zone page stomps out a ring of quakes; the signature swells you into a Titan; the daily regrows the body.
