The card's cut-off third text (an aura of fire) is not part of this weapon.
item.nusmp.null_blade.desc: A black greatsword with an eye in its cross. It frightens the weak, deals cold, eats maximum health and gives it to you as warding. After twenty lives it awakens. Anyone but its owner drops it.
item.nusmp.null_blade.card: Needs attunement; anyone but its attuned owner drops it and takes 3 cold damage (the card's 'forced to drop it, 1d6 cold'). Lesser creatures within 5 blocks flinch with Tensura's Fear. Each blow adds 3 cold damage and Frost, and takes up to 3 hearts of maximum health from the creature (a roll of d6 as half a heart per pip; at most 30% of a player, 8 health points, 2 minutes; at most half of a mob, 5 minutes), giving you temporary hit points equal to what it took, up to 10. When you shrug off a hostile spell the blade gains a charge (3 at most); Blindness / Deafness (use, 5 s) spends one: foes within 8 blocks are blinded and silenced for 5 seconds. The eye in the cross (automatic, every 10 s): a foe that strikes you from within 5 blocks is restrained (Slowness V and Frost, 2.5 s); if it strikes you again within 5 seconds it is frozen (Slowness VII and Frost for 5 s, Paralysis for 2.5 s); half that against a boss. Awakened after 20 kills with it: halves cold and necrotic damage; Armor of Agathys (sneak + use, once a day): 10 absorption for a minute, and whoever strikes you in melee takes 3 cold and Frost.
item.nusmp.viper_whip.desc: A whip of snakeskin that ends in a viper's head. It reaches further and poisons. Once a day the viper bites: for ten minutes you feel which way the bitten one lies.
item.nusmp.viper_whip.card: +1.5 blocks of reach. Each blow adds 2.5 poison damage and Poison for 5 seconds. Held, it lends Poison Resistance. Viper's Bite (use, once a day): the viper bites the foe you struck last (or the one you face within 6 blocks): for 10 minutes (the card's 12 hours) the action bar shows its direction and distance, alive, fallen or last known, up to 1000 blocks and across worlds.
item.nusmp.caesars_gladius.desc: A marbled gladius with a feathered guard. Once every five days it calls three gladiators for five minutes. Once in ten calls they remember the Republic, and turn on you.
item.nusmp.caesars_gladius.card: Call the Gladiators (use, 5% mana, every 5 days): three gladiators (Tensura lizardmen, or iron golems without Tensura) fight beside you for five minutes (the card's ten, the game's ally limit). One call in ten they remember the Republic: after 30 to 90 seconds, with a warning five seconds before, they turn into three hostile Gladiators of the Republic who hunt you for three minutes (the card's 'indefinitely') or until they fall.
item.nusmp.twin_swords_of_deflection.des: The right one of a matched pair of hooked blades. With the left one in your off hand both land with each blow; a tenth of blows are critical, and the wielder is quicker. Use to parry: missiles turn back on their sender.
item.nusmp.twin_swords_of_deflection.car:
Needs attunement (attuning one sword attunes both; the pair uses one of your three places). Pair: needs the other half. Hold one in the main hand and the other in the off hand: the off-hand sword adds a second blow of 60% of the first (own cooldown of 0.6 seconds), and the pair-only effects wake. One half alone keeps its abilities at a small penalty.
The pair strikes as one: the off-hand blade lands a second blow of 60% of the first, and one blow in ten is a critical (+50%, the card's 19 and 20). Dexterity +1 becomes +12% attack speed and +5% movement speed. Deflect (use, 2% mana, 6 s, shared by both swords): for 2 seconds missiles turn back on the one who sent them, melee blows lose 60% of their force and the attacker takes a 2.5 damage riposte. 4.4 damage each. The card is cut off after the Dexterity line; Deflect is added to fit its name.
item.nusmp.hunger.desc: A sentient greataxe with a mouth for a blade. It adds acid to every blow. Three times a day it devours a hit and gives you the blood as temporary health. If it goes hungry for three minutes it gnaws at you.
item.nusmp.hunger.card: A sentient greataxe. Each blow adds 4 acid damage (the card's 1d12) and Tensura's Corrosion. Held, it lends Danger Sense (its Wisdom +5). Devouring (use, 3 a day): for 20 seconds the next hit that draws blood gives you temporary hit points equal to the damage, up to 10 (6 against a player). Curse (the card is cut off after 'Every'): if it draws no blood for 3 minutes it gnaws at you, half a heart every 20 seconds, never below two hearts; any hit or kill feeds it.
item.nusmp.thornblight.desc: A thorn-hafted handaxe you can throw. Four times a day, thorns grow in the wound of the foe you struck last and fester. Its curse: every blow that lands costs you a point of health.
item.nusmp.thornblight.card: Throw the Axe (use, 2.5 s): the axe flies 18 blocks along your line of sight, hits the nearest foe for 7 damage and comes back. Spiteful Thorns (sneak + use, 4 a day, 3 s): thorns grow in the wound of the foe you struck within the last 10 seconds: Poison for 12 seconds (about 9 damage, never lethal) and Slowness. Curse: every blow that lands costs you 1 point of health, never the last two hearts. Milk ends the poison (the card's Remove Curse).
nusmp.discovery.hint: Undiscovered. Find it in the world to unlock this entry.
nusmp.ui.codex.sage.guide: Notice: turn pages with A and D.
nusmp.ui.toast.page_open: Notice: a new page has opened.
nusmp.ui.tensura.select: select an ability to analyze it.
nusmp.ui.tensura.mode: choose a mode for this ability.
nusmp.ui.tensura.category: choose a category to browse its abilities.
nusmp.ui.slot.bound: Grimoire bound. Its pages open with mastery.
nusmp.ui.slot.empty: no grimoire is bound. Place one in the slot.
nusmp.ui.status.read: The Multiverse record has been read.
nusmp.ui.wizard.hint: choose the answer that is closest to you.
nusmp.skill.book_air.description: A grimoire of Air Magic: air compressed, cut and made visible. A bullet of compressed air, a crescent blade of air, a field of dead air, a storm of orbiting blades, a glass-clear armour of air forged piece by piece, a burst forward, a pressure orb and a vacuum seal. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_air.attribute_bolt: Air Bullet: a fast bullet of compressed air that bursts for damage and a hard push. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_air.attribute_cut: Air Blade: a crescent blade of air flies twelve blocks along your aim, cutting and pushing aside every foe it passes once, and stops at a wall. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_air.attribute_field: Dead Air: five seconds of thin air where you aim. Foes inside are slowed and weakened, silenced briefly (shortened on bosses, shares the control lock) and hurt a little; enemy projectiles and bolts fall out of the air. Radius scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_air.attribute_domain: Air Blade Storm: five blades of air orbit you for fifteen seconds (longer with EP). Each flies at the nearest hostile within ten blocks once a second, cuts it and returns. You wear the air armour for five seconds.
nusmp.page.book_air.attribute_guard: Air Cushion Armour: nine seconds of glass-clear armour of compressed air forged piece by piece. Falls cost nothing, 35 percent of enemy projectiles are turned aside, you move faster and your blows hit harder.
nusmp.skill.book_hair.description: A grimoire of Hair: hair grown, hardened, wound and thrown. Beside the bolt, line, field, domain and guard it holds a lash, a binding, a cocoon, a woven suit that forges itself on you piece by piece, and the Mane of a Hundred Strands. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_hair.attribute_bolt: A bolt of Hair: a fast projectile that strikes the first foe or wall it meets and bursts there.
nusmp.page.book_hair.attribute_cut: A line of Hair drawn straight ahead: it cuts through every foe along its length.
nusmp.page.book_hair.attribute_field: A field of Hair laid at the aimed point: it stays for a while and hurts everything inside.
nusmp.page.book_hair.attribute_domain: The domain of Hair: a great burst around you that throws back and hurts everything near.
nusmp.page.book_hair.attribute_guard: A guard of Hair: the magic wraps you and grants its protective effect for a few seconds.
nusmp.skill.book_memory.description: A grimoire of Memory: a moment kept and shown again. Every cast puts the Reel Vestments on you for five seconds, blows come back as echoes, foes forget what they hunted and you can step back to where you were. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_memory.attribute_bolt: Recollection Bolt: an orb that bursts on the first foe or wall it meets. Sixteen ticks later the same blow lands again as an echo.
nusmp.page.book_memory.attribute_cut: Replay Line: a line drawn straight ahead through every foe on it, and the same line replayed ten ticks later.
nusmp.page.book_memory.attribute_field: Forgetting Field: a field laid at the aimed point for six seconds. Foes inside are hurt, blinded briefly and forget what they hunted; allies inside shake off a harmful effect and heal a little.
nusmp.page.book_memory.attribute_domain: Flashback Domain: a burst around you that hurts and blinds every foe near, and replays itself a second later for a second blow.
nusmp.page.book_memory.attribute_guard: Memory Veil: Night Vision, a melee bonus and thorns for nine seconds, and the next hit you take within eight seconds is forgotten (a boss's hit is only cut). The Reel Vestments last as long.
nusmp.skill.book_mineral.description: The grimoire of Mineral Magic: ore and crystal grown out of the rock. Its pages throw crystal lances that pierce, grow spires and a crystal garden, resonate and drain a foe's magicules and forge the crystal armour over you. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.attribute_bolt: Mineral Bolt - a lance of crystal flies along your line of sight, piercing every foe on its line once and slowing them, and bursts where it ends.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.attribute_cut: A row of crystal erupts along your line of sight, cutting everything it crosses.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.attribute_field: A crystal garden: three spires grow round the aimed point for about ten seconds, each pulsing shards that hurt and slow everything near it.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.attribute_domain: A resonance round you: a great burst of crystal that hurts everything near and, when the control lock is free, drains a share of each foe's magicules into yours (Energy Drain). Forges the crystal armour for a few seconds.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.attribute_guard: Crystal armour: ore matrix with crystal clusters forges over your body piece by piece for nine seconds, with Resistance, thorns and a share of your aura spent; a fan of crystal opens behind you. It shatters out when it ends.
nusmp.skill.book_modification.descriptio: Morris Libardirt's attribute: change the structure of things - needles that thread through matter, clawed tendrils out of the ground, a field that unravels barriers, a shock of rewritten air, a body that re-forms against the kind of blow that has been hurting it. Cast it and the Dissector's Frame forms: bone and steel plates, a ribcage over your chest, four tendrils from your back, a ring of needles over your head. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_modification.attribute_b: Modification: Dissection Needles - three to five needles fly from your hand in a fan; each pierces the first foe it meets and weakens it. More needles for more EP.
nusmp.page.book_modification.attribute_c: Modification: Clawed Tendrils - tendrils climb out of the ground under up to four foes within sixteen blocks, strike and drag them toward you (the drag uses the shared control lock).
nusmp.page.book_modification.attribute_f: Modification: Structural Unravel - a field laid at the aimed point for four seconds: barriers and enemy shots in it are broken as it opens, and foes in it are slowed, weakened and slowly cut.
nusmp.page.book_modification.attribute_d: Modification: Structure Shock - a blast of rewritten air all round you: a hard hit and a shove outwards on every foe within six and a half blocks. The five-second Frame forms.
nusmp.page.book_modification.attribute_g: Modification: Re-Structure - for nine seconds your body re-forms against the kind of blow that has been hurting it (melee, ranged or magic): a quarter to two fifths off that kind, but every other kind finds a hole. Vary your defence; the Frame forms.
nusmp.skill.book_mucus.description: A grimoire of mucus that smothers and entraps, soaks up blows and drinks the magic of whoever it holds. Its pages shoot blobs, lash tendrils, spread sticky fields, engulf everything near you, wrap you in a gel armour, and call a construct, walls and bubbles. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.attribute_bolt: Mucus Magic: Mucus Shot - a blob of mucus that bursts on the first foe, slows it and takes a little of its magicule.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.attribute_cut: Mucus Magic: Mucus Tendril - a tendril lashes along a line: it cuts, slows and drags everything on it toward you.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.attribute_field: Mucus Magic: Sticky Field - a field of mucus at the aimed point for 8 seconds: foes in it are slowed hard and their magicules are absorbed. Size scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.attribute_domain: Mucus Magic: Engulfing Tide - a tide of mucus engulfs everything round you: damage, slowed, silenced and drained.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.attribute_guard: Mucus Magic: Mucus Armor - the Gelplate armour spreads over you for 10 seconds like slime: blows are soaked (a third less), feed you a little, and drain the magicules of whoever strikes you.
nusmp.skill.book_mud.description: A grimoire of mud. Its pages throw heavy globs, send a wave of mud, turn the ground to a pit, burst a bog open, wrap you in a mud armour, and call a golem, spouts and walls. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_mud.attribute_bolt: Mud Magic: Mud Ball - a heavy glob of mud that bursts on the first foe and slows it.
nusmp.page.book_mud.attribute_cut: Mud Magic: Mud Wave - a wave of mud along a line: it cuts everything on it, throws it back and slows it.
nusmp.page.book_mud.attribute_field: Mud Magic: Mud Pit - the ground at the aimed point turns to a pit for 8 seconds: foes sink in it, are slowed hard and weakened. Size scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_mud.attribute_domain: Mud Magic: Bog Domain - the ground round the aimed point erupts: heavy damage, thrown back, then mired for a long time.
nusmp.page.book_mud.attribute_guard: Mud Magic: Mud Armor - the Bogplate armour drops onto you for 10 seconds, clod by clod: blows are softened by a third and whoever strikes you is slowed.
nusmp.skill.book_nail.description: A grimoire of Nail: nails driven through things and fingernails grown into claws. Beside the bolt, line, field, domain and guard it holds a barrage, a hammer, a suit of studded armour that forges itself on you piece by piece, a pinning of the feet, and the Nail Storm. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_nail.attribute_bolt: A bolt of Nail: a fast projectile that strikes the first foe or wall it meets and bursts there.
nusmp.page.book_nail.attribute_cut: A line of Nail drawn straight ahead: it cuts through every foe along its length.
nusmp.page.book_nail.attribute_field: A field of Nail laid at the aimed point: it stays for a while and hurts everything inside.
nusmp.page.book_nail.attribute_domain: The domain of Nail: a great burst around you that throws back and hurts everything near.
nusmp.page.book_nail.attribute_guard: A guard of Nail: the magic wraps you and grants its protective effect for a few seconds.
nusmp.skill.book_permeation.description: A grimoire of Permeation. Its pages are a bolt, a line, a field, a domain and a guard, all in the colour of the magic. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.attribute_bol: A bolt of Permeation: a fast projectile that strikes the first foe or wall it meets and bursts there.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.attribute_cut: A line of Permeation drawn straight ahead: it cuts through every foe along its length.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.attribute_fie: A field of Permeation laid at the aimed point: it stays for a while and hurts everything inside.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.attribute_dom: The domain of Permeation: a great burst around you that throws back and hurts everything near.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.attribute_gua: A guard of Permeation: the magic wraps you in the Phase Shroud, a see-through set of rings and lattice, and grants its protective effect for a few seconds.
nusmp.skill.book_poison_plant.descriptio: A grimoire of toxic plants. Its vines skewer and tunnel through the ground, its blooms breathe clouds of poison gas, its traps snap shut, and its antidote undoes it all. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.attribute_b: Poison Plant Magic: Venom Thorn - a hooked thorn that pierces and poisons.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.attribute_c: Poison Plant Magic: Burrowing Venom Vine - a vine tunnels along the ground and erupts under everything on a line: damage, thrown up, poisoned.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.attribute_f: Poison Plant Magic: Miasma Bloom - a bloom opens at the aimed point and breathes a cloud of poison gas for 9 seconds: damage, poison, blindness.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.attribute_d: Poison Plant Magic: Toxic Garden - three blooms and two trap maws spring up round you with a heavy poison zone for 10 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.attribute_g: Poison Plant Magic: Venomflora Armor - the Venomflora armour lunges onto you for 10 seconds: blows are softened and whoever strikes you is poisoned.
nusmp.skill.book_red_ochre.description: The grimoire of Red Ochre Magic: iron-red pigment and fired clay. Its pages paint foes so they weaken and glow, raise painted totems, daub your own body with War Paint and forge the clay armour over you. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.attribute_bolt: A bolt of red pigment: it bursts on the first foe or wall and saps the strength of everything it splashes.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.attribute_cut: A single brush stroke of ochre along your line of sight: it hurts what it crosses, weakens it and leaves it glowing, easy to see.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.attribute_fiel: A pool of pigment laid at the aimed point: everything inside is hurt, weakened and slowed while it stands there.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.attribute_doma: A burst of war paint round you: everything near is hurt, marked to glow and weakened, and the clay armour forges for a few seconds.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.attribute_guar: Clay armour: smooth fired clay with painted bands forges over your body piece by piece for nine seconds, with Resistance, thorns and a share of your aura spent; a sun disc turns behind you. It shatters out when it ends.
nusmp.skill.book_rock.description: The grimoire of Rock Magic: raw, jagged crag and boulder. Its pages throw boulders, break the ground into crags, drop rock on a field, call the Boulder Titan and wrap you in boulder armour. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_rock.attribute_bolt: Rock Bolt - a boulder is torn loose and thrown along your line of sight; it arcs a little, bursts on the first foe or block and hurts everything round the burst.
nusmp.page.book_rock.attribute_cut: Crags erupt one after another along your line of sight, hitting and lifting what stands on them.
nusmp.page.book_rock.attribute_field: A rockfall laid at the aimed point: stones keep dropping on everything inside, slowing and shoving it.
nusmp.page.book_rock.attribute_domain: A quake round you: a great burst that hurls back and weakens everything near, and forges the boulder armour for a few seconds.
nusmp.page.book_rock.attribute_guard: Boulder armour: heavy rock gathers over your body piece by piece for nine seconds, with Resistance II, thorns and a share of your aura spent; rocks orbit you. It shatters out when it ends.
nusmp.skill.book_sandstone.description: The grimoire of Sandstone Magic: layered stone that turns to sand and sets hard again. Its pages throw grit that blinds, raise slabs, hold a foe inside the Variable Hardness Prison and forge the Dune Plate over you. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.attribute_bolt: A bolt of packed sand: it bursts on the first foe or wall, throws everything near it back a step and fills its eyes with grit.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.attribute_cut: Slabs of sandstone break the ground one after another along your line of sight; each hits and slows what stands on it.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.attribute_fiel: A field of shifting sand laid at the aimed point: it hurts everything inside every moment, drags at its feet and stings its eyes.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.attribute_doma: A sandstorm round you: a great burst that throws back, blinds and hurts everything near, and forges the Dune Plate for a few seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.attribute_guar: The Dune Plate: stacked slabs of sandstone forge over your body piece by piece for nine seconds, with Resistance, thorns and a share of your aura spent. They shatter out when it ends.
nusmp.skill.book_scale.description: A grimoire of Scale: the overlapping scales of fish, lizards and dragons. Beside the bolt, line, field, domain and guard it holds a volley of scales, a serpent, a shield, a suit of scale mail that forges itself on you piece by piece, and the Shedding Tide. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_scale.attribute_bolt: A bolt of Scale: a fast projectile that strikes the first foe or wall it meets and bursts there.
nusmp.page.book_scale.attribute_cut: A line of Scale drawn straight ahead: it cuts through every foe along its length.
nusmp.page.book_scale.attribute_field: A field of Scale laid at the aimed point: it stays for a while and hurts everything inside.
nusmp.page.book_scale.attribute_domain: The domain of Scale: a great burst around you that throws back and hurts everything near.
nusmp.page.book_scale.attribute_guard: A guard of Scale: the magic wraps you and grants its protective effect for a few seconds.
nusmp.skill.book_shakudo.description: A grimoire of Shakudo, the black-purple alloy with fine gold inlay. Beside the bolt, line, field, domain and guard it holds a gilded lance, a golem, a bulwark, a suit of plate armour that forges itself on you piece by piece, and a colossus. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.attribute_bolt: A bolt of Shakudo: a fast projectile that strikes the first foe or wall it meets and bursts there.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.attribute_cut: A line of Shakudo drawn straight ahead: it cuts through every foe along its length.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.attribute_field: A field of Shakudo laid at the aimed point: it stays for a while and hurts everything inside.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.attribute_domain: The domain of Shakudo: a great burst around you that throws back and hurts everything near.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.attribute_guard: A guard of Shakudo: the magic wraps you and grants its protective effect for a few seconds.
nusmp.skill.book_skin.description: A grimoire of Skin. Its pages are a bolt, a line, a field, a domain and a guard, all in the colour of the magic. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_skin.attribute_bolt: A bolt of Skin: a fast projectile that strikes the first foe or wall it meets and bursts there.
nusmp.page.book_skin.attribute_cut: A line of Skin drawn straight ahead: it cuts through every foe along its length.
nusmp.page.book_skin.attribute_field: A field of Skin laid at the aimed point: it stays for a while and hurts everything inside.
nusmp.page.book_skin.attribute_domain: The domain of Skin: a great burst around you that throws back and hurts everything near.
nusmp.page.book_skin.attribute_guard: A guard of Skin: the magic wraps you and grants its protective effect for a few seconds.
nusmp.skill.book_smoke.description: A grimoire of Smoke Magic: the caster who hides, blinds and misleads inside a cloud of his own smoke. A bullet that bursts into a choking cloud, a serpent of smoke, a screen that hides allies and blinds foes, three clones, an armour of smoke that turns blows into vapour, a step through smoke, a coiling serpent and a rolling wave. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.attribute_bolt: Smoke Bullet: a bolt of dense smoke that bursts where it lands, blinding and slowing everything in the burst, and leaves a cloud for 2.5 seconds that keeps foes blind and slow. Damage and size scale with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.attribute_cut: Smoke Serpent: a serpent of smoke lunges ten blocks along your aim and bites every foe it passes through once, for damage and blindness. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.attribute_field: Smoke Screen: five seconds of thick smoke where you aim. Foes inside are blinded and slowed, choke a little and lose track of you; you and your allies inside turn invisible. Radius scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.attribute_domain: Smoke Clones: three clones of smoke stand round you for ten seconds (longer with EP). They breathe blinding smoke on everything near, cut the nearest hostile, make mobs lose you and burst into a cloud when they end. You vanish into the smoke armour for five seconds.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.attribute_guard: Smoke Armour: nine seconds of armour forged from smoke piece by piece. 30 percent of the blows that reach you turn into smoke, attackers are pricked, your blows hit harder and you move faster.
nusmp.skill.book_snow.description: A grimoire of Snow Magic: snow and cold shaped into bullets, crescents, storms and soldiers. A packed snowball, a crescent of hard snow, a blizzard, a golem of snow, a mantle of snow and ice forged piece by piece, a drift to slide on, a frost crystal and a whiteout. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_snow.attribute_bolt: Snow Bullet: a packed snowball that bursts where it lands for damage, slow II and frostbite. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_snow.attribute_cut: Snow Crescent: a crescent of hard snow cut nine blocks ahead through every foe on the line: damage, slow II and frostbite.
nusmp.page.book_snow.attribute_field: Blizzard: six seconds of blizzard at the aim point. Everything inside is slowed, frostbitten, hurt a little and pushed towards the edge. Radius scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_snow.attribute_domain: Snow Golem: a golem of packed snow with an ice heart rises beside you and fights for twenty seconds (longer with EP): it walks to the nearest hostile and slams it with a chilling shockwave, and crumbles when it ends. You wear the snow armour for five seconds.
nusmp.page.book_snow.attribute_guard: Snow Armour: nine seconds of mantle of snow, fur and ice forged piece by piece: damage resistance, a hit harder, and whatever strikes you in melee is chilled.
nusmp.skill.book_song.description: A grimoire of Song: notes, staff lines, choirs and brass. Every cast puts the Concert Regalia on you for five seconds, the pages call flying notes, a choir of singing spirits and a metronome, and the singing modes of the older pages keep their place. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_song.attribute_bolt: Staccato Bolt: three short note bolts, four ticks apart. Each is a flying note that bursts on the first foe or wall it meets and weakens what it hits. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_song.attribute_cut: Glissando: a staff of five lines drawn straight ahead through every foe on a long line, slowing them. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_song.attribute_field: Choir Field: a field laid at the aimed point for five seconds with three choir spirits standing in it. Every second foes inside are hurt and slowed, and allies are healed a little.
nusmp.page.book_song.attribute_domain: Grand Concerto: a great burst of music around you that hurts and throws back every foe near and wraps your allies in Absorption.
nusmp.page.book_song.attribute_guard: Aria Armour: Regeneration, a melee bonus and thorns for nine seconds, and the Concert Regalia for as long.
nusmp.skill.book_soul_corpse.description: A grimoire of Soul Corpse: a necromancer's craft of threads, Soul Zombies that fight for you and hands out of the grave. Rades's pages (Reanimation, his numbered undead No.4 Jimmy, No.3 David, No.2 Alfredo, No.1 Carl and No.0 Michael Caesal, True Soul Corpse Magic) are his alone. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.attribute_bo: Marionette Thread: a coffin nail on a thread that bursts on the first foe or wall it meets, slows and weakens what it hits and pulls it a little toward you.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.attribute_cu: Puppet Strings: threads drawn straight ahead through every foe on a long line. Each is hurt, slowed and pulled toward you.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.attribute_fi: Grave Field: a field laid at the aimed point for six seconds in which five hands rise from the ground and close on foes within reach, hurting and slowing them.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.attribute_do: Necropolis: a great burst of grave-cold around you that hurts and withers every foe near, and two Soul Zombies rise to fight for ten seconds.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.attribute_gu: Corpse Plate: Resistance, Absorption, a melee bonus and thorns for nine seconds, and the Marionette Shell for as long.
nusmp.skill.book_soul.description: A grimoire of Soul: pale soul fire and hollow-eyed spirits, the soul as something that can be struck, drained and harvested. Every cast puts the Spirit Raiment on you for five seconds, and every page pairs a blow to the body with Spiritual Damage. Lucius's Paladin pages keep their place. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_soul.attribute_bolt: Soul Flame Bolt: an orb of soul fire that bursts on the first foe or wall it meets, hurts the body and the soul, and drains a little of the foe's magicules to you.
nusmp.page.book_soul.attribute_cut: Soul Sever: a line drawn straight ahead through every foe on it, hurting body and soul and draining their magicules to you.
nusmp.page.book_soul.attribute_field: Soul Vortex: a field laid at the aimed point for five seconds. Every second foes inside take body and spiritual damage, are slowed and have magicules drained to you.
nusmp.page.book_soul.attribute_domain: Soul Release: a great burst of souls around you. Foes take body and spiritual damage and are weakened; allies are healed a tenth of their health.
nusmp.page.book_soul.attribute_guard: Spirit Mantle: Absorption, Regeneration, a melee bonus and thorns for nine seconds, and the Spirit Raiment for as long.
nusmp.skill.book_sound.description: A grimoire of Sound: vibration made visible. Every cast puts the Resonance Plate on you for five seconds, sonic hits leave resonance marks that stack, and speaker stacks, tuning forks and silence do the rest. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_sound.attribute_bolt: Sonic Bolt: a tuning-fork bolt that bursts on the first foe or wall it meets, marks what it hits with resonance and briefly jams its Ultimate skills. Wind damage scaling with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_sound.attribute_cut: Sound Wave: a waveform line drawn straight ahead through every foe, pushing them back and leaving a resonance mark.
nusmp.page.book_sound.attribute_field: Resonance Field: a field laid at the aimed point for five seconds with two speaker stacks flanking it. Every second foes inside are hurt, slowed and marked, and magic barriers inside it shatter.
nusmp.page.book_sound.attribute_domain: Sonic Boom: a burst around you that hurts and throws back every foe near, jams their Ultimate skills for a few seconds and marks them with resonance.
nusmp.page.book_sound.attribute_guard: Echo Plate: Speed, a melee bonus and thorns for nine seconds, and the Resonance Plate for as long.
nusmp.skill.book_spike.description: A grimoire of Spike: spikes thrust out of the ground and thrown from the body. Beside the bolt, line, field, domain and guard it holds an eruption, a wall, an urchin, a suit of spiked armour that forges itself on you piece by piece, and the Impaling Field. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_spike.attribute_bolt: A bolt of Spike: a fast projectile that strikes the first foe or wall it meets and bursts there.
nusmp.page.book_spike.attribute_cut: A line of Spike drawn straight ahead: it cuts through every foe along its length.
nusmp.page.book_spike.attribute_field: A field of Spike laid at the aimed point: it stays for a while and hurts everything inside.
nusmp.page.book_spike.attribute_domain: The domain of Spike: a great burst around you that throws back and hurts everything near.
nusmp.page.book_spike.attribute_guard: A guard of Spike: the magic wraps you and grants its protective effect for a few seconds.
nusmp.skill.book_switching.description: A grimoire of Switching. Its pages are a bolt, a line, a field, a domain and a guard, all in the colour of the magic. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_switching.attribute_bolt: A bolt of Switching: a fast projectile that strikes the first foe or wall it meets and bursts there.
nusmp.page.book_switching.attribute_cut: A line of Switching drawn straight ahead: it cuts through every foe along its length.
nusmp.page.book_switching.attribute_fiel: A field of Switching laid at the aimed point: it stays for a while and hurts everything inside.
nusmp.page.book_switching.attribute_doma: The domain of Switching: a great burst around you that throws back and hurts everything near.
nusmp.page.book_switching.attribute_guar: A guard of Switching: the magic wraps you and grants its protective effect for a few seconds.
nusmp.skill.book_tongue.description: A grimoire of Tongue. Its pages are a bolt, a line, a field, a domain and a guard, all in the colour of the magic. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.attribute_bolt: A bolt of Tongue: a fast projectile that strikes the first foe or wall it meets and bursts there.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.attribute_cut: A line of Tongue drawn straight ahead: it cuts through every foe along its length.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.attribute_field: A field of Tongue laid at the aimed point: it stays for a while and hurts everything inside.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.attribute_domain: The domain of Tongue: a great burst around you that throws back and hurts everything near.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.attribute_guard: A guard of Tongue: the magic wraps you and grants its protective effect for a few seconds.
nusmp.skill.book_tree.description: A grimoire of heartwood and living trunks. Its pages throw splinters, burst roots out of the ground, raise groves and a great tree, grow a bark armour over you, call a treant, and wall you in with oak. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_tree.attribute_bolt: Tree Magic: Splinter Shot - a sharpened shaft of wood that pierces everything on its line and slows it.
nusmp.page.book_tree.attribute_cut: Tree Magic: Root Lance - lances of root burst out of the ground in a line in front of you, one after another: each cuts, throws up and roots whoever stands on it.
nusmp.page.book_tree.attribute_field: Tree Magic: Grove - a grove grows at the aimed point for 8 seconds: foes in it are cut and held by roots, friends in it mend. Size scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tree.attribute_domain: Tree Magic: Great Tree Rising - a great trunk rises under everything round the aimed point: heavy damage, thrown up, then held by its roots for a while.
nusmp.page.book_tree.attribute_guard: Tree Magic: Bark Armor - the Heartwood armour grows over you for 10 seconds (it forges in piece by piece and shatters off at the end): blows are softened and whoever strikes you is pricked and rooted.
nusmp.skill.book_stone.description: The grimoire of Stone Magic: dressed, cut and carved stone. Its pages throw stone, push slabs out of the ground, raise walls and a Stone Sentinel, seal casting with a shockwave and forge the masonry armour over you. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_stone.attribute_bolt: A bolt of cut stone: it bursts on the first foe or wall and slows everything it hits.
nusmp.page.book_stone.attribute_cut: Stone slabs are pushed out of the ground one after another along your line of sight, hitting and slowing what stands on them.
nusmp.page.book_stone.attribute_field: A field of rising slabs laid at the aimed point: it hurts everything inside every moment and holds it back.
nusmp.page.book_stone.attribute_domain: A shockwave of stone round you: a great burst that hurls back everything near and, when the control lock is free, seals its casting for a few seconds (Magic Jamming). Forges the masonry armour for a few seconds.
nusmp.page.book_stone.attribute_guard: Masonry armour: dressed stone blocks forge over your body piece by piece for nine seconds, with Resistance II, thorns and a share of your aura spent; runed tablets float behind you. It shatters out when it ends.
nusmp.skill.book_vine.description: A grimoire of living vines, thorns and tendrils. Its pages fling thorns, crack a vine whip, tangle a thicket, whirl every vine in reach inward, grow a thorned armour over you, and call a serpent and walls of vine. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_vine.attribute_bolt: Vine Magic: Thorn Dart - a thorn flung on a vine: it pierces everything on its line and pricks with poison.
nusmp.page.book_vine.attribute_cut: Vine Magic: Vine Whip - a whip of vine along a line: it cuts everything on it and hauls it toward you.
nusmp.page.book_vine.attribute_field: Vine Magic: Thicket - a thicket at the aimed point for 8 seconds: foes are tangled, pricked and drained of a little magicule. Size scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_vine.attribute_domain: Vine Magic: Verdant Maelstrom - every vine round the aimed point whirls inward: foes are dragged to the middle, cut and held.
nusmp.page.book_vine.attribute_guard: Vine Magic: Thorn Mantle - the Thornbine armour grows over you for 10 seconds, vines climbing the body piece by piece: blows are softened and whoever strikes you is rooted and pricked.
nusmp.skill.book_vortex.description: A grimoire of Vortex Magic: spinning wind that draws everything in. A spinning shot that pulls, a spiral lance, a whirlpool, a walking cyclone, a whirling mantle of teal steel and rings of wind forged piece by piece, a spinning step, a maelstrom core and a spiral gale. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.attribute_bolt: Vortex Shot: a spinning bolt that bursts for damage and pulls everything near the burst towards its middle. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.attribute_cut: Vortex Lance, the Spiral Lance: a lance of wind eleven blocks long. Everything on the line is hurt and pulled towards you.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.attribute_field: Whirlpool: six seconds of whirlwind where you aim. Foes inside are drawn to the middle, slowed and cut a little. Radius scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.attribute_domain: Great Vortex: a cyclone rises in front of you and walks eight seconds (longer with EP) along your aim, pulling in and lifting everything within 3.5 blocks and cutting it, and throws it all away when it ends. You wear the whirling mantle for five seconds.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.attribute_guard: Vortex Mantle: nine seconds of a whirling mantle forged piece by piece, with bands of wind turning round you. Enemy projectiles that come within three and a half blocks are swept away, and your blows hit harder.
nusmp.skill.book_wing.description: A grimoire of Wing Magic: wings and feathers as weapons, flight and lift. A fan of feathers, a slash of the wing, an updraft, a launch into the sky with two feather hawks, a suit of silver and gold feathers with real wings forged piece by piece, a dash on the wing, a storm of feather blades and a diving hawk. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_wing.attribute_bolt: Feather Shot: three feathers fly in a fan, each bursting for damage and a short levitation. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_wing.attribute_cut: Wing Slash: a slash of the wing ten blocks long cuts everything on the line and throws it up. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_wing.attribute_field: Updraft: six seconds of rising wind where you aim. Foes inside float up (shortened on bosses, shares the control lock) and are hurt a little; you and your allies inside fall slowly. Radius scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_wing.attribute_domain: Skyward: you are flung into the sky on your wings and glide down slowly, two feather hawks hunt for you for twenty seconds (longer with EP), and you wear the winged armour for five seconds.
nusmp.page.book_wing.attribute_guard: Wing Armour: nine seconds of silver and gold armour with a pair of beating wings, forged piece by piece. Slow falling, no fall damage, speed and jump boost, and your blows hit harder.

nusmp.merge.description: %s: a magic merged from %s. Its spells are the parents' own, cast through them, drawn in their shared colours and carrying both hit effects; casting wraps you in a temporary armour of both. Any summoned grimoire of yours opens its pages.
item.nusmp.twin_hook_swords_left.desc: The left sword of a pair of hook swords. Right-click sweeps the leg of a two-legged or winged foe and drags it off its feet. Hold the right sword in the off hand: a second blow follows each strike, and the hooks hold you to a wall so you can climb.
item.nusmp.twin_hook_swords_left.card:
Normal Grade, the left sword of a PAIR of hook swords (the mirror of the right one): 3.8 damage, fast (2.4 attacks a second). Engravings: Swift, Sturdy. Pair: needs the other half. Hold one in the main hand and the other in the off hand: the off-hand sword adds a second blow of 60% of the first (own cooldown of 0.6 seconds), and the pair-only effects wake. One half alone keeps its abilities at a small penalty.
It carries every ability of the right sword (Sweep the Leg, the off-hand hook, the climb) and shares its cooldowns.
item.nusmp.whirling_blades_left.desc: The cold, cyan-bladed one of two curved swords that come as a pair: its blows chill. With the hot one in your off hand a second blow follows with its flame. Right-click joins their ends in a spin attack that hits everything around you.
item.nusmp.whirling_blades_left.card:
Rare Grade, the left (cold, cyan) sword of a PAIR of whirling blades: 5 damage, fast (2 attacks a second). Engravings: Severance, Swift. Pair: needs the other half. Hold one in the main hand and the other in the off hand: the off-hand sword adds a second blow of 60% of the first (own cooldown of 0.6 seconds), and the pair-only effects wake. One half alone keeps its abilities at a small penalty.
This blade's blows chill (Slowness and Tensura frost). It carries every ability of the right blade (the Spin Attack) and shares its cooldown.
item.nusmp.twin_swords_of_deflection_lef: The left one of a matched pair of hooked blades. With the right one in your off hand both land with each blow; a tenth of blows are critical, and the wielder is quicker. Use to parry: missiles turn back on their sender.

Needs attunement (set together with the right sword). Pair: needs the other half. Hold one in the main hand and the other in the off hand: the off-hand sword adds a second blow of 60% of the first (own cooldown of 0.6 seconds), and the pair-only effects wake. One half alone keeps its abilities at a small penalty.
The mirror of the right sword with all its abilities (Deflect, the crit, the speed) and shared cooldowns. 4.4 damage.

djinn_weapon.act.thunder_throw.desc: Hurls a bolt along your gaze that pierces up to five foes, slows them, and jumps on to the nearest others.
djinn_weapon.act.judgement_step.desc: Dashes forward in a trail of lightning, striking and slowing everything you pass.
djinn_weapon.act.sun_cleave.desc: A wide arc of sunfire in front of you: it burns every foe it touches and shoves them back.
djinn_weapon.act.ember_wall.desc: Raises a wall of flame two blocks ahead: foes in it burn and are thrown back; you shrug off fire for five seconds.
djinn_weapon.act.tide_spear.desc: A jet of water along your gaze: it hits everything in its line and pushes it away.
djinn_weapon.act.frost_surge.desc: A cone of freezing water: foes are hurt, frozen and slowed to a crawl.
djinn_weapon.act.cyclone_sweep.desc: Spins a ring of wind round you that throws every foe near you outward and up.
djinn_weapon.act.updraft_leap.desc: Leaps high on a column of wind (and floats down gently), lifting the foes at your feet.
djinn_weapon.act.bloom_heal.desc: A garden opens round you: you and your allies are healed and mended, foes are hurt and rooted by vines.
djinn_weapon.act.thorn_snare.desc: Thorns lash up to three foes in front of you: they are hurt, rooted and poisoned.
djinn_weapon.act.titan_slam.desc: Brings the axe down: a shockwave round you hurts every foe near, harder close in, and throws them into the air.
djinn_weapon.act.rock_breaker.desc: A crushing blow on up to three foes ahead: the more armour they wear the harder it lands, and it leaves them weakened and fragile.
djinn_weapon.act.resonance_wave.desc: A cone of sound: foes are hurt, thrown back and silenced.
djinn_weapon.act.dissonance.desc: A burst of clashing chords round you: foes near you are hurt, dizzied and slowed.
djinn_weapon.act.ember_rush.desc: Pounces forward in a streak of fire, setting alight everything in the path.
djinn_weapon.act.brand.desc: Brands the foe in your sights: it burns, glows, and takes more damage from everyone for eight seconds.
djinn_weapon.act.dawn_arrow.desc: Looses a shaft of dawn light that never drops: it strikes the first two foes in its line, twice as hard against the undead.
djinn_weapon.act.radiant_burst.desc: A flash of first light round you: foes are hurt and blinded, you and your allies are healed.
djinn_weapon.act.chain_lightning.desc: Lightning leaps from foe to foe, a little weaker at each jump.
djinn_weapon.act.storm_pillars.desc: Marks three places (on your foes, else ahead of you): a pillar of storm light falls on each a moment later, stilling what it hits.
djinn_weapon.act.crescent_wind.desc: Two crescents of wind sweep out to either side of your gaze, cutting everything in them and leaving the wounds bleeding.
djinn_weapon.act.heavenly_dash.desc: A dash on the wind, high and long, that cuts every foe on its way.
djinn_weapon.act.abyssal_reap.desc: A wide sweep of the scythe: foes are hurt and filled with dread, and a share of the harm comes back to you as health.
djinn_weapon.act.drowning_pull.desc: Pulls every foe near you in on a black whirlpool: they are hurt, slowed and lose their breath.
tooltip.nusmp.djinn_weapon.temp: A temporary weapon: %s's Djinn Equip made it. It lasts as long as the Equip; your own item is kept safe and returns when it ends.
tooltip.nusmp.djinn_weapon.admin: A weapon of %s's Djinn (admin). It does not depend on a Djinn Equip.
tooltip.nusmp.djinn_weapon.dark: Black rukh: it hits harder and drinks more Magoi.
tooltip.nusmp.djinn_weapon.act2: Sneak + right-click, Full Equip only: %s (%s%% of your Magoi, %s s)
tooltip.nusmp.djinn_weapon.rules: It cannot be dropped, stored or moved away from its slot; it is always back in your hand.
djinn_weapon.msg.returned: The Djinn weapon fades. Your own items are back.
djinn_weapon.msg.busy: The Djinn is gathering an Extreme Magic: the weapon is still.
djinn_weapon.msg.magoi: Your Magoi is too low for that.
djinn_weapon.msg.nothing: There is nothing in reach to strike.
djinn_weapon.cmd.nodjinn: That player holds no Djinn: name one (weapon give <player> <djinn> [dark]).
djinn_weapon.cmd.cleared: Removed %s Djinn weapon(s) from %s and ended the loan.
djinn_weapon.act.royal_decree.desc: A cone of royal command in front of you: foes are hurt, slowed and driven to their knees.
djinn_weapon.act.throne_quake.desc: The ground heaves round you: foes are hurt, thrown up, weakened and slowed.
djinn_weapon.act.tidal_lunge.desc: Lunges forward on a rushing tide: foes in the path are hurt, shoved and slowed.
djinn_weapon.act.undertow.desc: A pulling current drags every foe near you in and holds them, hurt and slowed.
djinn_weapon.act.spark_snatch.desc: Lightning snatches at the nearest foe and hops on to more, weakening each.
djinn_weapon.act.storm_heist.desc: A dash in a flash of lightning: foes in the path are hurt and slowed, and you are left quick.
djinn_weapon.act.wild_arrow.desc: A shaft of green light along your gaze strikes the first two foes and poisons them.
djinn_weapon.act.green_ambush.desc: Marks up to three foes (else ahead): thorned roots burst up a moment later, pinning and poisoning.
djinn_weapon.act.mirror_thrust.desc: A thrust of mirrored water along your gaze hits up to three foes and reveals them.
djinn_weapon.act.tide_mirror.desc: A mirror of water closes round you: Resistance and Absorption for you, and the foes near you are hurt and pushed back.
djinn_weapon.act.anchor_drop.desc: Brings the anchor down: a shock round you hurts foes, throws them up and cracks their guard.
djinn_weapon.act.shipwreck.desc: A wall of wrecked tide: foes in a broad band ahead are hurt, shoved back and slowed.
djinn_weapon.act.wing_hush.desc: A cone of white feathers: foes are hurt, silenced and thrown back.
djinn_weapon.act.muted_flurry.desc: A silent storm of feathers round you: foes near you are hurt, silenced and dizzied.
djinn_weapon.act.wheel_mend.desc: A turning wheel of light: you and your allies near you are healed, foes are hurt and weakened.
djinn_weapon.act.cleansing_spokes.desc: Spokes of green light cleanse every ailment from you and your allies and heal them, while the foes in reach are hurt and slowed.
djinn_weapon.act.star_spear.desc: A needle of starlight along your gaze strikes the first two foes and dazzles them.
djinn_weapon.act.peacock_fan.desc: A fan of a hundred eyes opens before you: foes are hurt, blinded and lit up.
djinn_weapon.act.charge_lance.desc: A mounted charge: you dash forward, and every foe in the path is hurt and flung aside.
djinn_weapon.act.dark_gallop.desc: A long gallop that tramples everything in its way and leaves you fast.
djinn_weapon.act.horn_note.desc: A single piercing note along your gaze hits up to three foes and dizzies them.
djinn_weapon.act.grand_chord.desc: A grand chord rings outward: foes near you are hurt, shoved far back and silenced.
djinn_weapon.act.hollow_cleave.desc: A hollow cleaving arc: foes are hurt, set alight and weakened.
djinn_weapon.act.throne_ash.desc: A burst of black ash: foes near you are hurt, burned and blinded.
djinn_weapon.act.pincer_snap.desc: The pincers snap shut on foes right ahead: they are hurt and held fast.
djinn_weapon.act.star_shell.desc: A shell of stars closes round you: a great deal of Absorption and Resistance for you, and the foes near you are hurt and dazzled.
djinn_weapon.act.swift_slash.desc: A flash of a dash that cuts everything in its path and leaves you quick.
djinn_weapon.act.gale_step.desc: A long step on the wind that cuts every foe on its way and leaves you moving fast.
djinn_weapon.act.forbidden_page.desc: A page of forbidden script flies along your gaze, striking the first two foes with dizziness and weakness.
djinn_weapon.act.many_faces.desc: Marks up to three foes (else ahead): a face of light looks up from each place a moment later, hurting and confusing.
djinn_weapon.act.seeker_bolt.desc: A bolt that finds what hides: it strikes up to three foes along your gaze, who are lit up.
djinn_weapon.act.unveil.desc: A flash of storm light over the area: foes near you are hurt, lit up and stripped of invisibility.
djinn_weapon.act.savage_rend.desc: Savage claws: foes right ahead are hurt and bleed.
djinn_weapon.act.bloodhound_rush.desc: A hound's rush: foes in the path are hurt and bleed, and a share comes back to you as health.
djinn_weapon.act.bull_gore.desc: A gore: you charge a few blocks, hurting and flinging the foes in the path.
djinn_weapon.act.great_work.desc: The Great Work: a burst round you hurts, poisons and weakens foes, and mends you with regeneration.
djinn_weapon.act.frost_bolt.desc: A bolt of cold along your gaze strikes the first two foes, freezing and slowing them.
djinn_weapon.act.rime_field.desc: A field of rime spreads round you: foes near you are hurt, frozen and slowed.
djinn_weapon.act.ice_wind_sweep.desc: A sweeping ice wind: a broad cone of foes is hurt, frozen and thrown back.
djinn_weapon.act.knights_gale.desc: A knight's charge on an ice wind: foes in the path are hurt, chilled and flung aside.
djinn_weapon.act.triple_flame.desc: Three tongues of flame leap from foe to foe, setting each alight.
djinn_weapon.act.prophecy.desc: Foretells three places (on your foes, else ahead): fire falls on each a moment later.
djinn_weapon.act.lion_slash.desc: Three clean claw-strokes of fire: foes in the cone are hurt and burn.
djinn_weapon.act.lions_roar.desc: A lion's roar: foes near you are hurt, weakened and filled with fear.
djinn_weapon.act.crow_flock.desc: A flock of crows streams from foe to foe, a little weaker at each peck.
djinn_weapon.act.murder_of_crows.desc: Marks up to three foes (else ahead): a murder of crows dives on each a moment later, filling them with fear.
djinn_weapon.act.death_drum.desc: A drumbeat you feel in your bones: foes round you are hurt, dizzied and thrown back.
djinn_weapon.act.funeral_march.desc: A slow funeral march: foes near you are drawn in, hurt, slowed and afraid.

item.nusmp.demon_shovel.card:
Rare shovel. Made by a demon for unknown purposes: evil mining, evil hole digging or, dare it be said, evil gardening.
Necrotic Blade: every hit deals 3.5 extra necrotic damage and withers the target for two seconds.
Evil Mining: while held, you break blocks 50% faster.
Evil Gardening (use, 20 s cooldown): up to twelve crops, saplings and plants within five blocks grow as if bone-mealed. Does nothing inside the Labyrinth or the Dungeon.
Evil Hole Digging (sneak + use, 2% of your magicules, 15 s cooldown): a pit of shadow opens three blocks round the spot you point at; foes in it take 5 damage, are slowed and weakened for three seconds and are pulled down.
item.nusmp.demon_shovel.desc: A fabulously lavender shovel made by a demon for unknown, probably evil, purposes. It hits with necrotic force, digs fast, coaxes the garden to grow (evil gardening) and opens a pit of shadow under your foes (sneak + use).
item.nusmp.dragoons_halberd.card:
Rare halberd (+1). The traditional weapon of the Dragoons, a military force trained to fight dragons. Reach +0.75.
Dragonslayer: hits against dragons, wyverns, drakes and wyrms deal 4 extra damage.
Drop Attack: a blow landed while falling (a fall of a block and a half or more) bursts in a two-block radius for 3.5 extra damage of the chosen element: Fire (sets alight), Frost (slows), Lightning (briefly paralyses) or Wind (throws up).
Choose the Element (use): cycles Fire, Frost, Lightning, Wind.
Dragoon's Leap (sneak + use, 8 s cooldown): leap up and forward, ready to come down on something.
item.nusmp.dragoons_halberd.desc: The halberd of the Dragoons, who train to fight dragons. It hits draconic creatures harder, and a blow struck while falling bursts in two blocks with an element of your choice (use to change it); sneak + use leaps.
item.nusmp.efreetis_kusarigama.card:
Rare sickle (reach, two-handed), requires attunement. Damage 1d6 slashing + 2 fire.
Solid Flame Blade: +2 to attacks; every hit adds 2 fire damage and sets the target alight. Reach +1.5, fire damage reduced by a quarter.
Grip of the Fire Genie (use, 15 s cooldown): the chain wraps a foe within nine blocks. It is pulled to within three blocks, rooted for six seconds (one round), and takes 3.5 fire damage when first gripped and every two seconds after. Bosses are slowed but not pulled. The grip breaks if you swap items, the foe dies or gets more than fourteen blocks away.
item.nusmp.efreetis_kusarigama.desc: A flame sickle on a long chain with an ember at its end. It reaches further, burns what it cuts, and the Grip of the Fire Genie wraps the chain round a foe, pulls it in and scorches it for six seconds.
item.nusmp.ilmare_gin_the_starlight_silv:
Rare weapon (katana), requires attunement. 1d8 slashing, finesse, versatile (1d10), thrown (20/60, 1d8 piercing).
+1 weapon; versatile: with an empty off-hand every hit deals 1.5 extra damage.
Starlight Throw (use, 5 s cooldown): throw the katana along your sight line up to twenty blocks (the old 20 ft was too short for a world of blocks). It deals 4.5 damage to the first foe in your sights, or bites into the block you aimed at.
Star Step (sneak + use, 2 s cooldown, within five seconds of the throw): teleport to the impact, gripping the weapon. Works on foes and on solid objects alike; needs room to stand.

A slim midnight-blue katana flecked with starlight. Use throws it along your sight line (twenty blocks); within five seconds sneak + use steps you along the starlight to where it struck and into your hand.
item.nusmp.katana_of_carnage.card:
Rare, requires attunement. +2 magical katana of sharpness (the printed text is cut off after this line; the rest is a fitting invention).
Sharpness: one blow in twenty severs: +40% damage and a poisoning wound for four seconds.
Carnage (invented): each kill within eight seconds of the last adds a stack (up to five) of +1 damage per stack; at five stacks each kill also heals one heart.
Bloodlust (use, 10 s cooldown): spends all stacks for three seconds of speed and haste per stack, and heals half a heart per stack.
item.nusmp.katana_of_carnage.desc: A +2 katana of sharpness with a blood-stained charm: one blow in twenty severs. Every kill within eight seconds of the last feeds Carnage (up to five stacks of added damage); use spends the stacks on speed, haste and a little blood back.
Very rare longsword (versatile), requires attunement by a Fighter or Ranger. 1d8 (1d10) +2 slashing.
Folded Steel: +2 weapon.
Deflection: when a melee blow strikes you while you hold the katana, there is a 45% chance (once every three seconds) that it is turned aside entirely, and you answer it with a normal attack of 6 damage.
Swift and Deadly (use, once per day, 5% of your magicules): Steel Wind Strike: 7 damage to each of up to five foes within eight blocks, and you end the strike beside the last of them.
A +2 folded-steel katana. It may turn a melee blow aside and answer it (one in two, every three seconds), and once a day Steel Wind Strike flickers you between up to five foes within eight blocks.
item.nusmp.lightworkers_scepter.card:
Heavy weapon, two-handed, sentient, requires attunement (clerics and paladins). A voice within gives guidance on compassion, mercy and virtue.
Ability scores (Intelligence and Wisdom +5, saves +2): +10% maximum magicules and +15% resistance to magic and darkness.
Psychic Resistance: fear, confusion, insanity and hypnosis slide off you.
Ward of Light: resisting a magical blow heals you two points, up to twenty a day.
Rechannel Energy (use, five a day): heals you ten points (and regenerates) and friends within eight blocks six each.
Soothing Presence (sneak + use, three a day): for a minute everyone within six blocks is soothed: friends regenerate and shake off fear, hostile mobs forget their anger.
Soulgate (once a day, automatic): a blow that would kill you is turned aside and you wake at four hearts, strongly protected for four seconds.
Mighty Ethereal Light (worn-relic key, once a day, 15% of your magicules): smite every foe within ten blocks of the one you are looking at (or of the spot ahead) for 14 damage, 21 against the undead.
Smite the Undead: hits against the undead deal 4 extra damage.
item.nusmp.lightworkers_scepter.desc: A feather-winged scepter with a kind voice. Rechannel Energy mends you and your friends (five a day), Soothing Presence calms a ring of six blocks (sneak + use), and the worn-relic key calls Mighty Ethereal Light. Once a day it pulls you out of a killing blow.
item.nusmp.mjolnir.card:
Rare warhammer. 1d8 bludgeoning. Can also be used as a projectile and be summoned back. Able to cast Lightning Bolt once per day.
Worthy: lightning damage to you is halved; hits against wet foes (in water or rain) deal 3 extra damage.
Hammer Throw (use, 4 s cooldown): the hammer flies up to twenty-four blocks down your sight line, strikes up to three foes for 8 damage and is back in your hand at once.
Lightning Bolt (sneak + use, once per day): a bolt along your sight line, 1.6 blocks wide, up to 24 blocks: 12 lightning damage to every foe in it (18 in a thunderstorm) and sets them alight.
item.nusmp.mjolnir.desc: The hammer of knotted steel. Use throws it down your sight line (it is back in your hand at once); sneak + use calls a Lightning Bolt once a day. It shrugs off lightning and shocks wet foes.
item.nusmp.overprotective_halberd.card:
Very rare halberd, requires attunement (spellcaster). The Vasteel crest is etched into it: it must have belonged to a Knight of Vasteel.
+2 weapon (reach +0.75).
Hover (use, 4% of your magicules): the halberd rises and hovers round you for three minutes. Whenever a creature within three blocks hits you in melee, it strikes that creature for 8 damage, once every two seconds (one round is six seconds, a reaction here is two). It works whether or not you hold it, as long as you carry it. Use again to call it back.
item.nusmp.overprotective_halberd.desc: A Vasteel halberd trailing red ribbons. Use sends it hovering round you for three minutes: it strikes back at whoever hits you in melee, once every two seconds, even when it is not in your hand. Use again to call it back.
item.nusmp.phoenix_flame.card:
Rare weapon (halberd), requires attunement. Heavy, reach, two-handed. 1d10 slashing.
Command Word (use): speak the word and flames erupt from the blade. While it is ablaze, every hit adds 7 fire damage (2d6) and sets the target alight, and the flames light the dark around you (night vision). They last until you speak again, drop the halberd or stow it.
Reach +1; fire damage to you reduced by 30%.
item.nusmp.phoenix_flame.desc: A halberd whose blade is a swept-wing phoenix. Use speaks the command word: flames erupt, light the dark around you and add fire damage to every hit. They burn until you speak again, drop the halberd or stow it.
item.nusmp.primal_chaos.card:
A rapier forged by the Gods designed specifically to destroy the creatures of the void. Though it is pointy and works on others too. 1d4 radiant. (The card is only partly drawn: the hilt and the lunge are invented.)
Radiant Point: every hit adds 2.5 radiant damage; against void creatures (the End's folk, shulkers, phantoms, vexes, wardens, anything called void) it adds 8.5 and locks them in place for two seconds.
Void Rend (use, 8 s cooldown): lunge five blocks, piercing up to five foes in a line for 5 damage (11 against void creatures, which cannot slip away for three seconds).
item.nusmp.primal_chaos.desc: A rapier of light forged by the gods to destroy the creatures of the void, though it is pointy and works on others too. It adds radiant damage, far more against void creatures, and Void Rend lunges through a line of foes.
item.nusmp.ravens_wing.card:
Rare, requires attunement. +2 glaive, 1d10+2 slashing, heavy, reach, two-handed. Reach +1.
Psychopomp (once per short rest): Toll the Dead (use, 2 minutes): a bell tolls in a creature's bones for 4.5 damage, 9 if it is already wounded; a creature that holds its ground (40%, always a boss) takes half. Spare the Dying (sneak + use, 2 minutes): the nearest dying friend within ten blocks (half health or less) is steadied: healed three hearts and regenerating.
Raven Sense (worn-relic key, three a day): ravens scout for you: every creature within thirty blocks is outlined for ten seconds and you gain Tensura's magic sense and danger sense for three minutes.
item.nusmp.ravens_wing.desc: A +2 glaive with a raven's wing for a blade. Use tolls the dead at a creature in sight, sneak + use spares a dying friend, and the worn-relic key sends ravens to scout (three a day).
item.nusmp.rift_breaker.card:
Rare spear (6.5 damage, quick). Requires attunement.
The tip of this spear is a strange crystal, sharp enough to pierce the fabric of reality.
Reach. +0.5 blocks of reach while held.
Rift Strike (four times a day, short cooldown). Two rifts open, one by you and one by the creature you see within 18 blocks, and the spear strikes it from any direction (9 damage). Sneak-use instead: the spear flies the rift line and cuts up to four creatures on it (8 damage each).
Dimension Door (once a day). Blink up to 24 blocks along your look to a safe spot; the Tensura skill Spatial Motion is lent for ten seconds if it exists.
Escape Rift (once only; sneak and hold, 3% magicules). Drive the butt into the ground three blocks ahead: a circle of teleportation 3 blocks across opens for six seconds. Anyone who steps into it (you included) is carried 30 to 60 blocks away to a safe spot. The spear is destroyed.
Tabletop became: 'once per long rest' = once per Minecraft day; '60 ft' = 18 blocks, '10 ft circle' = a 3 block doorway; 'an unknown location determined by the DM' = a random safe place 30 to 60 blocks away; 'one round' = 6 seconds; 'throw (range 60 ft)' = the sneak-use rift line.
item.nusmp.rift_breaker.desc: A spear with a crystal tip sharp enough to pierce reality. Once a day a Dimension Door; four times a day it strikes through a rift at a creature up to 18 blocks away (sneak: it flies the rift line and cuts everything on it). Once only, drive it into the ground to open an escape circle: the spear is destroyed.
item.nusmp.scimitar_of_the_seasons.card:
Unique scimitar (7.5 damage, quick).
Changing of the Seasons. The edge follows the calendar: a Minecraft year is four seasons of eight days each, spring first.
Command Word (use; use again to dismiss). While it is on, every blow adds 2d6 (7) of the season's kind: radiant in spring (and a glow on the target), fire in summer (the target burns), necrotic in autumn (Wither) and cold in winter (frostbite and Slowness). Two seasonal bites are at least 8 ticks apart.
Tabletop became: 'bonus action' = a use of the weapon; 'the weapon's appearance changes' = the glow colour of the bite (the held model is one model for all seasons); the real-world season = the in-game day count.
item.nusmp.scimitar_of_the_seasons.desc: A jade scimitar on a twisted branch. Speak the word (use it) and every blow bites for 2d6 extra of the season's kind: radiant in spring, fire in summer, necrotic in autumn, cold in winter. A season lasts eight Minecraft days. Use it again to dismiss the effect.
item.nusmp.silver_wind_mountain_glaive.c:
Rare glaive (10 damage, slow). Requires attunement.
A giant's double-headed glaive, nearly 12 feet from blade to blade. Heavy, two-handed, long reach (+1.5 blocks); the Tensura skill Wind Attack Resistance is lent while held.
Charges. Ten charges; about one comes back every 2.7 minutes (7 to 8 a day) while the glaive is in your hand.
Forceful Strike (1 charge). A gust cone 8 blocks long: foes in it are thrown back and cut for 3, missiles are pushed away.
Whirlwind Maneuver (2 charges, twice a day). For five seconds a storm 4 blocks out spins round you: you cannot walk, and every half second foes inside are dragged in and cut for 3.
Become the Hurricane (5 charges, 1% existence points). Steel Wind Strike: up to five foes within 9 blocks are cut for 8 each in a row.
Tabletop became: 'Strength 20 and speaking Giant' to attune = the glaive is simply heavy and slow; Gust of Wind, Whirlwind and Steel Wind Strike = the effects above; charges per long rest = a slow trickle while held.
item.nusmp.silver_wind_mountain_glaive.d: A cloud giant's double-headed glaive with ten charges. Forceful Strike blasts a gale in front of you, Whirlwind roots you in a spinning storm that drags foes in, Become the Hurricane strikes up to five foes like a steel wind. Charges come back, about seven a day.
item.nusmp.spider_sword.card:
Rare scimitar (5.5 damage, quick). Requires attunement.
Coated with a poisonous resin: every blow adds 3 magic damage and Poison (6 seconds on creatures, 3 on players). The Tensura skill Poison Resistance is lent while held.
Spider Climb. A short dash, then for ten seconds you stick to walls: push against one to climb it, sneak to hold still; the Tensura skill Sticky Steel Thread is lent for the same time.
Web Snare. Spin a web at the creature in your sights within 14 blocks: heavy Slowness and Weakness (8 seconds; 3 on players).
Tabletop became: 'Dash action' = the Spider Climb use; 'walk on webs' = the climb and the lent thread skill; 'spin webs of any size' = Web Snare; 1d10 poison = 3 damage and Poison.
item.nusmp.spider_sword.desc: A scimitar coated in poisonous red resin: every hit adds poison. Dash and the soles stick: for ten seconds you climb walls like a spider. Spin a web to bind a thief in place.
item.nusmp.stick_of_youth.card:
Rare club (5 damage). No attunement. (The card prints no rarity.)
To grown-ups it looks like a plain stick. In young hands it takes the form of any common weapon.
Take Form (use). The stick cycles club, sword, axe, spear, dagger and back. Club: a plain blow. Sword: 120% and the creatures at the target's side take 30%. Axe: 140%; a raised shield is knocked down and cooling down. Spear: 110%; the creature behind the target takes 40%. Dagger: 85%.
Tabletop became: 'adulthood' = no check: everyone is young at heart (a stated choice); 'proficiency bonus only if proficient with the chosen weapon' = the form multipliers above; 'any weapon from the table' = five forms.
item.nusmp.stick_of_youth.desc: A knotted wooden stick that looks like a plain club. In young hands it can take the form of any common weapon: use it to turn it from club to sword, axe, spear and dagger, and each form strikes the way that weapon does.
item.nusmp.sun_gift.card:
Rare twin glaive (11 damage). Requires attunement (the card asks for level 15: a stated drop). The card prints no rarity.
Heavy, two-handed, +1.5 blocks of reach; Light Attack Resistance is lent while held. Every blow adds 2d6 (7) radiant damage.
Charges. Four charges; one returns about every 2.8 minutes of daylight (clear sky, no rain) while the glaive is in your hand, 3 to 4 a day.
Guiding Bolt (1 charge). A bolt of light up to 24 blocks: 8 radiant damage and the target glows.
Fireball (2 charges). Fire where you look, 4 blocks across: 11 damage and burning. No blocks are harmed.
Flame Strike (3 charges). A column of fire and light, 3 blocks across: 14 fire and 10 radiant damage.
Firebolt (no charge). One bolt of fire for 6 damage; the card allows it only while stunned: it is at will here.
Tabletop became: 'spell save and attack modifiers' = fixed damage; 'recharges 1d4+1 per day on sunlight' = charging in daylight.
item.nusmp.sun_gift.desc: A twin-bladed glaive that drinks sunlight: every blow adds radiant damage. Four charges (they come back in the sun) cast Guiding Bolt, Fireball and Flame Strike; a Firebolt needs no charge.
item.nusmp.the_last_horseman.card:
Rare scythe (11 damage, slow). Requires attunement (the card asks for level 15: a stated drop). The card prints no rarity.
Reach +1.5 blocks; Darkness Attack Resistance is lent while held. Every blow adds 4.5 necrotic damage.
Damage reduces maximum health. Each blow takes 4% of the target's maximum health (at most 30%) for five minutes; it comes back sooner when the target logs out.
Spare the Dying. The most hurt ally (or you) within 6 blocks is steadied: 4 health and Regeneration.
Speak With Dead. Every undead creature within 24 blocks glows for ten seconds; you see in the dark and are told how many there are.
Find Steed: Nightmare (once a day, 2% magicules). A saddled skeletal horse, tamed to you, fast and fire-proof, for five minutes; you mount it.
Charges. Two charges; one returns each Minecraft day.
Create Undead (1 charge, 1% existence points). Three wither skeletons rise as your servants for three minutes.
Word of Ruin (1 charge, 2% existence points). Power Word Kill became a death word that never kills outright: 12 plus a third of the target's maximum health (capped on players) and Wither.
item.nusmp.the_last_horseman.desc: A scythe wreathed in violet flame. Its blows add necrotic damage and eat away at the target's maximum health. It can steady the dying, sense the dead, summon a Nightmare to ride, and with its two charges raise undead or speak a Word of Ruin.
item.nusmp.the_legacy.card:
Rare warhammer (10 damage). Requires attunement. The card prints no rarity.
The head levitates above the handle. +3.5 blocks of reach while held; Electricity Resistance is lent. Every blow adds 1d8 (4.5) thunder damage.
Toss the Head. The head flies up to 36 blocks along your look and strikes up to six creatures on the line for 10. The hammer is headless for eight seconds: its blows are an improvised club (40%) and carry no thunder.
Recall (sneak-use). The head slams back at once and strikes the foes within 5 blocks for 5.
Tabletop became: '30 ft attack range' = +3.5 blocks of reach; '120 ft toss' = 36 blocks; 'headless, 1d6 improvised' = 40% blows.
item.nusmp.the_legacy.desc: A warhammer whose head levitates above its handle: it reaches 3.5 blocks farther and every blow adds thunder. Toss the head up to 36 blocks to hit everything on the line; until it returns the hammer is a poor improvised club.
item.nusmp.the_librarians_maul.card:
Rare maul (9 damage, slow). No attunement. The card prints no rarity.
Strength and Intelligence both land the blow. Intelligence became experience: every experience level adds 0.15 damage (at most 6). With the off hand empty (two-handed, the d12) the whole blow is 15% heavier.
Quiet Please. The book slams shut: foes within 4 blocks take 7 damage, are slowed and silenced (6 seconds; 2 on players).
Tabletop became: 'Intelligence modifier' = experience levels; 'versatile 1d8 / 1d12' = the off-hand bonus.
item.nusmp.the_librarians_maul.desc: A granite book on a pole. Strength and learning both land the blow: every experience level adds damage, and with the off hand empty it hits like the two-handed 1d12. Quiet Please slams the book shut: nearby foes are hurt, slowed and silenced.
item.nusmp.time_hammer.card:
Legendary warhammer (12 damage). Requires attunement. Can be a Djinn Metal Vessel.
Forged by an ancient chronomancer. Spatial Attack Resistance is lent while held.
Stop (three times a day, 1.5% existence points, long cooldown). Time Stop: every foe within 12 blocks is frozen (heavy Slowness, Weakness and mining fatigue) for five seconds (three on players) and forgets its target; you move at Speed III and Haste III for the same time.
Hammertime. In the last two seconds of the stop (and a second after) your next blow with the hammer is a thunderous smite: +12 lightning damage, a shove and Slowness. Once per stop.
Tabletop became: 'Time Stop' = the freeze above, never a true halt; 'Thunderous Smite' = the smite; 'last round' = the last 40 ticks.
item.nusmp.time_hammer.desc: A chronomancer's stone hammer. Three times a day raise it and say Stop: every foe near you freezes for five seconds while you move at haste. Strike in the last two seconds and call Hammertime for a thunderous smite.
item.nusmp.vanguard_hammer.card:
Rare warhammer (8.5 damage). Requires attunement.
War Cry (once a day, long cooldown). You smash the ground and shout: every foe in a 12-block cone (60 degrees either side) takes 4 damage and may be frightened (75% on creatures, 40% on players, less with Tensura resistance): the Tensura effect Fear for a minute (8 seconds on players), and creatures run from you.
Tabletop became: 'DC 15 Wisdom save' = the fear chance; '1 minute' = 1200 ticks; 'must Dash away' = the Fear effect plus a flee order; '40 ft' = 12 blocks.
item.nusmp.vanguard_hammer.desc: A banded steel warhammer with a crimson ribbon. Once a day let out a war cry and smash the ground: every creature in a 12-block cone is frightened for a minute and runs from you.
item.nusmp.willbreaker.card:
Rare war hammer (8 damage). No attunement. The card prints no rarity.
The cries of its previous owners. On a critical hit the air fills with battle cries: the target and the foes within 3 blocks of it may be frightened (75% on creatures, 40% on players): the Tensura effect Fear for a minute (8 seconds on players).
Battle Cries (long cooldown). Call them on purpose: every foe within 6 blocks may be frightened.
Tabletop became: 'Critical Hit' = a vanilla critical blow (jumping and falling); 'Wisdom saving throw' = the fear chance.
item.nusmp.willbreaker.desc: A war hammer that carries the battle cries of its dead owners. A critical hit fills the air with them: the target, and the foes beside it, may be frightened. Call the cries on purpose to frighten everything close.
item.nusmp.dreamcore_woven_wand.card: Requires attunement. Spell focus: spell costs are 5% lower and chanting 5% faster. Dream Scryer (3 dreams a day in all, shared by the three dream keys): Sweet Dream (use) lets a creature in sight sleep well: an ally or you gain Regeneration and a little Absorption and lose fear, nausea and darkness; a foe drifts into a pleasant dream, is slowed and weakened and drops its target. Nightmare (sneak-use) traps a foe in fear, nausea and a stumble (a boss or another player only briefly). Wake (third key) ends every dream-like effect on a creature and gets a sleeper up. Read the Dream (fourth key, free) says whether a creature is in a nightmare, a neutral dream or a sweet dream, by the helpful and harmful effects on it. Tabletop replaced: +1 to spell attacks, damage and DC became a small Tensura spell-cost and chant-speed bonus; the command word became a key; the nightmare / neutral / sweet dream became the effects on the creature; 3 uses per day is a shared daily counter.
item.nusmp.dreamcore_woven_wand.desc: A twisted wand wrapped in crimson cloth, with a pink and blue dream-crystal at its tip. Use it to give a creature a sweet dream, sneak-use for a nightmare; two more keys wake a sleeper and read a creature's dream. Three dreams a day.
item.nusmp.lich_wand.card: Requires attunement. While you hold it: you need no air (Water Breathing), your food never falls below four drumsticks, the sleepless night never counts against you (no phantoms), and Tensura darkness attacks hurt less. Healing you receive grows 15% stronger but leaves you gaunt (Weakness for 5 seconds, at most once every 10 seconds).
