arc.dialogue.marx_francois.25: Warning on file: fighters from other worlds do not follow Clover Kingdom protocol. Plan accordingly.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.26: Return alive. The paperwork is shorter.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.27: Report back when you have results.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.28: Good luck. Strictly speaking, I am not permitted to say that.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.1: Hah! Fresh blood! I'm Mereoleona Vermillion. Don't bow, it makes my neck hurt.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.2: You look like you can take a punch. Good. I've been bored.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.3: Are you strong? No, don't answer. I'll find out.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.4: THAT'S you? The one clearing the guardians? Come here, let me see your arms!
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.5: Oh, it's you again. Have you been training?
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.6: Ha! Still in one piece. Excellent!
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.7: Mana Zone! Learn it! If you can't feel the magic around you, you're fighting blind, and I will laugh at you.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.8: Mana Strike is raw power with no tricks. I like it. It works on anything, and nobody can call it cheating.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.9: Talking won't make you stronger. Training will. Go hit something big!
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.10: Retreat? Never. Fall back to a Safe Zone and come back angrier. That's different.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.11: Fuegoleon thinks too much and Leopold shouts too much. The Crimson Lion is balanced by me, naturally.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.12: Pain is only information. Read it, and move on.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.13: No champions beaten? Hah! Then go beat one. Why are you still talking to me?
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.14: The Eye of the Midnight Sun are the first of many. Break them quickly, and keep your anger. It keeps you warm.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.15: You beat Vetto? That monster hit like a mountain. Come here, I'll buy you meat.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.16: A Spade Kingdom brat with gravity? Don't stand where he wants you standing. Move!
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.17: Lucius! I'd love to fight someone who reads my moves... and then break his nose with the one he didn't read.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.18: Strangers from other worlds in the Chronicle? Even better! Go, and bring me the strongest one's name.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.19: Go! Don't come back until you've broken something!
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.20: Bring me a good story, or a good bruise.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.1: Oh! Hello, I'm Mimosa Vermillion. Please don't be nervous, I'm only a Golden Dawn knight. ...Only.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.2: Welcome to the Sanctuary, %1$s! I hope you're not hurt. Healing is the one thing I'm good at, so please take care of yourself.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.3: Hello! Please take care of yourself down there. I'll worry otherwise.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.4: You've already beaten champions... you must be so tired. Please, rest and take care of yourself.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.5: %1$s! You came back safe. I'm so glad.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.6: Oh, hello again! You look tired. Please rest first.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.7: Rest in a Safe Zone or at a Landing whenever you can. Your body won't mend by itself down there, however brave you feel.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.8: Plants remember where the light was. If a room feels wrong, look at what grows in it.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.9: Flowers can't fight, but they can hold a wall. I think healing and protecting are the same thing.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.10: Eat before you go, and bring something for your friends. Nobody fights well on an empty stomach.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.11: Fuegoleon and Mereoleona are my brother and sister. I joined the Golden Dawn on my own, so nobody could say it was because of my name.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.12: I used to think only people with strong magic mattered. I was wrong, and it took my friends to show me.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.13: You haven't fought a champion yet, have you? Please take a friend with you for the first one.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.14: The Eye of the Midnight Sun frightens me. But I saw my friends stand up to them, and I want to stand up too.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.15: I heard Heath Grice is gone. I'm glad it's over, but I wish nobody had to be hurt like that.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.16: The Zogratis curses don't fade on their own. If you're marked, please don't hide it from your party. Tell them.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.17: Lucius... please, whoever you go with, hold each other's hands before you start. Even if it sounds silly.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.18: There are so many people from other worlds fighting down there. I hope they'll let us help them someday.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.20: I'll leave a flower here for you. Bring it back with a story!
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.1: Nozel Silva, captain of the Silver Eagle. State your business, or do not. I have little interest either way.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.2: A new delver. Do not expect special treatment because you stand on royal ground. Do expect honesty.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.3: Hmph. At least you do not shout. That puts you ahead of most.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.4: I have heard of you, %1$s. Do not let it go to your head.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.7: Mercury flows into every gap. A defence with no gap is worth more than ten attacks. Remember that.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.8: Do not mistake courage for competence. The dungeon punishes the first and rewards the second.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.9: Pride is not strength. But strength that does not know its worth is wasted. I speak from experience.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.10: Family is a matter of effort, not blood. ...Forget that I said that.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.11: A telegraphed blow is a gift. Anyone who dies to one has only himself to blame.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.12: Armour, barrier, mercury: choose what suits you, then trust it. Doubt kills faster than any blade.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.13: No champions defeated. Then you have much to prove. Begin by surviving the first one.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.14: The Eye of the Midnight Sun means to rewrite this kingdom. I do not intend to let them. Neither should you.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.15: The Eye has lost another piece. Continue.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.16: Spade Kingdom gravity can pin even armour. Do not lean on silver or steel to bear a weight meant for resolve.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.17: If you intend to face Lucius, do it as a unit. A single blade will not matter.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.18: The Chronicle holds strangers now. Fine. I will judge them as I judge everyone: by what they do under pressure.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.1: Solid Silva, Silver Eagle. Yes, those Silvas. Try not to look too impressed.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.2: Another delver? How tedious. ...Well, at least you are not shouting.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.3: You look like you need advice. Lucky for you I give it free. Do not expect it to be nice.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.4: So you are the delver who keeps turning up in the reports. I suppose I should say well done. ...There. I said it.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.7: Water takes the shape of whatever holds it. A mage who cannot adapt is just a puddle with pride.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.8: My family has a talent for looking down on people. I am working on it. Slowly.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.9: Do not waste mana on showy spells. Anyone can make a big splash. The trick is being the one still standing afterwards.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.10: My little sister turned out to be stronger than the rest of us. I will not say that out loud again.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.11: The tide goes out, the tide comes in. If you are losing a fight, remember the tide: pull back, then return stronger.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.12: No champions beaten? Fine. We all start somewhere. Some of us started with servants. Never mind.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.13: The Eye of the Midnight Sun are fanatics. Fanatics make mistakes when you wreck their plans. So wreck them.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.14: You beat Vetto? ...Tch. Fine. Good work. Do not make me say it twice.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.15: Spade Kingdom. Dark nonsense. Wash off the curses after every fight there.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.16: Lucius? Let somebody else go first. ...I am joking. Mostly.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.17: People from beyond our world in the Chronicle? Splendid. More people to out-perform.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.18: Do not die. It would be embarrassing for the Sanctuary.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.19: Go on. I have things to look down on.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.1: I am William Vangeance, captain of the Golden Dawn. You are welcome here, %1$s, as everyone is.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.2: The Sanctuary is a good place to set a burden down for an afternoon. I know something of burdens.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.3: You have the look of someone choosing a road. I will only say: choose it with open eyes.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.4: You have walked far already, %1$s. I will not waste your time with pleasantries.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.7: The World Tree has roots beneath every floor of this dungeon, if you know how to look. Wherever something grows, it is trying to tell you something.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.8: A captain is judged by those who stand behind him. I have not always been worthy of mine.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.9: Trust is easy to give and hard to win back. If someone offers you a second chance, take it, and spend your life deserving it.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.10: Be kind to people who wear masks. They usually have their reasons.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.11: Healing and growing are the same craft. A wound closes the way a seedling opens: slowly, and toward the light.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.12: Do not carry your doubts into a fight. Leave them here with me; I have room.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.13: You have not faced a champion yet. Good. Go slowly: your first impression of the dungeon will last.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.14: The Eye of the Midnight Sun's grief is older than their quarrel with us. I do not forgive them, but I understand it. That makes the fight harder, not easier.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.15: Zagred's words reached further than anyone knew. Some of them reached me. I am glad that voice is silenced.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.16: The Spade Kingdom's strength is taken from other people. Remember that when it merely looks powerful.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.17: When you face Lucius, remember that Julius is not gone. He fights beside you in that battle. I would stake what is left of my name on it.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.18: A tree grows toward whatever light there is, even another world's sun. I would like to learn from these newcomers.
arc.dialogue.yuno.1: %1$s. I have not seen you here before. I am Yuno, of the Golden Dawn.
arc.dialogue.yuno.2: A new delver. If you are going into the dungeon, go in with a plan. Ask me what you want to know.
arc.dialogue.yuno.3: Hm. You look like you have not decided whether to be brave or careful. Be both.
arc.dialogue.yuno.4: So you are the one the guardians keep losing to. I wanted to meet you, %1$s.
arc.dialogue.yuno.6: Still in one piece. That is a good start.
arc.dialogue.yuno.7: My rival would charge in first and think afterwards. I prefer the other order. Both work, if you survive.
arc.dialogue.yuno.8: Wind never pushes for the sake of pushing. It goes where the resistance is least. Fight the same way.
arc.dialogue.yuno.9: A spirit lends its strength only to someone it trusts. Treat the one that chose you as a partner, not a tool.
arc.dialogue.yuno.10: Spirit Dive asks a great deal of you both. Do not stay in it longer than the strain allows.
arc.dialogue.yuno.11: Mana runs lower down there than it feels. If your magic starts to stutter, step back and breathe before you cast again.
arc.dialogue.yuno.12: I mean to become Wizard King. So does Asta. Neither of us can afford to lose to anything in this dungeon.
arc.dialogue.yuno.13: You have not beaten a single champion yet. Start with the Eye of the Midnight Sun on the early floors. They are strong, but they are the first step, not the last.
arc.dialogue.yuno.14: Read the Chronicle in the plaza before you go down. It shows which fights are open to you and which are not.
arc.dialogue.yuno.15: You are making progress against the Eye of the Midnight Sun. Do not grow comfortable: the ones who lead them are far beyond the first.
arc.dialogue.yuno.16: Heath Grice is down? Then you know the Eye's soldiers can be beaten. Remember how you did it.
arc.dialogue.yuno.17: You brought Vetto down: all brawn and no mercy, and you still found a way. I am impressed.
arc.dialogue.yuno.18: The Spade Kingdom. The Zogratis name carries a weight the Eye never had: gravity, blood and bone. Prepare for each of them separately.
arc.dialogue.yuno.19: Lucius Zogratis. Even the Wizard King could not end him alone. Do not enter his arena unless you can fight as a team.
arc.dialogue.yuno.20: There are fighters in the Chronicle I have never heard of, from worlds I have never seen. I intend to measure myself against every one.
arc.dialogue.yuno.22: May the wind be at your back.
arc.dialogue.yuno.23: I will be here when you return. Try to make that certain.
message.nusmp.arc.early.revchi.bound: Chained for %s s: strike him to tear the links, or use anti-magic.
message.nusmp.arc.early.revchi.free: The chain breaks: you are free.
message.nusmp.arc.early.heath.shielded: The ice shield swallows it: close in, or use anti-magic.
message.nusmp.arc.early.lotus.fall: The smoke has you: you stumble.
message.nusmp.arc.early.mars.guarded: The crystal turns the blow: strike from the side, or use anti-magic.
message.nusmp.arc.early.vetto.shielded: A wall stands between you and the Mana Release.
item.nusmp.chronicle_sigil.tip.lore: Every saga is written down somewhere. This seal carries you to the page where the next boss waits.
item.nusmp.chronicle_sigil.tip.use: At the Chronicle in the Sanctuary Hub: click the lectern to choose a boss, then hold right click for 3 seconds. You and every player within 8 blocks (party first) are carried to that boss's arena. Hold again inside an arena to go home. Sneak and right click cycles the choice.
item.nusmp.chronicle_sigil.tip.rules: Only at the Chronicle and inside an arena. Not while hurt, nor while the arena fights or rests (leaving mid-fight takes 10 seconds). 30 second cooldown after coming home.
message.nusmp.arc.saga_clear: [Story] %s is cleared. The Chronicle pays its reward.
message.nusmp.arc.chronicle.protected: The Chronicle and the Promenade are protected.
message.nusmp.arc.arena.withdraws: The boss withdraws. The arena is quiet for 60 seconds.
message.nusmp.arc.arena.no_boss: %s does not answer. Try again in a minute.
message.nusmp.arc.arena.won: %s has fallen. The arena is yours.
message.nusmp.arc.arena.fell: You fell in the arena. Your belongings lie where you fell (%s) for five minutes; the Chronicle Sigil takes you back once the fight is over.
message.nusmp.arc.arena.ready: %s will answer ten seconds after the first of you arrives, or five seconds after one of you stands near their place.
message.nusmp.arc.arena.fighting: The fight is underway. Hold the Chronicle Sigil for ten seconds, or use a way home, to leave.
message.nusmp.arc.arena.resting: The arena is resting for %s more seconds.
message.nusmp.arc.chronicle.cannot_pick: The Chronicle cannot carry you to that one yet.
message.nusmp.arc.chronicle.picked: The Chronicle Sigil will carry you to %s.
message.nusmp.arc.chronicle.nobody: The Chronicle has nobody to carry you to.
message.nusmp.arc.chronicle.picked_short: The sigil now carries you to %s.
message.nusmp.arc.chronicle.empty: The Chronicle is blank: no boss is written in it yet.
message.nusmp.arc.arena.sigil_dormant: The sigil is dormant while the boss fights. Hold the Chronicle Sigil for ten seconds to leave.
message.nusmp.arc.arena.no_dimension: The arena does not answer: its dimension is not loaded.
message.nusmp.arc.arena.no_room: Every site of the arenas is taken. An operator can free one with /multiverse arc arena status.
message.nusmp.arc.arena.home: You are carried home from the arena.
advancement.nusmp.arc.root.title: The Chronicle of the Arcs
advancement.nusmp.arc.root.desc: Meet a friend or defeat a boss of the arcs: every character of the stories you walk through is written down here.
advancement.nusmp.arc.arena.title: Into the Arena
advancement.nusmp.arc.arena.desc: Be carried into a story arena by the Chronicle Sigil.
advancement.nusmp.arc.saga_spade_raid.de: Defeat all 4 bosses of: Spade Kingdom Raid Saga.
advancement.nusmp.arc.saga_wizard_king.d: Defeat the boss of: Ultimate Wizard King Arc.
advancement.nusmp.arc.defeated_charybdis: Defeat Spawn of Charybdis. Saga: DanMachi.
advancement.nusmp.arc.defeated_devil_ava: Defeat Devil Avatar. Saga: Spade Kingdom Raid Saga.
advancement.nusmp.arc.defeated_dante.des: Defeat Dante Zogratis. Saga: Spade Kingdom Raid Saga.
advancement.nusmp.arc.defeated_vanica.de: Defeat Vanica Zogratis. Saga: Spade Kingdom Raid Saga.
advancement.nusmp.arc.defeated_zenon.des: Defeat Zenon Zogratis. Saga: Spade Kingdom Raid Saga.
advancement.nusmp.arc.defeated_lucius.de: Defeat Lucius Zogratis. Saga: Ultimate Wizard King Arc.
effect.nusmp.flattened_air.description: Lucifero has pressed the air flat: you cannot jump and you fall twice as fast. Walking is untouched, so walk out of his lanes and rings. Holders of anti-magic are not held.
effect.nusmp.kneeling.description: The weight of the King of Devils has put you on your knees: no walking, no jumping, for three seconds at most. Crouch when he orders the Bow, stand in still air for Kneel Before the King, or hold anti-magic.
effect.nusmp.specimen.description: Morris has marked you with his thread, and you are slower while it holds. Have an ally stand on the thread, break line of sight, hit Morris hard, or hold anti-magic.
message.nusmp.spade.bow_order: BOW! Crouch (hold sneak) before the weight falls, or hold anti-magic.
message.nusmp.spade.bowed: You bowed. He lets you stand.
message.nusmp.spade.cage_order: DISSECTION THEATRE! Leave the ring through one of its doors (the gaps).
message.nusmp.spade.cage_wall: The tendril wall: leave through a door (a gap in the ring).
message.nusmp.spade.crushed: You did not bow. Crouch (hold sneak) when he orders it, or hold anti-magic.
message.nusmp.spade.flatten: The air is pressed flat: no jumping, no gliding. Walk. Anti-magic holders are not held.
message.nusmp.spade.horizon_order: EVENT HORIZON! Walk away from Lucifero: the core is 9 blocks wide.
message.nusmp.spade.kneel_order: KNEEL BEFORE THE KING! Stand in a white ring of still air or hold anti-magic. Crouching will not save you.
message.nusmp.spade.kneel_ultimate: Crushed. Find the still air (white rings) or hold anti-magic: crouching is not enough.
message.nusmp.spade.parried: Your anti-magic cuts the hand of gravity.
message.nusmp.spade.specimen: You are the specimen: the thread drags and drains you. Have an ally stand on it, break line of sight, or hold anti-magic.
message.nusmp.spade.unbowed: Your anti-magic holds the weight off you.
message.nusmp.zagred.word.halt.hint: Leave the ring, or stand close to him
message.nusmp.zagred.word.trident.hint: Leave the line, or raise your shield
message.nusmp.zagred.word.swords.hint: Raise your shield, or leave the marks
message.nusmp.zagred.word.seal.hint: Break his sight, or hold anti-magic
message.nusmp.zagred.word.redact.hint: Step between the letters; anti-magic cuts the sentence
message.nusmp.zagred.word.shatter.hint: Hold your fire: projectiles are erased
message.nusmp.zagred.word.reverse.hint: Hold your blows: they come back
message.nusmp.zagred.word.verdict.hint: Answer the word written over your head
message.nusmp.zagred.word.overwrite.hint: Break three of the five stones
message.nusmp.zagred.rule.no_fire.hint: Do not strike him with fire
message.nusmp.zagred.rule.no_ice.hint: Do not strike him with ice
message.nusmp.zagred.rule.no_lightning.h: Do not strike him with lightning
message.nusmp.zagred.rule.no_flying.hint: Keep your feet on the ground
message.nusmp.zagred.rule.no_still.hint: Never stand still for a second
message.nusmp.zagred.held: You hold the line against the word.
message.nusmp.zagred.overwrite.sub: Break three of the five stones before the sentence is written
message.nusmp.zagred.composed: He is composed: he cannot be cut again yet.
message.nusmp.zagred.cut.sub: He cannot speak for three seconds
message.nusmp.zagred.heart.closed: His heart is closed: strike when he finishes a Word.
message.nusmp.zagred.unwritten.sub: He cannot act and takes half again: strike now
message.nusmp.zagred.act.1.name: The Reader
message.nusmp.zagred.act.2.name: The Speaker
message.nusmp.zagred.act.3.name: The Judge
message.nusmp.zagred.act.4.name: The Author
message.nusmp.zagred.act.5.name: The Heart
arc.dialogue.asta.1: Oh! A new face! I'm Asta! I'm going to be the Wizard King, %1$s, and I train every single day to get there!
arc.dialogue.asta.2: Hey, %1$s! You look strong! Do you train? Please say you train. I'm Asta, by the way!
arc.dialogue.asta.3: Nice to meet you! I'm Asta, a Black Bull! I don't have any magic, but that's okay, because I have guts and a really big sword!
arc.dialogue.asta.4: You've been fighting down there, haven't you? I can tell! Your hands look like mine after training. I'm Asta!
arc.dialogue.asta.5: You beat Vetto?! For real?! Then we have to train together! I'm Asta!
arc.dialogue.asta.6: First rule of the labyrinth: don't stand still. Second rule: if you can't dodge it, hit it harder. That's all I know. I'm still learning the rest.
arc.dialogue.asta.7: The Spire goes up and the Chasm goes down, and once you clear the first floor of one, the other one locks! I can't even try both. So unfair!
arc.dialogue.asta.8: The Eye of the Midnight Sun are no joke! Heath Grice, Vetto, and the rest. I fought one of them in a temple at the bottom of the sea. With Noelle and the captain. Mostly I got hit.
arc.dialogue.asta.9: Vetto is huge, he heals, and he's super mean! My sword drains magic, but you still have to survive his fists. Don't just swing. Dodge first!
arc.dialogue.asta.10: Past the thirtieth floor the strongest of the Eye wait with a third eye! And way down in the Chasm there's Zagred, a devil who makes words come true. Say no really loudly. I'd try that!
arc.dialogue.asta.11: Spade Kingdom stuff is the worst! Devils, a giant ritual, brothers who look at you like you're a snack. Dante, Vanica and Zenon are on the floors now. Be ready!
arc.dialogue.asta.12: The last one's Lucius. He and the Wizard King shared one body. I still don't get it, but I know he has to be stopped. Right here, right now!
arc.dialogue.asta.13: There are seven weirdos on the floors now! The Seven Deadly Sins! Wrath, Pride, Greed, Gluttony, Lust, Sloth, Envy... I only know about being stubborn. Is stubborn a sin?
arc.dialogue.asta.14: Did you know there's a whole other dungeon in here? With a bull-headed monster? I'm a Black Bull, he's a bull... we should have a talk!
arc.dialogue.asta.15: Past twenty fights?! Wow! Come on, spar with me! Please!
arc.dialogue.asta.16: My grimoire has a sword in it! When the book opens, the sword falls right into your hand. I know it sounds weird. Anti-magic doesn't care how big a spell is, it just cuts it.
arc.dialogue.asta.17: Anti-magic stores up! Every time magic hits you, it charges your Anti-Magic Power. So don't be scared of spells. Be scared of fists. Fists are still fists!
arc.dialogue.asta.18: If you master the book, something wakes up in it. More swords answer: Demon-Dweller, Demon-Destroyer, Demon-Slasher. And Black Asta stops being a quick trick and becomes a form you hold as long as you can stand it.
arc.dialogue.asta.19: When you beat somebody big, their grimoire might drop, and you can borrow their moves for a while by holding it! I can't, I have no mana. So I'll cheer as loudly as I can instead!
arc.dialogue.asta.20: You took down Vetto?! Noelle's Sea Dragon's Roar took his arm off, my sword drained his magic, and the captain finished him... and you did it yourself?! Amazing!
arc.dialogue.asta.21: Heath Grice is down? He scared me! He was all calm about being scary, which is the worst kind!
arc.dialogue.asta.22: A devil who makes words come true, and you beat him? How?! Did you shout louder than he did?!
arc.dialogue.asta.23: The whole Dark Triad?! Okay, now I'm jealous. Teach me everything!
arc.dialogue.asta.24: Lucius is gone? For real? Then the Wizard King is safe, and I can keep saying I'll be the next one. Thanks, %1$s!
arc.dialogue.asta.25: I do a thousand swings every morning. The captain said that's pointless, then made me do two thousand.
arc.dialogue.asta.26: Noelle says I'm an idiot. She says it a lot. I think it's how she says she likes me?
arc.dialogue.asta.27: Never giving up is my magic! It doesn't glow or anything, but it works!
arc.dialogue.asta.28: Yuno and I made a promise: whoever gets there first becomes Wizard King. I'm not letting him win!
arc.dialogue.asta.29: People keep telling me anti-magic is a curse. I think it's the best thing that ever happened to me!
arc.dialogue.asta.30: If you get hungry, ask Charmy which monster meat is safe. Raw meat makes you sick! Cook it first!
arc.dialogue.asta.31: Keep a torch! If you stay in the dark too long, you get weak. I tried it. I felt weak. Then I did push-ups, which made it worse.
arc.dialogue.asta.32: Keep training, %1$s! See you next time!
arc.dialogue.asta.33: Don't give up, okay? Not ever!
arc.dialogue.asta.34: Time for my swings! Come back soon!
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.1: Hello! I'm Charmy! Do you have food? No? That's okay, Charmy has food. Do you want some? ...Charmy is not sure Charmy wants to share.
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.2: Mmm! New person! You smell like adventure! And maybe a little like biscuits? Charmy is Charmy Pappitson!
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.3: Charmy is hungry. Charmy is always hungry. What's your name? Do you like sheep?
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.4: You beat a big one! You must be hungry! Charmy will share! A little! Charmy Pappitson!
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.5: You've been fighting! Fighting makes you hungry! Charmy knows because Charmy fights! Charmy Pappitson!
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.6: Raw monster meat makes you sick. Charmy knows. Charmy tried it. Cook it first, or purify it. Cooked meat is yummy meat!
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.7: Monsters drop magic stones and meat! Stones are money! Meat is food! That's a good deal! Charmy wants the meat!
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.8: The Eye of the Midnight Sun are scary, but they don't share. Charmy doesn't like people who don't share. Charmy doesn't like Heath Grice.
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.9: The Eye's elite are down deep, past the thirtieth floor! Bring snacks. A lot of snacks. Charmy always brings snacks.
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.10: Spade Kingdom monsters are huge. Dante is huge. If Dante was a pie, he'd feed everyone for a week. Charmy should not be saying that.
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.11: Lucius is the last one. After that, Charmy wants a feast. A big one. For everyone!
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.12: One of the Seven Deadly Sins is Gluttony. Charmy wants to meet her. Charmy will challenge her to an eating contest!
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.13: Another dungeon! New monsters! New meat! Charmy is very excited!
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.14: Twenty fights! Charmy is proud! Charmy will cook a feast! ...after Charmy eats something. Right now.
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.15: Sheep Cook! Three chef sheep cook for everyone nearby. It heals, it fills your belly, and the regeneration lasts a long time. Charmy's best page!
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.16: Sleeping Sheep Strike makes a real sheep jump out of a cloud and put an enemy to sleep. Sheep Bondage hugs them in a cocoon of cotton. Sheep are the best!
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.17: Cotton Cloud carries you and up to four friends where you walk, then puts you down softly. Charmy rides it to lunch.
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.18: Glutton's Banquet is a giant mouth. It eats every spell in front of it and bites the enemies, then turns it all into mana. It's also a very good name.
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.19: Charmy's grimoire has Cotton AND Food magic. A new grimoire picks one side when it's first bound, but Charmy's gets both. Charmy is special!
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.20: You beat the monster Vetto! Did it drop anything good? Charmy asks for a friend. The friend is Charmy.
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.21: Charmy doesn't like devils who talk. Charmy likes devils who eat. Good job on Zagred!
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.22: All three brothers! Charmy would give you the biggest piece of cake!
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.23: Lucius is gone! Party! Charmy brings the cake! Charmy eats the cake! You can have the crumbs!
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.24: Charmy's rule: never touch Charmy's food. Charmy is nice, but not about food.
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.25: Asta ate Charmy's leftovers once. Charmy forgave him. Eventually.
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.26: Charmy is small, but when Charmy eats, Charmy gets big! That's food magic!
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.27: What's your favorite food? Charmy's is all of them.
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.28: Charmy's sheep are very polite. They say baa and nothing else.
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.29: Hunger makes you slow down in the dungeon! Eat before you're hungry. Charmy never has this problem.
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.30: Don't let the lights go out! No light, no food, no fun!
arc.dialogue.charmy_pappitson.31: Bye! Charmy is going to eat now!
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.1: Oh! A new customer! I mean, a new friend. Finral Roulacase, Black Bulls, transport and general errands. Hello, %1$s!
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.2: Welcome, welcome! Don't be afraid, I'm the friendly one. Well, the cowardly one. But friendly! Finral!
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.3: Ah, are you lost? Don't worry, I can take you anywhere. Almost anywhere. Finral Roulacase, at your service!
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.4: Wow, you're already past a few floors? That's more than I managed on my first day. Finral! Tell me if you need a lift.
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.5: You beat Revchi Salik?! Oh, you're strong! I mean, I'm glad you're on our side. Finral, at your service!
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.6: Okay, the basics: the Spire climbs, the Chasm drops, and the gate behind you goes home. Even after the other road locks, you can always come back to the plaza. I checked. Twice. For safety!
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.7: Every floor is a level of its own. You arrive at the foot of the stairs, you find the far end, and the next floor builds while you walk. If the stairs say they're still forming, give them a moment. Don't poke them.
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.8: The early floors are crawling with leftovers from all the old trouble. Heath Grice, Vetto, those Diamond Kingdom mages. If you get cornered, remember: running away is a perfectly valid tactic! I'm an expert!
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.9: Deeper down, the Eye sends the really scary ones, with a third eye. If you meet one, open a Fallen Angel Gate and use it. Running through a door you made yourself counts as tactics.
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.10: The Spade Kingdom's brothers are three kinds of awful. Dante crushes, Vanica curses, Zenon folds space. When Zenon folds space I'm offended on behalf of my magic. He's doing it wrong.
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.11: Lucius Zogratis is the last one, I think. I try not to think about him. I think about Finesse, and soup. Mostly Finesse.
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.12: There are strangers on the floors who are very, very strong, and some of them are very, very beautiful. I'm not saying I'll introduce myself. I'm saying I want to survive long enough to try.
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.13: Another dungeon! With a goddess and a hearth and a family-run feeling. I like it already. Still, be careful: monsters aren't polite just because the city is.
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.14: Twenty already?! You're making me look bad! Which isn't hard, but still!
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.15: Fallen Angel Gate opens two doors that lead to each other. Cast it once, aim, and cast it again. Both stay open for twenty seconds, and then it needs forty-five seconds to rest. Perfect for running. I love running.
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.16: Sacred Mana Domination wipes out the nearest enemy projectile within eight blocks. If there isn't one, it drags your target four blocks closer. One or the other, never both. I tried both once. It was awkward.
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.17: The dungeon sorts its floors by team. Your friends share your floors, and other teams get their own copies. Like a private labyrinth, but with company! Nobody steals your corridor.
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.18: Lotus Whomalt is down? The smoke and poison gas fellow? I'd have fainted. Respect!
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.19: You beat Mars, the crystal fellow? Crystal magic is gorgeous, but not when it's coming at your face!
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.20: Zenon's down? He did space magic wrong and I'm not even mad. Okay, I'm a little mad. But thank you!
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.21: Lucius, finished. I'm so relieved I could cry. I'm going to cry a little. Don't look!
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.22: Everyone calls me a taxi. I'm a fully qualified Magic Knight who happens to be very good at driving.
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.23: My brother Langris is in the Golden Dawn. Perfect hair, perfect magic, perfect attitude. I'm better at jokes.
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.24: I'm going to become the head of House Vaude and marry Finesse. I'll be brave soon. Very soon.
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.25: Gordon is creepy. Magna is loud. Luck is terrifying. Everyone here is wonderful, honest!
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.26: I keep telling Asta that fear is just caution wearing a funny hat.
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.27: A little advice: bring a light and keep it burning. Stay in the dark too long and you go weak, and I can't drive weak people. Ooh, that came out wrong.
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.28: Safe travels! Don't forget to come back! I'll keep the gate warm.
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.29: Okay, bye! Be brave! One of us has to be.
arc.dialogue.finral_roulacase.30: Careful out there. If you see a lady in distress, tell her I said hi.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.1: ...What do you want? I don't talk to strangers. Gauche Adlai. That's all you get.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.2: You're staring. Stop it. If you must know, I'm Gauche. Mirror Magic. Don't bother me unless it's important.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.3: Hmph. Another person who thinks the Black Bulls are a joke. I'm Gauche Adlai. Prove me wrong.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.4: So you're the one who cleaned out the Diamond mages. ...Fine. Gauche Adlai. Don't think this makes us friends.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.5: You look like you've done something useful for once. Gauche. Save your breath.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.6: Listen once, because I won't repeat it. Don't fight in the open when a corridor will do. Don't fight when you're hurt. Don't fight when you don't have to.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.7: The System window follows you around down there, and it can be moved. It has its own keybinds. Look for them before you complain about it covering your view.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.8: The Eye of the Midnight Sun fights as one organism. Kill the loud ones first and the quiet ones come apart. Their leader wears a borrowed face and fights with light.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.9: Light against a mirror is a bad bet. A mirror turns light back. If the leader of the Eye comes at you with it, you'll know where to stand.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.10: The Zogratis brothers: gravity, curses, space. Three kinds of pressure. A mirror won't help against gravity. Don't bother.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.11: Lucius Zogratis. Time, souls, and a bad temper. I suggest you don't make him angry, but you'll do it anyway.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.12: Those Sins. Lust and Envy are the irritating ones: a man who toys with minds and a giant who envies everyone. I don't like fighting people who toy with minds.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.13: That other dungeon's monsters are simple. Good. Simple things die easily. I like them.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.14: Twenty. Hmph. That's the lowest number a competent person would be proud of.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.15: Reflect Refrain hangs a mirror before you for four seconds. It catches two to four shots, sends them back and silences whoever fired. Time it. Don't flail.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.16: Real Double steps a copy of you out of a mirror. Each double costs a tenth of your magicules, takes extra damage, and adds a fifth to your own blows, up to three. Don't be sentimental about them. They aren't you.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.17: Full Reflection turns every shot back for eight seconds and returns most of every blow. Mirror Array keeps a ring of mirrors around you, and one shatters in place of a killing blow. Use both. Stop dying.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.18: Mirrors are weak to gel and to dark. A slime ruins a mirror's day. Keep that in mind, if you have a brain.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.19: Mars? Crystal brain. Fine. You beat him. Don't expect applause.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.20: Vetto. A big beast who never stops. Hmph. I'd have been faster. But fine, you got him.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.21: Zenon Zogratis. Space and bone. A smart one. You're better than you look, which wasn't hard.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.22: Lucius is dead? Hm. I wanted to see it. ...Marie would have wanted to see it, too.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.23: Marie is the cutest thing in this kingdom. Say otherwise and I will end you. ...What? It's a fact.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.24: Marie hits harder than any bull. It's character building.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.25: I'm the smartest one in the squad. Not because the rest are dumb, though they are, but because I actually read things.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.26: My left eye is a mirror. It sees more than the other one. Don't ask.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.27: Stop looking at me like that. I'm not blushing. It's just hot.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.28: If the room is a trap, leave. If the trap is a room, leave faster.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.29: Floors lie. A pitfall tile looks exactly like the one beside it. Mirrors don't lie. Check the corners.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.30: Hmph. Get out of my sight. ...Be careful.
arc.dialogue.gauche_adlai.31: Don't die. It would be a waste of my advice.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.1: ...Oh. Hello. I... I'm Gordon. Gordon Agrippa. I'm sorry... for existing. Please don't leave.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.2: Heh... you can see me. Most people don't. I'm Gordon. Poison magic. Don't worry, I only curse people I don't like.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.3: I... mumble. Sorry. It's a habit. I'm Gordon, of the Black Bulls. ...I think you seem nice.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.4: You... took down Heath Grice. Good. I'm glad. I was hiding in the dark and thinking someone should. Gordon.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.5: You look... tired. Tired is good. Tired means you did something. I'm Gordon...
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.6: The dark... isn't so bad. But stay in it too long and the dungeon makes you weak. Carry a light. I'd carry one too, but I like the dark. ...Heh. Carry a light.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.7: Raw monster meat is poison. Real poison, not the good kind. Cook it or purify it. I know ten ways to ruin it. And one way to fix it.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.8: The Eye of the Midnight Sun... they're hurt people who hurt people. Heath Grice, Vetto... I understand them. ...I'm still going to curse them. A little.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.9: The ones with the third eye... they don't think they're villains. That's the worst kind. Be careful past the thirtieth floor.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.10: Vanica's curse... it's a very good curse. Terrible, but good. I could study it for years. ...Please don't tell the captain I said that.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.11: Lucius... took people's souls and called it mercy. I don't think I like him. ...I don't like many people. But him less.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.12: Seven sins... I think I have at least five. ...Shame is one of them. Is shame a sin? ...Hm.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.13: That other dungeon has a hearth where the weak can sit. I like that. ...I'd sit by it, if I was allowed.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.14: Twenty... fights? You're braver than me. ...That's not hard, but still.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.15: Aufwachen Dachs sends a badger of poison. Violett Schirm hangs a curtain of poison for eight seconds: spells that cross it melt, foes that touch it sicken. Basilisk's Breath... is not for the squeamish.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.16: My own page is Curse-Worker's Neighbor. It cleans your side of every curse and pours them on the other side. It only opens in my grimoire. ...Sorry. It's a bit selfish.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.17: Curses aren't evil. They're debts. If you pay them, they go away. If you don't, they grow.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.18: Poison, in the right dose, is medicine. I research that. With my father. We... talk now. Sometimes.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.19: You beat Vanica? ...Her curse was the most beautiful horror I've ever seen. I'm glad you survived it.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.20: A devil of words... and you stopped him. I have so many questions. Don't answer them. I like not knowing.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.21: Lucius is gone... the world feels lighter. ...Or I'm just hungry. Both.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.22: Mars... crystals are nice. ...Sorry. I'm talking about the enemy again.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.23: People think I'm creepy. I think it's the eyebrows. ...I don't have eyebrows.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.24: Gauche asked me for advice once. I was so surprised I forgot how to speak. ...More than usual.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.25: The Black Bulls are... nice. They don't ask me to speak louder.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.26: I never used to have friends. ...Now I have too many. It's lovely.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.27: Sunlight is overrated. Under a ceiling, a man can think.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.28: At the end of every ten floors there's a vault with relics. When you take one, the dungeon answers: a collapsing ceiling, a magicule flood, a cursed spirit. ...Stay calm. Walk to the exit.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.29: If you're poisoned, a bucket of milk clears everything. I don't know why. Cows are magic. ...Don't tell my father I said that.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.30: ...Goodbye. Please be careful. I'll be here, in the dark.
arc.dialogue.gordon_agrippa.31: Thank you for talking to me. ...Really.
arc.dialogue.grey.1: U-um... h-hello. I'm... G-Grey. Sorry. Sorry! I didn't mean to stand so close. We're not even touching. Sorry anyway.
arc.dialogue.grey.2: A-ah! Someone's talking to me! I'm Grey. Of the Black Bulls. I... I turn into things. It helps me talk.
arc.dialogue.grey.3: Hello! (deepens voice) I mean, hah! Hello! I am the great Grey! ...Sorry. I'm just Grey. Nice to meet you.
arc.dialogue.grey.4: Y-you beat Lotus Whomalt? That's amazing! I'm Grey. I was too scared to come out until you did. Sorry.
arc.dialogue.grey.5: You look tired. I c-could turn into a pillow! ...I'm joking. S-sorry. I'm Grey.
arc.dialogue.grey.6: Not every chest is a chest. Some have teeth. If it's sitting alone in a corner, be careful. ...Don't ask how I know.
arc.dialogue.grey.7: If something looks too friendly, it might be a monster. Or me. ...It's usually a monster.
arc.dialogue.grey.8: The Eye of the Midnight Sun is scary. They don't scare me as much as my family did. ...That's not comforting, is it? Sorry.
arc.dialogue.grey.9: People with a third eye don't blink the same. I noticed that. ...I notice things when I'm hiding.
arc.dialogue.grey.10: The three brothers... one is gravity, one is curses, one is space. I could turn into a rock, but a rock gets crushed too. Sorry.
arc.dialogue.grey.11: Lucius... is the one at the end. I'll hide behind someone bigger. ...I'll be someone bigger. Then I'll hide.
arc.dialogue.grey.12: Seven strong strangers... Merlin is scary. Diane is huge. I could turn into a giant, but she'd just step on me. ...Sorry for thinking about it.
arc.dialogue.grey.13: Another dungeon... with a hearth. A family. I wish I had a family like that. ...Oh! I do. The Black Bulls. Sorry, I forgot.
arc.dialogue.grey.14: Twenty fights?! I... I think I'm proud of you. Is that allowed? Sorry.
arc.dialogue.grey.15: Magic Convert draws a circle in front of you for two seconds. Any enemy spell that touches it turns into your mana. I'm... very proud of that one. ...Sorry for being proud.
arc.dialogue.grey.16: Transmutation: Iron Spikes turns the ground ahead into iron and thrusts it up in a line. Quagmire turns the ground into sand for five seconds, and everything sinks.
arc.dialogue.grey.17: Grand Transmutation turns every blessing on the enemies around you into a curse, and you take the blessings. It's a bit mean. ...Sorry.
arc.dialogue.grey.18: I can change what I look like, and sometimes what other things are. The first time, I turned into a very large man by accident. ...He was loud.
arc.dialogue.grey.19: Mars... crystals. I turned a rock into a crystal once, but it was a bad crystal. Sorry.
arc.dialogue.grey.20: You beat Vetto? He grew his arm back, right? I'd have run. I'm glad you didn't.
arc.dialogue.grey.21: Zagred makes words true... I can change what things are, too. But I have to touch them. He doesn't. That's... unfair.
arc.dialogue.grey.22: Lucius is finished? I can stop pretending to be a rock now? Oh! Sorry. That was private.
arc.dialogue.grey.23: When I'm shy, I turn into someone braver. When I'm someone braver, I turn into someone shy. It doesn't make sense, I know.
arc.dialogue.grey.24: Asta never laughs at me. He just shouts good job at everything. I... like it.
arc.dialogue.grey.25: Noelle is so brave. I wish I could be brave like that. ...Oh, she gets embarrassed when I say that. Sorry.
arc.dialogue.grey.26: Zora pranked me once. I turned into a statue so he couldn't find me. It worked for three days.
arc.dialogue.grey.27: I like it here. Nobody asks me to be someone else. ...Which is funny, because that's my magic.
arc.dialogue.grey.28: There's no easy healing down there, so rest in safe rooms and Landings. I hide in them. Sometimes for hours.
arc.dialogue.grey.29: Relics come from vaults, pedestals and bosses, as far as I know. If someone offers you one for free... it's probably a me. Sorry!
arc.dialogue.grey.31: Take care! (deep voice) And don't dawdle!
arc.dialogue.grey.32: Thank you for talking to me. I... don't do that often.
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.1: Hey hey! You look strong! Are you strong? I'm Luck! Luck Voltia! Wanna fight? Later! Maybe now!
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.2: Ooh, a new face! New faces are fun, they haven't seen my tricks yet. I'm Luck, a Black Bull. Hi!
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.3: Hi hi hi! I love fighting, I love lightning, and I love being fast. I'm Luck. What about you?
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.4: I heard you beat Revchi Salik! Was it fun? Tell me everything! I'm Luck!
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.5: You've been fighting a lot, haven't you? I can tell, you've got that look. Luck Voltia! Let's compare scars!
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.6: Fast beats strong, strong beats slow, and fast AND strong beats everything. I'm trying to be both. Try it!
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.7: The dungeon has wandering bosses! They walk the rooms like they own the place. Find one and say hi for me. Then run.
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.8: Ooh, the Eye of the Midnight Sun! Strong people with strange reasons. Heath Grice, Vetto... Vetto grows his arm back! That's so cool! I'd hit him twice just to watch.
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.9: The Eye's elite have a third eye and a terrible attitude. Those are the fun ones! Find them past the thirtieth floor. Don't fight them tired!
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.10: The Dark Triad! Gravity, curses, space! I've always wanted to be hit by gravity. Not like I'd enjoy it. I'd... enjoy it a bit.
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.11: Lucius is the last big one! The Wizard King's face and a really bad attitude. Fun and scary. Mostly scary. Bring snacks.
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.12: The Seven Deadly Sins are on the floors, and I really want to fight Wrath! And Pride! The one who's strongest at noon! I'll fight at noon, in the dungeon, if I have to!
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.13: Another dungeon with another city's monsters! New enemies, new tricks! The bull-headed one is supposed to be really strong. I'd love to race it.
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.14: Twenty fights! You're fun! Let's fight each other! Please? I'll go easy. A little.
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.15: Thunder Fiend wraps lightning around you for thirty seconds. You get fast, and your hits jump to a second enemy. It only opens for my own grimoire, so no borrowing. I don't have a favorite page. Okay, it's this one.
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.16: Black Lightning Battle Fiend is the big one: faster, stronger, and every blow arcs to two more enemies. Mine again. You can't borrow that one either.
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.17: Chain Lightning jumps from enemy to enemy within five blocks, three targets in a row. Great against crowds. Terrible when you're the crowd.
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.18: Vetto! You beat Vetto?! I wanted to fight Vetto! Fine, fine, I'll fight you instead. Good job, though!
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.19: Dante's down? Was the gravity fun?
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.20: Zagred's down! The word devil! Did he say die? Did it work? Obviously it didn't, you're here!
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.21: Lucius is down?! Then who's left? Wait, there's always someone. Good!
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.22: Magna's my best friend. Don't tell him. He'd get a big head. It's already big.
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.23: Pranks are the best training. Dodging pranks makes you fast. I'm basically a teacher.
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.24: Charmy says I'm scary when I smile. I say I'm just happy! Why is that scary?
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.25: When I get excited, my smile gets wider. Gordon says it's unsettling. Gordon says everything is unsettling.
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.26: Sometimes I think lightning is the only thing faster than my mouth.
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.27: Noise brings monsters! Light brings monsters! Being too much fun brings monsters! ...Okay, mostly noise and light.
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.28: Don't run ahead of your team! I do it all the time, but you shouldn't. The floors are split per team, so if you get hurt, nobody from another team is going to come save you.
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.29: Bye bye! Win something for me!
arc.dialogue.luck_voltia.30: See you! Next time we fight, okay?
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.1: Oi, who're you? Name's Magna Swing! Black Bulls! Don't let the jacket fool you, I'm tougher than I look. Actually I look pretty tough.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.2: Hah! Another fresh face! I'm Magna. Fire's my game. Sit down before you fall over.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.3: Don't stare at the mohawk. Everybody does. Magna Swing. Remember it, 'cause I'm gonna be famous.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.4: You took down Revchi Salik? Heh. Not bad! Not bad at all! Magna Swing! Wanna see my broom?
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.5: You look like you've been through it. Good. Real fighters have a look. Magna Swing, Black Bull. Pleased to meet ya.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.6: Fire's simple. Hit hard, hit first, don't stop. That's the whole spell book. Okay, there's more. But that's the important part.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.7: Keep a flame going down there. Stay in the dark long enough and the dungeon makes you weak. A fire mage with no fire is a sad sight.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.8: Eye of the Midnight Sun, huh? Heath Grice, Vetto, the whole gang. I'd go after them myself, but the captain says I'd burn the dungeon down. He's right. I don't like it.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.9: Deeper down, the Eye sends the third-eye freaks. Big, ugly, hard to kill. Hit them harder. Then hit them again. That's the whole plan. Don't improve it.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.10: Dante Zogratis, the big gravity brute. I've met that name before and I'd like another go. Take him head on, just don't stand where the ground's heavy.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.11: Lucius. The one at the top, wearing the Wizard King's face. Heh. I'd burn that face off, but I hear he's not the burning kind.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.12: New guys on the floors, and they're strong. Luck-level strong. I'm gonna have to watch Luck so he doesn't run off and challenge all of 'em.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.13: A bull-headed monster in that other dungeon? And I'm a Black Bull? Hey, we should settle who the better bull is.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.14: Twenty fights! Not bad, not bad! Don't let it go to your head, or I'll set your hair on fire. Friendly like.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.15: My go-to is the Exploding Fireball, the first page of the Fire book. It hits harder than it looks. A fire mage who can't throw one is just a cook.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.16: Leo Rugiens and Calidos Brachium only open for the grimoires of the Vermillions. Don't ask me for 'em. The Crimson Lions keep the fancy stuff to themselves.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.17: My broom's called Crazy Cyclone. It flies, it's fast, it's mine. Touch it and I'll set your boots on fire.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.18: Dante's down? Heh! Told you he could be beaten. Nice work, %1$s.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.19: Vetto, the big beast? I'd love to have seen his face when you finished him. Nice!
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.20: Mars, huh. Crystals. I bet he sparkled on the way down.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.21: Lucius is done! Time for a feast! Hey Charmy, we're celebrating!
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.22: Luck and I fight over everything. Food, seats, who's stronger. We're best friends. Don't tell him.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.23: I was a delinquent in Rayaka. Now I'm a Magic Knight. Life's funny.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.24: The captain's a legend, but don't tell him. His head's big enough already.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.25: Fireballs are about attitude. More attitude, more boom.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.26: Anyone messes with the squad, they mess with me. That includes Gauche. Okay, not Gauche.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.27: Bring a friend into the dungeon. Two fighters beat one, simple math. The floors are split per team, so nobody steals your kills.
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.28: Later! Don't die, or I'll be mad!
arc.dialogue.magna_swing.30: Come back and tell me who you set on fire.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.1: ...Another one. I'm Nacht Faust. I don't waste time on people who lose, so don't lose.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.2: You'll be asking about devils sooner or later. Everyone does. Nacht Faust. Ask quickly.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.3: So you're the new one. Hm. You look tougher than you sound. Name's Nacht.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.4: You put Vetto down. Good. I don't like noise from beasts. Nacht Faust. Sit, if you want. I won't.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.5: Plenty of fights behind you, and you're still standing. Not an idiot, then. Nacht Faust.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.6: First rule: losing is your own fault. Second rule: so is dying. Third rule: don't make me repeat the first two.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.7: Noise and light. Everything down there counts them. A torch draws attention, and noise draws more. If you can't fight it, don't let it see you.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.8: The Eye of the Midnight Sun has a devil at its root. Zagred, its secret founder. You'll meet his people first. Don't underestimate them just because they're human.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.9: Zagred is down the Chasm, somewhere below the fortieth floor. A devil of words: say it and it becomes true. You can't win by listening. Plug your ears, if you have to.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.10: Three brothers, three devils: Lucifero, Megicula, Beelzebub. Gravity, curses, space. Devils lend power and take payment. The Zogratis paid with everything they had.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.11: Astaroth, the devil of time, was bound to Lucius. A devil that can fold hours. Whatever you plan, he's already thought of it. So plan twice.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.12: Seven people from another world, each carrying a sin. Nothing to do with devils. Nothing to do with me. That's what makes it interesting.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.13: That other dungeon breeds monsters the way mine breeds regrets. Efficiently. Don't go in unprepared.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.14: Twenty or more victories. Fine. I'll admit it: you're not an idiot.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.15: Liebe is anti-magic. Zagred is words. Megicula curses. Lucifero crushes with gravity. Beelzebub tears space. Astaroth bends time. Know the name, know the trick.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.16: Mine are different: Slotos the horse, Gimodelo the dog, Plumede the cat, Walgner the rooster. In Unite Mode each lends me its body for thirty seconds: a fortress, a pack, a stalker, a stunning call. Those pages open only in my own grimoire.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.17: Shadow Travel works if you stand in shadow and there is a shadow to land in. The labyrinth is generous with both.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.18: A five-leaf grimoire may carry a devil. Devil Union is what it grants. Don't envy anyone who has one. The devil always collects.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.19: Zagred is down? Good. Devils lie. He lied loudest.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.20: The whole Dark Triad is down. Three contracts broken at once. I almost feel sorry for their devils. Almost.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.21: Lucius, finished. A man who chose a devil of time and still ran out of it. Poetic.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.22: My brother Morgen died stopping a ritual that tried to bind a devil. I haven't forgotten the lesson. Devils are not tools.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.23: Asta talks too much. Noelle sulks too much. Everyone eats too much. It's an exhausting squad. ...I'd die for them.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.24: I wear four relics on a string around my neck. They're not jewelry. Don't touch them.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.25: The captain doesn't care about rank. I do. Rank is how you tell who has to pay.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.26: If you want to talk about feelings, find Vanessa. She's drunk. It will be a good conversation.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.27: Shadow is my road, but darkness will weaken you if you stay in it. Carry a lantern anyway.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.29: Go. Come back with something worth saying.
arc.dialogue.nacht_faust.30: If you see a devil, don't trust its smile.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.1: O-oh. A stranger. I am Noelle Silva, of House Silva. Don't just stand there staring, %1$s. Say something!
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.2: Hmph. I suppose you want to know who I am. Noelle Silva. Black Bulls. And yes, I really am from that Silva family, so don't gawk.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.3: You can stop being so stiff, %1$s. I'm not going to bite. ...Usually. I'm Noelle.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.4: You've been fighting a lot already, I can tell. Good. A Silva respects someone who doesn't run. I'm Noelle.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.5: You beat Vetto?! Hmph. I'll have you know I tore his arm off first. ...That doesn't make you any less impressive. I'm Noelle Silva.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.6: The labyrinth is dangerous, but it teaches better than my family ever did. Stay calm, control your mana, and don't panic, %1$s. I learned that the hard way.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.7: Water goes where you tell it to. Remember that, whatever you wield. Panic floods everything, and I do not need another flood in the plaza.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.8: Men like Heath Grice, Revchi Salik and the Diamond Kingdom mages are not a matter of pride, they're a matter of survival. Don't underestimate anyone just because they stand on an early floor.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.9: Vetto grew his arm back right in front of me. If you face him, don't stop after the first hit. And past the thirtieth floor, the Eye's elite have a third eye. That isn't a metaphor.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.10: The Dark Triad are what happens when talent and cruelty share a house. Dante, Vanica, Zenon. Don't face them alone, and don't face them proud.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.11: Lucius Zogratis wore the Wizard King's face. Whatever he says, whatever he shows you, remember who you are. I'll... keep that in mind as well.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.12: Those Sins have strange manners and stranger strength. No titles, no houses, only power. I find it... refreshing. Don't tell my brother.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.13: The monsters of that other dungeon are crude, but crude is not the same as weak. The bull-headed one especially. Keep your head.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.14: Twenty already? Hmph. That is... acceptable. For a commoner. I mean it as a compliment. Probably.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.15: Sea Dragon's Roar is a homing dragon of water that hits like a landslide. The trick isn't throwing it harder. It's throwing it at the right thing.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.16: The Valkyrie Dress wraps you in water armor for thirty seconds: faster, stronger, harder to hurt, light on your feet. It needs a full minute to recover, so choose the moment carefully.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.17: Sea Dragon's Nest is a dome of water. Enemy spells inside it are swallowed, foes slow down, and my side gets patched up. I cast it when things look bad. Then they look less bad.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.18: Vetto is gone? Good. I blew his arm off with one spell and he simply grew it back. I found that rude.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.19: Vanica's down? Good. Hers was the cruelest curse I have ever seen. You have my respect.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.20: Lucius is finished? ...Good. Then I may finally stop pretending that I'm not afraid of him.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.21: My brother Nozel never says anything kind. He never says anything cruel, either. I can't decide which is worse.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.22: I used to think my mana was a curse. Now it's just... difficult. Like a very large cat.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.23: Asta is an idiot. A loud, sweaty, wonderful idiot. Don't tell him I said wonderful.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.24: Eat something, %1$s. Charmy's cooking is surprisingly good. Surprisingly. I'm not being nice.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.25: A Silva does not hesitate. Unfortunately, I am a Silva who hesitates. Often.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.26: Raw monster meat makes you sick. I can't believe I have to say that out loud. Cook it first.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.27: Don't let your torch go out. I was in the dark too long once and it left me weak. Not that I was afraid. I was... conserving energy.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.28: Hmph. Try not to get yourself killed. I... would find it inconvenient.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.29: G-good luck, %1$s. That's all. Don't make it weird.
arc.dialogue.noelle_silva.30: Go on. And stand up straight. A Silva notices.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.1: ...Hello. I am Secre Swallowtail. I seal things, and I open them again. You may call me Secre.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.2: I see. A new person. I will remember your face, %1$s. I remember faces, locks and debts.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.3: Do not stand so close. I am not angry. This is my normal face.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.4: You are the one who put Vetto down. Then it is time for me to be here. I am Secre.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.5: You have the look of someone who has opened many doors. I am Secre. I prefer locks.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.6: Gatekeeper doors answer to Mana Cores, not to hope. Beat the guardian, take the core, open the door. Hope is optional.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.7: Locked chests exist. Branching Array opens them if you look at one from eight blocks or closer. A grimoire is faster than a key. If it is mine.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.8: The Eye of the Midnight Sun seals people inside rituals. I know how that works. The seal is rarely the problem. The one who holds the key is.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.9: A seal is a promise that something stays shut. Zagred keeps promises only when they please him. Do not trust a lock in front of him.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.10: Someone opened a gate to a lower place in the Spade Kingdom, and devils walked through. The Dark Triad stand on your floors because of that. I would rather not discuss it.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.11: Lucius Zogratis hid inside the Wizard King for years. A lock nobody knew was locked. Prince Lemiel would have been furious.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.12: The Seven Deadly Sins are people from elsewhere. I have no seal for them. I would like that on record.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.13: Another dungeon. More monsters behind more doors. I do not care, as long as they stay behind their doors.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.14: Twenty fights. Hm. You are... acceptable. This is a compliment.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.15: My four seals open only in my own grimoire: Branching Array, Eternal Prison, Wound Sealing, Orbital Bind. A borrowed book will refuse them. That is not rude. That is a lock.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.16: Eternal Prison encases a target in a cube for six seconds. Nothing goes in, nothing comes out. A boss slips free in a second and a half. Plan for that.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.17: Wound Sealing mends thirty percent of an ally's health and clears what ails them. Orbital Bind makes an ally harder to hit with magic for half a minute, and it pairs well with an anti-magic sword. Ask Asta. Both seals are quiet. I like quiet.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.18: The ordinary Seal page silences a mage's grimoire for five seconds. A boss's for one. Do not cast it in a panic. Time it.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.19: Vetto is gone? Good. A thing that heals that fast should have been sealed, not fought.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.20: Heath Grice closed his own story before anyone could question him. A poor seal. It did not hold.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.21: You broke Zagred's hold on the Eye. Hm. It did not hold either.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.22: Lucius is sealed away for good. I would like to believe that. Prince Lemiel would have liked it, too.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.23: I once sealed my lord inside a statue. It was necessary. I do not enjoy explaining it.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.24: I used to be a bird. Black, small, loud. I preferred it, though the food was worse.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.25: Asta is noisy. His grimoire is quiet. I like his grimoire.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.26: I peck him when he is annoying. He deserves it. That is all I will say.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.27: The Black Bulls are loud, dirty and unreliable. I have never been so content.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.28: A door that does not open has a rule. Find the rule, and the door opens. Find the key, and the door opens faster.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.29: The Crucible shows three relics and asks you to choose one. Whichever you take, the vault answers with a catastrophe. I would choose quickly, and leave quickly.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.30: Goodbye. Do not be loud on the way out.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.31: Return safely. I dislike changing locks.
arc.dialogue.secre_swallowtail.32: I will be here. I am always here. It is a good place to be quiet.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.1: Mmm... a new face. Come closer, sweetie, I don't bite. I'm Vanessa. Don't mind the bottle, it's medicinal.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.2: Well, well. Fresh blood for the labyrinth. Vanessa Enoteca, at your service, %1$s. Buy a girl a drink sometime.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.3: Oh, you've got a thread on you. A bright one, too. Interesting. Name's Vanessa, cutie.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.4: You've been out there a while, haven't you? There's blood in your threads. Sit, drink some water. I'm Vanessa.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.5: Mm, you dealt with Heath Grice. That's why I woke up. I'm Vanessa. Pour yourself something and tell me about it.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.6: A little advice from a lazy woman: don't rush. The labyrinth isn't going anywhere. Rest in a Landing, drink some water, and live to see tomorrow.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.7: Don't go alone, sweetie. Every thread needs another end. The dungeon keeps one set of floors per party, so the people you bring are the only ones you'll see down there.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.8: The Eye of the Midnight Sun is a knot of old grudges. Heath Grice, Vetto and the rest sit at the tangles. Pull at the right one and the whole thing loosens.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.9: Further down there's a devil who talks things into being. Zagred. I can't read his thread; words don't have one. Keep your own tied tight when you go in.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.10: Three brothers, three devils: gravity, curses, space. I'd stay far away from the one with the curses. A curse is just a thread someone tied around you without asking.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.11: I'm told Lucius has two souls on one thread. Rude. I'd need a very strong drink to read that one.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.12: Seven strangers named for sins. Even the thread around them hums. It's a different weave from ours, as if it came off another loom.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.13: In that other dungeon the threads all run one way: down. Be careful what you follow, sweetie.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.14: Twenty fights and you're still smiling? Lovely. Come sit, I'll buy the first round. Er. You'll buy it, I'll drink it.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.15: Red Thread holds an ordinary enemy for about three seconds from sixteen blocks away, and a boss for one. Bind the same target again within half a minute and it holds half as long. Plan around that, sweetie.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.16: Rouge is a cat of red thread. Cast her page and she sits on your head for ten minutes, watching you, your party, your pets and up to six friends you name by sneaking and casting at them.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.17: While Rouge watches, a blow that would kill, or take over a third of someone's health, never lands. Every save costs your mana, double against a boss, and a boss gets no second save on the same person for eight seconds.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.18: Arresting Dark Weave, Thread Trap and the Reinforcement that turns mana into a second skin only open in my own grimoire. A borrowed book won't oblige. Threads are picky.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.19: Curses are threads someone tied around you. Don't yank on them. Find the knot, ask nicely, and if the knot says no... then pull.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.20: Heath Grice. Poor man; he tied himself in his own knot. You cut it clean, sweetie. I'm impressed.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.21: You beat Zagred? A devil that speaks reality? Come here, I want to look at your thread. ...Still there. Good. You're a lucky one.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.22: The whole Dark Triad? Ooh, that calls for a night of drinking. Sit.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.23: Two souls, one body, and you cut the knot. Take your time, sweetie. You've earned a nap.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.24: I'm not lazy. I'm conserving energy for important things, like sleeping, and flirting with the captain.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.25: The captain never notices. Or maybe he does and he's too embarrassed to say. Either way, it's adorable.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.26: Noelle's a sweet girl, but she needs to relax. Asta needs to relax even more. Honestly, everyone needs a drink.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.27: Fate isn't a straight line, %1$s. It's a tangle. You can pull it, cut it, braid it... just don't tie it to yourself.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.28: Mmm. Do you smell that? Charmy's cooking. Follow your nose. That's an order. From a drunk witch.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.29: The beds in the corridors are for show, honey. Real rest is in a Landing or a safe room. I checked every single one.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.30: There's no easy healing down there. The dungeon doesn't let you just regenerate. So bring potions, or bring me. I accept payment in alcohol.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.31: Go on, sweetie. Come back and tell me everything.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.32: Mmm... leaving so soon? Fine. I'll drink to your safe return.
arc.dialogue.vanessa_enoteca.33: Fate willing, we'll meet again. And if not... I'll have a drink in your name.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.1: Hm? New face. Yami Sukehiro, captain of the Black Bulls. Don't expect a speech, %1$s.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.2: You can stand upright and hold a weapon. That's more than half my squad managed when they showed up. Name's Yami.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.3: So you're the one everybody's whispering about. I'm Yami. Black Bulls. Worst squad in the kingdom, and proud of it.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.4: Hah. You've been down there and back already, haven't you? You smell like the dungeon. Good. I like people who come back. Yami.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.5: The Spire climbs and the Chasm drops. Pick a road and mean it, %1$s. Clear the first floor of one and the other shuts behind you. Think it over. I never do.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.6: Every tenth floor has a guardian sitting on the stairs. Don't take one alone unless you're an idiot, or me.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.7: The Eye of the Midnight Sun and its friends left their mess on the early floors. Revchi Salik, Heath Grice, a beast called Vetto, a pair of Diamond Kingdom mages. From the tenth floor on, you'll trip over one of them.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.8: Past the thirtieth floor the Eye sends its elite, the ones with the third eye. And down the Chasm, below the fortieth, sits the devil behind all of them. Zagred. Take friends.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.9: Spade Kingdom. Three brothers made deals with devils and wore the power like armor: Dante, Vanica, Zenon. Don't fight them like it's a normal fight. It isn't.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.10: One left at the top of the pile. Lucius Zogratis, eldest of those three. He wore the Wizard King's face for years and nobody noticed. Bring everything you've learned.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.11: Strangers have turned up on the floors. Seven of them, named after sins, from some other world. I don't know why they're here and I don't care. Rank means nothing to them. Respect them or run.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.12: Out past the edges there's a pit that belongs to another city's dungeon. Orario. A bull-headed brute, a giant, a two-headed horror. Not our usual trouble, but trouble is trouble.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.13: Twenty down already? Not bad, %1$s. If you were in my squad, I'd make you do the paperwork.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.14: A boss can drop its own grimoire, once per world. An unlucky kill only means the next kill rolls again. Hold it or wear it and you borrow its owner's tricks for a while. Don't get attached. It's a loan.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.15: There's a slash in the Dark book called Equinox. It opens only for my own grimoire. No, you can't borrow mine.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.16: At the end of every ten floors there's a vault with three relics and a bad attitude. Take one, and the vault bites back: the ceiling falls, the room floods with bad magicules, or a cursed spirit wakes. Grab and run.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.17: There's a rotunda on the Promenade, the paved ring round the plaza, with a lectern in it. It lists your story: who's beaten, who's open, who's still locked. Read it before you pick a fight.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.18: Heath Grice stays down for you? He'd rather die than answer questions, that one. Typical.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.19: Vetto's down for you, too? Last time it took half the squad. I made the last cut, obviously. The brat will tell you he did.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.20: You beat Zagred. A devil whose words turn into facts, and you came back with your head on. Tch. Drinks are on you.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.21: All three Zogratis. You're either very good or very lucky, and I don't believe in luck.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.22: Lucius, finished. Then that's the lot. Take the rest of the day off. Take a week. I won't tell anyone.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.23: A captain's job is to stand in front. The rest is paperwork, and I don't do paperwork.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.24: Black Bulls don't get medals. We get the jobs nobody else wants. Suits me.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.25: Magic isn't everything. Guts count. Ask the brat. More guts than anyone I've met, and zero mana.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.26: If you see Charmy near food, hide it. If you see Vanessa near drinks, hide those. If you see Magna and Luck together, hide yourself.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.27: Every captain who threw out a misfit got a worse squad. I picked them all up. Funny thing is, they're the ones who stayed.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.28: Keep a light burning. Stay in the dark long enough and the dungeon makes you weak, and weak people don't come back.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.29: Raw monster meat will make you sick. Cook it, or find a way to purify it. Don't ask me how. I eat what Charmy gives me.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.30: Don't go dying out there. It's a lot of paperwork.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.31: Tch. Come back in one piece, %1$s.
arc.dialogue.yami_sukehiro.32: Go on. I've got a cigarette to finish.
arc.dialogue.zora_ideale.1: Tch. Another one. Zora Ideale. Don't expect a handshake. I might leave a trap in it.
arc.dialogue.zora_ideale.2: You staring at the straps? Yeah, they're real. So's my temper. Zora Ideale, Black Bulls. What do you want?
arc.dialogue.zora_ideale.3: Hah! You don't look like a noble. That's a good start. I'm Zora.
arc.dialogue.zora_ideale.4: You took out Heath Grice? Not bad. Don't get a big head. Zora Ideale. Come to see what a real trap looks like?
arc.dialogue.zora_ideale.5: You've been in the dungeon long enough to learn how things bite. Good. Zora. Don't step on anything shiny.
arc.dialogue.zora_ideale.6: Rule one of the dungeon: the floor lies to you. A pitfall tile looks exactly like the tiles around it, and if the floor is suspiciously clean, somebody wanted you to walk on it.
arc.dialogue.zora_ideale.7: Some rooms have a glyph that eats your light. Torches die, lanterns die, and you can't place new ones nearby. Don't plant a torch near one. Carry your light out the other side.
arc.dialogue.zora_ideale.8: The Eye of the Midnight Sun, hah. Terrorists with relics and rituals who think nobody's watching. Heath Grice even died to hide the plan. Who does that?
arc.dialogue.zora_ideale.9: Past the thirtieth floor, the Eye's elite wait with their third eyes open. Fun to avoid, anyway. Learn their patterns, then set a trap.
