hero.passive.katana.keen_opening.desc: The first full swing after 4 seconds without a katana action strikes again for 3 damage, as a draw cut should.
hero.passive.katana.riposte.desc: After a successful parry the next full swing within 3 seconds is followed by a riposte for 3 damage.
hero.skill.book.read_composition.name: Read Composition
hero.skill.book.read_composition.desc: Reads the next page of the offence chapter, in order: a Bird of Flame (6 damage along a line of 14 blocks), a Needle Rain (4 volleys of 2.5 on a circle of 3 blocks) and, with the Feather page, a beam of 9 damage. A page that finds no target is not read.
hero.skill.book.read_verse.name: Read Verse
hero.skill.book.read_verse.desc: Reads the next page of the support chapter, in order: a Paper Wall (absorption for you and friends within 5 blocks), a Healing Verse (3 pulses, together at most 25 percent of a friend's health) and, with the Binding page, a Constriction.
hero.skill.book.turn_page.name: Turn the Page
hero.skill.book.turn_page.desc: Turns past the next page of the chapter you read last without reading it, so another page comes up. A skipped page is still unread, so the volume is not complete until it is read.
hero.skill.book.paper_burst.name: Paper Splits Rock
hero.skill.book.paper_burst.desc: The page you aim at lights up (a ring shows where) and 8 ticks later explodes: foes within 3.5 blocks take 9 damage and are pushed away. Counter: leave the ring.
hero.skill.book.life_force_burst.name: Life Force Burst
hero.skill.book.life_force_burst.desc: Pages wrap the foe on your crosshair; if it stays within 6 blocks of where it was wrapped for 1.2 seconds, the trapped life force bursts for 14 damage. Counter: run before the burst.
hero.skill.book.constriction.name: Constriction
hero.skill.book.constriction.desc: Pages close into a cage round the foe on your crosshair (within 14 blocks): it is rooted for up to 2 seconds, then needles fall through the False Ceiling for 6 damage. It is hard control and shares the 12 second control rest.
hero.skill.book.libraria.name: Libraria
hero.skill.book.libraria.desc: Ultimate. Needs a complete volume (every page of both chapters read). The room turns white and in 8 volleys birds of fire, lightning, boulders and beams fall on every foe within 9 blocks for 3.5 damage each (28 in all). Counter: leave the white room.
hero.passive.book.chapters.desc: The book holds two chapters read in order: use reads the offence chapter, sneak and use the support chapter. Reading every page of both completes the volume and opens Libraria.
hero.passive.book.deck_feathers.desc: Adds the Feather Volley to the offence chapter: a beam of 12 blocks for 9 damage that mends you a little.
hero.passive.book.deck_cage.desc: Adds the Constriction to the support chapter.
hero.passive.book.revised_edition.desc: Every page and burst is 25 percent stronger, within the limits of its kind.
hero.passive.book.grand_library.desc: Libraria falls in 10 volleys, and the volume needs all but one page.
hero.skill.mirror.mirror_bash.name: Mirror Bash
hero.skill.mirror.mirror_bash.desc: Strike with the edge of the glass: a short cone, 3.6 blocks, that hurts for 6, shoves and staggers with a brief slowing. Every foe struck adds a little to the gleam. Needs a foe in reach.
hero.skill.mirror.glass_shield.name: Glass Shield
hero.skill.mirror.glass_shield.desc: Stand a pane of glass in the air ahead for 6 seconds. It turns three hostile shots back at their shooters and stores their light as gleam. When spent or out of time it bursts into shards that cut the foes near it for 4. Two panes stand at most; a third pushes the oldest out.
hero.skill.mirror.prism_ray.name: Prism Ray
hero.skill.mirror.prism_ray.desc: After a short, visible charge (a bright line shows the path) a beam of refracted light, 22 blocks long. It hurts for 7, and for up to 13 with a full gleam, which it spends. If it passes a standing pane it bounces off and strikes another foe for four fifths of that.
hero.skill.mirror.stardust_mirror.name: Stardust Mirror
hero.skill.mirror.stardust_mirror.desc: A barrier of star-glass round the ally you look at, or round you and the people beside you (three at most): Absorption for 8 seconds, and the next two hostile shots aimed at each of them are turned back.
hero.skill.mirror.release_rebound.name: Release Rebound
hero.skill.mirror.release_rebound.desc: For 4 seconds half of every spell that strikes you is turned back on its caster, at most 12 a blow and 20 in all. Two harmful effects are cleansed from you, and the plain damaging ones are sent on to the nearest foe for 6 seconds. Every reflected spell adds to the gleam.
hero.skill.mirror.movement_mirror.name: Movement Mirror
hero.skill.mirror.movement_mirror.desc: Step through the glass up to 9 blocks the way you look, leaving a silent image where you stood for 12 seconds. The image soaks one creature's blow, up to 35 percent of your health. Cast again while it stands to step back into its place.
hero.skill.mirror.chain_binding.name: Chain Binding Mirror
hero.skill.mirror.chain_binding.desc: Chains link your standing glass, panes and image, and bind up to 4 foes within 5 blocks of it for 3 seconds. Needs a Glass Shield or an image standing. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.mirror.kaleidoscope.name: Kaleidoscope
hero.skill.mirror.kaleidoscope.desc: A ring of six panes round the ground you aim at, up to 18 blocks away. After a short, visible tell, six pulses of light, one every 0.6 seconds, strike every foe inside the ring for 5 each. Leave the ring to answer it.
hero.skill.mirror.covet.name: Covet
hero.skill.mirror.covet.desc: Envy. Copy up to three of a foe's helpful effects onto yourself for up to 10 seconds, at most level III; the foe keeps theirs. Costs extra magicules and 35 corruption.
hero.skill.mirror.ressentiment.name: Ressentiment
hero.skill.mirror.ressentiment.desc: Envy. For 4 seconds the creatures within 9 blocks, six at most, turn on each other. No bosses, no players, and it needs two. Shared control lock. 40 corruption.
hero.skill.instrument.music_strike.name: Music Strike
hero.skill.instrument.music_strike.desc: Shoot a note like an arrow, up to 24 blocks. With no harmony it strays by up to 6 degrees; keep the beat and it flies true. It hits for 6, half a point more with each harmony.
hero.skill.instrument.demons_melody.name: Demon's Melody
hero.skill.instrument.demons_melody.desc: Seven notes in a fan, up to 14 blocks. The fan narrows as the harmony builds. Each note that strikes does 3, and one foe takes at most three of them.
hero.skill.instrument.stun_beat.name: Stun Beat
hero.skill.instrument.stun_beat.desc: A guitar note that flies to where you look and bursts in a flash of light. Foes within 3.5 blocks take 6 and, behind the shared control lock, are stunned for 2 seconds and dazzled for 1.
hero.skill.instrument.march.name: March
hero.skill.instrument.march.desc: A song that follows you for 10 seconds, longer with harmony. Allies within 10 blocks move and work faster: Speed I, and Speed II from harmony 3.
hero.skill.instrument.war_song.name: War Song
hero.skill.instrument.war_song.desc: A song that follows you for 8 seconds, longer with harmony. Allies within 10 blocks hit harder (Strength I) and, from harmony 3, take less damage (Resistance I).
hero.skill.instrument.lullaby.name: Lullaby
hero.skill.instrument.lullaby.desc: A drowsy tune: the foes within 9 blocks are slowed (level III) and weakened for up to 6 seconds, less on players and bosses. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.instrument.dirge.name: Dirge
hero.skill.instrument.dirge.desc: A funeral tune: the foes within 9 blocks are poisoned and weakened for 6 seconds, 8 from harmony 3. Poison never kills a player.
The tune of the grilled-fish instrument: allies within 8 blocks eat a little and mend a tenth of their health. It does nothing for those who are full and unhurt.
hero.skill.instrument.zero_note.name: Zero Note
hero.skill.instrument.zero_note.desc: A silent note, no damage: every ally within 8 blocks is freed of two harmful effects and of a sealed grimoire.
hero.skill.instrument.crescendo.name: Crescendo
hero.skill.instrument.crescendo.desc: Needs harmony 3 and spends the whole phrase. After a long breath (a ring on the ground shows its reach) the song swells for six pulses, 0.6 seconds apart: foes within 10 blocks take 4 each and are slowed, allies mend a fortieth of their health each time.
hero.skill.harpoon.harpoon_throw.name: Harpoon Throw
hero.skill.harpoon.harpoon_throw.desc: Skewer the first foe you look at, up to 18 blocks, for 7 and tie the line to it for 8 seconds. One creature is tied at a time, and the other techniques act on it. With Storm Charged the lightning arcs to one more foe beside it for 3.
hero.skill.harpoon.reel_in.name: Reel In
hero.skill.harpoon.reel_in.desc: Pull the tied creature to you, or, if it is heavy or a boss, pull yourself to it. It strikes for 4 on arrival. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.harpoon.lightning_strike_drag: Charge up to 8 blocks wreathed in lightning, hitting what is on the way for 7; after a breath turn and charge back the same way for 5.
hero.skill.harpoon.whale_hunting_harpoon: After a short, visible gathering (a ring and a column of light stand on the target) one great throw on the tied creature, or the one you look at: 14, a quarter more against a body with 40 health or more. It slams the target down and staggers it (shared control lock).
hero.skill.harpoon.crucifixion.name: Crucifixion
hero.skill.harpoon.crucifixion.desc: Pin the tied creature for 3 seconds under a cross of lightning that burns it three times for 4. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.harpoon.lightning_shock_harpo: Send lightning down the line: the tied creature is shocked for 7 and the current jumps to up to three foes within 6 blocks of it for 4 each.
hero.skill.harpoon.harpoon_zero.name: Harpoon 0
hero.skill.harpoon.harpoon_zero.desc: The 0 series: no damage. Strip up to three helpful effects from the tied or aimed creature, and one from each of up to three foes beside it.
hero.skill.harpoon.brave_fish_blaster.de: After a long, visible gathering (a line shows the path) a surge of lightning-charged water in the shape of a great fish, 20 blocks long: everything in it takes 16 and is staggered (shared control lock).
hero.skill.sewing_set.needle_shot.name: Needle Shot
hero.skill.sewing_set.needle_shot.desc: Three needles in a narrow fan, 20 blocks. Each needle that strikes does 3 and leaves a stitch mark in the foe for 8 seconds. With nothing struck, the middle needle marks the ally you look at (a beacon for 20 seconds) or plants itself in the ground.
hero.skill.sewing_set.bind_wire.name: Bind Wire
hero.skill.sewing_set.bind_wire.desc: Silk binds the foe you look at fast for 3 seconds and seals its skills for that long (a creature is silenced where Tensura has the effect). It hurts for 3 and leaves a stitch mark. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.sewing_set.jumping_needle.des: Jump, up to 48 blocks, to the nearest ally you have put a needle in, or to the needle planted in the ground. With neither, plant a needle where you stand.
hero.skill.sewing_set.stitch_mend.name: Stitch Mend
hero.skill.sewing_set.stitch_mend.desc: Close wounds with silk: four allies at most, those within 6 blocks and those you have put a needle in even 30 blocks away, mend 8 percent of their health and shed one harmful effect.
hero.skill.sewing_set.scissor_cut.name: Scissor Cut
hero.skill.sewing_set.scissor_cut.desc: Two great snips crossed on the spot you look at, up to 10 blocks away, after a short, visible crossing of lines. Foes within 3 blocks take 10, 30 percent more if they carry a stitch mark, which the snip uses up. It also snips you free of slowness.
hero.skill.sewing_set.stitched_barrier.d: A seam of stitches across the ground ahead, 9 blocks wide, for 6 seconds. It catches up to six hostile shots, and foes that touch it are slowed and pricked once for 3.
hero.skill.sewing_set.spider_net.name: Spider Net
hero.skill.sewing_set.spider_net.desc: A net of silk flung where you look, up to 14 blocks: up to three foes within 2.8 blocks of the target are held almost fast for up to 4 seconds, pricked for 4 and marked. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.sewing_set.ariadnes_thread.de: After a visible gathering of threads, up to four allies within 40 blocks, the ones with a needle in them first, then your party and pets, are drawn to your side, and every foe within 24 blocks is lit up for 8 seconds.
hero.skill.chain.chain_lash.name: Chain Lash
hero.skill.chain.chain_lash.desc: A lash of the chain along your look direction, 7 blocks: it hurts everything it crosses for 6, four foes at most, and tugs the far ones towards you.
hero.skill.chain.chain_pull.name: Chain Pull
hero.skill.chain.chain_pull.desc: Hook the first foe in sight, up to 16 blocks, and yank it to you; it strikes for 4 on arrival. A boss barely moves. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.chain.chain_binding.name: Chain Binding
hero.skill.chain.chain_binding.desc: Chains coil round one foe, up to 14 blocks away, and hold it fast for 3 seconds, hurting it for 3. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.chain.hydra.name: Hydra
hero.skill.chain.hydra.desc: After a short, visible gathering the chain is slammed down and five chains race out along the floor in a fan, 10 blocks long. A foe in any of them is struck once for 7 and popped up.
hero.skill.chain.chain_defence.name: Chain Defence
hero.skill.chain.chain_defence.desc: Chains wrap you and up to three people within 4 blocks: Absorption and Resistance I for 6 seconds.
hero.skill.chain.grapple.name: Grapple
hero.skill.chain.grapple.desc: Hook the first foe in sight, up to 20 blocks, and swing yourself to it, striking it for 6 where you land.
hero.skill.chain.orochi.name: Multi-Headed Orochi
hero.skill.chain.orochi.desc: Four groups of chains fall on the ground you aim at, up to 18 blocks away, after a visible tell. Up to four foes inside the 6-block ring are bound for up to 4 seconds and squeezed twice for 8 each, 1.5 seconds apart. Shared control lock.
hero.skill.chain.sloth_weight.name: Sloth: Weight
hero.skill.chain.sloth_weight.desc: Sloth. The foes within 8 blocks grow heavy: slowed and weakened for up to 6 seconds (shared control lock). You are slowed a little too. 30 corruption.
hero.skill.chain.sloth_snap.name: Sloth: Snap
hero.skill.chain.sloth_snap.desc: Sloth. A chain wraps the foe you look at now and slows it, behind the control lock; 3 seconds later it snaps tight for 12 if the foe is still within 18 blocks. 35 corruption.
hero.skill.chain.debt_comes_due.name: The Bill Comes Due
hero.skill.chain.debt_comes_due.desc: Sloth. For 6 seconds heavy chains lie round you: the foes within 9 blocks are slowed and tired for up to 6 seconds (shared control lock, taken once), and so are you. Then the whole bill comes due on every foe within 11 blocks: one great blow of 16 and a stagger. 120 corruption.
hero.passive.mirror.spell_ward.desc: While the mirror is in your hand the magic damage you take is cut by 15 percent.
hero.passive.mirror.afterimage.desc: Your image repeats your next Mirror Bash or Prism Ray once, 0.6 seconds later and at half strength, and then dissolves.
hero.passive.instrument.perfect_pitch.de: Your notes never stray: the Music Strike flies true and the Demon's Melody fan stays narrow, even with no harmony.
hero.passive.instrument.fairy_choir.desc: Songs and tunes reach a quarter farther.
hero.passive.instrument.steady_beat.desc: The pocket in which the next technique counts as in time is a second wider, so harmony is easier to build.
hero.passive.harpoon.barbed_head.desc: A melee blow on the creature the line is tied to keeps the line alive 2 seconds longer, to 12 seconds after the throw at most.
hero.passive.harpoon.storm_charged.desc: The lightning of the throw arcs to one more foe beside the target.
hero.passive.sewing_set.fine_stitch.desc: A stitch mark in a foe lasts 4 seconds longer.
hero.passive.chain.heavy_links.desc: Every blow of the chain hangs a link on what it strikes. At the third blow in a row, each within 3 seconds of the last, the weight takes hold and the creature is slowed for 2 seconds.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.frightful: A True Dragon's pressure crushes the hall. %1$s failed the save.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.lair_tremor: The hall shudders. Get off the floor!
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.lair_light: Searing light gathers at a hero's feet. Move!
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.lair_stars: Stars fall around you. Watch the rings!
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.lair_mist: A necrotic mist rolls over the floor. Leave it.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.haki: The dragon's pressure rolls over you. %1$s failed the save.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.breath: It draws breath... %1$s! Get out of the ring!
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.mind_blast: A psychic wave rolls out. %1$s failed the save.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.death_touch: Death Touch marks %1$s. Step out of the circle!
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.lair_field: An anti-magic field blooms. Your magicules drain inside it.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.exec_cast: Word of Ending: %1$s is named. Heal, break line of sight, or break its concentration!
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.exec_mark: WORD OF ENDING - heal above 35 %, break sight, or hurt the boss hard!
nusmp.skill.hk_provoke.description: Roar a challenge: hostile creatures near you turn on you, and you gain a short Resistance. (Skill Tree: Oath of the Heavy Armor.)
nusmp.skill.hk_shield_wall.description: Plant yourself: strong Resistance and Absorption for a few seconds. (Skill Tree: Oath of the Heavy Armor.)
nusmp.skill.hk_shield_bash.description: Slam your shield into everyone in front of you: they are hurt, shoved back and slowed. (Skill Tree: Oath of the Heavy Armor.)
nusmp.skill.hk_power_strike.description: One heavy blow at the foe in front of you. (Skill Tree: Basic Swordsmanship.)
nusmp.skill.hk_swift_step.description: A quick dash forward with a breath of Resistance. (Skill Tree: Basic Swordsmanship.)
nusmp.skill.hk_crescent_cut.description: A wide sweeping cut through everyone in front of you. (Skill Tree: Basic Swordsmanship.)
nusmp.skill.hk_gamblers_coin.description: Flip a coin: heads gives Luck, Speed and Regeneration, tails a little Regeneration. Your Luck tilts the coin. (Skill Tree: Lady Luck.)
nusmp.skill.hk_jackpot.description: Secret Art. Pull the lever and the world pays out emeralds and experience; Luck makes the pot deeper. (Skill Tree: Lady Luck.)
tooltip.nusmp.skill_book.use: Right-click to read it. The book is used up.
gui.nusmp.shop.title: THE BLACK MARKET
gui.nusmp.shop.sub: Behind the cobwebs, nothing is cheap.
gui.nusmp.shop.empty_shelf: The shelves are bare. Come back after the dust settles.
gui.nusmp.shop.empty_goods: Nothing in your pockets interests me, dearie. Go and kill something.
gui.nusmp.shop.welcome: Come in, come in. Mind the cobwebs, they are older than you.
gui.nusmp.shop.hint_sneak: Sneak and right click to show her your coin
gui.nusmp.shop.hint_open: Right click to see her wares
gui.nusmp.shop.blurb.flagship: The fang. Every fire-eater's dream, and every fire-eater's ruin.
gui.nusmp.shop.blurb.route: A whole road in one book. Read it once and it is yours for good.
gui.nusmp.shop.blurb.sp: Small purse, small book. Points are points, dearie.
gui.nusmp.shop.blurb.sp.beginner_archery: A bow for beginners. Cheap, and worth every coin.
gui.nusmp.shop.blurb.sp.elemental_primer: The elements, for the curious. Handle with care, dearie.
gui.nusmp.shop.blurb.sp.magic_booster: A booster for the greedy. More points, more power.
gui.nusmp.shop.blurb.sp.jack_in_the_box: The Box. Little, usually. A great deal, sometimes. Hee hee.
gui.nusmp.shop.blurb.goods: %1$s gold each. Take it or leave it.
gui.nusmp.shop.blurb.sell: %1$s gold for one. Shift or right click and the whole stack goes.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.bought.1: Pleasure doing business, dearie. No refunds. No questions.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.bought.2: It is yours now. Do try not to read it in public.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.sold.1: Mm, fair goods. Here is your gold, count it twice.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.sold.2: Hee hee, thank you, dearie. The dungeon is generous.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.closed.1: The shop is shut, dearie. Come back when the lamps are lit.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.closed.2: Not today. The market is closed to you.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.far.1: Come closer, dearie. I do not shout my prices.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.far.2: Too far. I cannot take coin from a stranger across the room.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.unknown.1: That book is not on my shelves. Perhaps it never was.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.unknown.2: Hm? I have no such thing. Look again.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.sold_out.1: Gone. Someone was quicker with their coin, dearie.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.sold_out.2: Sold out. The shelves turn over in a few days. Hee hee.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.price_moved.1: The price moved while you dithered. Look again, dearie.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.price_moved.2: Ah, the market's mood changed. Look at the new price.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.limit.1: That is enough for one day. Come back when the sun has turned.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.limit.2: No more today, dearie. Even I have rules. A few.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.poor.1: Not enough gold, dearie. I accept coin, not promises.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.poor.2: Your purse is too light for that. Fill it and come back.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.nothing.1: Nothing there I want, dearie. Show me something with a price.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.nothing.2: I cannot pay for what you do not have.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.full_purse.1: Your purse cannot hold any more, dearie. Spend some first.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.full_purse.2: Heavy purse! Spend some gold before you sell me more.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.failed.1: Something went wrong, dearie. Try again. Do not blame me.
gui.nusmp.shop.reply.failed.2: The jars rattled. The deal did not happen. Try again.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.1: Hee hee hee... a customer. Shut the door behind you, %1$s, the draught is bad for the books. And for my business.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.2: Hush, hush. Keep your voice down, dearie. Nobody sold you anything and you were never here. Now then, what are you buying?
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.3: Well, well. Another one drawn in by the whisper of books. I am the Old Witch, %1$s, and everything on these shelves has a price. Everything.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.4: A new face. Fresh coin, I hope? Sneak up to me and show me your purse. I do not do business in the open.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.5: Revchi Salik is down, I hear. Hee hee. Chain thieves are bad for trade and heroes are good for it. Come, come, sneak up and show me what the dungeon gave you.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.6: You smell of the dungeon, %1$s, and of coin. The finest perfume there is. Sneak up and show me your purse, we have a great deal to talk about.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.7: Sneak and show me your coin, %1$s. A plain knock gets you chatter, a crouch gets you the shelves. That is how it is done here.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.8: Books. Dusty ones, rare ones. A fang that smoulders... for the right price. Hee hee. You know the one I mean.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.9: One of my books opens a whole road for you, dearie. Read it once and the road is yours for good. A bargain at any price. Mine are 'any price'.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.10: Those books fall from the dungeon too, did you know? The Abyssal side lets one slip now and then, and the guardians every tenth floor carry them. If you have the luck. I deal in certainty.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.11: Millions, for a road-book. Millions! Do not make that face. It is the market's mood, not mine. The price moves with the days, and I move with the price.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.12: My stock turns over every few days. When a book is gone, it is gone until the shelves turn, and whoever is quicker with their coin gets it.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.13: Small purses have the primers. Archery for beginners, the elements for the curious, a booster for the greedy... and the Box, for the brave. Or the foolish. Same thing on a good day.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.14: The Jack-in-the-Box? Little, usually. A great deal, sometimes. Hee hee. That is why it is called a gamble, dearie, and why the house loves it.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.15: I pay for what the dungeon gives: stones, crystals, gems, monster meat and the rest. Sneak up and I will name my price. Gold is the only language the market speaks.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.16: Raw monster meat, cooked monster meat, I take both. Cooked fetches more, mind. A little fire and a little patience and the same meat is worth twice as much. That is alchemy, dearie.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.17: Haggle? Hee hee hee. I never haggle. Ask the last fool who tried. Oh, you cannot. He is not here. Neither is the shop.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.18: You have been busy. Bosses fall and purses fill. Bring me the pieces, %1$s, and I will bring you what you came for.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.19: Early days for you, hm? Start with a primer. A few points go a long way when you have never had any. A road-book is for when your pockets are heavy.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.20: Do not touch the jars. The big one bites. The small one was a customer who was late with a payment.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.21: Come in, come in. Mind the cobwebs, they are older than you.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.22: Show me the coin first, dearie. Then the shelves. Those are the rules.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.23: Eyes on the shelf, hands off the shelf, purse on the counter. Lovely.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.24: Everything is for sale. Even my good mood, if the price is right.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.25: Take your time, %1$s. Looking is free. Touching is a purchase.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.26: Welcome back to the dust, %1$s. Let us see what your pockets have been up to.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.28: Spend freely, dearie, spend freely. I will not tell a soul. I never do. I have none.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.29: Hee hee hee. The door is where you left it. So am I.
arc.dialogue.black_market_witch.30: Still here? Buy something, or let the cobwebs have you.
item.nusmp.echidnas_tea_set.card: Rare Grade. A white porcelain tea set that is always warm and always set for two. A cup poured from it soothes the body and loosens the tongue, and for a moment you feel you are being watched kindly.
item.nusmp.echidnas_tea_set.desc: A white porcelain tea set that is always warm and always set for two. A cup poured from it soothes the body and loosens the tongue, and for a moment you feel you are being watched kindly.
item.nusmp.gospel_of_the_mansion.card: Unique Grade. A black book whose pages already describe the next hour. It tells you where to stand and when to step; the more closely you follow it, the less you are surprised.
item.nusmp.gospel_of_the_mansion.desc: A black book whose pages already describe the next hour. It tells you where to stand and when to step; the more closely you follow it, the less you are surprised.
item.nusmp.pucks_crystal_pendant.card: Unique Grade. A small cold crystal that is a sleeping spirit's home. Frost answers it; fire flinches from it. When you are in danger something small and grey is suddenly beside you.
item.nusmp.pucks_crystal_pendant.desc: A small cold crystal that is a sleeping spirit's home. Frost answers it; fire flinches from it. When you are in danger something small and grey is suddenly beside you.
item.nusmp.gloves_of_the_unseen_hand.car: Unique Grade. Black gloves that the wearer's hands barely seem to be in: the real work is done by invisible hands that reach farther than arms should.
item.nusmp.gloves_of_the_unseen_hand.des: Black gloves that the wearer's hands barely seem to be in: the real work is done by invisible hands that reach farther than arms should.
item.nusmp.oni_maids_horn_circlet.card: Rare Grade. A pink circlet with a single small horn. While you wear it you are stronger than you look, and fiercest when someone behind you is in danger.
item.nusmp.oni_maids_horn_circlet.desc: A pink circlet with a single small horn. While you wear it you are stronger than you look, and fiercest when someone behind you is in danger.
item.nusmp.sword_saints_mantle.card: Legend Grade. A white mantle with a thin gold border, worn by the line that gets the Divine Protections. Blows that should have hurt find the cloth first.
item.nusmp.sword_saints_mantle.desc: A white mantle with a thin gold border, worn by the line that gets the Divine Protections. Blows that should have hurt find the cloth first.
item.nusmp.shard_of_the_witch_factor.car: Legend Grade. A black shard that is warm in the hand and hungry. It gives power gladly and takes something in return: the wearer feels sharper, and a little less themselves.
item.nusmp.shard_of_the_witch_factor.des: A black shard that is warm in the hand and hungry. It gives power gladly and takes something in return: the wearer feels sharper, and a little less themselves.
item.nusmp.pocket_watch_of_return.card: God Grade. A silver pocket watch whose hands run backwards at the worst possible moment. It will not save you twice in a day, and it remembers every time it did.
item.nusmp.pocket_watch_of_return.desc: A silver pocket watch whose hands run backwards at the worst possible moment. It will not save you twice in a day, and it remembers every time it did.
item.nusmp.roswaals_jester_cloak.card: Unique Grade. A half-black, half-white cloak with a mad collar. The mana in its lining answers a whisper, and its wearer is not always where you aimed.
item.nusmp.roswaals_jester_cloak.desc: A half-black, half-white cloak with a mad collar. The mana in its lining answers a whisper, and its wearer is not always where you aimed.
item.nusmp.forbidden_library_key.card: Rare Grade. A small iron key on a chain. In any wall it finds a door to a room that is not on any map, and the door opens only for as long as you do not look back.
item.nusmp.forbidden_library_key.desc: A small iron key on a chain. In any wall it finds a door to a room that is not on any map, and the door opens only for as long as you do not look back.
item.nusmp.ribbon_of_the_half_elf.card: Rare Grade. A silver-white ribbon braided into the hair. Cold does not like it; neither does a lie told in front of it.
item.nusmp.ribbon_of_the_half_elf.desc: A silver-white ribbon braided into the hair. Cold does not like it; neither does a lie told in front of it.
item.nusmp.clairvoyant_monocle.card: Rare Grade. A single lens cut from red glass. Through it you see what someone nearby sees, and what is hiding behind a wall.
item.nusmp.clairvoyant_monocle.desc: A single lens cut from red glass. Through it you see what someone nearby sees, and what is hiding behind a wall.
item.nusmp.gauntlets_of_the_iron_fang.ca: Unique Grade. Heavy gauntlets with a row of iron teeth. Every blow lands a little heavier than it should, and whoever wears them is hard to move.
item.nusmp.gauntlets_of_the_iron_fang.de: Heavy gauntlets with a row of iron teeth. Every blow lands a little heavier than it should, and whoever wears them is hard to move.
item.nusmp.rogues_insignia.card: Rare Grade. A small badge that proves a thief has been somewhere they should not. It is very lucky, and very hard to catch.
item.nusmp.rogues_insignia.desc: A small badge that proves a thief has been somewhere they should not. It is very lucky, and very hard to catch.
item.nusmp.wind_blessed_mantle.card: Unique Grade. A green mantle that moves a moment before the wind does. Arrows part around the wearer, and the ground seems a little farther away.
item.nusmp.wind_blessed_mantle.desc: A green mantle that moves a moment before the wind does. Arrows part around the wearer, and the ground seems a little farther away.
item.nusmp.anastasias_fur_coat.card: Rare Grade. A thick, expensive fur coat. It keeps the cold out and the owner's luck in, and it is cut so that no one can quite tell how much it cost.
item.nusmp.anastasias_fur_coat.desc: A thick, expensive fur coat. It keeps the cold out and the owner's luck in, and it is cut so that no one can quite tell how much it cost.
item.nusmp.quasi_spirit_bracelet.card: Unique Grade. A bracelet set with six small stones, one for each of six small spirits that fight beside a knight. The stones glow in turn as they are asked.
item.nusmp.quasi_spirit_bracelet.desc: A bracelet set with six small stones, one for each of six small spirits that fight beside a knight. The stones glow in turn as they are asked.
item.nusmp.vollachian_dragon_scale_plate: Unique Grade. Red-black plate cut from the scale of a great dragon. It is heavy and proud and hard to burn; the old empire thought it made soldiers into something larger.
Red-black plate cut from the scale of a great dragon. It is heavy and proud and hard to burn; the old empire thought it made soldiers into something larger.
item.nusmp.murasames_sheath.card: Rare Grade. A black lacquered sheath with a red cord. Whoever wears it draws faster than the eye can follow, and the blade leaves no doubt about who drew it.
item.nusmp.murasames_sheath.desc: A black lacquered sheath with a red cord. Whoever wears it draws faster than the eye can follow, and the blade leaves no doubt about who drew it.
item.nusmp.tracksuit_of_the_wandering_he: Rare Grade. A very odd outfit of soft, stretchy cloth in a strange blue, with white stripes. It is comfortable beyond reason, and its wearer gets back up more often than they should.
A very odd outfit of soft, stretchy cloth in a strange blue, with white stripes. It is comfortable beyond reason, and its wearer gets back up more often than they should.
item.nusmp.red_whistle.card: Normal Grade. The first rung of a Delver's ladder: a red whistle on a cord. It is lucky for a beginner, and its owner is a little braver at the edge of a drop.
item.nusmp.red_whistle.desc: The first rung of a Delver's ladder: a red whistle on a cord. It is lucky for a beginner, and its owner is a little braver at the edge of a drop.
item.nusmp.blue_whistle.card: Special Grade. A blue whistle, for a Delver who has been below the first Layers and come back. The cave air feels a little lighter around it.
item.nusmp.blue_whistle.desc: A blue whistle, for a Delver who has been below the first Layers and come back. The cave air feels a little lighter around it.
item.nusmp.moon_whistle.card: Rare Grade. A pale whistle for the ones who have seen the dark below. Poison does not catch you easily, and your steps are quiet.
item.nusmp.moon_whistle.desc: A pale whistle for the ones who have seen the dark below. Poison does not catch you easily, and your steps are quiet.
item.nusmp.black_whistle.card: Unique Grade. A black whistle that has been past the Sixth Layer. Its owner is hard to kill and harder to scare, and no one can say what they have seen.
item.nusmp.black_whistle.desc: A black whistle that has been past the Sixth Layer. Its owner is hard to kill and harder to scare, and no one can say what they have seen.
item.nusmp.white_whistle.card: God Grade. A white whistle, worn by those who have seen the bottom. It is power and something more than power; its wearer has lost much to earn it and is hard to hurt.
item.nusmp.white_whistle.desc: A white whistle, worn by those who have seen the bottom. It is power and something more than power; its wearer has lost much to earn it and is hard to hurt.
item.nusmp.star_compass.card: Unique Grade. A brass compass with a needle that does not point north but to the place you want to find, if the place wants to be found.
item.nusmp.star_compass.desc: A brass compass with a needle that does not point north but to the place you want to find, if the place wants to be found.
item.nusmp.cradle_of_desire.card: Legend Grade. A pale cradle-shaped relic. It gives what you hope for and charges for it: when the cost comes due you may be at your weakest.
item.nusmp.cradle_of_desire.desc: A pale cradle-shaped relic. It gives what you hope for and charges for it: when the cost comes due you may be at your weakest.
item.nusmp.incinerator_arm.card: God Grade. A black mechanical arm that stores fire for a single blast that fells almost anything. Its owner is hard to knock down, and the arm hums.
item.nusmp.incinerator_arm.desc: A black mechanical arm that stores fire for a single blast that fells almost anything. Its owner is hard to knock down, and the arm hums.
item.nusmp.zoaholic_ring.card: Legend Grade. A ring with a hunger for the living. It would be happy to share what its wearer's body has, and, very rarely, to bring back what has been lost.
item.nusmp.zoaholic_ring.desc: A ring with a hunger for the living. It would be happy to share what its wearer's body has, and, very rarely, to bring back what has been lost.
item.nusmp.curse_repelling_vessel.card: Unique Grade. A glass vessel of grey water that drinks bad luck. The Abyss's curses come to it before they come to you, and it overflows eventually.
item.nusmp.curse_repelling_vessel.desc: A glass vessel of grey water that drinks bad luck. The Abyss's curses come to it before they come to you, and it overflows eventually.
item.nusmp.delvers_lantern.card: Rare Grade. A brass lantern whose flame never gets smaller below, and never gets bigger above. It lights the cave and keeps the dark out of your head.
item.nusmp.delvers_lantern.desc: A brass lantern whose flame never gets smaller below, and never gets bigger above. It lights the cave and keeps the dark out of your head.
item.nusmp.rikos_satchel.card: Rare Grade. A patched leather satchel that holds more than it should, and a little notebook in which every cave is somehow already drawn.
item.nusmp.rikos_satchel.desc: A patched leather satchel that holds more than it should, and a little notebook in which every cave is somehow already drawn.
item.nusmp.prushkas_fur_cloak.card: Rare Grade. A thick pelt cloak that smells of the Abyss. It keeps the cold out, and nothing that lives below looks at its wearer twice.
item.nusmp.prushkas_fur_cloak.desc: A thick pelt cloak that smells of the Abyss. It keeps the cold out, and nothing that lives below looks at its wearer twice.
item.nusmp.hollow_hood_of_nanachi.card: Unique Grade. A soft hood with long ears. Its wearer hears everything, sets traps no one has found, and is endlessly kind to those who deserve it.
item.nusmp.hollow_hood_of_nanachi.desc: A soft hood with long ears. Its wearer hears everything, sets traps no one has found, and is endlessly kind to those who deserve it.
item.nusmp.veil_of_the_princess_of_the_g: Veil of the Princess of the Gate
Legend Grade. A silver veil on a thin crown, worn by the one the Abyss calls its own. The lowest places take the wearer in, and everything above has a reason to fear.
A silver veil on a thin crown, worn by the one the Abyss calls its own. The lowest places take the wearer in, and everything above has a reason to fear.
item.nusmp.ozens_immovable_boots.card: Unique Grade. Heavy boots that remember being stood upon by a person who would not move. Almost nothing moves their wearer, and kicks land like falling rocks.
item.nusmp.ozens_immovable_boots.desc: Heavy boots that remember being stood upon by a person who would not move. Almost nothing moves their wearer, and kicks land like falling rocks.
item.nusmp.abyssal_curse_mantle.card: Unique Grade. A mantle the colour of a bruise that has been touched by the Curse of the Abyss. Wearing it hurts; hurting it hurts more.
item.nusmp.abyssal_curse_mantle.desc: A mantle the colour of a bruise that has been touched by the Curse of the Abyss. Wearing it hurts; hurting it hurts more.
item.nusmp.cave_raiders_greaves.card: Special Grade. Hard-wearing greaves for climbing: grip, ankle, and a short, sure first step on any slope.
item.nusmp.cave_raiders_greaves.desc: Hard-wearing greaves for climbing: grip, ankle, and a short, sure first step on any slope.
item.nusmp.seekers_pendant.card: Rare Grade. A pendant with a half-drawn map etched in it. It finishes the lines for you the deeper you go.
item.nusmp.seekers_pendant.desc: A pendant with a half-drawn map etched in it. It finishes the lines for you the deeper you go.
item.nusmp.cartridge_of_the_gate.card: Legend Grade. A boxy cartridge that does something to the world when it is fed to a machine. The machine is the Abyss, and the Abyss is happy to take it.
item.nusmp.cartridge_of_the_gate.desc: A boxy cartridge that does something to the world when it is fed to a machine. The machine is the Abyss, and the Abyss is happy to take it.
item.nusmp.shroud_of_the_sixth_layer.car: Legend Grade. A grey cloak that has seen the Layer where the body changes and the mind does not. The wearer does not feel the cold, nor much of anything else.
item.nusmp.shroud_of_the_sixth_layer.des: A grey cloak that has seen the Layer where the body changes and the mind does not. The wearer does not feel the cold, nor much of anything else.
item.nusmp.odins_all_seeing_eye.card: God Grade. A pale eye set in a gold band, taken from a god's tomb. The wearer sees what is hidden and what is meant, and pays for the sight by being known in return.
item.nusmp.odins_all_seeing_eye.desc: A pale eye set in a gold band, taken from a god's tomb. The wearer sees what is hidden and what is meant, and pays for the sight by being known in return.
item.nusmp.gungnirs_shadow.card: Legend Grade. The shadow of a spear that never misses, worn as a cloak: it cannot be touched by thrown things, and what you aim at is soon in front of you.
item.nusmp.gungnirs_shadow.desc: The shadow of a spear that never misses, worn as a cloak: it cannot be touched by thrown things, and what you aim at is soon in front of you.
item.nusmp.mammons_vault_ring.card: Legend Grade. A heavy gold ring with a coin-sized stone: anything you hold for long enough becomes more valuable. Luck follows it, and so does envy.
item.nusmp.mammons_vault_ring.desc: A heavy gold ring with a coin-sized stone: anything you hold for long enough becomes more valuable. Luck follows it, and so does envy.
item.nusmp.tomb_raiders_headlamp.card: Rare Grade. A miner's helmet with a lamp that does not need oil. It is a very old tool and a very good one, and tomb air sits easier with it on.
item.nusmp.tomb_raiders_headlamp.desc: A miner's helmet with a lamp that does not need oil. It is a very old tool and a very good one, and tomb air sits easier with it on.
item.nusmp.hunters_grappling_belt.card: Rare Grade. A belt with a coiled hook line, standard for the Hunters who climb into tombs. Short, safe, quick pulls.
item.nusmp.hunters_grappling_belt.desc: A belt with a coiled hook line, standard for the Hunters who climb into tombs. Short, safe, quick pulls.
item.nusmp.anubis_judges_pendant.card: Unique Grade. A jackal-headed scale in a black frame. The pendant weighs the wearer's blows against the target's sins, and the heavier the sin, the harder it hits.
item.nusmp.anubis_judges_pendant.desc: A jackal-headed scale in a black frame. The pendant weighs the wearer's blows against the target's sins, and the heavier the sin, the harder it hits.
item.nusmp.thoths_tablet.card: Unique Grade. A small clay tablet with a language that rearranges itself when you are not looking. Whatever the wearer needs to read, it has already translated.
item.nusmp.thoths_tablet.desc: A small clay tablet with a language that rearranges itself when you are not looking. Whatever the wearer needs to read, it has already translated.
item.nusmp.ras_dawn_crown.card: God Grade. A crown that holds a small piece of the dawn. It is gentle on friends and burns what has lived in the dark.
item.nusmp.ras_dawn_crown.desc: A crown that holds a small piece of the dawn. It is gentle on friends and burns what has lived in the dark.
item.nusmp.sphinxs_riddle_mask.card: Unique Grade. A stone mask with an unreadable face. Whoever fails its riddle finds themselves slower; whoever answers is faster than a thought.
item.nusmp.sphinxs_riddle_mask.desc: A stone mask with an unreadable face. Whoever fails its riddle finds themselves slower; whoever answers is faster than a thought.
item.nusmp.tomb_wardens_greaves.card: Special Grade. Stone-grey greaves that were made to stand at a tomb door for a thousand years, and are happy to start again.
item.nusmp.tomb_wardens_greaves.desc: Stone-grey greaves that were made to stand at a tomb door for a thousand years, and are happy to start again.
item.nusmp.hunter_license_insignia.card: Normal Grade. A small badge stamped with a rank. It does little but the Association knows who you are, and in the tombs that is worth a little luck.
item.nusmp.hunter_license_insignia.desc: A small badge stamped with a rank. It does little but the Association knows who you are, and in the tombs that is worth a little luck.
item.nusmp.cursed_pharaohs_wrappings.car: Unique Grade. Old linen that will not rot. Blows are softened in it, and what it does not stop it remembers.
item.nusmp.cursed_pharaohs_wrappings.des: Old linen that will not rot. Blows are softened in it, and what it does not stop it remembers.
item.nusmp.osiriss_reed_scepter_charm.ca: Legend Grade. A little green reed in a gold clasp. The tomb gods hold the dead in it, and the wearer may borrow a moment of that grace.
item.nusmp.osiriss_reed_scepter_charm.de: A little green reed in a gold clasp. The tomb gods hold the dead in it, and the wearer may borrow a moment of that grace.
item.nusmp.sets_storm_mantle.card: Legend Grade. A rust-red mantle that carries a little of the desert storm: it blows around the wearer and everything that stands near them.
item.nusmp.sets_storm_mantle.desc: A rust-red mantle that carries a little of the desert storm: it blows around the wearer and everything that stands near them.
item.nusmp.horus_falcon_gauntlets.card: Unique Grade. Blue-gold gauntlets with falcon talons. Fast hands, a quick eye, and a dive that strikes like a stone.
item.nusmp.horus_falcon_gauntlets.desc: Blue-gold gauntlets with falcon talons. Fast hands, a quick eye, and a dive that strikes like a stone.
item.nusmp.scarab_heart_amulet.card: Rare Grade. A scarab carved from green stone, placed over the heart. Not a lucky piece: a quiet one, and it keeps its wearer from saying anything they will regret.
item.nusmp.scarab_heart_amulet.desc: A scarab carved from green stone, placed over the heart. Not a lucky piece: a quiet one, and it keeps its wearer from saying anything they will regret.
item.nusmp.pharaohs_sandals_of_silence.c: Rare Grade. Gold-strapped sandals that make no sound on stone. The best way to cross a tomb is to wake nothing in it.
item.nusmp.pharaohs_sandals_of_silence.d: Gold-strapped sandals that make no sound on stone. The best way to cross a tomb is to wake nothing in it.
item.nusmp.seal_of_the_sealed_god.card: Genesis Grade. A fist-sized seal that has held something large for a long time. It is not entirely certain it should release it, but sometimes it does.
item.nusmp.seal_of_the_sealed_god.desc: A fist-sized seal that has held something large for a long time. It is not entirely certain it should release it, but sometimes it does.
item.nusmp.sukunas_finger.card: Unique Grade. A dried finger that is still, in some small way, awake. It hands out power in exchange for being fed, and its owner finds they are not entirely alone.
item.nusmp.sukunas_finger.desc: A dried finger that is still, in some small way, awake. It hands out power in exchange for being fed, and its owner finds they are not entirely alone.
item.nusmp.sukunas_twenty_fingers.card: Genesis Grade. All twenty, together. The King of Curses is not here, but his pride is, and it gives the wearer a power that has no good place to put it.
item.nusmp.sukunas_twenty_fingers.desc: All twenty, together. The King of Curses is not here, but his pride is, and it gives the wearer a power that has no good place to put it.
item.nusmp.playful_cloud_charm.card: Special Grade. A grey wrapping charm modelled on a heavy cursed tool. It adds a surprising amount of reach and weight to a swing.
item.nusmp.playful_cloud_charm.desc: A grey wrapping charm modelled on a heavy cursed tool. It adds a surprising amount of reach and weight to a swing.
item.nusmp.inverted_spear_of_heaven_wrap: Legend Grade. A binding of blank paper that cancels what it touches. Techniques wither at its edge, and its owner is wrapped in the quiet of having none.
A binding of blank paper that cancels what it touches. Techniques wither at its edge, and its owner is wrapped in the quiet of having none.
item.nusmp.black_flash_gloves.card: Unique Grade. Gloves that crackle black and red. A blow landed at exactly the right instant is worth many times its weight; practice makes it feel natural.
item.nusmp.black_flash_gloves.desc: Gloves that crackle black and red. A blow landed at exactly the right instant is worth many times its weight; practice makes it feel natural.
item.nusmp.limitless_blindfold.card: God Grade. A black blindfold over six blue eyes. Nothing reaches the wearer unless they let it, and when they pull the cloth away they can see all of it.
item.nusmp.limitless_blindfold.desc: A black blindfold over six blue eyes. Nothing reaches the wearer unless they let it, and when they pull the cloth away they can see all of it.
item.nusmp.prison_realm_cube.card: Genesis Grade. A cube of seals that has held someone who should not be held. It can hold something else, though not for ever, and it does not like to be asked.
item.nusmp.prison_realm_cube.desc: A cube of seals that has held someone who should not be held. It can hold something else, though not for ever, and it does not like to be asked.
item.nusmp.binding_vow_seal.card: Rare Grade. A tablet of vows. The more you give up, the stronger it gets: at the moment it asks only for your modesty.
item.nusmp.binding_vow_seal.desc: A tablet of vows. The more you give up, the stronger it gets: at the moment it asks only for your modesty.
item.nusmp.cursed_womb_death_painting.ca: Legend Grade. A scroll painted with a small, flat child. Whatever it is shown it keeps; whatever it keeps it may release in the wearer's time.
item.nusmp.cursed_womb_death_painting.de: A scroll painted with a small, flat child. Whatever it is shown it keeps; whatever it keeps it may release in the wearer's time.
item.nusmp.divergent_fist_knuckles.card: Rare Grade. Plain iron knuckles that deliver a blow in two moments, a heartbeat apart. The second does not care what the first did.
item.nusmp.divergent_fist_knuckles.desc: Plain iron knuckles that deliver a blow in two moments, a heartbeat apart. The second does not care what the first did.
item.nusmp.domain_expansion_mantle.card: Legend Grade. A black mantle sewn with an inner sky. Once a day it opens it, and the wearer's rules apply.
item.nusmp.domain_expansion_mantle.desc: A black mantle sewn with an inner sky. Once a day it opens it, and the wearer's rules apply.
item.nusmp.shikigami_whistle.card: Rare Grade. A black whistle that calls shadow creatures. They come reluctantly, and they will bite what you point at.
item.nusmp.shikigami_whistle.desc: A black whistle that calls shadow creatures. They come reluctantly, and they will bite what you point at.
item.nusmp.cursed_speech_collar.card: Unique Grade. A high collar over a mouth full of power. A single word can bring the room to a halt, but the throat is always sore.
item.nusmp.cursed_speech_collar.desc: A high collar over a mouth full of power. A single word can bring the room to a halt, but the throat is always sore.
item.nusmp.ten_shadows_seal.card: Legend Grade. A black seal that opens onto ten shadows, each an ally that must first be beaten. Anyone it has taken is kept, for now.
item.nusmp.ten_shadows_seal.desc: A black seal that opens onto ten shadows, each an ally that must first be beaten. Anyone it has taken is kept, for now.
item.nusmp.reverse_cursed_technique_char: Unique Grade. A green charm that turns bad energy into good. It is difficult to learn and very hard to be killed while holding.
A green charm that turns bad energy into good. It is difficult to learn and very hard to be killed while holding.
item.nusmp.jujutsu_high_uniform.card: Rare Grade. A dark student uniform with gold buttons, the practical clothing of someone who goes into curses for a living.
item.nusmp.jujutsu_high_uniform.desc: A dark student uniform with gold buttons, the practical clothing of someone who goes into curses for a living.
item.nusmp.cursed_spirit_sash.card: Special Grade. A sash of absorbed curses that rustles when something nearby is wrong. It shares its fear generously.
item.nusmp.cursed_spirit_sash.desc: A sash of absorbed curses that rustles when something nearby is wrong. It shares its fear generously.
item.nusmp.holy_grail_fragment.card: Genesis Grade. A golden fragment of a cup that grants a wish and charges it to everyone else. It will not break; it can only be spent.
item.nusmp.holy_grail_fragment.desc: A golden fragment of a cup that grants a wish and charges it to everyone else. It will not break; it can only be spent.
item.nusmp.command_seal_tattoo.card: Unique Grade. Three red marks on the back of the hand: three orders that cannot be refused, and each is a little shorter than the last.
item.nusmp.command_seal_tattoo.desc: Three red marks on the back of the hand: three orders that cannot be refused, and each is a little shorter than the last.
item.nusmp.rule_breaker_dagger_charm.car: Legend Grade. A crooked little blade that cancels every contract. The wearer is not much of a fighter; but nothing can bind them.
item.nusmp.rule_breaker_dagger_charm.des: A crooked little blade that cancels every contract. The wearer is not much of a fighter; but nothing can bind them.
item.nusmp.excaliburs_scabbard_avalon.ca: God Grade. An ornate scabbard of green and gold. It will not allow its owner to be hurt where it is worn, and its owner does not age.
item.nusmp.excaliburs_scabbard_avalon.de: An ornate scabbard of green and gold. It will not allow its owner to be hurt where it is worn, and its owner does not age.
item.nusmp.gae_bolg_spear_charm.card: Legend Grade. A red barb that curses a wound so it cannot close. Once you are marked for it it is simply a matter of when.
item.nusmp.gae_bolg_spear_charm.desc: A red barb that curses a wound so it cannot close. Once you are marked for it it is simply a matter of when.
item.nusmp.gate_of_babylon_crest.card: Genesis Grade. A golden mantle woven with doors, each one open on a different treasury. Whatever you need is there, and whatever you want is somewhere else.
item.nusmp.gate_of_babylon_crest.desc: A golden mantle woven with doors, each one open on a different treasury. Whatever you need is there, and whatever you want is somewhere else.
Legend Grade. A brooch with a rusted field in it: swords on a hill, each one copied once and never forgotten. The wearer makes a decent copy of anything.
A brooch with a rusted field in it: swords on a hill, each one copied once and never forgotten. The wearer makes a decent copy of anything.
item.nusmp.catalyst_fang_of_the_beast_ki: Catalyst Fang of the Beast King
Rare Grade. A fang kept as a catalyst: it calls a servant of the same beast kind, when one can be found. It is as lucky for the finder as for the beast.
A fang kept as a catalyst: it calls a servant of the same beast kind, when one can be found. It is as lucky for the finder as for the beast.
item.nusmp.servant_contract_ring.card: Rare Grade. A ring that binds mana between a master and a servant. The master's strength flows out; the servant's flows back, and the two share a pulse.
item.nusmp.servant_contract_ring.desc: A ring that binds mana between a master and a servant. The master's strength flows out; the servant's flows back, and the two share a pulse.
item.nusmp.rulers_banner_mantle.card: Unique Grade. A white mantle with a blue cross, borne by one who judges war without joining it. Allies at your back feel it; enemies feel it too.
item.nusmp.rulers_banner_mantle.desc: A white mantle with a blue cross, borne by one who judges war without joining it. Allies at your back feel it; enemies feel it too.
item.nusmp.mystic_eyes_of_the_rider.card: Unique Grade. A fall of violet hair parted over a pair of eyes. Whatever they look at turns to stone, for a moment; not the wearer, who sees in the dark.
item.nusmp.mystic_eyes_of_the_rider.desc: A fall of violet hair parted over a pair of eyes. Whatever they look at turns to stone, for a moment; not the wearer, who sees in the dark.
item.nusmp.sabers_blue_dress_armor.card: Legend Grade. A silver breastplate over a blue dress, the clothing of a king who is a young woman and does not apologise for either.
item.nusmp.sabers_blue_dress_armor.desc: A silver breastplate over a blue dress, the clothing of a king who is a young woman and does not apologise for either.
item.nusmp.archers_red_cloak.card: Unique Grade. A weather-beaten red cloak, worn by someone who knows that every battle is the same battle. Arrow and bolt alike go a little off for him.
item.nusmp.archers_red_cloak.desc: A weather-beaten red cloak, worn by someone who knows that every battle is the same battle. Arrow and bolt alike go a little off for him.
item.nusmp.servant_summoning_circle_chal: Special Grade. A vial of mixed chalk and blood for drawing circles. It is surprisingly useful for drawing lines, too.
A vial of mixed chalk and blood for drawing circles. It is surprisingly useful for drawing lines, too.
item.nusmp.berserkers_stone_skin_plate.c: Unique Grade. A grey slab of chest plate that took twelve blows to wear down. Each blow that lands on it is one fewer in the world.
item.nusmp.berserkers_stone_skin_plate.d: A grey slab of chest plate that took twelve blows to wear down. Each blow that lands on it is one fewer in the world.
Rare Grade. A white skull mask over a dark hood. Its owner is hard to find, easy to forget, and has already been where you are going.
A white skull mask over a dark hood. Its owner is hard to find, easy to forget, and has already been where you are going.
item.nusmp.casters_rule_breaker_cowl.car: Unique Grade. A violet cowl for a witch of the old gods. Its wearer does little with their hands, and a great deal with the air.
item.nusmp.casters_rule_breaker_cowl.des: A violet cowl for a witch of the old gods. Its wearer does little with their hands, and a great deal with the air.
item.nusmp.kotomines_black_keys_cord.car: Rare Grade. A cord of blessed black thread with a row of pins. It is not a nice thing; it is a very effective one.
item.nusmp.kotomines_black_keys_cord.des: A cord of blessed black thread with a row of pins. It is not a nice thing; it is a very effective one.
item.nusmp.noble_phantasm_token.card: Special Grade. A coin that can be spent once, on one great gesture. It comes back at dawn, and some say it grants wishes.
item.nusmp.noble_phantasm_token.desc: A coin that can be spent once, on one great gesture. It comes back at dawn, and some say it grants wishes.
item.nusmp.return_crystal.card: Special Grade. A clear crystal that remembers where you stood. Hold it and it carries you out of the dungeon to Floor 0, and keeps the place so you can find your way back to the very block.
item.nusmp.return_crystal.desc: A clear crystal that remembers where you stood. Hold it and it carries you out of the dungeon to Floor 0, and keeps the place so you can find your way back to the very block.
item.nusmp.gate_key.card: Rare Grade. A heavy brass key cut for no lock you can find. Away from the dungeon it opens the way back to the place you left, exactly; held while sneaking it opens a Return Portal on the spot.
item.nusmp.gate_key.desc: A heavy brass key cut for no lock you can find. Away from the dungeon it opens the way back to the place you left, exactly; held while sneaking it opens a Return Portal on the spot.
item.nusmp.rift_compass.card: Rare Grade. A compass whose needle ignores north and swings toward the nearest tear in the dungeon's air.
item.nusmp.rift_compass.desc: A compass whose needle ignores north and swings toward the nearest tear in the dungeon's air.
item.nusmp.pocket_key.card: Legend Grade. A small violet key that unlocks nothing and everything. Turn it in the air of a floor and a hidden realm's door opens in front of you, once a day.
item.nusmp.pocket_key.desc: A small violet key that unlocks nothing and everything. Turn it in the air of a floor and a hidden realm's door opens in front of you, once a day.
item.nusmp.waypoint_anchor.card: Special Grade. A small iron anchor on a chain. Squeeze it and the place you are standing becomes the one the Return Crystal and the Gate Key bring you back to.
item.nusmp.waypoint_anchor.desc: A small iron anchor on a chain. Squeeze it and the place you are standing becomes the one the Return Crystal and the Gate Key bring you back to.
item.nusmp.ring_of_the_sorcerer_king.car: Legend Grade. A ring of black metal with a ruby that looks like a small, patient eye. Its wearer's magic comes easier, and the dead do not like to attack them.
item.nusmp.ring_of_the_sorcerer_king.des: A ring of black metal with a ruby that looks like a small, patient eye. Its wearer's magic comes easier, and the dead do not like to attack them.
item.nusmp.gloves_of_nazarick.card: Rare Grade. Black gloves with a gold crest on the back. Every spell cast through them feels as if someone has already prepared the ground.
item.nusmp.gloves_of_nazarick.desc: Black gloves with a gold crest on the back. Every spell cast through them feels as if someone has already prepared the ground.
item.nusmp.great_tomb_sigil.card: Unique Grade. A bone-white sigil from the tomb's gate. Inside its own halls a bearer of it is a different kind of creature; outside, only a little of that remains.
item.nusmp.great_tomb_sigil.desc: A bone-white sigil from the tomb's gate. Inside its own halls a bearer of it is a different kind of creature; outside, only a little of that remains.
item.nusmp.mantle_of_the_overlord.card: God Grade. A mantle that seems to have more folds than it has cloth. Those who look at it hear a faint, courteous laugh and forget what they meant to say.
item.nusmp.mantle_of_the_overlord.desc: A mantle that seems to have more folds than it has cloth. Those who look at it hear a faint, courteous laugh and forget what they meant to say.
item.nusmp.skull_mask_of_the_undead_king: Skull Mask of the Undead King
Legend Grade. A smooth white skull mask with two embers for eyes. It makes the wearer unreadable and the living around them slightly afraid.
A smooth white skull mask with two embers for eyes. It makes the wearer unreadable and the living around them slightly afraid.
item.nusmp.shalltears_spirit_robe.card: Legend Grade. A crimson gown with a lace collar and a sleeve full of small, hungry spirits. It heals the wearer when it is hurt, and then asks for something in return.
item.nusmp.shalltears_spirit_robe.desc: A crimson gown with a lace collar and a sleeve full of small, hungry spirits. It heals the wearer when it is hurt, and then asks for something in return.
item.nusmp.albedos_black_wings_brooch.ca: Rare Grade. A brooch of one black feather and one white. A woman with a gentle smile once said it was a promise; it keeps its wearer warm and steady.
item.nusmp.albedos_black_wings_brooch.de: A brooch of one black feather and one white. A woman with a gentle smile once said it was a promise; it keeps its wearer warm and steady.
item.nusmp.cocytuss_frost_gauntlets.card: Unique Grade. Blue-white gauntlets rimed with ice. They do not feel cold to the one wearing them, and everything they strike afterwards is slower.
item.nusmp.cocytuss_frost_gauntlets.desc: Blue-white gauntlets rimed with ice. They do not feel cold to the one wearing them, and everything they strike afterwards is slower.
item.nusmp.demiurges_spectacles.card: Unique Grade. A pair of rimless spectacles over eyes that count everything. Plans go better around them, and not always for the people they were made for.
item.nusmp.demiurges_spectacles.desc: A pair of rimless spectacles over eyes that count everything. Plans go better around them, and not always for the people they were made for.
item.nusmp.auras_whistle.card: Rare Grade. A green whistle for a small, loud forest. Beasts hear it and come; plain enemies hear it and think better of it.
item.nusmp.auras_whistle.desc: A green whistle for a small, loud forest. Beasts hear it and come; plain enemies hear it and think better of it.
item.nusmp.mares_hood_of_earth.card: Rare Grade. A hood with two earth-brown ears. The ground obliges its wearer: it lifts, it holds, it swallows.
item.nusmp.mares_hood_of_earth.desc: A hood with two earth-brown ears. The ground obliges its wearer: it lifts, it holds, it swallows.
item.nusmp.sebass_butler_gloves.card: Special Grade. White gloves that have never been dirty. A calm hand lands a blow where it is aimed and never wastes one.
item.nusmp.sebass_butler_gloves.desc: White gloves that have never been dirty. A calm hand lands a blow where it is aimed and never wastes one.
item.nusmp.pandoras_actor_mask.card: Unique Grade. A smooth egg-shaped mask. It becomes whatever face the wearer needs, and the wearer is only sure which one it was afterwards.
item.nusmp.pandoras_actor_mask.desc: A smooth egg-shaped mask. It becomes whatever face the wearer needs, and the wearer is only sure which one it was afterwards.
item.nusmp.rubedo_thread_charm.card: Special Grade. A thread of red tied in a bow. It does very little, except bring the bearer back to the tomb's good graces.
item.nusmp.rubedo_thread_charm.desc: A thread of red tied in a bow. It does very little, except bring the bearer back to the tomb's good graces.
item.nusmp.scroll_case_of_the_tenth_tier: Scroll Case of the Tenth Tier
Rare Grade. A leather case of scrolls too heavy for the room. One page is always the right one, and it is never the one you wanted.
A leather case of scrolls too heavy for the room. One page is always the right one, and it is never the one you wanted.
item.nusmp.cloak_of_the_floor_guardian.c: Special Grade. A short cape with a crest. It makes ordinary arrows think twice.
item.nusmp.cloak_of_the_floor_guardian.d: A short cape with a crest. It makes ordinary arrows think twice.
item.nusmp.belt_of_the_eight_edge.card: Rare Grade. A belt of eight small black blades, tipped with something that makes the bearer's knives quieter.
item.nusmp.belt_of_the_eight_edge.desc: A belt of eight small black blades, tipped with something that makes the bearer's knives quieter.
Special Grade. Boots that smell of old stone and never leave a track. Underfoot, the dead make room.
Boots that smell of old stone and never leave a track. Underfoot, the dead make room.
item.nusmp.crystal_of_resurrection.card: Unique Grade. A clear crystal in a gold net: a spell that remembers. It brings back one who has just fallen and costs something quiet and large.
item.nusmp.crystal_of_resurrection.desc: A clear crystal in a gold net: a spell that remembers. It brings back one who has just fallen and costs something quiet and large.
item.nusmp.guild_banner_of_ainz_ooal_gow: Guild Banner of Ainz Ooal Gown
Legend Grade. A banner worn as a mantle: forty-one sigils, thirty-seven of them for people who are not here. Allies near the wearer fight as if the room were full.
A banner worn as a mantle: forty-one sigils, thirty-seven of them for people who are not here. Allies near the wearer fight as if the room were full.
item.nusmp.staff_mages_journey_pendant.c: Rare Grade. A star-shaped pendant from a ten-year journey. It remembers every camp the wearer slept at, and makes the next one a little safer.
item.nusmp.staff_mages_journey_pendant.d: A star-shaped pendant from a ten-year journey. It remembers every camp the wearer slept at, and makes the next one a little safer.
item.nusmp.heros_statue_charm.card: Unique Grade. A small stone figurine of a brave person. It makes its owner a little braver than is wise.
item.nusmp.heros_statue_charm.desc: A small stone figurine of a brave person. It makes its owner a little braver than is wise.
item.nusmp.mirror_lotus_hairpin.card: Rare Grade. A hairpin of a flower that blooms in a mirror. Whoever wears it sees through a trick once and is never fooled by it again.
item.nusmp.mirror_lotus_hairpin.desc: A hairpin of a flower that blooms in a mirror. Whoever wears it sees through a trick once and is never fooled by it again.
item.nusmp.grimoire_of_flower_fields.car: Unique Grade. A book of spells that do almost nothing except make flowers. In the right hands, and with enough of them, it makes a battlefield very kind.
item.nusmp.grimoire_of_flower_fields.des: A book of spells that do almost nothing except make flowers. In the right hands, and with enough of them, it makes a battlefield very kind.
item.nusmp.zoltraak_mages_mantle.card: Legend Grade. A mantle of the school that wrote the spell that cuts anything. The wearer's cast goes out clean and narrow, and what it touches does not argue.
item.nusmp.zoltraak_mages_mantle.desc: A mantle of the school that wrote the spell that cuts anything. The wearer's cast goes out clean and narrow, and what it touches does not argue.
item.nusmp.ferns_diligence_ribbon.card: Rare Grade. A neat blue ribbon from someone who practises every day. Spells come out fast and plain; none of them are wasted.
item.nusmp.ferns_diligence_ribbon.desc: A neat blue ribbon from someone who practises every day. Spells come out fast and plain; none of them are wasted.
item.nusmp.starks_cowardly_axe_strap.car: Rare Grade. A heavy belt of someone who is afraid of everything and has never once stepped back. The fear becomes strength, a little late.
item.nusmp.starks_cowardly_axe_strap.des: A heavy belt of someone who is afraid of everything and has never once stepped back. The fear becomes strength, a little late.
item.nusmp.himmels_sword_sheath_charm.ca: Legend Grade. A blue sheath charm of the hero who was kind. A friend close by feels braver and swings harder.
item.nusmp.himmels_sword_sheath_charm.de: A blue sheath charm of the hero who was kind. A friend close by feels braver and swings harder.
item.nusmp.heiters_brandy_flask.card: Special Grade. A priest's flask of something strong. It heals, and then makes the wearer a little less afraid than they should be.
item.nusmp.heiters_brandy_flask.desc: A priest's flask of something strong. It heals, and then makes the wearer a little less afraid than they should be.
item.nusmp.eisens_shield_strap.card: Unique Grade. A dwarf warrior's shield strap. Behind it nothing is touched until the strap goes, and it has never gone.
item.nusmp.eisens_shield_strap.desc: A dwarf warrior's shield strap. Behind it nothing is touched until the strap goes, and it has never gone.
item.nusmp.series_ancient_grimoire.card: God Grade. An elf's book of spells older than the languages it was written in. It knows what the wearer is about to cast, and cheerfully lends a few more.
item.nusmp.series_ancient_grimoire.desc: An elf's book of spells older than the languages it was written in. It knows what the wearer is about to cast, and cheerfully lends a few more.
item.nusmp.ubels_slicing_cord.card: Rare Grade. A thin pink cord around the wrist that cuts what it is aimed at, as long as its wearer can picture the cut.
item.nusmp.ubels_slicing_cord.desc: A thin pink cord around the wrist that cuts what it is aimed at, as long as its wearer can picture the cut.
item.nusmp.wirbels_guard_pendant.card: Special Grade. A guard's pendant, plain and well kept. Its wearer watches the road and is not startled.
item.nusmp.wirbels_guard_pendant.desc: A guard's pendant, plain and well kept. Its wearer watches the road and is not startled.
item.nusmp.land_of_souls_lantern.card: Legend Grade. A lantern with a flame that is the shape of someone you miss. It lights the way, and gently brings someone back from the edge.
item.nusmp.land_of_souls_lantern.desc: A lantern with a flame that is the shape of someone you miss. It lights the way, and gently brings someone back from the edge.
item.nusmp.flammes_founder_cloak.card: God Grade. A cloak of the founder of human magic. Those who wear it can cast a spell that has no name, and it is always the right spell.
item.nusmp.flammes_founder_cloak.desc: A cloak of the founder of human magic. Those who wear it can cast a spell that has no name, and it is always the right spell.
item.nusmp.travelers_boots_of_the_journe: Special Grade. Boots that remember a hundred roads. The next mile is always a little shorter.
Boots that remember a hundred roads. The next mile is always a little shorter.
item.nusmp.magic_of_the_soul_compass.car: Unique Grade. A compass that points to where a person's soul lives. Walls are not obstacles for it, only for the walker.
item.nusmp.magic_of_the_soul_compass.des: A compass that points to where a person's soul lives. Walls are not obstacles for it, only for the walker.
item.nusmp.demon_hunters_spirit_mask.car: Rare Grade. A mask of a mage who spent a lifetime killing demons. Its wearer feels the lies in a voice.
item.nusmp.demon_hunters_spirit_mask.des: A mask of a mage who spent a lifetime killing demons. Its wearer feels the lies in a voice.
item.nusmp.imitation_ring_of_the_first_c: Imitation Ring of the First-Class Exam
Special Grade. A ring from a hard exam that nobody was supposed to pass. It brings out a little more than its wearer thought they had.
A ring from a hard exam that nobody was supposed to pass. It brings out a little more than its wearer thought they had.
item.nusmp.cooks_dungeon_pot.card: Rare Grade. A big iron pot that can make a meal of almost anything, and always does. Stew from it restores and settles the stomach and the mind.
item.nusmp.cooks_dungeon_pot.desc: A big iron pot that can make a meal of almost anything, and always does. Stew from it restores and settles the stomach and the mind.
item.nusmp.walking_mushroom_pouch.card: Special Grade. A belt of pouches that smell of mushrooms, which turn out to be a good thing to have around when somebody is poisoned.
item.nusmp.walking_mushroom_pouch.desc: A belt of pouches that smell of mushrooms, which turn out to be a good thing to have around when somebody is poisoned.
item.nusmp.dwarfs_knife_roll.card: Rare Grade. A roll of well-oiled kitchen knives. A cook with them cuts anything clean, including what was meant to be dodged.
item.nusmp.dwarfs_knife_roll.desc: A roll of well-oiled kitchen knives. A cook with them cuts anything clean, including what was meant to be dodged.
item.nusmp.apron_of_the_dungeon_cook.car: Special Grade. A stained apron with deep pockets. Tired travellers eat and are less tired, and the wearer is hard to catch on a hot pan.
item.nusmp.apron_of_the_dungeon_cook.des: A stained apron with deep pockets. Tired travellers eat and are less tired, and the wearer is hard to catch on a hot pan.
item.nusmp.slime_jelly_ring.card: Special Grade. A ring of a green jelly that does not melt. The wearer shrugs off a little of what lands on them.
item.nusmp.slime_jelly_ring.desc: A ring of a green jelly that does not melt. The wearer shrugs off a little of what lands on them.
item.nusmp.kelpies_bridle.card: Unique Grade. A bridle of wet leather that remembers being a horse. It carries its wearer over water as if there were no water.
item.nusmp.kelpies_bridle.desc: A bridle of wet leather that remembers being a horse. It carries its wearer over water as if there were no water.
item.nusmp.chimeras_spice_rack.card: Rare Grade. A little rack of spices from a monster that had too many parts. The right pinch makes a blade hotter or a wound cooler.
item.nusmp.chimeras_spice_rack.desc: A little rack of spices from a monster that had too many parts. The right pinch makes a blade hotter or a wound cooler.
item.nusmp.dragon_scale_frying_pan.card: Unique Grade. A black pan made from a scale, too heavy to lift and too good to put down. It takes a hit and gives it back.

item.nusmp.knights_appetite_charm.card: Special Grade. A charm worn by someone who has never turned down a bite. Hunger is kept at bay and morale never wanders.
item.nusmp.knights_appetite_charm.desc: A charm worn by someone who has never turned down a bite. Hunger is kept at bay and morale never wanders.
item.nusmp.lycans_moonlit_collar.card: Rare Grade. A collar with a silver tooth. In moonlight the wearer is a little quicker and a little less careful.

item.nusmp.golem_garden_gloves.card: Special Grade. Gloves of a gardener who tends a field of stone. Earth does what it is asked, gently.

item.nusmp.hobgoblins_rice_bowl.card: Special Grade. A plain bowl of rice that is warm every time it is opened. A very modest kind of miracle.
item.nusmp.hobgoblins_rice_bowl.desc: A plain bowl of rice that is warm every time it is opened. A very modest kind of miracle.

item.nusmp.adventurers_ration_satchel.ca: Normal Grade. A satchel of dried rations. It will not impress anyone, but nobody has ever starved with it.

item.nusmp.knight_of_the_shadow_ring.car: Unique Grade. A ring that holds a loyal, quiet soldier. When the wearer is hit hard, a dark knight appears to take the next one.

item.nusmp.stone_statue_pendant.desc: A small stone statue pendant from a trial room. Fits well and stands still very patiently.

item.nusmp.monarchs_command_sigil.desc: A sigil on the back of the hand that makes a dark order out of a suggestion.

A plain blue brooch for a mage who stopped saying the words. Casting is silent, quick and slightly embarrassed.

item.nusmp.man_gods_whisper_mask.desc: A smiling mask and a voice that is very helpful. Everything it says is just true enough to follow.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.name: The Curse of the Rim
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.desc: A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.flavor: Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.
The Curse of the Rim: Rotting Rim

A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. The sickness is a creeping rot that eats health instead of the stomach.
Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.
The Curse of the Rim: Footfall
A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. Running in its area sets it off.
Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.c_hold_li: The Curse of the Rim: Lantern-bearer

A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. Carry a light through it long enough and it relents.
Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.e_bleed.f: Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.name: The Ebb and Flow of Magic
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.desc: The floor's mana rises and falls like a tide: while it ebbs the delvers' magicules drain away, and the pulse repeats until the tide is turned.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.flavor: Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.e_surge.n: The Ebb and Flow of Magic: Surging Tide

mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.e_surge.f: Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.t_area_en: The Ebb and Flow of Magic: Threshold

mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.c_lever.f: Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.e_blessin: The Ebb and Flow of Magic: Tide of Plenty

Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.
