mechanic.nusmp.floor.gravity_change.name: Gravity Change
mechanic.nusmp.floor.gravity_change.desc: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.gravity_change.e_he: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires. Gravity swings the other way and nails everyone to the stones.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.gravity_change.t_ju: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires. Jumping in its area sets it off.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.gravity_change.c_le: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.gravity_change.e_sp: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires. The pull turns sideways and swirls, and nobody can walk straight.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.gravity_change.t_pa: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.silence_field.name: Field of Silence
mechanic.nusmp.floor.silence_field.desc: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.silence_field.flavo: No sound enters. No incantation leaves.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.silence_field.e_man: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time. It also bleeds a share of their magicules each time.
No sound enters. No incantation leaves.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.silence_field.t_ite: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time. It reacts to the use of items in its area.
No sound enters. No incantation leaves.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.silence_field.c_lev: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
No sound enters. No incantation leaves.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.silence_field.e_dea: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time. It is worse than quiet: the sound is gone and so is the sense of direction.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.silence_field.t_dam: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.na: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room
mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.de: Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.fl: A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.e_: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Quickened Hours
Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year. Time runs the other way too: it throws everyone forward faster than they can steer.
A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.t_: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Threshold
Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.c_: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Anchored
Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.e_: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Stuttering Hours

Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year. Time hiccups: the walls blink and everyone is carried a step back to where they entered.
A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.t_: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Footfall

A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.c_: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Endurance

A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.living_labyrinth.de: The dungeon rearranges itself: walls thicken out of nowhere and as quickly thin away again, closing off a path just as a delver commits to it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.living_labyrinth.fl: She is a mother, and she turns over in her sleep.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.living_labyrinth.e_: The Labyrinth Is Alive: Closing Walls

The dungeon rearranges itself: walls thicken out of nowhere and as quickly thin away again, closing off a path just as a delver commits to it. The walls do not blink: they close round the party and stay shut a while.
She is a mother, and she turns over in her sleep.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.living_labyrinth.t_: The dungeon rearranges itself: walls thicken out of nowhere and as quickly thin away again, closing off a path just as a delver commits to it. It answers the dungeon's deaths: every few kills in the area set it off.
She is a mother, and she turns over in her sleep.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.living_labyrinth.c_: The dungeon rearranges itself: walls thicken out of nowhere and as quickly thin away again, closing off a path just as a delver commits to it. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.living_labyrinth.e_: The Labyrinth Is Alive: Glass Walls

mechanic.nusmp.floor.living_labyrinth.t_: The dungeon rearranges itself: walls thicken out of nowhere and as quickly thin away again, closing off a path just as a delver commits to it. Standing still in its area for a few seconds sets it off.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.name: The Eclipse Dark
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.desc: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.flavor: Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.e_hush: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. Nothing but the dark: no darkness potion, only the lamps gone.
Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.t_dark: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. It thrives where the light is low and strikes the delver who lingers in the dark.
Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.c_hold: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. Carry a light through it long enough and it relents.
Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.e_eyes: The Eclipse Dark: Eyes in the Eclipse
The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. Things hunt in the dark: a swarm of small biters comes with the lamps going out.
Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.t_hp_b: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. It smells a wounded delver and strikes when someone drops under half health.
Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.name: The Weeping Sky
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.desc: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.flavor: The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.e_storm: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day. The rain turns to a storm, and bolts walk the floor.
The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.t_timer: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.c_hold_: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day. Carry a light through it long enough and it relents.
The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.e_clear: The Weeping Sky: The Cleared Sky

The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.t_area_: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.red_gate_magma.desc: In the red dungeons the ground itself turns against the hunters: patches of floor go to glowing magma under their feet, for a while, on a timer.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.red_gate_magma.flav: The floor lit up, and the hunters ran.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.red_gate_magma.e_ri: Red Gate Magma: Ring of Fire

mechanic.nusmp.floor.rukh_current.desc: The birds of fate flow through the corridors as a visible current: those who walk with it are mended, those who stand against it are chilled.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rukh_current.flavor: Everything that lives is carried by the Rukh, and returns to it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rukh_current.e_coun: The Current of the Rukh: Counter-Current

Everything that lives is carried by the Rukh, and returns to it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rukh_current.t_area: The Current of the Rukh: Threshold

Everything that lives is carried by the Rukh, and returns to it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rukh_current.t_idle: The Current of the Rukh: Stillness

Everything that lives is carried by the Rukh, and returns to it.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.wild_surge.desc: The raw magic of the floor goes off at random: each surge picks one wild effect, and nobody, the floor included, knows which.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.wild_surge.flavor: Roll the die. Tell the table what you meant to do.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.wild_surge.e_kind.d: The raw magic of the floor goes off at random: each surge picks one wild effect, and nobody, the floor included, knows which. A kinder table: the surge draws only the gifts, a heal and a shield of luck.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.name: The Hunger of the Depths
mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.desc: Everything on this floor is a little bit hungry, and it feeds on you: the deeper the floor, the more of your magicules it gnaws (your food bar is never touched), and only a proper meal laid out for it puts it right.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.flavor: Eat the monster. It is only polite.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.e_cook: The Hunger of the Depths: Cook's Hunger

Everything on this floor is a little bit hungry, and it feeds on you: the deeper the floor, the more of your magicules it gnaws (your food bar is never touched), and only a proper meal laid out for it puts it right. Hunger bites, but it also bargains: a smell of stew restores a share of health with each wave.
Eat the monster. It is only polite.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.t_spri: The Hunger of the Depths: Footfall

mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.c_item: The Hunger of the Depths: Tribute

Eat the monster. It is only polite.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.e_shak: The Hunger of the Depths: Shaky Hands

Everything on this floor is a little bit hungry, and it feeds on you: the deeper the floor, the more of your magicules it gnaws (your food bar is never touched), and only a proper meal laid out for it puts it right. A starving hand shakes: every wave also breaks the grip on every item for a few seconds.
Eat the monster. It is only polite.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.t_hp_b: The Hunger of the Depths: Wounded

mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.name: Pressure of the Heavy Aura
mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.desc: A hunter's aura, vast and unfriendly, lies over the whole floor: it presses on the shoulders and sets the knees shaking, more so with every pack the delver carries.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.flavo: Kneel. Or don't, and watch what happens.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.e_har: Pressure of the Heavy Aura: Crushing Aura

A hunter's aura, vast and unfriendly, lies over the whole floor: it presses on the shoulders and sets the knees shaking, more so with every pack the delver carries. The aura does not just press: it bruises. Standing still invites it.
Kneel. Or don't, and watch what happens.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.t_tim: Pressure of the Heavy Aura: Clockwork

A hunter's aura, vast and unfriendly, lies over the whole floor: it presses on the shoulders and sets the knees shaking, more so with every pack the delver carries. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
Kneel. Or don't, and watch what happens.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.c_sne: Pressure of the Heavy Aura: Creeping

Kneel. Or don't, and watch what happens.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.t_dam: Pressure of the Heavy Aura: Backlash

mechanic.nusmp.floor.listening_walls.fla: Quiet. Even the goblins are listening.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.listening_walls.e_g: The dungeon hears everything: running boots and jumping feet wake whatever sleeps close by, and a quiet party is a safe one. What answers is a small band of goblin-like raiders, not insects.
Quiet. Even the goblins are listening.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.listening_walls.t_j: The dungeon hears everything: running boots and jumping feet wake whatever sleeps close by, and a quiet party is a safe one. Jumping in its area sets it off.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.listening_walls.c_q: The dungeon hears everything: running boots and jumping feet wake whatever sleeps close by, and a quiet party is a safe one. Neither sprint nor jump for a while and it lets go.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.witchs_carpet.desc: The floor changes its pattern into a loud ornamental carpet, and the room's whole sense of order goes with it: delvers lose their bearings and the walls seem to watch.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.witchs_carpet.flavo: Everything looks like a nursery, and nothing is safe.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.witchs_carpet.e_dol: The Witch's Labyrinth Carpet: The Doll Carpet

Everything looks like a nursery, and nothing is safe.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.witchs_carpet.c_kil: The floor changes its pattern into a loud ornamental carpet, and the room's whole sense of order goes with it: delvers lose their bearings and the walls seem to watch. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
Everything looks like a nursery, and nothing is safe.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.witchs_carpet.e_cho: The Witch's Labyrinth Carpet: Choir Carpet

The floor changes its pattern into a loud ornamental carpet, and the room's whole sense of order goes with it: delvers lose their bearings and the walls seem to watch. A pattern that hums: a note rings in each step and the party's items fall silent.
Everything looks like a nursery, and nothing is safe.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.witchs_carpet.t_jum: The floor changes its pattern into a loud ornamental carpet, and the room's whole sense of order goes with it: delvers lose their bearings and the walls seem to watch. Jumping in its area sets it off.
Everything looks like a nursery, and nothing is safe.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.great_wind.name: The Great Wind
mechanic.nusmp.floor.great_wind.desc: A great wind blows through the halls like a living thing and pushes everyone one way, mild at first and then in gusts that make a fall dangerous.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.great_wind.flavor: The Storm Dragon turns in her sleep.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.great_wind.e_east.n: The Great Wind: The Eastern Gale
mechanic.nusmp.floor.great_wind.e_east.d: A great wind blows through the halls like a living thing and pushes everyone one way, mild at first and then in gusts that make a fall dangerous. The wind comes from the opposite side and drags everybody the other way.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.great_wind.e_east.f: The Storm Dragon turns in her sleep.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.great_wind.t_sprint: A great wind blows through the halls like a living thing and pushes everyone one way, mild at first and then in gusts that make a fall dangerous. Running in its area sets it off.
The Storm Dragon turns in her sleep.
A great wind blows through the halls like a living thing and pushes everyone one way, mild at first and then in gusts that make a fall dangerous. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
The Storm Dragon turns in her sleep.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.great_wind.e_gust.d: A great wind blows through the halls like a living thing and pushes everyone one way, mild at first and then in gusts that make a fall dangerous. It gusts and shoves, and each gust is a proper blow.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.great_wind.e_gust.f: The Storm Dragon turns in her sleep.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.great_wind.t_area_e: A great wind blows through the halls like a living thing and pushes everyone one way, mild at first and then in gusts that make a fall dangerous. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
The Storm Dragon turns in her sleep.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.anti_magic_fog.name: The Anti-Magic Fog
mechanic.nusmp.floor.anti_magic_fog.desc: A grey fog from the deepest tier smothers magic itself: spells and enchanted gear stutter, and the delver's own reserve of mana bleeds into it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.anti_magic_fog.flav: A world with no magic left in it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.anti_magic_fog.e_de: The Anti-Magic Fog: Anti-Magic Devil's Breath

A grey fog from the deepest tier smothers magic itself: spells and enchanted gear stutter, and the delver's own reserve of mana bleeds into it. The fog is the devil's own breath; it hurts, too, in proportion to the mana taken.
A world with no magic left in it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.anti_magic_fog.t_ti: A grey fog from the deepest tier smothers magic itself: spells and enchanted gear stutter, and the delver's own reserve of mana bleeds into it. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
A world with no magic left in it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.anti_magic_fog.c_ki: A grey fog from the deepest tier smothers magic itself: spells and enchanted gear stutter, and the delver's own reserve of mana bleeds into it. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
A world with no magic left in it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.anti_magic_fog.e_th: A grey fog from the deepest tier smothers magic itself: spells and enchanted gear stutter, and the delver's own reserve of mana bleeds into it. A thin fog that taxes mana a little less but lingers for longer.
A world with no magic left in it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.anti_magic_fog.t_it: A grey fog from the deepest tier smothers magic itself: spells and enchanted gear stutter, and the delver's own reserve of mana bleeds into it. It reacts to the use of items in its area.
A world with no magic left in it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.witch_miasma.name: The Witch's Miasma
mechanic.nusmp.floor.witch_miasma.desc: The scent of a witch lies on the floor like fog: nobody dies of it, but no wound heals, and the longer it lingers the more the party starts hearing its own names.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.witch_miasma.e_envy: The Witch's Miasma: Scent of Envy

The scent of a witch lies on the floor like fog: nobody dies of it, but no wound heals, and the longer it lingers the more the party starts hearing its own names. The scent of envy turns allies against one another: wounds sting extra when the party stands apart.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.witch_miasma.t_time: The scent of a witch lies on the floor like fog: nobody dies of it, but no wound heals, and the longer it lingers the more the party starts hearing its own names. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.witch_miasma.c_kill: The scent of a witch lies on the floor like fog: nobody dies of it, but no wound heals, and the longer it lingers the more the party starts hearing its own names. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.witch_miasma.e_slot: The Witch's Miasma: Scent of Sloth

The scent of a witch lies on the floor like fog: nobody dies of it, but no wound heals, and the longer it lingers the more the party starts hearing its own names. The scent of sloth: everything is a bit slower.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.witch_miasma.t_dama: The scent of a witch lies on the floor like fog: nobody dies of it, but no wound heals, and the longer it lingers the more the party starts hearing its own names. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.shinsu_density.name: Shinsu Density
mechanic.nusmp.floor.shinsu_density.desc: Shinsu lies thick or thin from room to room: in the thick places the body is slower and tires fast, in the thin ones a leap carries far.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.shinsu_density.flav: Each floor has a Test, and the air is part of it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.shinsu_density.e_th: Shinsu lies thick or thin from room to room: in the thick places the body is slower and tires fast, in the thin ones a leap carries far. A thin pocket: speed rather than slowness, a long leap rather than a heavy foot.
Each floor has a Test, and the air is part of it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.shinsu_density.t_ti: Shinsu lies thick or thin from room to room: in the thick places the body is slower and tires fast, in the thin ones a leap carries far. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
Each floor has a Test, and the air is part of it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.shinsu_density.c_st: Shinsu lies thick or thin from room to room: in the thick places the body is slower and tires fast, in the thin ones a leap carries far. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
Each floor has a Test, and the air is part of it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.shinsu_density.e_fl: Shinsu lies thick or thin from room to room: in the thick places the body is slower and tires fast, in the thin ones a leap carries far. The density flickers from thick to thin and back, throwing the party about.
Each floor has a Test, and the air is part of it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.shinsu_density.t_sp: Shinsu lies thick or thin from room to room: in the thick places the body is slower and tires fast, in the thin ones a leap carries far. Running in its area sets it off.
Each floor has a Test, and the air is part of it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.ice_hell.name: Cocytus
mechanic.nusmp.floor.ice_hell.desc: The deepest of the cold halls lays an unbroken frost over the floor: breath hangs in the air, bones ache, and slow ones are covered in rime.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.ice_hell.flavor: The cold of the ninth circle does not forgive.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.ice_hell.e_blizzard: The deepest of the cold halls lays an unbroken frost over the floor: breath hangs in the air, bones ache, and slow ones are covered in rime. A blizzard rather than a still cold: a wind drives the party and the snow bites.
The cold of the ninth circle does not forgive.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.ice_hell.t_idle.des: The deepest of the cold halls lays an unbroken frost over the floor: breath hangs in the air, bones ache, and slow ones are covered in rime. Standing still in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.ice_hell.t_idle.fla: The cold of the ninth circle does not forgive.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.ice_hell.c_hold_lig: The deepest of the cold halls lays an unbroken frost over the floor: breath hangs in the air, bones ache, and slow ones are covered in rime. Carry a light through it long enough and it relents.
The cold of the ninth circle does not forgive.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.ice_hell.e_breath.d: The deepest of the cold halls lays an unbroken frost over the floor: breath hangs in the air, bones ache, and slow ones are covered in rime. A giant's breath, a single enormous burst that damages and shoves.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.ice_hell.e_breath.f: The cold of the ninth circle does not forgive.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.ice_hell.t_damage_t: The deepest of the cold halls lays an unbroken frost over the floor: breath hangs in the air, bones ache, and slow ones are covered in rime. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
The cold of the ninth circle does not forgive.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.colour_order.name: The Rooms of Colour
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.colour_order.desc: The doors close and four coloured pedestals stand in the dust; the walls hint at an order, and a wrong choice does not forgive: reinforcements trickle in every half minute until the right sequence is pressed.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.colour_order.flavo: Only the fool presses the red one first.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.colour_order.e_flo: The Rooms of Colour: Rising Colours

The doors close and four coloured pedestals stand in the dust; the walls hint at an order, and a wrong choice does not forgive: reinforcements trickle in every half minute until the right sequence is pressed. The room slowly floods instead of filling with monsters.
Only the fool presses the red one first.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.colour_order.t_flo: The doors close and four coloured pedestals stand in the dust; the walls hint at an order, and a wrong choice does not forgive: reinforcements trickle in every half minute until the right sequence is pressed. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
Only the fool presses the red one first.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.colour_order.c_mir: The doors close and four coloured pedestals stand in the dust; the walls hint at an order, and a wrong choice does not forgive: reinforcements trickle in every half minute until the right sequence is pressed. Repeat the pattern it shows.
Only the fool presses the red one first.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.colour_order.e_arr: The Rooms of Colour: Arrow-Slit Colours

The doors close and four coloured pedestals stand in the dust; the walls hint at an order, and a wrong choice does not forgive: reinforcements trickle in every half minute until the right sequence is pressed. Hidden slits in the walls send arrows at whoever dawdles.
Only the fool presses the red one first.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.colour_order.t_pro: The doors close and four coloured pedestals stand in the dust; the walls hint at an order, and a wrong choice does not forgive: reinforcements trickle in every half minute until the right sequence is pressed. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
Only the fool presses the red one first.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.colour_order.c_pil: The doors close and four coloured pedestals stand in the dust; the walls hint at an order, and a wrong choice does not forgive: reinforcements trickle in every half minute until the right sequence is pressed. Light every pillar within a few seconds of each other.
Only the fool presses the red one first.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.mirror_demon_patte: The Mirror Demon's Pattern
A demon of mimicry has made the room a game: it flashes a pattern of lights and wants it played back, and each failure feeds its taste for the player's own face.
It learns your voice by asking you to repeat it.
The Mirror Demon's Pattern: Long Pattern

A demon of mimicry has made the room a game: it flashes a pattern of lights and wants it played back, and each failure feeds its taste for the player's own face. A longer pattern, one more note than usual.
It learns your voice by asking you to repeat it.
The Mirror Demon's Pattern: Omen

A demon of mimicry has made the room a game: it flashes a pattern of lights and wants it played back, and each failure feeds its taste for the player's own face. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
It learns your voice by asking you to repeat it.
The Mirror Demon's Pattern: Sequenced

A demon of mimicry has made the room a game: it flashes a pattern of lights and wants it played back, and each failure feeds its taste for the player's own face. Use its pedestals in the right order to end it.
It learns your voice by asking you to repeat it.
The Mirror Demon's Pattern: Silent Pattern

A demon of mimicry has made the room a game: it flashes a pattern of lights and wants it played back, and each failure feeds its taste for the player's own face. A silent pattern: the flashes are shown but never sounded, so it must be watched.
It learns your voice by asking you to repeat it.
The Mirror Demon's Pattern: Gaze

A demon of mimicry has made the room a game: it flashes a pattern of lights and wants it played back, and each failure feeds its taste for the player's own face. It wakes when someone looks straight at it.
It learns your voice by asking you to repeat it.
The Mirror Demon's Pattern: Switch

A demon of mimicry has made the room a game: it flashes a pattern of lights and wants it played back, and each failure feeds its taste for the player's own face. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
It learns your voice by asking you to repeat it.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.chain_spell_pillar: The Pillars of the Chain Spell
Three pillars of mana must be lit in one breath: a lone mage lights one and watches it die, so the whole party must reach their pillar and act as one.
One mage is a spark. A squad is a spell.
The Pillars of the Chain Spell: Four Pillars
Three pillars of mana must be lit in one breath: a lone mage lights one and watches it die, so the whole party must reach their pillar and act as one. A fourth pillar: it needs a bigger squad.
One mage is a spark. A squad is a spell.
The Pillars of the Chain Spell: Omen

Three pillars of mana must be lit in one breath: a lone mage lights one and watches it die, so the whole party must reach their pillar and act as one. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
One mage is a spark. A squad is a spell.
The Pillars of the Chain Spell: Sequenced
Three pillars of mana must be lit in one breath: a lone mage lights one and watches it die, so the whole party must reach their pillar and act as one. Use its pedestals in the right order to end it.
One mage is a spark. A squad is a spell.
The Pillars of the Chain Spell: Quick Chain
Three pillars of mana must be lit in one breath: a lone mage lights one and watches it die, so the whole party must reach their pillar and act as one. A tight window: three seconds.
One mage is a spark. A squad is a spell.
The Pillars of the Chain Spell: Quorum

Three pillars of mana must be lit in one breath: a lone mage lights one and watches it die, so the whole party must reach their pillar and act as one. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
One mage is a spark. A squad is a spell.
The Pillars of the Chain Spell: Split
Three pillars of mana must be lit in one breath: a lone mage lights one and watches it die, so the whole party must reach their pillar and act as one. Two delvers must hold two plates at once.
One mage is a spark. A squad is a spell.
The Scales of Balance
A huge pair of scales hangs over the altar and wants a weight in gold on one pan before the ceiling comes down: the ceiling is patient, but not for ever.
Weigh your offer carefully. The ceiling already has.
The Scales of Balance: Scales of Iron

A huge pair of scales hangs over the altar and wants a weight in gold on one pan before the ceiling comes down: the ceiling is patient, but not for ever. The scales want iron, not gold: more of it, and less of a bargain.
Weigh your offer carefully. The ceiling already has.
The Scales of Balance: Omen

A huge pair of scales hangs over the altar and wants a weight in gold on one pan before the ceiling comes down: the ceiling is patient, but not for ever. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
Weigh your offer carefully. The ceiling already has.
The Scales of Balance: Soul-tithe

A huge pair of scales hangs over the altar and wants a weight in gold on one pan before the ceiling comes down: the ceiling is patient, but not for ever. Pay a few levels of experience at the altar to end it.
Weigh your offer carefully. The ceiling already has.
The Scales of Balance: Scales of Blood

A huge pair of scales hangs over the altar and wants a weight in gold on one pan before the ceiling comes down: the ceiling is patient, but not for ever. The scales are content with a few hearts instead of gold.
Weigh your offer carefully. The ceiling already has.
The Scales of Balance: Tripwire

A huge pair of scales hangs over the altar and wants a weight in gold on one pan before the ceiling comes down: the ceiling is patient, but not for ever. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
Weigh your offer carefully. The ceiling already has.
The Scales of Balance: Anchored

A huge pair of scales hangs over the altar and wants a weight in gold on one pan before the ceiling comes down: the ceiling is patient, but not for ever. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
Weigh your offer carefully. The ceiling already has.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.lever_gallery.name: The Gallery of Levers
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.lever_gallery.desc: A long gallery of dead machinery and exactly one lever that matters: pull the wrong stud and the gallery makes a sound like a bell, and the bells draw in the monsters.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.lever_gallery.flav: Every floor has a door. Every door has a trick.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.lever_gallery.e_pr: The Gallery of Levers: Gallery of Pressure

A long gallery of dead machinery and exactly one lever that matters: pull the wrong stud and the gallery makes a sound like a bell, and the bells draw in the monsters. Pressure plates and a lever: the plate is the hint, standing on it for a few seconds does the trick.
Every floor has a door. Every door has a trick.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.lever_gallery.t_fl: A long gallery of dead machinery and exactly one lever that matters: pull the wrong stud and the gallery makes a sound like a bell, and the bells draw in the monsters. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
Every floor has a door. Every door has a trick.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.lever_gallery.c_se: A long gallery of dead machinery and exactly one lever that matters: pull the wrong stud and the gallery makes a sound like a bell, and the bells draw in the monsters. Use its pedestals in the right order to end it.
Every floor has a door. Every door has a trick.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.lever_gallery.e_lo: The Gallery of Levers: Gallery of Bells

A long gallery of dead machinery and exactly one lever that matters: pull the wrong stud and the gallery makes a sound like a bell, and the bells draw in the monsters. The bells are loud and relentless: a quake rattles the room until the lever is found.
Every floor has a door. Every door has a trick.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.lever_gallery.t_in: A long gallery of dead machinery and exactly one lever that matters: pull the wrong stud and the gallery makes a sound like a bell, and the bells draw in the monsters. It needs a hand on its altar block to begin.
Every floor has a door. Every door has a trick.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.lever_gallery.c_ki: A long gallery of dead machinery and exactly one lever that matters: pull the wrong stud and the gallery makes a sound like a bell, and the bells draw in the monsters. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
Every floor has a door. Every door has a trick.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.tsuzumi_rooms.name: The Drum Rooms
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.tsuzumi_rooms.desc: A demon beats a drum and the rooms turn: walls swing away and swing back with every beat, and only the pattern of the beats reveals the way out.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.tsuzumi_rooms.flav: Every drum beat is a new room, and every new room is a new cage.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.tsuzumi_rooms.e_fa: A demon beats a drum and the rooms turn: walls swing away and swing back with every beat, and only the pattern of the beats reveals the way out. A faster drum: the walls turn twice as often.
Every drum beat is a new room, and every new room is a new cage.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.tsuzumi_rooms.t_ar: A demon beats a drum and the rooms turn: walls swing away and swing back with every beat, and only the pattern of the beats reveals the way out. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
Every drum beat is a new room, and every new room is a new cage.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.tsuzumi_rooms.c_se: A demon beats a drum and the rooms turn: walls swing away and swing back with every beat, and only the pattern of the beats reveals the way out. Use its pedestals in the right order to end it.
Every drum beat is a new room, and every new room is a new cage.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.tsuzumi_rooms.e_bo: A demon beats a drum and the rooms turn: walls swing away and swing back with every beat, and only the pattern of the beats reveals the way out. A drum of bone: each beat calls a skeleton out of the wall.
Every drum beat is a new room, and every new room is a new cage.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.tsuzumi_rooms.t_sp: A demon beats a drum and the rooms turn: walls swing away and swing back with every beat, and only the pattern of the beats reveals the way out. Running in its area sets it off.
Every drum beat is a new room, and every new room is a new cage.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.return_by_death_me: The Memory of the Last Death
A room remembers how it killed the last delver, and shows it to the next: the pattern of the trap is the pattern of the lock, and the lock is the only way out.
I have seen this room before. I did not survive it.
The Memory of the Last Death: Death's Voice

A room remembers how it killed the last delver, and shows it to the next: the pattern of the trap is the pattern of the lock, and the lock is the only way out. Each reset also costs: a wound the delver does not remember taking.
I have seen this room before. I did not survive it.
The Memory of the Last Death: Threshold

A room remembers how it killed the last delver, and shows it to the next: the pattern of the trap is the pattern of the lock, and the lock is the only way out. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
I have seen this room before. I did not survive it.
The Memory of the Last Death: Sequenced

A room remembers how it killed the last delver, and shows it to the next: the pattern of the trap is the pattern of the lock, and the lock is the only way out. Use its pedestals in the right order to end it.
I have seen this room before. I did not survive it.
The Memory of the Last Death: The Loop

A room remembers how it killed the last delver, and shows it to the next: the pattern of the trap is the pattern of the lock, and the lock is the only way out. Every failure is also a reset of the room: the party is returned to the door and the pattern is shown again.
I have seen this room before. I did not survive it.
The Memory of the Last Death: Wounded

A room remembers how it killed the last delver, and shows it to the next: the pattern of the trap is the pattern of the lock, and the lock is the only way out. It smells a wounded delver and strikes when someone drops under half health.
I have seen this room before. I did not survive it.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.courier_of_the_pot: A stew pot sits on a stone at one end of the room and a hungry statue waits at the other: carry the pot across without losing it, over a room full of things that smell the soup.
Everything in the dungeon wants a bite.
The Courier of the Pot: A Very Hot Pot

A stew pot sits on a stone at one end of the room and a hungry statue waits at the other: carry the pot across without losing it, over a room full of things that smell the soup. The pot is hot: carrying it hurts a little, constantly.
Everything in the dungeon wants a bite.
The Courier of the Pot: Omen

A stew pot sits on a stone at one end of the room and a hungry statue waits at the other: carry the pot across without losing it, over a room full of things that smell the soup. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
Everything in the dungeon wants a bite.
The Courier of the Pot: Tribute

A stew pot sits on a stone at one end of the room and a hungry statue waits at the other: carry the pot across without losing it, over a room full of things that smell the soup. Lay an offering on its altar to quiet it.
Everything in the dungeon wants a bite.
The Courier of the Pot: A Heavy Pot

A stew pot sits on a stone at one end of the room and a hungry statue waits at the other: carry the pot across without losing it, over a room full of things that smell the soup. A big pot: the courier moves like wading in mud.
Everything in the dungeon wants a bite.
The Courier of the Pot: Tripwire

A stew pot sits on a stone at one end of the room and a hungry statue waits at the other: carry the pot across without losing it, over a room full of things that smell the soup. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
Everything in the dungeon wants a bite.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.sunlight_relay.des: The room is dark on purpose and a single lantern is the only key: carrying real light through it, and keeping it lit, is what the old door was built to test.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.sunlight_relay.fla: Science is just patience with a lens.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.sunlight_relay.e_e: The room is dark on purpose and a single lantern is the only key: carrying real light through it, and keeping it lit, is what the old door was built to test. The dark has voices in it: a swarm of cave biters stirs while the lantern burns.
Science is just patience with a lens.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.sunlight_relay.t_a: The room is dark on purpose and a single lantern is the only key: carrying real light through it, and keeping it lit, is what the old door was built to test. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
Science is just patience with a lens.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.sunlight_relay.c_s: The room is dark on purpose and a single lantern is the only key: carrying real light through it, and keeping it lit, is what the old door was built to test. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
Science is just patience with a lens.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.sunlight_relay.e_m: The room is dark on purpose and a single lantern is the only key: carrying real light through it, and keeping it lit, is what the old door was built to test. The room is lined with mirrors that throw the light back: lit crystals dazzle the eyes.
Science is just patience with a lens.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.sunlight_relay.t_d: The room is dark on purpose and a single lantern is the only key: carrying real light through it, and keeping it lit, is what the old door was built to test. It thrives where the light is low and strikes the delver who lingers in the dark.
Science is just patience with a lens.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.sphinx_riddle.name: The Sphinx's Riddle
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.sphinx_riddle.desc: A sphinx's carving asks its riddle in silence, the answer to which is an offering laid on its paws: wrong offerings are eaten, and what the sphinx does with an angry guest is written on the wall.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.sphinx_riddle.flav: Answer well. She is not hungry for your gold.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.sphinx_riddle.e_co: The Sphinx's Riddle: Riddle of Coin

A sphinx's carving asks its riddle in silence, the answer to which is an offering laid on its paws: wrong offerings are eaten, and what the sphinx does with an angry guest is written on the wall. The answer is a coin, as many as the guest dares.
Answer well. She is not hungry for your gold.
mechanic.nusmp.puzzle.sphinx_riddle.t_fl: A sphinx's carving asks its riddle in silence, the answer to which is an offering laid on its paws: wrong offerings are eaten, and what the sphinx does with an angry guest is written on the wall. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
Answer well. She is not hungry for your gold.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.wall_waves.name: The Wave Over the Wall
mechanic.nusmp.combat.wall_waves.desc: The hall is a bulwark and the enemy comes in waves, each larger than the last, with a calm in between that is only for catching breath.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.wall_waves.flavor: The wall has stood for a hundred years. Today we will see why.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.dungeon_ambush.des: A quiet room with nobody in it, until the door closes: the monsters were waiting in the dark on all sides, for as long as it took the delvers to wander in.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.gel_splitting.name: The Splitting Gel
mechanic.nusmp.combat.gel_splitting.desc: A great gelatinous thing and the knowledge that every blow that kills it makes two smaller ones: the smart party fights with fire and patience, the other with a sword.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.gel_splitting.flav: Never feed a slime after midnight, they said.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.initiative_round.t: The fight runs in rounds: every few seconds the monsters get a turn, a surge of speed and fury, and then the delvers get theirs. The wise take their turn when the monsters' is over. It answers the dungeon's deaths: every few kills in the area set it off.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.witch_cult_horde.d: A cult of the dead witch keeps its dead in the walls: whenever a delver falls, the dead stir, and the cult sends reinforcements to finish the work.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.witch_cult_horde.f: The cult does not mourn. It collects.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.witch_cult_horde.e: The Witch Cult's Horde: The Cult's Reply

A cult of the dead witch keeps its dead in the walls: whenever a delver falls, the dead stir, and the cult sends reinforcements to finish the work. It answers every kill of its own followers instead: two more come for each death.
The cult does not mourn. It collects.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.witch_cult_horde.t: A cult of the dead witch keeps its dead in the walls: whenever a delver falls, the dead stir, and the cult sends reinforcements to finish the work. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
The cult does not mourn. It collects.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.witch_cult_horde.c: A cult of the dead witch keeps its dead in the walls: whenever a delver falls, the dead stir, and the cult sends reinforcements to finish the work. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
The cult does not mourn. It collects.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.witch_cult_horde.e: The Witch Cult's Horde: The Blood Cult

A cult of the dead witch keeps its dead in the walls: whenever a delver falls, the dead stir, and the cult sends reinforcements to finish the work. The reinforcements are fiends of blood, and the cult withdraws them after two minutes if they have not finished the job.
The cult does not mourn. It collects.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.witch_cult_horde.t: A cult of the dead witch keeps its dead in the walls: whenever a delver falls, the dead stir, and the cult sends reinforcements to finish the work. It smells a wounded delver and strikes when someone drops under half health.
The cult does not mourn. It collects.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.planar_gate.name: The Planar Gate
mechanic.nusmp.combat.planar_gate.desc: A ring of carved doorway stands open on some other plane, and things in transit stumble through: some are fiends, some are lost wanderers, and all of them want out of the draught.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.planar_gate.flavor: The City of Doors has a door for everything, and everything has a door for you.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.planar_gate.e_arca: The Planar Gate: The Arcane Gate

A ring of carved doorway stands open on some other plane, and things in transit stumble through: some are fiends, some are lost wanderers, and all of them want out of the draught. The things that come through are mages.
The City of Doors has a door for everything, and everything has a door for you.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.thrall_court.name: The Court of Thralls
mechanic.nusmp.combat.thrall_court.desc: The count's old court is still in session: his thralls, glassy-eyed and elegant, rise to protect him from anything that moves and bow to anyone who bows first.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.thrall_court.flavo: Come in. Sit down. They never mind visitors.
mechanic.nusmp.combat.thrall_court.e_bat: The Court of Thralls: The Bat Court

The count's old court is still in session: his thralls, glassy-eyed and elegant, rise to protect him from anything that moves and bow to anyone who bows first. The thralls come as a flight of bats: fast and bitey.
Come in. Sit down. They never mind visitors.

mechanic.nusmp.combat.thrall_court.e_blo: The Court of Thralls: The Court of Blood

mechanic.nusmp.risk.cursed_chest.name: The Cursed Chest
mechanic.nusmp.risk.cursed_chest.desc: A chest on a plinth, locked by nothing but dread: the loot inside is real, and so is the curse that comes out of the lid with it.
mechanic.nusmp.risk.cursed_chest.flavor: Everyone sees the gold. Nobody sees the second lid.
mechanic.nusmp.risk.cursed_chest.e_mimic: The Cursed Chest: The Hungry Chest
A chest on a plinth, locked by nothing but dread: the loot inside is real, and so is the curse that comes out of the lid with it. The chest may also be a mimic.
Everyone sees the gold. Nobody sees the second lid.

mechanic.nusmp.risk.mimic_chest.name: The Mimic
mechanic.nusmp.risk.mimic_chest.desc: Treasure in an open room, which is the first sign that something is wrong: it is a chest only until a hand touches the lid.
mechanic.nusmp.risk.mimic_chest.e_half.n: The Mimic: A Chest and a Half

mechanic.nusmp.risk.devils_bargain.name: The Devil's Bargain
mechanic.nusmp.risk.devils_bargain.desc: A devil offers power through a circle in the floor, for a price in the delver's own blood: the more is paid, the more is returned, and the devil has never once lost an argument.
mechanic.nusmp.risk.devils_bargain.flavo: Power is easy. The price is the only thing that is hard.
mechanic.nusmp.risk.devils_bargain.e_man: The Devil's Bargain: Bargain in Mana

A devil offers power through a circle in the floor, for a price in the delver's own blood: the more is paid, the more is returned, and the devil has never once lost an argument. The devil takes magicules, not blood.
Power is easy. The price is the only thing that is hard.

mechanic.nusmp.risk.coin_flip_altar.desc: An altar with a single rule: touch it and the stakes are decided by a coin nobody sees. Heads, a bounty. Tails, the room objects.
mechanic.nusmp.risk.coin_flip_altar.flav: All games are decided by who dares the bet.
mechanic.nusmp.risk.coin_flip_altar.e_fa: The Coin-Flip Altar: A Fair Coin

mechanic.nusmp.risk.sacrifice_shrine.fla: The Behelit always opens for those who want it enough.
mechanic.nusmp.risk.sacrifice_shrine.e_f: The Sacrifice Shrine: Offering a Friend's Strength

mechanic.nusmp.risk.closing_vault.desc: A hidden treasure room that closes in sixty seconds: grab the loot and get out, or be shut in with the room's keeper.
mechanic.nusmp.risk.closing_vault.flavor: A little hidden room, a door that remembers, and a clock nobody can hear.

mechanic.nusmp.travel.flying_carpet.e_st: The Flying Carpet: The Carpet in a Storm
A woven platform that glides across a chasm on a slow, magical wind: a seat for as many as the weaver could fit and no handrail. A gale tugs at the carpet and knocks the riders about.
Up, up, and not too steeply.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.flying_carpet.t_ar: A woven platform that glides across a chasm on a slow, magical wind: a seat for as many as the weaver could fit and no handrail. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
Up, up, and not too steeply.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.anywhere_gate.name: The Gate of Nazarick
mechanic.nusmp.travel.anywhere_gate.desc: A dark gate with a gold rim that opens to whichever place its master chooses: the party can ask it, but it only sends them somewhere it has already decided upon.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.anywhere_gate.e_ro: The Gate of Nazarick: The Gate to a Far Hall
A dark gate with a gold rim that opens to whichever place its master chooses: the party can ask it, but it only sends them somewhere it has already decided upon. The gate opens onto another hall.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.anywhere_gate.t_pr: A dark gate with a gold rim that opens to whichever place its master chooses: the party can ask it, but it only sends them somewhere it has already decided upon. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.anywhere_gate.c_pa: A dark gate with a gold rim that opens to whichever place its master chooses: the party can ask it, but it only sends them somewhere it has already decided upon. Pay a few levels of experience at the altar to end it.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.anywhere_gate.e_ba: The Gate of Nazarick: The Gate Back

A dark gate with a gold rim that opens to whichever place its master chooses: the party can ask it, but it only sends them somewhere it has already decided upon. The gate opens back where the party came in.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.anywhere_gate.t_it: A dark gate with a gold rim that opens to whichever place its master chooses: the party can ask it, but it only sends them somewhere it has already decided upon. It reacts to the use of items in its area.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.floating_islands.d: A hall of islands of stone hanging in the air: gravity is light, the gaps are wide, and the way across is a chain of jumps that are never quite where they seem.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.floating_islands.f: Aincrad has many floors, and none of them stay put.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.floating_islands.e: The Floating Islands: The Heavy Islands

A hall of islands of stone hanging in the air: gravity is light, the gaps are wide, and the way across is a chain of jumps that are never quite where they seem. Heavy gravity instead of light: the jumps are shorter and the falls harder.
Aincrad has many floors, and none of them stay put.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.floating_islands.t: A hall of islands of stone hanging in the air: gravity is light, the gaps are wide, and the way across is a chain of jumps that are never quite where they seem. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
Aincrad has many floors, and none of them stay put.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.floating_islands.c: A hall of islands of stone hanging in the air: gravity is light, the gaps are wide, and the way across is a chain of jumps that are never quite where they seem. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
Aincrad has many floors, and none of them stay put.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.floating_islands.e: The Floating Islands: The Drifting Islands

Aincrad has many floors, and none of them stay put.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.floating_islands.t: A hall of islands of stone hanging in the air: gravity is light, the gaps are wide, and the way across is a chain of jumps that are never quite where they seem. Jumping in its area sets it off.
Aincrad has many floors, and none of them stay put.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.trapdoor_chute.des: An unremarkable stretch of floor that tips open under the weight of a heavy foot and slides everyone down a chute into another part of the dungeon.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.trapdoor_chute.fla: Trapdoor. Roll a Reflex save. Or don't.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.trapdoor_chute.e_n: The Trapdoor Chute: The Chute to the Next Hall
An unremarkable stretch of floor that tips open under the weight of a heavy foot and slides everyone down a chute into another part of the dungeon. The chute runs to the next hall.
Trapdoor. Roll a Reflex save. Or don't.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.trapdoor_chute.t_s: An unremarkable stretch of floor that tips open under the weight of a heavy foot and slides everyone down a chute into another part of the dungeon. Running in its area sets it off.
Trapdoor. Roll a Reflex save. Or don't.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.trapdoor_chute.c_s: An unremarkable stretch of floor that tips open under the weight of a heavy foot and slides everyone down a chute into another part of the dungeon. Sneak through its area long enough and it loses interest.
Trapdoor. Roll a Reflex save. Or don't.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.trapdoor_chute.e_h: The Trapdoor Chute: The Rough Chute
An unremarkable stretch of floor that tips open under the weight of a heavy foot and slides everyone down a chute into another part of the dungeon. A rough ride: a bump on arrival.
Trapdoor. Roll a Reflex save. Or don't.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.trapdoor_chute.t_j: An unremarkable stretch of floor that tips open under the weight of a heavy foot and slides everyone down a chute into another part of the dungeon. Jumping in its area sets it off.
Trapdoor. Roll a Reflex save. Or don't.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.airship_rails.name: The Airship Rails
mechanic.nusmp.travel.airship_rails.desc: A set of rails of pale light that a carriage of the Magic Knights runs on, back and forth across the hall at a stately pace.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.airship_rails.flav: The Golden Dawn's carriage never loses time.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.airship_rails.e_da: The Airship Rails: The Black Bulls' Wagon
A set of rails of pale light that a carriage of the Magic Knights runs on, back and forth across the hall at a stately pace. The wagon is slower and rougher.
The Golden Dawn's carriage never loses time.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.airship_rails.t_ar: A set of rails of pale light that a carriage of the Magic Knights runs on, back and forth across the hall at a stately pace. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
The Golden Dawn's carriage never loses time.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.airship_rails.c_le: A set of rails of pale light that a carriage of the Magic Knights runs on, back and forth across the hall at a stately pace. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
The Golden Dawn's carriage never loses time.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.airship_rails.e_bo: The Airship Rails: A Crossing Pair
A set of rails of pale light that a carriage of the Magic Knights runs on, back and forth across the hall at a stately pace. Two carriages cross at the middle.
The Golden Dawn's carriage never loses time.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.airship_rails.t_pr: A set of rails of pale light that a carriage of the Magic Knights runs on, back and forth across the hall at a stately pace. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
The Golden Dawn's carriage never loses time.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.odm_anchors.name: The Anchor Posts
mechanic.nusmp.travel.odm_anchors.desc: Iron posts set into the walls and ceiling, made for swinging: a jump near one hooks it and swings the delver the length of the hall at speed.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.odm_anchors.flavor: Gear up. Swing. Don't think about the ground.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.odm_anchors.e_long: The Anchor Posts: The Long Swing
Iron posts set into the walls and ceiling, made for swinging: a jump near one hooks it and swings the delver the length of the hall at speed. A swing that carries across the whole hall.
Gear up. Swing. Don't think about the ground.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.odm_anchors.t_prox: Iron posts set into the walls and ceiling, made for swinging: a jump near one hooks it and swings the delver the length of the hall at speed. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.

mechanic.nusmp.travel.odm_anchors.c_leve: Iron posts set into the walls and ceiling, made for swinging: a jump near one hooks it and swings the delver the length of the hall at speed. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
Gear up. Swing. Don't think about the ground.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.odm_anchors.e_snap: The Anchor Posts: The Snapping Cable
Iron posts set into the walls and ceiling, made for swinging: a jump near one hooks it and swings the delver the length of the hall at speed. The cable snaps: a hard fall at the end.
Gear up. Swing. Don't think about the ground.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.odm_anchors.t_spri: Iron posts set into the walls and ceiling, made for swinging: a jump near one hooks it and swings the delver the length of the hall at speed. Running in its area sets it off.
Gear up. Swing. Don't think about the ground.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.portal_maze.name: The Portal Maze
mechanic.nusmp.travel.portal_maze.desc: A hall of doorways to places that may or may not exist, each with a keyhole and a rumour: step through the right one and it is a shortcut, the wrong one and it is somewhere else.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.portal_maze.flavor: There's a door to everywhere, if you know the key.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.portal_maze.e_swap: The Portal Maze: The Swapping Doors

A hall of doorways to places that may or may not exist, each with a keyhole and a rumour: step through the right one and it is a shortcut, the wrong one and it is somewhere else. The doors swap two delvers.
There's a door to everywhere, if you know the key.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.portal_maze.t_inte: A hall of doorways to places that may or may not exist, each with a keyhole and a rumour: step through the right one and it is a shortcut, the wrong one and it is somewhere else. It needs a hand on its altar block to begin.
There's a door to everywhere, if you know the key.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.portal_maze.c_sequ: A hall of doorways to places that may or may not exist, each with a keyhole and a rumour: step through the right one and it is a shortcut, the wrong one and it is somewhere else. Use its pedestals in the right order to end it.
There's a door to everywhere, if you know the key.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.portal_maze.e_home: The Portal Maze: The Doorless Maze

A hall of doorways to places that may or may not exist, each with a keyhole and a rumour: step through the right one and it is a shortcut, the wrong one and it is somewhere else. No door leads away: the party is tossed around the same room.
There's a door to everywhere, if you know the key.
mechanic.nusmp.travel.portal_maze.t_idle: A hall of doorways to places that may or may not exist, each with a keyhole and a rumour: step through the right one and it is a shortcut, the wrong one and it is somewhere else. Standing still in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
There's a door to everywhere, if you know the key.
mechanic.nusmp.party.master_servant_link: The Master and Servant Link
Every delver is bound to the nearest ally by a thin line of mana: when one is struck, the other takes half of it. The line makes sense for a pair and nonsense for a crowd.
A Servant's wound is its Master's.
The Master and Servant Link: A Perfect Link

Every delver is bound to the nearest ally by a thin line of mana: when one is struck, the other takes half of it. The line makes sense for a pair and nonsense for a crowd. A perfect link: the wounds are split evenly.
A Servant's wound is its Master's.
The Master and Servant Link: Threshold

Every delver is bound to the nearest ally by a thin line of mana: when one is struck, the other takes half of it. The line makes sense for a pair and nonsense for a crowd. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
A Servant's wound is its Master's.
The Master and Servant Link: Muster

Every delver is bound to the nearest ally by a thin line of mana: when one is struck, the other takes half of it. The line makes sense for a pair and nonsense for a crowd. Every living member of the party must stand on the plate together.
A Servant's wound is its Master's.
The Master and Servant Link: A Thin Link

Every delver is bound to the nearest ally by a thin line of mana: when one is struck, the other takes half of it. The line makes sense for a pair and nonsense for a crowd. A thin link: a quarter of each wound is shared.
A Servant's wound is its Master's.
The Master and Servant Link: Quorum

Every delver is bound to the nearest ally by a thin line of mana: when one is struck, the other takes half of it. The line makes sense for a pair and nonsense for a crowd. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
A Servant's wound is its Master's.
The Master and Servant Link: Anchored

Every delver is bound to the nearest ally by a thin line of mana: when one is struck, the other takes half of it. The line makes sense for a pair and nonsense for a crowd. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
A Servant's wound is its Master's.
mechanic.nusmp.party.chain_jail.name: The Chain Jail
mechanic.nusmp.party.chain_jail.desc: Two delvers are chained together by a conjured chain: if they stray far from each other the chain bites, and the farther they stray the more it hurts.
mechanic.nusmp.party.chain_jail.flavor: The chain only breaks when the one who made it chooses.
mechanic.nusmp.party.chain_jail.e_pull.n: The Chain Jail: The Drawing Chain
mechanic.nusmp.party.chain_jail.e_pull.d: Two delvers are chained together by a conjured chain: if they stray far from each other the chain bites, and the farther they stray the more it hurts. The chain also drags the strayer back.
mechanic.nusmp.party.chain_jail.e_pull.f: The chain only breaks when the one who made it chooses.
mechanic.nusmp.party.chain_jail.t_floor_: Two delvers are chained together by a conjured chain: if they stray far from each other the chain bites, and the farther they stray the more it hurts. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
The chain only breaks when the one who made it chooses.
mechanic.nusmp.party.chain_jail.c_kill_m: Two delvers are chained together by a conjured chain: if they stray far from each other the chain bites, and the farther they stray the more it hurts. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
The chain only breaks when the one who made it chooses.
The Chain Jail: A Short Chain
Two delvers are chained together by a conjured chain: if they stray far from each other the chain bites, and the farther they stray the more it hurts. A shorter chain: three blocks of slack.
The chain only breaks when the one who made it chooses.
mechanic.nusmp.party.chain_jail.t_party_: Two delvers are chained together by a conjured chain: if they stray far from each other the chain bites, and the farther they stray the more it hurts. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
The chain only breaks when the one who made it chooses.

mechanic.nusmp.party.revival_item.name: The Revival Window
mechanic.nusmp.party.revival_item.desc: A fallen delver is not dead yet: for twenty seconds they lie in a daze, and any ally who kneels beside them can lift them back up; after that, they log out for good.
mechanic.nusmp.party.revival_item.flavor: Ten seconds, and the healer is out of range.
mechanic.nusmp.party.revival_item.e_shor: The Revival Window: A Short Window
A fallen delver is not dead yet: for twenty seconds they lie in a daze, and any ally who kneels beside them can lift them back up; after that, they log out for good. Only ten seconds.
Ten seconds, and the healer is out of range.
mechanic.nusmp.party.revival_item.t_area: A fallen delver is not dead yet: for twenty seconds they lie in a daze, and any ally who kneels beside them can lift them back up; after that, they log out for good. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.

mechanic.nusmp.party.revival_item.e_long: The Revival Window: A Long Window

A fallen delver is not dead yet: for twenty seconds they lie in a daze, and any ally who kneels beside them can lift them back up; after that, they log out for good. A full minute, but the downed player cannot see.

mechanic.nusmp.party.death_saves.name: The Death Saves
mechanic.nusmp.party.death_saves.desc: When a delver falls they do not die: they roll their saves, a short desperate count in which every wound or kind word matters, and then they either stand or do not.
mechanic.nusmp.party.death_saves.flavor: Three successes, three failures. The dice are not on anyone's side.
mechanic.nusmp.party.death_saves.e_lucky: When a delver falls they do not die: they roll their saves, a short desperate count in which every wound or kind word matters, and then they either stand or do not. A forgiving table: the downed also get a short regeneration.
Three successes, three failures. The dice are not on anyone's side.

mechanic.nusmp.party.party_pack.name: The Party's Pack
mechanic.nusmp.party.party_pack.desc: The party's pack is heavy and shared: the more each member carries, the slower the whole party moves, until somebody puts something down.
mechanic.nusmp.party.party_pack.flavor: Even the hero's party had a pack mule. She was called Fern.
The Party's Pack: The Shared Burden

The party's pack is heavy and shared: the more each member carries, the slower the whole party moves, until somebody puts something down. The burden is split: it takes the whole party's count to slow anyone.
Even the hero's party had a pack mule. She was called Fern.
mechanic.nusmp.party.party_pack.t_area_e: The party's pack is heavy and shared: the more each member carries, the slower the whole party moves, until somebody puts something down. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.

mechanic.nusmp.party.fallen_comrade.name: The Fallen Comrade's Rage
mechanic.nusmp.party.fallen_comrade.desc: When one of the party falls the others do not mourn: they fight harder, faster and wider, for a while, and are not themselves afterwards.
mechanic.nusmp.party.fallen_comrade.flav: We carry them with us. Every one.
mechanic.nusmp.party.fallen_comrade.e_he: The Fallen Comrade's Rage: Rage and Grief
When one of the party falls the others do not mourn: they fight harder, faster and wider, for a while, and are not themselves afterwards. A grief that mends: part of the strength is a heal.
We carry them with us. Every one.
mechanic.nusmp.party.fallen_comrade.t_hp: When one of the party falls the others do not mourn: they fight harder, faster and wider, for a while, and are not themselves afterwards. It smells a wounded delver and strikes when someone drops under half health.
We carry them with us. Every one.
mechanic.nusmp.party.fallen_comrade.c_ki: When one of the party falls the others do not mourn: they fight harder, faster and wider, for a while, and are not themselves afterwards. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
