mechanic.nusmp.party.fallen_comrade.e_cu: The Fallen Comrade's Rage: A Bitter Rage
When one of the party falls the others do not mourn: they fight harder, faster and wider, for a while, and are not themselves afterwards. A bitter rage that costs mana.
We carry them with us. Every one.
mechanic.nusmp.party.fallen_comrade.t_da: When one of the party falls the others do not mourn: they fight harder, faster and wider, for a while, and are not themselves afterwards. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
We carry them with us. Every one.
mechanic.nusmp.party.fallen_comrade.c_su: When one of the party falls the others do not mourn: they fight harder, faster and wider, for a while, and are not themselves afterwards. Last out the time and it ends by itself.
We carry them with us. Every one.
mechanic.nusmp.party.four_key_door.name: The Four-Key Door
mechanic.nusmp.party.four_key_door.desc: A vault door with four locks and four keys, each in a different corner of the room: they must be turned at the same moment by four hands.
mechanic.nusmp.party.four_key_door.flavo: Two keys is a puzzle. Four keys is a meeting.
mechanic.nusmp.party.four_key_door.e_two: The Four-Key Door: The Two-Key Door
A vault door with four locks and four keys, each in a different corner of the room: they must be turned at the same moment by four hands. Two keys only: a smaller party can manage.
Two keys is a puzzle. Four keys is a meeting.
mechanic.nusmp.party.four_key_door.t_flo: A vault door with four locks and four keys, each in a different corner of the room: they must be turned at the same moment by four hands. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
Two keys is a puzzle. Four keys is a meeting.
mechanic.nusmp.party.four_key_door.c_all: A vault door with four locks and four keys, each in a different corner of the room: they must be turned at the same moment by four hands. Every living member of the party must stand on the plate together.
Two keys is a puzzle. Four keys is a meeting.
mechanic.nusmp.party.four_key_door.e_pla: The Four-Key Door: The Door of Plates
A vault door with four locks and four keys, each in a different corner of the room: they must be turned at the same moment by four hands. Four plates and four feet.
Two keys is a puzzle. Four keys is a meeting.
mechanic.nusmp.party.four_key_door.t_par: A vault door with four locks and four keys, each in a different corner of the room: they must be turned at the same moment by four hands. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
Two keys is a puzzle. Four keys is a meeting.
mechanic.nusmp.party.four_key_door.c_seq: A vault door with four locks and four keys, each in a different corner of the room: they must be turned at the same moment by four hands. Use its pedestals in the right order to end it.
Two keys is a puzzle. Four keys is a meeting.
mechanic.nusmp.party.lantern_bearer.name: The Lantern-Bearer
mechanic.nusmp.party.lantern_bearer.desc: A black hall where one member of the party must carry a light, and everybody else must stay within its glow: the bearer cannot fight, and the others cannot stray.
mechanic.nusmp.party.lantern_bearer.flav: Whoever has the torch has the party.
mechanic.nusmp.party.lantern_bearer.e_sh: A black hall where one member of the party must carry a light, and everybody else must stay within its glow: the bearer cannot fight, and the others cannot stray. A shorter dark, with the same rules.
Whoever has the torch has the party.
mechanic.nusmp.party.lantern_bearer.t_ar: A black hall where one member of the party must carry a light, and everybody else must stay within its glow: the bearer cannot fight, and the others cannot stray. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
Whoever has the torch has the party.
mechanic.nusmp.party.lantern_bearer.c_su: A black hall where one member of the party must carry a light, and everybody else must stay within its glow: the bearer cannot fight, and the others cannot stray. Last out the time and it ends by itself.
Whoever has the torch has the party.
mechanic.nusmp.party.lantern_bearer.e_be: The Lantern-Bearer: Things That Like the Dark

A black hall where one member of the party must carry a light, and everybody else must stay within its glow: the bearer cannot fight, and the others cannot stray. Beasts out of the dark go for the bearer.
Whoever has the torch has the party.
mechanic.nusmp.party.lantern_bearer.t_da: A black hall where one member of the party must carry a light, and everybody else must stay within its glow: the bearer cannot fight, and the others cannot stray. It thrives where the light is low and strikes the delver who lingers in the dark.
Whoever has the torch has the party.
mechanic.nusmp.party.lantern_bearer.c_st: A black hall where one member of the party must carry a light, and everybody else must stay within its glow: the bearer cannot fight, and the others cannot stray. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
Whoever has the torch has the party.
mechanic.nusmp.party.bell_test.name: The Bell Test
mechanic.nusmp.party.bell_test.desc: A test in the style of an old teacher: there are two bells and too many students, and the only way through is to work together, which the test spends all its effort preventing.
mechanic.nusmp.party.bell_test.flavor: Those who break the rules are scum, but those who abandon their friends are worse than scum.
mechanic.nusmp.party.bell_test.e_pair.na: The Bell Test: The Pair Test
mechanic.nusmp.party.bell_test.e_pair.de: A test in the style of an old teacher: there are two bells and too many students, and the only way through is to work together, which the test spends all its effort preventing. Two bells and two delvers.
mechanic.nusmp.party.bell_test.e_pair.fl: Those who break the rules are scum, but those who abandon their friends are worse than scum.
mechanic.nusmp.party.bell_test.t_floor_e: A test in the style of an old teacher: there are two bells and too many students, and the only way through is to work together, which the test spends all its effort preventing. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
Those who break the rules are scum, but those who abandon their friends are worse than scum.
mechanic.nusmp.party.bell_test.c_kill_al: A test in the style of an old teacher: there are two bells and too many students, and the only way through is to work together, which the test spends all its effort preventing. It is held up by wardens that spawn with it; kill them all to end it.
Those who break the rules are scum, but those who abandon their friends are worse than scum.
mechanic.nusmp.party.bell_test.e_blind.n: The Bell Test: The Blind Test
mechanic.nusmp.party.bell_test.e_blind.d: A test in the style of an old teacher: there are two bells and too many students, and the only way through is to work together, which the test spends all its effort preventing. The test starts with every student blind for a moment.
mechanic.nusmp.party.bell_test.e_blind.f: Those who break the rules are scum, but those who abandon their friends are worse than scum.
mechanic.nusmp.party.bell_test.t_party_s: A test in the style of an old teacher: there are two bells and too many students, and the only way through is to work together, which the test spends all its effort preventing. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
Those who break the rules are scum, but those who abandon their friends are worse than scum.
mechanic.nusmp.party.bell_test.c_pillars: A test in the style of an old teacher: there are two bells and too many students, and the only way through is to work together, which the test spends all its effort preventing. Light every pillar within a few seconds of each other.
Those who break the rules are scum, but those who abandon their friends are worse than scum.
mechanic.nusmp.party.decoy_mark.name: The Decoy Mark
mechanic.nusmp.party.decoy_mark.desc: One delver is picked out by an unseen eye and marked: the dungeon's hunters want that one first, and everyone else can only help by drawing the eye elsewhere.
mechanic.nusmp.party.decoy_mark.flavor: A pawn in the right place can win the game.
mechanic.nusmp.party.decoy_mark.e_swap.d: One delver is picked out by an unseen eye and marked: the dungeon's hunters want that one first, and everyone else can only help by drawing the eye elsewhere. The mark jumps to another delver half way through.
mechanic.nusmp.party.decoy_mark.e_swap.f: A pawn in the right place can win the game.
mechanic.nusmp.party.decoy_mark.t_floor_: One delver is picked out by an unseen eye and marked: the dungeon's hunters want that one first, and everyone else can only help by drawing the eye elsewhere. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
A pawn in the right place can win the game.
mechanic.nusmp.party.decoy_mark.c_kill_a: One delver is picked out by an unseen eye and marked: the dungeon's hunters want that one first, and everyone else can only help by drawing the eye elsewhere. It is held up by wardens that spawn with it; kill them all to end it.
A pawn in the right place can win the game.
mechanic.nusmp.party.decoy_mark.e_lastin: The Decoy Mark: The Lasting Mark
One delver is picked out by an unseen eye and marked: the dungeon's hunters want that one first, and everyone else can only help by drawing the eye elsewhere. The mark lasts the whole fight.
A pawn in the right place can win the game.
mechanic.nusmp.party.decoy_mark.t_party_: One delver is picked out by an unseen eye and marked: the dungeon's hunters want that one first, and everyone else can only help by drawing the eye elsewhere. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
A pawn in the right place can win the game.
mechanic.nusmp.party.decoy_mark.c_sneak_: One delver is picked out by an unseen eye and marked: the dungeon's hunters want that one first, and everyone else can only help by drawing the eye elsewhere. Sneak through its area long enough and it loses interest.
A pawn in the right place can win the game.
mechanic.nusmp.party.relay_labyrinth.des: A long hall with a wooden idol at one end that must be carried to a shrine at the other: the carrier is slowed and the others have to clear the way and take over when they tire.
mechanic.nusmp.party.relay_labyrinth.fla: The Labyrinth only opens for a team.
mechanic.nusmp.party.relay_labyrinth.e_h: The Relay Labyrinth: The Heavy Idol

A long hall with a wooden idol at one end that must be carried to a shrine at the other: the carrier is slowed and the others have to clear the way and take over when they tire. A heavier idol: the carrier moves slowly indeed.
The Labyrinth only opens for a team.
mechanic.nusmp.party.relay_labyrinth.t_f: A long hall with a wooden idol at one end that must be carried to a shrine at the other: the carrier is slowed and the others have to clear the way and take over when they tire. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
The Labyrinth only opens for a team.
mechanic.nusmp.party.relay_labyrinth.c_i: A long hall with a wooden idol at one end that must be carried to a shrine at the other: the carrier is slowed and the others have to clear the way and take over when they tire. Lay an offering on its altar to quiet it.
The Labyrinth only opens for a team.
mechanic.nusmp.party.relay_labyrinth.e_b: The Relay Labyrinth: The Bell Idol

A long hall with a wooden idol at one end that must be carried to a shrine at the other: the carrier is slowed and the others have to clear the way and take over when they tire. The idol rings: every move calls a hunter.
The Labyrinth only opens for a team.
mechanic.nusmp.party.relay_labyrinth.t_p: A long hall with a wooden idol at one end that must be carried to a shrine at the other: the carrier is slowed and the others have to clear the way and take over when they tire. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
The Labyrinth only opens for a team.
mechanic.nusmp.party.relay_labyrinth.c_l: A long hall with a wooden idol at one end that must be carried to a shrine at the other: the carrier is slowed and the others have to clear the way and take over when they tire. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
The Labyrinth only opens for a team.
mechanic.nusmp.party.shared_mana_pool.de: The squad's mana is a single pool: one mage's spell is paid for by all, and one mage's burnout leaves the others empty.
mechanic.nusmp.party.shared_mana_pool.fl: A squad stands or falls on the same mana.
mechanic.nusmp.party.shared_mana_pool.e_: The Shared Mana Pool: A Lean Pool
The squad's mana is a single pool: one mage's spell is paid for by all, and one mage's burnout leaves the others empty. The pool leaks: little comes back.
A squad stands or falls on the same mana.
mechanic.nusmp.party.shared_mana_pool.t_: The squad's mana is a single pool: one mage's spell is paid for by all, and one mage's burnout leaves the others empty. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
A squad stands or falls on the same mana.
mechanic.nusmp.party.shared_mana_pool.c_: The squad's mana is a single pool: one mage's spell is paid for by all, and one mage's burnout leaves the others empty. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
A squad stands or falls on the same mana.
mechanic.nusmp.party.shared_mana_pool.e_: The Shared Mana Pool: A Brimming Pool
The squad's mana is a single pool: one mage's spell is paid for by all, and one mage's burnout leaves the others empty. The pool refills quickly after the draw.
A squad stands or falls on the same mana.
mechanic.nusmp.party.shared_mana_pool.t_: The squad's mana is a single pool: one mage's spell is paid for by all, and one mage's burnout leaves the others empty. It reacts to the use of items in its area.
A squad stands or falls on the same mana.
mechanic.nusmp.party.friendly_fire.name: The Friendly Fire
mechanic.nusmp.party.friendly_fire.desc: An explosion mage in the party, a pit of unreasonable depth and a narrow corridor: area attacks here hit whoever is standing in them, ally or not.
mechanic.nusmp.party.friendly_fire.flavo: It isn't friendly fire if you're all on the same blast.
mechanic.nusmp.party.friendly_fire.e_lig: The Friendly Fire: Chain Lightning Fire
An explosion mage in the party, a pit of unreasonable depth and a narrow corridor: area attacks here hit whoever is standing in them, ally or not. Bolts that leap from delver to delver.
It isn't friendly fire if you're all on the same blast.
mechanic.nusmp.party.friendly_fire.t_par: An explosion mage in the party, a pit of unreasonable depth and a narrow corridor: area attacks here hit whoever is standing in them, ally or not. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
It isn't friendly fire if you're all on the same blast.
mechanic.nusmp.party.friendly_fire.c_kil: An explosion mage in the party, a pit of unreasonable depth and a narrow corridor: area attacks here hit whoever is standing in them, ally or not. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
It isn't friendly fire if you're all on the same blast.
mechanic.nusmp.party.friendly_fire.e_slo: The Friendly Fire: The Slow Blasts
An explosion mage in the party, a pit of unreasonable depth and a narrow corridor: area attacks here hit whoever is standing in them, ally or not. A blast every five seconds, larger.
It isn't friendly fire if you're all on the same blast.
mechanic.nusmp.party.friendly_fire.t_dam: An explosion mage in the party, a pit of unreasonable depth and a narrow corridor: area attacks here hit whoever is standing in them, ally or not. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
It isn't friendly fire if you're all on the same blast.
mechanic.nusmp.party.lone_hunter.name: The Lone Hunter's Handicap
mechanic.nusmp.party.lone_hunter.desc: A gate with a party minimum: a single hunter alone in the room is slowed and weakened by the room's rules, and the penalty melts away when allies arrive.
mechanic.nusmp.party.lone_hunter.flavor: Gates remember who walks in alone.
The Lone Hunter's Handicap: The Lone Wolf's Edge
A gate with a party minimum: a single hunter alone in the room is slowed and weakened by the room's rules, and the penalty melts away when allies arrive. The reverse: a lone hunter is strengthened.
Gates remember who walks in alone.
mechanic.nusmp.party.lone_hunter.t_party: A gate with a party minimum: a single hunter alone in the room is slowed and weakened by the room's rules, and the penalty melts away when allies arrive. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
Gates remember who walks in alone.
mechanic.nusmp.party.lone_hunter.c_all_p: A gate with a party minimum: a single hunter alone in the room is slowed and weakened by the room's rules, and the penalty melts away when allies arrive. Every living member of the party must stand on the plate together.
Gates remember who walks in alone.
The Lone Hunter's Handicap: The Lone Wolf's Toll
A gate with a party minimum: a single hunter alone in the room is slowed and weakened by the room's rules, and the penalty melts away when allies arrive. A lone hunter also bleeds.
Gates remember who walks in alone.
mechanic.nusmp.party.lone_hunter.t_hp_be: A gate with a party minimum: a single hunter alone in the room is slowed and weakened by the room's rules, and the penalty melts away when allies arrive. It smells a wounded delver and strikes when someone drops under half health.
Gates remember who walks in alone.
mechanic.nusmp.party.spiral_crowd.name: The Spiral Crowd
mechanic.nusmp.party.spiral_crowd.desc: The more of the squad stand in one spot, the more spiral energy they raise, and the room, which is built on that energy, notices: crowds are fine, but a crowd that cannot move is not.
mechanic.nusmp.party.spiral_crowd.flavor: Who the hell do you think we are?
mechanic.nusmp.party.spiral_crowd.e_four: The Spiral Crowd: A Four-Man Spiral

The more of the squad stand in one spot, the more spiral energy they raise, and the room, which is built on that energy, notices: crowds are fine, but a crowd that cannot move is not. It needs four to fire.
Who the hell do you think we are?
mechanic.nusmp.party.spiral_crowd.t_area: The more of the squad stand in one spot, the more spiral energy they raise, and the room, which is built on that energy, notices: crowds are fine, but a crowd that cannot move is not. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
Who the hell do you think we are?
mechanic.nusmp.party.spiral_crowd.c_stan: The more of the squad stand in one spot, the more spiral energy they raise, and the room, which is built on that energy, notices: crowds are fine, but a crowd that cannot move is not. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
Who the hell do you think we are?
mechanic.nusmp.party.spiral_crowd.e_heal: The Spiral Crowd: The Spiral Heals

The more of the squad stand in one spot, the more spiral energy they raise, and the room, which is built on that energy, notices: crowds are fine, but a crowd that cannot move is not. The energy heals as well.
Who the hell do you think we are?
mechanic.nusmp.party.spiral_crowd.t_idle: The more of the squad stand in one spot, the more spiral energy they raise, and the room, which is built on that energy, notices: crowds are fine, but a crowd that cannot move is not. Standing still in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
Who the hell do you think we are?

mechanic.nusmp.party.executioner_pairs.d: Delvers are paired off, convict and executioner, and the pairs are bound by a leash of fear: if either strays too far from the other, both are punished.
mechanic.nusmp.party.executioner_pairs.f: Survive together, or be swept aside separately.
mechanic.nusmp.party.executioner_pairs.e: The Executioner and the Convict: The Short Leash
Delvers are paired off, convict and executioner, and the pairs are bound by a leash of fear: if either strays too far from the other, both are punished. A three-block leash.
Survive together, or be swept aside separately.
mechanic.nusmp.party.executioner_pairs.t: The Executioner and the Convict: Omen

Delvers are paired off, convict and executioner, and the pairs are bound by a leash of fear: if either strays too far from the other, both are punished. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
Survive together, or be swept aside separately.

Survive together, or be swept aside separately.
mechanic.nusmp.party.executioner_pairs.t: The Executioner and the Convict: Quorum

Survive together, or be swept aside separately.
mechanic.nusmp.party.soul_resonance.name: The Soul Resonance
mechanic.nusmp.party.soul_resonance.desc: Two delvers must act in perfect unison: stand on two pedestals, strike the same note at the same moment, and the doors answer; one lagging half a beat is enough to spoil it.
mechanic.nusmp.party.soul_resonance.flav: Our souls are in sync. Don't tell me you can't feel it.
mechanic.nusmp.party.soul_resonance.e_th: Two delvers must act in perfect unison: stand on two pedestals, strike the same note at the same moment, and the doors answer; one lagging half a beat is enough to spoil it. Three pedestals.
Our souls are in sync. Don't tell me you can't feel it.
mechanic.nusmp.party.soul_resonance.t_fl: Two delvers must act in perfect unison: stand on two pedestals, strike the same note at the same moment, and the doors answer; one lagging half a beat is enough to spoil it. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
Our souls are in sync. Don't tell me you can't feel it.
mechanic.nusmp.party.soul_resonance.c_sp: Two delvers must act in perfect unison: stand on two pedestals, strike the same note at the same moment, and the doors answer; one lagging half a beat is enough to spoil it. Two delvers must hold two plates at once.
Our souls are in sync. Don't tell me you can't feel it.
mechanic.nusmp.party.soul_resonance.e_sl: Two delvers must act in perfect unison: stand on two pedestals, strike the same note at the same moment, and the doors answer; one lagging half a beat is enough to spoil it. A slower beat and a wider window.
Our souls are in sync. Don't tell me you can't feel it.
mechanic.nusmp.party.soul_resonance.t_pa: Two delvers must act in perfect unison: stand on two pedestals, strike the same note at the same moment, and the doors answer; one lagging half a beat is enough to spoil it. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
Our souls are in sync. Don't tell me you can't feel it.
mechanic.nusmp.party.trust_fall.name: The Trust Fall
mechanic.nusmp.party.trust_fall.desc: A test floor that splits the party across two ledges over a gap: one must trust the other to let go, drop through, and be caught by a safety the test pretends not to have.
mechanic.nusmp.party.trust_fall.flavor: A Regular always has to decide who to trust, and who to push.
The Trust Fall: Three on the Ledge

A test floor that splits the party across two ledges over a gap: one must trust the other to let go, drop through, and be caught by a safety the test pretends not to have. Three delvers hold three plates.
A Regular always has to decide who to trust, and who to push.

mechanic.nusmp.party.trust_fall.e_hard.d: A test floor that splits the party across two ledges over a gap: one must trust the other to let go, drop through, and be caught by a safety the test pretends not to have. The test has no safety net: a hard landing.

A Regular always has to decide who to trust, and who to push.

_note: Lang fragment of the map-mod compatibility (docs/compat/maps.md). Merge into assets/nusmp/lang/en_us.json (not edited by this branch). Every message key below also has the same English text as its in-code fallback, so the game reads well before the merge. The biome and dimension names are what a minimap (Xaero's shows the biome name) and a world map display for the mod's biomes and dimensions; without them the raw key is shown.
message.nusmp.maps.hover: Click to copy the coordinates (%1$s). With Xaero's Minimap or World Map, click the grey text to add the waypoint.
message.nusmp.maps.hover_raw: Click to copy the Xaero's waypoint text.
message.nusmp.maps.ftb_warn: FTB Chunks lets players claim chunks in this mod's dimensions (%1$s). Add to its world config: %2$s. Details: /multiverse compat maps
message.nusmp.maps.player_only: Only a player has a position to share.
message.nusmp.maps.share.state: Waypoint lines: %1$s for you (server: %2$s). /multiverse waypoint share on|off|here|gate|return
message.nusmp.maps.share.on: You will get waypoint lines for places that matter (gates, rifts, safe rooms).
message.nusmp.maps.share.off: You will not get automatic waypoint lines any more.
message.nusmp.maps.share.no_gate: You do not know a Gate yet: walk through the Labyrinth Gateway first.
message.nusmp.maps.share.no_return: You have no Return Waypoint yet: stand somewhere in the dungeon first.
message.nusmp.maps.status.none: No map mod seen by this side. (A client-only map mod such as Xaero's is invisible to a dedicated server; the data below still works for it.)
message.nusmp.maps.status.colours: Block map colours: all %1$s custom blocks have a mapColor.
message.nusmp.maps.status.colours_bad: Block map colours: %1$s of %2$s custom blocks have NO mapColor (a vanilla map looks through them): %3$s. Re-run MapBlockColourGuardTest and fix the registration.
message.nusmp.maps.status.share: Waypoint lines: %1$s (raw Xaero's string %2$s, JourneyMap form %3$s, at most %4$s per player per minute). Players: /multiverse waypoint share on|off|here|gate|return.
message.nusmp.maps.status.ftb_ok: FTB Chunks: claims are blocked in this mod's dimensions (%1$s).
message.nusmp.maps.status.ftb_open: FTB Chunks WARNING: players can claim chunks in %1$s.
message.nusmp.maps.status.ftb_fix: Add to FTB Chunks' world config (%1$s): %2$s
message.nusmp.maps.status.ftb_unknown: FTB Chunks: its world config (%1$s) was not found, so claims in this mod's dimensions cannot be checked. Make sure it has: %2$s
message.nusmp.maps.status.ftb_absent: FTB Chunks: not loaded on this side.
message.nusmp.maps.status.test: Self-test: /multiverse mega selftest compat.maps. Details: docs/compat/maps.md.
message.nusmp.maps.status.ftb_block: FTB Chunks claim block: %1$s (config blockFtbClaims = %2$s, refused in: %3$s).
message.nusmp.maps.ftb_claims_blocked: Claiming is not allowed in the dungeons
nusmp.merge.retired.description: The merged (custom) magics were removed. Two attributes now stay two attributes, each with its own grimoire.
nusmp.page.book_air.air_step: Air Step: a burst of air carries you up to nine blocks forward and a little up, pushing aside what you pass.
nusmp.page.book_air.pressure_burst: Pressure Burst: a pressure orb swells where you aim for a second and a half, then bursts for damage and a hard push in 4.5 blocks (a boss is pushed a third as far).
nusmp.page.book_air.vacuum_seal: Vacuum Seal: the air leaves the foe you look at. It is drawn in front of you (not a boss), silenced and slowed for as long as your control allows.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_shroud: Ash Shroud: nine seconds of charcoal armour cracked with embers and the bare branches of an ash tree on your back, forged piece by piece. Damage resistance, a hit harder, and whatever strikes you in melee withers.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_soldiers: Ash Soldiers: two soldiers of ash rise and fight for fifteen seconds (longer with EP): each walks to the nearest hostile and strikes it, withering it, and crumbles when it ends.
nusmp.page.book_ash.cursed_ash: Cursed Ash: cursed ash on the foe you look at: damage, wither II for five seconds and six percent of its mana drained into you (two percent on a boss).
nusmp.page.book_dark.dark_cloak: Dark Cloaked Guard - Yami's Dark Cloaked. The dark armour forges on and stays until you cast the page again, your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die. While it is on a tenth of every blow is turned aside and you hit harder. The cast gives fifteen seconds of resistance and absorption, and twelve percent of the damage you deal comes back as healing. The Dark Cloaked slashes are spells: they never put the armour on.
nusmp.page.book_dark.shadow_embrace: Dark Cloaked Shadow Embrace - a void opens round you for four seconds: foes are slowed, blinded and drained of magicules, up to five at a time.
nusmp.page.book_dark.black_hole_collapse: Black Hole Collapse - a great black hole at the aim point pulls foes in for three and a half seconds (never a boss), swallows spells, then collapses for 30 damage.
nusmp.page.book_earth.earth_golem: A Clay Guardian - a colossus of mud and grass - rises at your side for about twenty-five seconds. It slams the nearest foe with both fists, lifting and slowing everything near the blow.
nusmp.page.book_earth.earth_armor: The Gnome Plate: packed soil with grass and roots forges over your body piece by piece, with Resistance and thorns for ten seconds and a share of your aura spent. The plate stays until you cast the page again, your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die; it shatters out when it ends. Spirit Dive is the spirit's own form.
nusmp.page.book_earth.sinkhole: Swallowing Ground - the earth opens under your target and everything round it: they are crushed and held fast, then the ground closes again with a second blow (hard control, shared lock; bosses are held for less).
nusmp.page.book_fire.crimson_lion_king: Crimson Lion King - a lion of flame at two and a half times the size runs twenty-four blocks, burning everything on its way, and explodes where it ends.
nusmp.page.book_fire.flame_armour: Flame Armour - Fuegoleon's armour of the Crimson Lion. Cast it and the armour forges on; it stays until you cast the page again (taking it off is free), your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die. While it is on fire cannot hurt you, a tenth of every blow is turned aside, you hit harder, and every blow sets its target alight with four extra damage. The cast itself also gives thirty seconds of Fire Resistance and Strength. A little mana is paid every second. No other spell ever puts it on.
nusmp.page.book_fire.phoenix_flare: Phoenix Flare - a phoenix of flame flies twenty blocks, burning everything on its line; allies near you are healed and a sunburst blooms where it ends.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.heavy_infighting: Heavy Infighting: Gladiator - three slams in a row on one foe within 8 blocks, 8 x EP scale each; the ground answers every one and they stay pinned and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.evil_gods_pressu: Evil God's Pressure Craft - a rock is pulled out of the ground in front of you and compressed into a great sword. It rises, turns to where you aim and is launched: 26 x EP scale along its path, ignoring 30 percent of armour, piercing.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.lightened_step: Lightened Step - you and the allies within 4 blocks have gravity lowered for 8 s: slow falling, a high leap and a lighter run.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.weighted_blows: Weighted Blows - for 15 s the weight on your fists and weapon is raised: melee blows land 40 percent (+5 percent per EP step) harder and press the foe into the ground.
nusmp.page.book_hair.hair_lash: Hair Lash: a tendril rises under the foe in your crosshair, lashes it (damage scales with EP) and holds it for a moment.
nusmp.page.book_hair.hair_bind: Hair Bind: the same tendril kept for four seconds: the foe is held in place (shortened for bosses). Uses the shared control lock.
nusmp.page.book_hair.hair_cocoon: Hair Cocoon: an egg of woven hair closes round you for about seven seconds: absorption hearts, projectiles stopped, 1.5 hit points a second, and a burst of healing when it opens.
nusmp.page.book_hair.hair_weave: Hair Weave: a suit woven of hair forges itself on you for 20 seconds: a fifth of every blow is softened, attackers are bound by strands, and it mends you every two seconds.
nusmp.page.book_hair.hair_mane: Mane of a Hundred Strands: for five seconds a tendril lashes each of the three nearest foes within seven blocks every second and some of their magicules flow to you.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.raging_lightni: Raging Lightning - the lightning armour forges on and stays until you cast a Fiend page or this page again, your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die. The cast gives thirty seconds of Speed III and Strength II, and every two seconds a bolt strikes the nearest foe within eight blocks.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunder_drum: Raijin's Thunder Drums - for five seconds bolts strike up to three foes in the zone every half second; a quarter of the strikes paralyse (never a boss).
nusmp.page.book_lightning.lightning_surg: Lightning Surge - you dash through up to four foes within twelve blocks, one hop every two ticks, 9 damage each, and keep a stored charge for your next blow.
nusmp.page.book_memory.memory_echo: Echo: an afterimage of you for fifteen seconds. It blinks beside the nearest foe every second and a half, strikes, and replays the blow a moment later.
nusmp.page.book_memory.memory_forget: Forget: the foe in your sights forgets you. A mob's target is cleared again and again for six seconds and it is slowed; a player is weakened and blinded. Uses the shared control lock.
nusmp.page.book_memory.memory_recall: Recall: back to where and how you were three to seven seconds ago: your place, your health if it was higher, and harmful effects are shaken off. Needs a remembered moment at least three seconds old in the same dimension.
nusmp.page.book_memory.memory_archive: Archive: every foe within sixteen blocks (up to eight) is archived for six seconds. Everything that hurts it is written down, and at the end sixty percent of it is replayed on the foe, capped by its health.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_bullet: Mercury Magic: Silver Bullet - five to eight small spheres of condensed mercury, thrown fast in a spread.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_spear: Mercury Magic: Silver Spear - one to three spears of mercury launched at the target (the middle one homes); they pierce, and fire melts them.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_shining_r: Mercury Magic: Silver Shining Regal Spear - the palm held out, a long beam of shining mercury follows it for two seconds and cuts through everything in line; it breaks barriers on its way. The five-second coat forms.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_star_of_e: Mercury Creation Magic: Silver Star of Execution - the mercury is spread over the area and closes into a giant cage for five seconds: its bars launch spears at those inside, its shield plates block what is thrown back, and whoever tries to leave is turned back (the shared control lock; bosses are not held).
nusmp.page.book_mineral.mineral_spire: A crystal spire grows where you aim (two at most): it pulses shards every moment, hurting and slowing everything close. It stands solid and can be broken.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.lance_volley: Five crystal lances thrown in a fan; each pierces the foes on its line.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.reflect_iris: Reflect Iris - a ring of mirrors shows every foe within 14 blocks that is looking at you its own gaze: they are paralysed for 3 s (shorter on bosses, after the shared control gate), their magic is jammed and they take 6 x EP scale. Foes looking away are left alone.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.glass_garb: Glass Garb - for 20 s the Glass Garb wraps you: a crown of mirror panes, an oval mirror breastplate, a fan of floating mirrors behind your back. A third of every shot or spell that strikes you is thrown back at whoever sent it; the rest is cut by 15 percent.
nusmp.page.book_modification.specimen_th: Modification: Specimen Mark - a thread to the foe you look at: it is drawn slowly toward you (a walker can always walk away), drained and cut every second, and dissected when it arrives. Hard control: shares the twelve-second lock.
nusmp.page.book_modification.spell_rewri: Modification: Spell Rewrite - for four seconds the enemy shots that come within four and a half blocks of you are rewritten into needles and thrown back at their shooters, up to six.
nusmp.page.book_modification.test_subjec: Modification: Test Subjects - two (three for a mighty caster) edited humans with blade arms and claws rise for thirty seconds, follow you and cut the nearest foe.
nusmp.page.book_modification.dissection_: Modification: Dissection Theatre - a ring of tendrils closes round the aimed point from eight blocks to three over five seconds, with two doors; whoever touches the wall from inside is cut, and the squeeze at the end hits hard.
nusmp.page.book_modification.dissector_f: Dissector's Frame - the Frame for twenty seconds: eleven pieces forge in on your body and a ring of needles circles your head, firing one at the nearest foe every second or two. A fifth to three tenths off every blow. Resistance I.
nusmp.page.book_nail.nail_barrage: Nail Barrage: three giant nails (five for a mighty caster) fly at your crosshair, pin what they hit (damage scales with EP, Slowness III) and stay driven in walls.
nusmp.page.book_nail.nail_driver: Nail Driver: a spectral hammer comes down on the foe under your crosshair and pins it to the ground for about two seconds (shortened for bosses). Uses the shared control lock.
nusmp.page.book_nail.nail_mail: Nail Mail: dark studded iron with a wheel of nails on the back forges itself on you for 20 seconds: a quarter of every blow is softened, attackers are pricked and slowed, Resistance II.
nusmp.page.book_nail.nail_pin: Pinning Nails: three nails are driven into the ground round the foe under your crosshair: it cannot run or jump for about three seconds (shortened for bosses). Uses the shared control lock.
nusmp.page.book_nail.nail_storm: Nail Storm: for four seconds nails fall in a six block ring round your crosshair, each hurting and slowing what stands where it lands.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.phase_step: Phase Step - for 3 s you are out of step with the world: blows and shots pass through you (a spell takes half), you run faster, and a phase echo of you stays where you were.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.phase_through: Phase Through - step through the wall in front of you (up to 3 blocks away) to the first free space behind it within 8 blocks, through two phase doors. It fails when there is no wall or no room on the other side.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.permeating_st: Permeating Strike - a blow that goes through armour and barriers: 15 x EP scale, 90 percent of the armour ignored, the barriers within 3 blocks cut down.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.ghost_zone: Ghost Zone - for 8 s everything within 5 blocks (scaled by the grimoire) is outside the world's rules: you and your allies take 40 percent less from everything, foes there are slowed.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_armo: House Armour - the magic house worn as armour for twenty seconds: eleven pieces forge in on your body, the house stands on your back, and a quarter of every blow (more with EP, at most 38 percent) is taken off. Resistance I.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.room_rebui: Recombination: Room Rebuild - as the house mends itself, you and your allies within seven blocks are healed and regenerate; a room rises at your side.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.ultra_gian: Ultra Giant Bull - the Compound spell: your house-golem grows one and a half times, fires four cannons at a time and strikes harder for twenty seconds. The Raging Black Bull must already stand.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.plank_snar: Recombination: Plank Snare - boards close round a foe and hold it for three seconds, then it takes a blow. Hard control: shares the twelve-second lock, a boss is held for a quarter as long.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.ochre_totem: A painted totem rises where you aim (two at most): every moment it spits a bolt of pigment at the nearest foe, weakening and marking it. It stands solid and can be broken.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.war_paint: War Paint - your body is daubed in ochre for twelve seconds: your blows hit harder, you run faster, the clay armour forges, and every foe near you is marked to glow.
nusmp.page.book_rock.boulder_titan: The Boulder Titan - a hunched crag giant rises at your side with a shock where it stands. It stomps the nearest foe, and now and then roars: everything close is thrown back and weakened (hard control, shared lock).
nusmp.page.book_rock.boulder_barrage: Three boulders thrown in a fan; each bursts where it lands.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.sandstone_pris: Variable Hardness Prison - a large block of sandstone leaves the grimoire, dissolves into sand and reforms around the target, then hardens and leaves it to suffocate: it is held inside and crushed for a few seconds. Hard control (shared lock; bosses are held for less).
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.sandstone_slab: A wall of sandstone slabs, five wide and three high, raised in front of you for eight seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.sandstone_sphi: A guardian of layered sandstone, a sphinx, rises at your side for about twenty-five seconds: it pounces on the nearest foe from several blocks away and claws sand into its eyes.
nusmp.page.book_scale.scale_volley: Scale Volley: throw five scales in a fan. Each hurts the first foe it meets (damage scales with EP) and weakens it.
nusmp.page.book_scale.scale_serpent: Scale Serpent: call a wyrm of scales that follows you, slithers to the nearest foe and bites it (Weakness, Slowness) for about 25 seconds. A mighty caster calls two.
nusmp.page.book_scale.scale_shield: Scale Shield: a kite shield of scales hovers in front of you for about 15 seconds and turns every projectile that flies at you back at its sender.
nusmp.page.book_scale.scale_mail: Scale Mail: a suit of teal scales forges itself on you for 20 seconds: a quarter of every blow is softened and a fifth more against projectiles, Resistance II.
nusmp.page.book_scale.scale_tide: Shedding Tide: shed your scales in a wave that hurts everything within six blocks and throws it back; you slough every harmful effect and heal a sixth of your health.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.shakudo_lance: Gilded Inlay Lance: thrust a lance of inlaid alloy 14 blocks ahead. It pierces everything on its line (damage scales with EP), staggers it and slows it.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.shakudo_golem: Shakudo Golem: raise a 2.3 block alloy golem that follows you and brings both fists down on the nearest foe for about 25 seconds (longer and bigger with EP). One at a time.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.shakudo_bulwark: Shakudo Bulwark: raise a solid slab of alloy three blocks ahead. It blocks the way and destroys every projectile that flies at it for about 10 seconds, unless it is broken first.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.shakudo_plate_ar: Shakudo Plate Armor: a suit of black alloy with gold inlay forges itself on you for 20 seconds: a third of every blow is softened, melee attackers are staggered and cut, Resistance II.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.shakudo_colossus: Shakudo Colossus: a golem 1.7 times the size with a heavier fist stands at your side for about 20 seconds (longer with EP). Two minutes to recover.
nusmp.page.book_slash.lunatic_slash: Death Scythe: Lunatic Slash - the forearm blades throw a chaotic flurry of ten flying slashes in one second over an 80 degree cone: each pierces for 6 x EP scale and cuts adaptively. Uses aura.
nusmp.page.book_slash.adaptive_edge: Adaptive Edge - the blades read the foe you look at: three adaptation marks are laid on it at once, the barriers around it are cut down, and its magic is jammed for 4 s (2 s and half as likely on a boss).
nusmp.page.book_smoke.smoke_step: Smoke Step: you turn to smoke and flow up to eleven blocks along your aim, blinding everything you pass, and stay unseen for two seconds. Mobs hunting you lose the trail.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.coiling_serpent: Coiling Serpent: a serpent of smoke coils round one foe in sight. Held and squeezed for as long as your control allows (shortened on bosses, shares the twelve second control lock).
nusmp.page.book_smoke.smoke_wave: Smoke Wave: a rolling wall of smoke in a cone in front of you: damage, a push and blindness. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_snow.snow_drift: Snow Drift: you slide on a drift up to ten blocks along your aim, chilling everything you pass.
nusmp.page.book_snow.frost_crystal: Frost Crystal: an ice crystal grows where you aim and lasts ten seconds (longer with EP). Every second it pulses frost on everything within four and a half blocks, and it shatters at the end.
nusmp.page.book_snow.whiteout: Whiteout: a ring of white around you: foes within seven blocks are blinded, slowed hard and hurt.
nusmp.page.book_song.song_choir: Choir of Spirits: three singing spirits circle you for twenty seconds. Every second and a half each sings a verse that heals allies near it and hurts the nearest foe.
nusmp.page.book_song.song_metronome: Metronome: a brass metronome planted where you aim for ten seconds. Allies within six blocks of its beat are hastened and foes are slowed.
nusmp.page.book_song.song_harmony: Harmony: up to four allied players within twelve blocks share Resistance, Speed and Regeneration for ten seconds.
nusmp.page.book_song.song_finale: Grand Finale: everything the song has built is released at once. Every foe within fourteen blocks takes a heavy blow and spiritual damage, allies are healed a quarter of their health (never bosses), and the choir sings its loudest verse.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.corpse_mario: Marionette: a Soul Zombie fights for you for twenty-five seconds. It follows you and fights your foes only, never burns in daylight and drops nothing. At most six zombies of yours stand at a time (the oldest is dismissed first).
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.corpse_swap: Corpse Swap: a decoy puppet takes your place and you step six blocks back. Mobs that hunted you lose their target, and the decoy bursts after three seconds.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.corpse_legio: Corpse Legion: four Soul Zombies rise round you for twenty seconds and the hands of the grave close under every foe near you.
nusmp.page.book_soul.soul_wisps: Soul Wisps: three soul spirits circle you for twenty seconds and lunge at any foe within ten blocks, biting for body and spiritual damage.
nusmp.page.book_soul.soul_bind: Soul Bind: the foe in your sights is struck three times a second apart for body and spiritual damage, weakened and made to glow, and you recover health with each pulse.
nusmp.page.book_soul.soul_harvest: Soul Harvest: for ten seconds every foe that dies within sixteen blocks returns a share of your magicules and health (the first six souls).
nusmp.page.book_soul.soul_ascension: Soul Ascension: three wisps rise round you and detonate after two seconds, hurting body and soul every foe near each of them, and you recover a share of your health.
nusmp.page.book_sound.sound_speaker: Speaker Stack: two speaker stacks are planted at your sides for fifteen seconds. Each sends a sonic pulse at the nearest foe every second and a half and briefly jams its Ultimate skills.
nusmp.page.book_sound.sound_silence: Silence: Magic Jamming over a wide circle. Every active skill of every foe in it is put on a cooldown (bosses for a shorter time) and a Silence effect is laid on them. No damage.
nusmp.page.book_sound.sound_resonance: Resonant Shatter: rings every resonance mark within range at once. Each foe takes damage per stack of marks (up to five) and the barriers round it shatter.
nusmp.page.book_sound.sound_boom: Mach Step: a dash that hits everything on the way and marks it with resonance, leaving a shock ring where you started.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.dimensional_armo: Dimensional Armour - for 20 s the Gate Garb wraps you: a pearl and void set with gate rings on the shoulders, hips and knees, a gate wheel behind your back. A blow aimed at you may fall through a gate and miss (15 to 35 percent by EP); the rest are cut by a fifth.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.gate_strike: Gate Strike - a rift opens behind the foe you look at and the cut comes out of it: 14 x EP scale spatial damage that ignores 40 percent of their armour, and a short slow.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.gate_swap: Gate Swap - two gates open and you trade places with the foe or ally you look at (20 blocks). A foe is slowed; a boss is too heavy for a gate and is only shaken.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.dimension_collap: Dimension Collapse - space folds in on the aimed point. For two seconds everything within 6 blocks (scaled by the grimoire and EP) is dragged in, then the fold shuts for 22 x EP scale spatial damage. Bosses are pulled a third as hard and their damage is capped.
nusmp.spatial.fell_through: The blow falls through a gate.
nusmp.spatial.too_heavy: It is too heavy for a gate: it is only shaken.
nusmp.page.book_spike.spike_eruption: Spike Eruption: six spike pillars erupt in a line ahead of you, one after the other. Each impales what stands on it (damage scales with EP) and slows it.
nusmp.page.book_spike.spike_wall: Spike Wall: seven spike pillars stand across your way for about 8 seconds and keep pricking whatever stays on them.
nusmp.page.book_spike.spike_urchin: Spike Urchin: a spiked ball homes in on the foe under your crosshair and bursts in a three block ring, throwing its spikes (damage scales with EP, Slowness).
nusmp.page.book_spike.spike_armor: Spike Armor: gun-metal plate bristling with spikes forges itself on you for 20 seconds: a fifth of every blow is softened and attackers are cut for half of what they dealt.
nusmp.page.book_spike.spike_impaling_fie: Impaling Field: for five seconds a spike pillar erupts every half second under each of the three nearest foes within seven blocks.
nusmp.page.book_stone.stone_sentinel: A Stone Sentinel rises at your side: a knight of masonry with a tower shield that turns projectiles back and a block hammer that smashes the nearest foe.
nusmp.page.book_stone.stone_wall: A wall of stone bricks, six wide and four high, raised in front of you for ten seconds.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemic_b: Transmutation: Alchemic Blades - three to five blades of iron and brass circle you for ten seconds and lunge at the nearest foe within twelve blocks, one cut each, then return. More blades for more EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.flowering: Transmutation: Flowering - as Grey and Gauche turned the tendrils into flowers: in seven blocks the foes' shots and the other casters' constructs become flowers, allies lose harmful effects and are healed. Flowers grow for ten seconds.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.transmuted: Transmutation: Transmuted Sentinel - a two-block golem of iron and stone, circles engraved on it, rises at your side for thirty seconds, follows you and strikes the nearest foe. One at a time.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemist_: Alchemist's Armour - the Gilded Plate for twenty seconds: eleven pieces of brass and iron forge in on your body, a great circle turns behind you, and a fifth of every blow (more with EP, at most 35 percent) is taken off. Resistance I.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.vortex_step: Vortex Step: you spin forward up to ten blocks, cutting what you pass and leaving a pull behind you.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.maelstrom_core: Maelstrom Core: a core of wind hangs where you aim for eight seconds (longer with EP), drawing in everything within eight blocks (a boss at a third of the strength) and cutting what is near it, then implodes for damage.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.spiral_gale: Spiral Gale: a spiral gale in a cone in front of you: damage, a push and a lift.
nusmp.page.book_water.sea_dragons_wrath: Sea Dragon's Wrath - three sea dragons fan out from you; each one hits what it reaches for 14 and throws it back. Scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_water.tide_lance: Valkyrie Tide Lance - a great lance of water, thrown from the armour's hand: 22 damage to everything on its line, and it pushes them back.
nusmp.page.book_water.scale_mail: Sea Dragon's Scale Mail - scales of water close over you: absorption hearts and resistance for fifteen seconds, allies near you are healed, and the water armour forges on. It stays until you cast the page again, your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die; a little mana is paid every second.
nusmp.page.book_water.torrent: Sea Dragon's Torrent - a cone of rushing water nine blocks long: damage, a hard push and Slowness. The cone grows with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_wing.wing_dash: Wing Dash: a beat of the wings carries you twelve blocks in a line, cutting and pushing everything you pass.
nusmp.page.book_wing.feather_storm: Feather Storm: four feather blades orbit you for fifteen seconds (longer with EP). Each flies at the nearest hostile within ten blocks once a second, cuts it and returns.
nusmp.page.book_wing.hawk_strike: Hawk Strike: a feather hawk dives at the foe you look at, striking once for damage and a push.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.mucus_construct: Mucus Magic: Mucus Construct - a mound of mucus beside you for 15 seconds swallows every projectile near it and engulfs foes. It can be hit.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.smother: Mucus Magic: Smother - mucus closes over one foe (hard control, shares the 12 second control lock): slowed, silenced, blinded and drained.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.absorption_wall: Mucus Magic: Absorption Wall - a wall of mucus that dissolves what is shot at it and drains the magicules of foes beyond it.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.sticky_trail: Mucus Magic: Sticky Trail - you leave a trail of mucus for 6 seconds that slows whoever steps in it.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.mucus_burst: Mucus Magic: Bubble Burst - bubbles of mucus drift to the aimed point and burst one after another: damage and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_mud.mud_golem: Mud Magic: Mud Golem - a golem of mud rises beside you for 20 seconds, follows you and pounds the nearest foe. It can be hit.
nusmp.page.book_mud.mud_spout: Mud Magic: Mud Spout - spouts of mud burst under up to four foes near the aimed point: damage and thrown up.
nusmp.page.book_mud.mud_wall: Mud Magic: Mud Wall - a wall of packed mud rises in front of you; foes in front of it are thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_mud.mud_shackle: Mud Magic: Mud Shackle - mud closes round one foe's legs (hard control, shares the 12 second control lock).
nusmp.page.book_mud.mud_barrage: Mud Magic: Mud Barrage - for 3 seconds globs of mud rain on the aimed point.
nusmp.page.book_plant.seed_bloom: Plant Magic: Seed Bloom - a seed that blossoms where it lands: foes are hurt and slowed, friends in the blast heal.
nusmp.page.book_plant.healing_bloom: Plant Magic: Healing Bloom - a great bloom grows at the aimed point and heals everyone friendly near it for about 8 seconds, slowing foes.
nusmp.page.book_plant.flower_sprite: Plant Magic: Flower Sprite - a flower sprite circles you for 30 seconds: it mends the most hurt friend and spits petals at foes. It can be hit.
nusmp.page.book_plant.ivy_barrier: Plant Magic: Ivy Barrier - a wall of flowering leaves that dissolves everything shot at it.
nusmp.page.book_plant.blossom_dress: Plant Magic: Blossom Dress - the Blossom armour drifts onto you for 10 seconds, petal by petal: blows are softened, each one mends you a little, and you regenerate.
nusmp.page.book_plant.petal_storm: Plant Magic: Petal Storm - for 8 seconds a storm of petals circles you: foes are cut and slowed, friends mend.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.trap_maw: Poison Plant Magic: Trap Maw - a carnivorous trap that snaps on the first foe to come near, again every 2.5 seconds, for 12 seconds: damage, strong poison, rooted.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.spore_burst: Poison Plant Magic: Spore Burst - a cone of spores: foes are blinded, made sick and poisoned.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.antivenom_g: Poison Plant Magic: Antivenom Graft - you graft an antidote on yourself and friends near you: harmful effects are cleansed and a little health returns.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.pitcher_swa: Poison Plant Magic: Pitcher Swallow - a pitcher plant swallows one foe (hard control, shares the 12 second control lock): it is held, digested and drained.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.thorn_volle: Poison Plant Magic: Toxic Thorn Volley - five homing venom thorns.
nusmp.page.book_tree.heartwood_guardian: Tree Magic: Heartwood Guardian - a treant of heartwood rises beside you for 20 seconds, follows you and slams the nearest foe. It can be hit.
nusmp.page.book_tree.seedling_volley: Tree Magic: Seedling Volley - five seeds that sprout into rooting thorns where they land.
nusmp.page.book_tree.timber_wall: Tree Magic: Timber Wall - a wall of oak trunks rises in front of you; foes in front of it are thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_tree.verdant_canopy: Tree Magic: Verdant Canopy - a canopy spreads over you for 10 seconds: friends beneath it mend and regenerate, foes are slowed.
nusmp.page.book_tree.heartwood_fist: Tree Magic: Heartwood Charge - you charge forward with a fist of heartwood, hitting everything on the way and throwing it back.
nusmp.page.book_vine.vine_serpent: Vine Magic: Vine Serpent - a serpent of vine hunts the nearest foe for 15 seconds, biting, rooting and poisoning. It can be hit.
nusmp.page.book_vine.vine_wall: Vine Magic: Thicket Wall - a wall of living vines rises in front of you; thorns tear whoever leans on it.
nusmp.page.book_vine.vine_swing: Vine Magic: Vine Swing - a vine thrown at the aimed point hauls you there; foes at the landing are caught.
nusmp.page.book_vine.strangling_bloom: Vine Magic: Strangling Bloom - vines bind one foe (hard control, shares the 12 second control lock): they tighten and feed on its magicules.
nusmp.page.book_vine.lash_barrage: Vine Magic: Lash Barrage - for 3 seconds whips of vine lash at up to three foes at a time.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.beam_mirrors.h: A beam leaves the golden block heading east. Right-click the mirrors to turn them until the beam lights the red crystal.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.chain_reaction: A right click adds a charge to a crystal. A crystal with as much charge as it has neighbours bursts and charges them in turn. Burst the golden core crystal before the clicks run out.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.cmd.apply.ok: Started %s here (#%s). Crouch and right-click its lectern twice to give up.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.cmd.info: Family %s, %s cells at tier 1 for one delver.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.cmd.list.head: Puzzle rooms: %s puzzles, at most %s a floor, switched %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.cmd.plan.head: Sector %s (theme %s): %s planned.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.cmd.plan.none: You are not in a sector.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.cmd.player: Only a player can do that.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.cmd.reset: Cleared and given-up puzzles may start again.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.cmd.verify.ok: All %s puzzles pass: solvable by their own hint, palettes and texts complete.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.colour_mix.hin: Each lamp mixes its two pillars: red and blue make purple, red and yellow orange, blue and yellow green. Make every lamp match the colour above it. Right-click a pillar to change its colour.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.adminNo: No room for that puzzle here.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.bypass: The mechanism grinds to a halt. Nothing is locked, but it pays nothing.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.bypassW: The mechanism is winding down: it lets you go in %s seconds.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.cooling: The mechanism is cooling down for a moment.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.dismiss: Crouch and right-click the lectern again to give up on this puzzle.
You give up the puzzle. The way stays open, and it pays nothing.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.fade: The pattern fades from the floor.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.flawles: Not one mistake: the mechanism pays double.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.jam: The mechanism jams from too much fiddling.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.nudge: Stuck? Right-click the lectern for the hint.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.pity: A faint glow shows where to try next.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.tooMany: Too many mistakes: the mechanism starts over.
Right-click the stars to draw one closed figure through all of them without ever crossing your own thread. Click the last star again to take a thread back, and close the figure on the first star.
That star is already on the thread.
The thread snaps where it would cross itself.
Take shards from the four crystals. Each pedestal wants a compound of two elements (steam is fire and water ...). Offer two shards with a right click; crouch to empty a pedestal.
This pedestal wants %s (%s of 2 shards given).
The shade caught the spirit and it flees back to the start.
Stand on the tile ahead of the pale spirit to light its way. Keep ahead of the creeping shade, and stand on the shade's tile to push it back.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.gravity_maze.h: Tip the room with the arrow pillars. The lit marble slides until a wall stops it. Drop it into the gold hole.
Purple shards that ring like a bell when struck, grown in a hollow of stone.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.bone.q: The dead leave me behind, and wolves would sit for me.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.coal.q: Born in the dark of the deep, black as night, I give my warmth when you burn me.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.copper.q: An orange metal that turns green as it ages.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.diamond.q: The hardest gem, found at the deepest layers, bright as ice.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.emerald.q: Green and bright, I buy bread from villagers.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.gold.q: Kings wear me and fools chase me, and I never rust.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.iron.q: I am forged into the blade and the shield, and I rust if left out in the rain.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.lapis.q: Deep blue as the night sky, scholars grind me into ink and dye.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.quartz.q: White and hard, grown in the red lands of fire, I am the stone of the Nether.
A red dust that wakes sleeping wires.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.key_and_lock.h: Take a key from its pedestal (right-click) and carry it to the lock of the same colour. Opening a lock frees the next key.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.key_and_lock.n: The lock wants a key of its colour.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.key_and_lock.s: This pedestal is sealed until the lock before it opens.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.lights_out.hin: Right-click a tile to flip it and the four tiles beside it. Light every tile.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.melody_notes.h: Strike the bell to hear the tune. Play it back on the note pillars (light is low, dark is high), then touch the stave stone.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.melody_notes.o: Off key. The notes fall silent.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.memory_tiles.h: Step on a tile to see its symbol, then find its twin. Matching tiles stay lit. Too many mistakes and the floor shuffles itself.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.memory_tiles.s: Too many mistakes: the floor shuffles itself.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.mimic_chests.h: Exactly one inscription tells the truth. Right-click a chest to read its inscription, and open it with a crouching right click. Only one chest is real.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.mimic_chests.i: Chest %s says: the treasure is in chest %s.
Chest %s says: the treasure is not in chest %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.number_lock.hi: Right-click the plaques scattered about the room: each states a fact about the code. Set the dials (crouch to turn back) and touch the lock stone.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.pendulum_cross: Cross the lanes to the far row. A blade sweeps each lane: red is where it is, amber where it goes next. Step where it is not.
The blade caught you: back to the start row.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.pipe_connect.h: Right-click a pipe tile to turn it. Join the golden inlet to the drain on the far side; wet pipes show where the water goes.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.pit_jump.hint: The column of colours beside the field names the safe colour of each row. Step only on tiles of that colour, from one end of the field to the other; any other tile gives way.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.pit_jump.name: The Coloured Floor
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.plate_sequence: Read the coloured tiles on the wall side, then step on the plates of the same colours in that order. A wrong plate puts the lights out.
A wrong plate: the lights go out.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.clock.q: What has hands but cannot clap?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.cloud.q: I fly without wings, I cry without eyes, and wherever I go, darkness follows. What am I?
The one who makes me does not need me; the one who buys me does not use me; the one who uses me never knows it. What am I?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.darknes: The more of me there is, the less you see. What am I?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.echo.q: I speak without a mouth and answer when you call. What am I?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.fire.q: Feed me and I live; give me water and I die. What am I?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.flame.q: I am not alive, but I grow; I have no lungs, but I need air. What am I?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.footste: The more of me you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
What is always in front of you but can never be seen?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.map.q: I have cities but no houses, mountains but no trees, and water but no fish. What am I?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.piano.q: What has keys but cannot open a lock?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.river.q: What runs but never walks, has a mouth but never talks, and has a bed but never sleeps?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.silence: What breaks the moment you speak its name?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.ton.q: Forward I am heavy, backward I am not. What am I?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.towel.q: What gets wetter the more it dries?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.umbrell: What goes up when the rain comes down?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle_door.hi: Answer the sphinx's riddles by clicking an answer in chat. A wrong answer costs you and brings a different riddle. Right-click the sphinx to hear the riddle again.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle_offerin: Each altar speaks a riddle whose answer is a thing. Take that thing from the matching bowl (right-click it) and offer it to the altar with a right click.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.rotating_pilla: Right-click the stones to turn them until every one faces the arrow on the compass stone. Meshing gears drag a neighbour round too.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.rune_copy.hint: Copy the master runes onto your stones: right-click a stone to change its rune (crouch to go back), then touch the seal stone. Deeper down the master fades; the oracle stone shows it again.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.rune_copy.name: The Copyist's Stones
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.sentry_stealth: Cross the lanes to the far row. A lane is watched while its statue and tiles glow red: wait until it looks away. Amber is a warning.
A statue saw you: back to the start row.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.shadow_cast.hi: Right-click the pillars to turn them until the shadow row on the wall matches the wanted row.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.simon_levers.h: Watch and listen to the levers, then press them in the same order. Each round adds one more.
Right-click a tile in the hole's row or column to slide the line toward the hole. Put the numbers in order, like the picture beside the grid.
Only a tile in the hole's row or column can slide.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.sundial.hint: A shadow creeps round the ring of hours. Right-click the gnomon in the moment the shadow lies on the gold stone.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.sundial.name: The Sundial Without a Sun
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.abyss: Something far below turns its attention to you: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.astral: The stars left a lesson in the floor: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.blood: The stone is warm and wet, and it remembers a game: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.celestia: The court sets a trial of wit before judgement: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.crystal_: The crystals hum a test through the rock: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.cursed_a: A librarian's ghost slides a card across the table: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.default: An old mechanism wakes as you enter: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.drowned_: Water drips in time with an old lock: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.dwarven_: The smiths built a mechanism here and never took it down: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.feywild_: The fey love a game, and they have made one: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.flame: Heat shimmers over a device of fire and stone: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.frost: Frost has crept into the gears but they still turn: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.fungal_u: Pale spores drift over a device someone left to rot: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.gravity: The floor leans a little, as if the puzzle itself were heavy: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.haunted_: A parlour game from a house that never ended: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.holy_chu: A catechism carved in stone invites you to answer: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.infernal: The foundry's overseers set a test for new hands: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.mountain: The monks leave a koan in the stone: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.necropol: The dead keep score, and a game is laid out for the living: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.radiant: The light itself is the lock, and you are the key: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.shadow: The dark offers a trade, and a game: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.sky_cita: The winds sing a measure above the clouds: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.spatial: Space folds round a small puzzle: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.spider_w: Webs hold a mechanism as a spider holds a fly: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.sunken_t: The tide worked this lock before the temple sank: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.vampire_: An old lord sets a guest a courtesy: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.verdant: Roots and vines have grown a puzzle round the stone: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.torch_order.gu: A flame woke out of turn: every brazier goes out.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.torch_order.hi: Right-click the lectern: it recites which flame must wake before which. Light the braziers in an order that keeps every rule, or they all go out.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.torch_order.re: The lectern recites %s rules of the flames:
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.torch_order.ru: The %s flame must wake before the %s one.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.water_level.hi: Click a tank to pick it, then the spring to fill it, the drain to empty it, or another tank to pour into it. Bring exactly as much water as the glass column shows into one tank.
The height of a stone is its weight. Right-click a stone to put it on the blue pan, on the red pan, or off the scale. Use every stone and make the pans balance.
message.nusmp.create.hint: Gears grind behind the walls. A lever on the wall would stop them.
message.nusmp.create.status.head: Create compatibility: Create is %s, the master switch is %s.
message.nusmp.create.status.absent: Nothing in the dungeon is changed: it is as it is without Create.
message.nusmp.create.status.sites: Traps: %s planned, %s built, %s dropped; %s awake near players.
message.nusmp.create.plan.done: Planned %s trap(s) in sectors that had none. They are built when someone comes near.
message.nusmp.create.player_only: Only a player has a place to build at.
message.nusmp.create.arm.family: Unknown family. Try saw_run, press, drill_wall, treadmill, pour or sequence.
message.nusmp.create.arm.dimension: Stand in the Mega-Dungeon, in a corridor, to build a trap.
message.nusmp.create.arm.done: Built a %s trap (%s trigger) at %s, running %s.
message.nusmp.create.arm.failed: No place within 24 blocks took a %s trap: %s
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.title: FLOOR %1$s  -  %2$s
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.road.hol: HOLY ROAD: the way on climbs UP
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.road.aby: ABYSSAL ROAD: the way on descends DOWN
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.note.req: Floor report, as it stands now.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.boss: BOSS FLOOR: the Guardian waits at the end of this floor.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.ge: A floor of its own palette. Its Crucible leans towards: %1$s.
A floor of its own palette; nothing more is recorded about it.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.mech.non: No floor-wide mechanic is in effect on this floor.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.mech.off: Mechanics are switched off on this server.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.mech.cou: Counter: none. Survive it, or leave its area.
Counter: see the mechanic's own hint in the room.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.mech.roo: %1$s more mechanic(s) wait in the rooms of this floor. You are told when you step into one.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.depth: DEPTH %1$s: monsters +%2$s%% health and +%3$s%% damage, mind level %4$s, kills give x%5$s experience.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.depth.fl: DEPTH %1$s: the first floor, monsters have their base strength.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.hint: Press %1$s, or type /dungeon floor, to read this again.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.cmd.off: The System floor report is switched off on this server.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.cmd.not_: You are not on a floor of the Mega-Dungeon.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.cmd.head: [SYSTEM] Floor report
key.nusmp.system_floor: Show the floor report (theme and mechanics)
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.gr: The baseline deepslate hold of falling stone, heavy weights and lightning rods.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.bl: Nether brick and crimson wood: blood, bone and torture, with the Crimson Reliquary at its heart.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.sp: End stone, purpur and crying obsidian: folded space, mirrors and doors that lead nowhere.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.fl: Blackstone, magma and lava forges: heat, sparks and molten channels.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.fr: Packed ice, snow and spruce: a freezing hold where the cold slows everything.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.ve: Mossy stone, azalea and cherry: an overgrown ruin the forest has taken back.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.st: Oxidised copper, tuff and lightning rods: a vault that crackles with the weather.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.sh: Polished blackstone, sculk and soul lanterns: halls of shadow that hide what stalks them.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.as: Quartz, calcite, prismarine and gold: a cold observatory of stars.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.ra: White quartz, smooth stone and gold with light everywhere, the air thick with Light Rukh.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.ab: Dark organic rock, sculk, moss and netherrack growing through deepslate, lit by soul fire.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.fe: The Feywild: giant glowing flowers and mushrooms, will-o'-wisps, tricks and illusions.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.dw: A dwarven hold of dressed stone, copper and iron, anvils, lava behind glass and a vault of kings.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.cr: A giant amethyst geode of calcite and basalt, budding crystals, crystal bridges and a resonance puzzle.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.su: The temple of a forgotten good god, flooded to the knees: prismarine, sea lanterns and tidal gates.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.ho: A great cathedral: nave and pews, stained glass, a bell tower, a crypt and a reliquary.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.ce: The marble terraces, golden gates and colonnades of a heavenly court.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.sk: A cloud giant's castle in the sky: white stone, wind and long drops.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.mo: A monks' retreat of timber and paper: a dojo, a bell and a hall of prayer wheels.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.cu: A library of forbidden knowledge: endless shelves, reading halls, chained tomes and a scriptorium.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.ne: A city of the dead: sandstone catacombs, bone pillars, mausoleums and bone bridges over an abyss.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.va: A grey gothic keep with crimson trim: a dining hall, a desecrated chapel, coffin crypts and mirrors that show nothing.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.ha: A haunted house: a nursery with a rocking horse, a ballroom of dancing ghosts, long corridors and sudden big rooms.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.fu: The Underdark: forests of huge mushrooms, glowing spores, obsidian drow halls and a dark lake.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.in: The Nine Hells as a factory: red nether brick, chains, cages, lava crucibles, anvils and a contract hall.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.dr: A sunken crypt of dark prismarine and mossy stone, barnacles, kelp-grown sarcophagi, tide gates and air pockets.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.sp: A spider queen's warren: black stone and tuff veiled in cobweb, silk bridges, egg sacs and the queen's lair.
message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.rune.exit: Right-click: leave the arena, the boss is restored
message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.sealed: The way out is sealed. A release rune appears in %1$s seconds. You can also type /dungeon unstuck.
message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.sealed_bo: The arena is closed while the boss lives. The exit rune is here: right-click it to leave and reset the fight.
message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.rune_show: A release rune has appeared. Right-click it, or type /dungeon release.
message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.toast.sea: SEALED: A RELEASE RUNE APPEARS IN %1$s S
message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.toast.res: THE SYSTEM TOOK YOU TO SAFETY
message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.open.abse: The seal opens: nobody was left inside.
message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.open.boss: The seal opens: the boss is dead.
message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.open.max_: The seal gives way: it held for too long.
message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.open.unso: The seal opens: the party present could not have beaten it.
message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.open.resc: The seal opens: nothing hostile was left in the room.
message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.open.rune: %1$s used the rune. The way is open.
message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.open.comm: %1$s released the seal. The way is open.

message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.status.se: Sealed in by %1$s for %2$s seconds. Rune in %3$s seconds. It opens by itself within %4$s seconds at the latest.
message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.unstuck.f: You were sealed in, so the System asks nothing for this.

message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.dest.arri: the arrival stairs of this floor
message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.dest.forw: the forward stairs of this floor
message.nusmp.mega.system.lock.refuse.co: Not yet: %1$s seconds left on /dungeon unstuck.
