message.nusmp.mega.rift.hint: [SYSTEM] A rift opened %s blocks to the %s. Walk into the tear, or right-click it, to step through; it closes in a few minutes.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.pocket.nodim: The hidden realm has no ground to stand on: the dungeon's dimension is not loaded.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.shortcut.settled: The tear steadies: it leads %s floors on.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.failed: The tear shudders and lets go of you. (The error is in the server log.)
message.nusmp.mega.system.toast.rift_cle: HIDDEN REALM CLEARED: THE VAULT IS OPEN
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.infoGone: Its pocket (slot %s) does not exist (any more): the next step in builds a new one.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.infoOther: Slot %s belongs to another rift now: the next step in builds a new pocket.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.noneNear16: No open rift within 16 blocks of %s.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.notmega: Stand in the Mega-Dungeon to roll for a rift.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.rollno: No rift opened: %s. (/multiverse mega rift why lists the conditions.)
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.nodim2: The dungeon dimension is not loaded.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.whyGate: Spawner gate at your feet: %s (enabled=%s, on ground=%s, floor=%s, built=%s, safe room=%s, rifts within %s blocks=%s of %s).
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.whyRoll: Next natural roll for you in %s s; per roll: pocket %s, shortcut %s (never on a boss floor); a rift stays %s s.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.whyBoss: This is a boss floor: only pocket rifts open here.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.alreadyOpen: The vault of slot %s is open already.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.cleared: Opened the vault of the pocket in slot %s.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.visited: Stepped into the pocket in slot %s.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.novariant: The config's bossShare (%s) allows no %s pocket.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.lich.p2: The phylactery cracks, and soul fire pours out of the lich's sockets.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.lich.p3: The phylactery breaks. The lich burns with everything it has bound.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.acererak.p2: Acererak's gems blaze, and the skulls of the Devoured begin to circle him faster.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.acererak.p3: The Eternal Lich rises: every gem in his crown is a soul, and all of them scream.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.vecna.p2: The Hand of Vecna ignites and the Eye opens: he sees everyone in the hall.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.vecna.p3: Vecna is whole again. The Hand burns, the Eye is wide open, and the web closes.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.strahd.p2: Strahd tears his cape open: leathery wings, and the bats come down from the rafters.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.strahd.p3: The Devil of Barovia is the swarm. His eyes burn and the floor runs with red mist.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.zariel.p2: Zariel's wings catch fire and the plate begins to glow.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.zariel.p3: The Archduchess of Avernus unfolds a second pair of wings; her halo closes into a ring of fire.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.asmodeus.p2: Asmodeus spreads his wings and the hall fills with the heat of the Nine Hells.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.asmodeus.p3: The wings burn along every vein, the horns grow tall, and a ring of hellfire opens behind the Archdevil.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.orcus.p2: The gut of Orcus splits and soul fire shows in the wound.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.orcus.p3: Ribs break out of the demon prince; a crowd of souls rises with him.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.lich_king.p2: Ice crystals break through the Lich King's armour and the runeblade sings.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.lich_king.p3: The Frozen Throne answers: a ring of runes opens under the Lich King.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.solar.p2: A second pair of wings unfolds behind the Solar and the sunburst turns.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.solar.p3: Six wings, a full halo and a bow drawn to the ear: the Solar judges the hall.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.demogorgon.p: Both of Demogorgon's heads open their eyes and the barbs on his tentacles light up.
The Prince of Demons crowns both heads in horns and the air round him whirls dark purple.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.beholder.p2: The Beholder's eyestalks flare: every ray is awake.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.beholder.p3: Four more stalks tear free and the central eye opens its cone of nothing.
The jar cracks. The Elder Brain swells and the whole hall hums.
The jar bursts. A bare brain, ringed with psionic light, hangs among its own glass.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.kraken.p2: The Kraken's lights blaze and four more arms climb out from under it.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.kraken.p3: Lightning crawls over the Kraken's mantle: the black tide is about to break.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.tiamat.p2: All five mouths of Tiamat fill with their own breath.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.tiamat.p3: Tiamat's wings spread to their full span and the five colours circle her necks.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.bahamut.p2: Bahamut's eyes blaze and a halo of platinum light opens behind him.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.bahamut.p3: The Platinum Dragon spreads his wings: a corona of light fills the hall.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.dracolich.p2: Soul fire swells in the Dracolich's ribs and its skull ignites.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.dracolich.p3: The phylactery rises over its back, and the dead dragon burns white.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.tarrasque.p2: The carapace of the Tarrasque begins to shimmer: spells will come back.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.tarrasque.p3: The mirror-carapace blazes. Nothing that is cast at the Tarrasque stays cast.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.lolth.p2: Four more legs rise behind Lolth like a crown of black blades.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.lolth.p3: A second pair of arms, eight burning eyes and a blazing hourglass: the Spider Queen is whole.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.quasit.p2: The Quasit's wings unfurl and its tail ignites.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.quasit.p3: A ring of fire circles the Quasit as its horns and claws lengthen.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.vrock.p2: Spores rise from the Vrock's wings.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.vrock.p3: Violet fire runs along the Vrock's wings and its eyes swell.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.hezrou.p2: The spines of the Hezrou glow and acid drips from its jaw.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.hezrou.p3: The Hezrou swells: eyes huge, crest raised, the stench so thick the air turns green.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.balor.p2: The cracks in the Balor's skin open and its wings catch fire along the veins.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.balor.p3: The Balor is ablaze from horn to hoof.

nusmp.skill.crash.description: Unique. Gildarts' Crash: whatever you touch is shattered. Crash, Crash Boom, Crash Bomb, the Gravity-free Crush and Magic Crash, which breaks the spells on your foes.
nusmp.skill.fire_dragon_king.description: Ultimate. Evolved from Fire Dragon Slayer Magic by mastery. Every flame spell, far stronger, and the three Dragon Slayer forms: Dragon Force, Lightning Flame Dragon Mode and Fire Dragon King's Mode.
nusmp.skill.fire_dragon_slayer.descripti: Unique. Natsu's Fire Dragon Slayer Magic: roar, fist, claw, wing attack, sword horn, brilliant flame and the Crimson Lotus Exploding Flame Blade. Eat flame to heal and to charge the next spell; fire cannot hurt you. Mastering it awakens the Fire Dragon King.
nusmp.skill.ice_make.description: Unique. Gray's Ice-Make: lance, hammer, shield, floor, cannon and the Saint, and Demon Slayer Ice, the Ice Devil's Rage. Cold cannot hurt you.
nusmp.skill.iron_dragon_slayer.descripti: Unique. Gajeel's Iron Dragon Slayer Magic: club, sword, roar, scales, demon blade, the Shadow Iron Dragon, and eating iron to heal and to charge your spells.
nusmp.skill.lightning_dragon_slayer.desc: Unique. Laxus' Lightning Dragon Slayer Magic: roar, jaw, iron fist, halberd, breakdown fist, Lightning Body, Thunder Palace and the Raging Bolt. Lightning cannot hurt you.
nusmp.skill.mode.ice_make.ice_devil_rage: Demon Slayer Ice: Ice Devil's Rage
nusmp.skill.msg.fairytail.control_cooldo: Binding spells are still recovering (%s s).
nusmp.skill.msg.fairytail.locked: %s is not open yet: master %s more.
nusmp.skill.msg.fairytail.no_flame: There is no flame to eat.
nusmp.skill.msg.fairytail.no_iron: You have no iron to eat.
nusmp.skill.msg.fairytail.recovering: This magic is recovering from a fault.
nusmp.skill.sky_dragon_slayer.descriptio: Unique. Wendy's Sky Dragon Slayer Magic: roar, wing attack, sky drill, Troia, Vernier, the Sky Dragon's Armor and healing enchantments for the party.
nusmp.skill.water_magic.description: Unique. Juvia's Water Magic: Water Slicer, Water Lock, Water Nebula, Water Cane, Water Body, which turns most blows aside, and the Rain Woman.
nusmp.skill.erza_requip.description: Ultimate. Equip Magic: change between fourteen armours, one per mode, each with its own strength, resistances, weapon and two special attacks. Press the skill key in an armour's mode to put it on, again to attack (sneak for the second attack); the last mode takes the armour off.
nusmp.skill.msg.erza.no_target: Telekinesis needs a target in sight.
nusmp.skill.msg.erza.locked: %s is not yet yours: master Requip to %s percent.
nusmp.skill.msg.erza.dry: Your magic power runs dry: the armor fades.
nusmp.requip.weapon.lore: Requipped with its armour; it vanishes when the armour is dismissed.
nusmp.requip.book.lore: Teaches Requip: The Knight (Ultimate skill): fourteen armours, one per mode.
nusmp.requip.book.need: Needs %s max EP, or %s with a mastered Unique skill.
nusmp.skill.line_abyssal_black_flame.des:
A cold, dark fire that burns what ordinary flames cannot. Wrap a fist in black flame, roll it across the ground, or let it bloom into a dragon of ash.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Smoldering Cloak, Unbound Inferno, Black Flame Fist, Creeping Flame, Black Flame Nova, Flame-Wreathed, Abyssal Scorch, Falling Ember, Ash-Feeding Bite, Abyssal Black Flame Dragon, Black Flame Inferno.
While switched on: Flame-Bound Body, Ash-Hardened Skin, Searing Touch, Ember Footing, Flame-Kin, Burning Fury, Feed on the Fire, Scorching Retort, Heat Haze, Ashes of the Slain, Black Flame Brand.
nusmp.skill.line_aether_bow.description:
An archer's line of arrows made of mana: piercing shots, seeker volleys and arrows that mark, pin and rain from above. A ranged line for patient hunters.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Draw and Hold, Skirmisher's Pace, Mana Arrow, Volley, Hunter's Mark, Backstep Shot, Seeker Arrow, Net Arrow, Pinning Volley, Thousand Arrow Rain, Dragonpiercer.
While switched on: Archer's Constitution, Steady Arm, Hawk Eye, Light Stride, Archer's Crit, Calm Draw, Finishing Arrow, Insect Hunter, Quick Roll, Quiver Salvage, Packed Lunch.
nusmp.skill.line_aether_destruction.desc:
Aether in its most unforgiving aspect. Lances, collapses and cleaves that do not stop at armor, for a fighter who ends fights fast and pays in guard.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Destruction Aspect, Restrained Aspect, Aether Lance, Aetheric Collapse, Rend, Shatter Line, Detonate, Hollow Strike, Ruin Aspect, World-Rending Cleave, Aether Annihilation Lance.
While switched on: Aether Vein, Ruinous Edge, Cleaving Reach, Breaker of Titans, Armor Pierce, Finishing Aether, Blast Hardened Body, Ruinous Rhythm, Last Spark, Withering Touch.
nusmp.skill.line_aether_step.description:
Aether used to cross distance: step through a heartbeat, vanish from where the blow lands and appear behind the foe. The line of speed, afterimages and the single decisive strike.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Afterimage Stance, Anchored Step, Aether Step, Afterimage Veil, Step Slash, Blur Combo, Step Behind, Quicken the Aether, Phase Cut, Hundred Steps of the Sovereign, Step Beyond the Horizon.
While switched on: Thin Air, Stepper's Heart, Edge Between, Longstep, Vanishing Dodge, Strike From Nowhere, Weak-Point Eye, Stepping Rhythm, Light Foot, Hidden Step, Fleeting Edge.
nusmp.skill.line_aevum_hourglass.descrip:
A time-bending art of the Aevum: sand that slows the foe, shortens the fight and stretches the moments you need. Slow-and-wait control with a sudden fall of years.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Slowing Sand, Quickened Sand, Frozen Instant, Echo Ward, Skipped Seconds, Shared Tempo, Weight of Hours, Beam of Elapsed Years, Suspended Strike, Moment Eternal, Century Fall.
While switched on: Grain of Life, Sand Step, Slipping Seconds, Slowing Field, Sidestepped Blow, Time Gained, Saved Hours, Borrowed Moment, Quiet Hour, Perfect Moment.
nusmp.skill.line_aggro_manipulation.desc:
Read and bend the hidden threat table of every monster so the whole room hits the armor and nothing else. A tank's discipline: hold attention, soak it, hand it back.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Hate Generator Posture, Threat Handoff Posture, Aggro Spike, Threat Hook, Hate Shockwave, Mitigation Window, Counter-Taunt Smash, Fixate Mark, Pillar of Provocation, Total Aggro Lock, Wipe Prevention Pulse.
While switched on: Raid-Tank Constitution, Plate of Mitigation, Anchor Stance Weight, Toughness Rating Bonus, Spiked Aggro Plate, Mitigation Rotation, Raid Resistance Aura, Cooldown Panic Button, Healer's Overtime, Bash Knockback Rider, Slow the Attacker.
nusmp.skill.line_airiel_wind_maiden.desc:
A sword wrapped in a gale: dashes, crescents and a descent from the sky, all carried by a wind that never leaves the blade. The Sword Princess's way.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Wind-Sheathed, Sword Princess's Guard, Airiel Armor, Tempest Dash, Wind-Edged Cut, Cyclone Dance, Gale Slash, Descending Storm, Wind Lance, Tempest: Sword Princess's Gale, Airiel: Storm Maiden.
While switched on: Gale-Honed Edge, Tailwind, Sword Princess's Poise, Gale-Cushioned Landing, Wind-Footed Draw, Edge of the Gale, Slip the Wind, Wind Cushion, Aerial Strike, Gale Push, Wind Deflection.
nusmp.skill.line_amazon_berserker.descri:
Fight like the warrior-women of the Amazons: huge swings, a rage that feeds on its own wounds and a charge that does not care who is in the way.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Berserk Stance, Amazon Discipline, Amazon Spin, Greatsword Smash, Rage Awakens, Skyward Cleave, Berserker Charge, Blood Frenzy Bite, War Cry Blast, Berserk: Hundred-Blade Rage, Greatsword's Fall.
While switched on: Tribal Might, Warrior's Vigor, Light-Footed Giant, Rage Feeds on Wounds, Blood-Drunk, Brutal Instinct, Triumph of the Tribe, Cleaver's Shove, Fighter's Reprieve, Rising Fury.
nusmp.skill.line_animation_cancel.descri:
Skip the recovery of every move: end a lunge halfway, step out of a swing, chain the next one before the last has landed. Frames are the only currency.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Frame-Skip Stance, Recovery-Cancel Stance, Cancelled Lunge, Input Buffer Blink, Rising Cancel, Spin-Cancel Cyclone, Hop-Cancel Slam, Cancel Chain, Weave Slash, Zero-Frame Combo, Infinite Cancel Barrage.
While switched on: Input Buffer Reflexes, Cancel-Step Legs, Hop-Cancel Spring, Ledge Skip Soles, Sprint Window Bonus, Chain Frame Momentum, I-Frame Roll, Hasted by the Run, Canceled Combo Counter, Soft Landing Cancel, Shove Cancel.
nusmp.skill.line_anti_magic_blade_dancer:
No spells, no grimoire: a sword that eats magic and a body that never stops moving. Cut the incoming spell in half, rush through the gap and keep swinging.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Cut-Magic Stance, Relentless Rush, Spell-Cutting Slash, Void Edge Dash, Spell Cutter, Rising Cut, Finishing Cut, Sword Dance, Fighting Spirit, Slash Beyond Magic, Black Edge Storm.
While switched on: Never-Resting Muscles, Sword Speed, Fighting Heart, Footwork, Rhythm of the Blade, No Rest, Mana-Eating Edge, Duck and Weave, Spot the Opening, Running Start, Stubborn Wounds.
nusmp.skill.line_argonaut_charge.descrip:
The Skill that rewards daring: charge the strike, loose it all at once and hit the thing everyone else ran from.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Charging Stance, Run Toward the Light, Charge Up, Charge Dash, Heroic Finisher, Hero's Leap, Giant-Felling Upper, Release the Charge, Rookie's Dare, Argonaut: Full Charge, Hero's Descent.
While switched on: Hero's Resolve, Courage Under Fire, Charged Edge, Charge Stacks, Three-Beat Rhythm, Courage in Crisis, Heroic Momentum, Finish What You Start, Not Backing Down, Run-Up Bonus.
nusmp.skill.line_asura_ascension.descrip:
The bloodline of the gods of Epheotus. A towering, almost unkillable fighter who stands where a mountain would fall, crushes with pressure and lands like a falling sky.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Asura Body, Asura's Fury, Asura's Descent, Radiant Lance of Epheotus, Crushing Pressure, Asura's Dance of War, Immovable Mountain, Godkiller Blow, Challenge of the Elders, Ten Thousand Leagues, Epheotus Judgement.
While switched on: Divine Frame, Godly Strength, Sovereign Hide, Unmoving, Divine Endurance, Elder's Contempt, Never Fallen, Bloodline Mending, Hungry Gods, Pride Spikes, Thunderous Fist.
nusmp.skill.line_basic_swordsmanship.des:
The first skill every sword-bearer learns, in the same series: a plain, honest blade skill. Strikes, steps, a crescent cut and the habit of answering a blow with a better one.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Power Strike, Swift Step, Crescent Cut.
While switched on: Sword Mastery, Riposte.
nusmp.skill.line_beast_communion.descrip:
A boy who can talk to animals leads a pack. Howl to rally it, charge as one, and let the wild take care of its own.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Pack Leader, Feral Instinct, Pounce of the Wolf, Pack Howl, Quieting Call, Charging Boar, Pack Mending, Rally the Pack, Horn Toss, Great Stampede, Call of the Alpha.
While switched on: Beast Bond, Predator's Gait, Thick Hide, Wild Senses, Pack's Presence, Pounce Momentum, Wild Reflex, Hamstring Bite, Forager's Appetite, Cat's Landing, Wounded Beast.
nusmp.skill.line_beast_monarch.descripti:
Lead the pack as the apex of every wild thing: pounces, rending claws and a howl that lifts the whole party.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Feral Surge, Pack Alpha, Claw Pounce, Pack's Call, Maul and Devour, Rending Maul, Hurling Swipe, Claw Tear, Alpha's Challenge, Primal Frenzy, Beast King's Charge.
While switched on: Alpha's Frame, Rending Claws, Predator's Gait, Sure-Footed, Moon Vitality, Apex Predator, Moonlit Might, Hamstring Strike, Pack Bond, Fresh Kill, Shoulder-Shove.
nusmp.skill.line_beast_will.description:
Instinct from a beast's will, grafted onto a human fighter. The line feels for prey, pounces, rends and grows more dangerous with every kill.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Predator Crouch, Ancient Bulk, Scent the Prey, Pounce, Predator's Bite, Feral Surge, Rending Claws, Killing Instinct, Hunter's Leap, Apex Hunt, Rampage of the Beast.
While switched on: Wild Heart, Raking Claws, Hunter's Stride, Beast's Edge, Blood Taste, Chase Instinct, Moonlit Hunger, Trophy Hunter, Sixth Sense, Apex Predator, Hunting Rhythm.
nusmp.skill.line_beastkin_lord_carrion.d:
A beastman's war form: bounding, clawing, crushing. The body becomes a lion or a wolf for a time, and fights as one does when the hunt is on.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Beast Form, Humanoid Guard, Lion's Pounce, Claw Rush, Rending Claws, Feral Frenzy, Lion's Roar, Beast Form Surge, Fang Rip, Beast Lord's Rampage, Roar of the Lion King.
While switched on: Beast Muscle, Thick Pelt, Wild Legs, Beast Lord's Constitution, Hunter's Dash, Wounded Beast, Shove of the Beast, Monster Hunter, Hunt Rhythm, Pack Instinct, Night Hunter.
nusmp.skill.line_bell_firebolt.descripti:
Chantless fire magic fired as fast as the next breath: streams of bolts, a charged lance and the nerve to keep running straight at the monster.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Rapid-Fire Stance, Burning Sprint, Firebolt Rapid Fire, Charged Firebolt, Arcing Firebolt, Blazing Dash, Firebolt Boost Jump, Scorched Sidestep, Backdraft, Firebolt: Burst Fire, Hero's Spark.
While switched on: Rookie's Magic, Sparks in the Legs, Small but Stubborn, Fire-Eater, Lucky Shot, Hot on the Heels, Singed Trail, Blast Shove, Running Rookie, No Chant Needed.
nusmp.skill.line_beru_ant_king.descripti:
The insect marshal's savage grace: leaping pounces, mandible rushes and regeneration that makes him all but unkillable. Feral, fast and hungry.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Swarm-Lord's Hunt, Chitin Carapace, Mandible Rush, Swarm Claw, Ant King's Feast, Sky-Rending Pounce, Chitin Shriek, Formic Spray, Regrowth Molt, Ant King's Rampage, Plague of Wings.
While switched on: Regenerating Marrow, Mandible Power, Pouncing Legs, Wall-Climber's Grip, Insatiable Maw, Endless Regeneration, Venomous Claws, Bane of Kings, Hunt Rush, Self-Mending Shell, Spiked Exoskeleton, Devour the Fallen.
nusmp.skill.line_beta_tester_insight.des:
He knows the early versions: where the item is hidden, which patch broke the boss. His knowledge reads the world like a sheet of notes, and every note is a target.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Old Patch Stance, Hotfix Stance, Known Weakness Strike, Bug Report, Launch Glitch, Debug Mode, Chained Exploit, Texture Glitch Breath, Teleport Exploit, Developer Smite, Teleport to Spawn.
While switched on: Dev Console Luck, Beta Stamina, Known Exploit Reach, Bug Boots, Know-It-All Crits, Experience Cheat, Drop Table Knowledge, Execute Notes, Glowing Outline, Rolling Experience, Lucky Dodge.
nusmp.skill.line_black_bulls_vanguard.de:
The reckless frontliner of a squad of misfits: draw the whole battlefield onto yourself, laugh at the damage and hit back twice as hard. Strength through spite.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Reckless Charge, Hold the Line, Rowdy Challenge, Bullhorn Charge, Squad Brawl Leap, Barroom Sweep, Raider's Feast, Hideout Cheer, Spite Haymaker, Underdog Overdrive, All Hands Brawl.
While switched on: Bottomless Guts, Heavy Hand, Bull's Neck, Lucky Last Gasp, Bar Fight Appetite, Spiked Pride, Stubborn to the End, Monster Hunter's Grudge, Never Backing Down, Squad Spirit.
nusmp.skill.line_black_heavenly_demon_sw:
A merciless sword style soaked in demonic qi. Every cut is a crescent of black light that drinks a little of whatever it touches.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Demon's Stance, Heavenly Sheath, Black Crescent, Demon-Splitting Wave, Heavenly Rising Cut, Devouring Edge, Descent of the Black Sword, Qi Rot, Three Hundred Slashes, Black Heavenly Demon Slash, Ten Thousand Demon Dance.
While switched on: Black Edge, Demon Core, Sword Callus, Sword Qi Flow, Sword Heart, Demonic Qi, Blood Qi Circulation, Killing Intent, Feast of the Fallen, Qi-Hardened Body, Overwhelming Edge.

While switched on: Tyrant's Wit, Glass Reflexes, Mirror-Bright Will, Mirrored Pain, Facet Strike, Dazzling Reflection, Pristine Glass, Author's Instinct, Reflected Blow, Spell-Turning Glass.
nusmp.skill.line_vampire_queen_night.des:
The queen of the night walks in her own dark: stronger the longer the sun is gone, with a bite that feeds her and a stare that holds her prey in place.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Queen of the Night, Daywalker's Veil, Blood Kiss, Mist Form, Bat Step, Charm Gaze, Blood Recovery, Crimson Lance, Midnight Strength, Crimson Banquet, Night Sovereign's Command.
While switched on: Undying Blood, Vampiric Grace, Fanged Strength, Noble Poise, Vampiric Touch, Blood Moon Power, Moonlit Regeneration, Child of the Night, Drained Spoils, Charmed Sidestep, Undead Bloodline.
nusmp.skill.line_velzard_frost_dragon.de:
The ice dragon's cold, patient fury: frost that settles gently and then stays. Every move leaves the air colder, and the foe a little slower.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Frostbound Dragon, Blizzard Flight, Frost Breath, Ice Lance, Frost Nova, Glacier Wave, Flash Freeze, Ice Armor, Hail Spear, Absolute Zero, Glacier Breath.
While switched on: Dragon Chill, Ice Scale Plating, Cold Strength, Glacial Footing, Frostproof Scales, Chilled Edge, Snow Calm, Freezing Presence, Cold Resolve, Brittle Counter, Dragon Frost Healing.
nusmp.skill.line_vritra_blood_rite.descr:
The bloodline of a ruling Asura clan, unleashed. A predatory line of drains, hooks and burning blood; it does better the more it spills.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Bloodline Awakened, Ascended Scales, Blood Tithe, Crimson Lance, Hooked Chains, Rot Breath, Blood Frenzy, Predator's Fall, Blood Nova, Blood Moon Rising, Vritra's Hunger.
While switched on: Ancient Blood, Predator's Claws, Cold Scales, Sanguine Hunger, Rotting Claws, Blood Feast, Thorned Scales, Cornered Predator, Wounded Fury, Blood Oath.
nusmp.skill.line_wall_clip_glitch.descri:
Slip into the seam between two blocks where the game's rules fail: the enemy cannot see you, you cannot be reached, and the ground itself fights for you.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Clipped-Inside Posture, Out-of-Bounds Dash, Seam Slip, Backfloor Drag, Frozen Collision, Geometry Fracture, Out-of-Sight Rush, Void Cloud, Under-Map Meteor, Total Clip-Through, Underworld Spikes.
While switched on: Collision Thinness, Clipping Reach, Seam-Slip Legs, Void-Touched Hide, Cave Armor, Wall-Cramped Fury, Cave Sight, Clip Dodge, Void Landing, Gravity Seep, Hidden Loot.
nusmp.skill.line_way_of_the_wind.descrip:
A swordsman's road that follows the breeze. Never stand still: dash, spin and fall on the enemy like a gale with a blade.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Breeze Stance, Gale Stance, Wind Step, Cyclone Dance, Crescent of Wind, Vanish on the Breeze, Descending Gale, Rolling Gust, Rising Updraft, Tailwind, Tempest Step, Hundred-Gust Storm.
While switched on: Light Step, Windborne Leap, Fall Like a Leaf, Swift Blade Hand, Wind at Your Back, Gathering Gale, Leaf in the Wind, Feather Fall, Pushing Gust, Cutting Draft, Entangling Breeze, Light as Air.
nusmp.skill.line_werewolf_gale_kick.desc:
A beast-person kicker in magic boots: charging, flipping, ricocheting kicks and a howl that rattles the nerves. Fast, rude and hard to pin down.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Hunter's Prowl, Stubborn Wolf, Gale Kick Rush, Crescent Kick, Ricochet Kick, Wolf Pounce Step, Wolf's Stomp, Howl of Contempt, Flurry of Kicks, Flosvirt: Raging Tempest, Fang-Strike Charge.
While switched on: Boot-Driven Power, Wolf's Legs, Spring in the Step, Thick Fur, Kick Rhythm, Charging Wolf, Boot Heel Crit, Taste of Blood, Moon-Chaser, Monster Hunter's Pride, Wolf's Reflexes.
nusmp.skill.line_white_flame_sovereign.d:
A fire that burns hotter than red and cleans what it touches: needles of white flame, purging warmth for friends and a core that does not scorch you.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Pale Blaze, Ember Veil, Flame Needle Rain, Cinder Rush, Pillar Dance, White Nova, Purging Warmth, Arc Flame, Searing Lance, White Sun Descends, Pyres of the Sovereign.
While switched on: Core of White Fire, Incandescent Edge, Ashen Footfall, Radiant Mantle, Burning Heart, Born of the Flame, Fireproof Spirit, Cleansing Ash, Revealing Light, Hearth of the Flame, Lantern-Bearer's Luck.
nusmp.skill.line_wizard_king_sovereign.d:
The one who leads the whole kingdom's knights: rally the line, hold the field with composure and drop a royal decree when the moment is ripe. Power as a duty.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Sovereign Poise, Banner of Command, Rally the Knights, Royal Decree Strike, Edict of Light, Aegis of the Crown, Healing Proclamation, Command Presence, Stand Down, Sovereign's Judgment, Banner of the Realm.
While switched on: Royal Reserve, Commanding Edge, Armor of State, Unmoved, Aura of the Banner, Unshaken Composure, Last Duty, A King's Education, Duty to the Realm, Dignified Recovery, Ward of Legends.
nusmp.skill.line_wynn_fimbulvetr.descrip:
Elven chant magic of ice: the long winter arrives on cue. Freezing breath, a pull toward the cold and slow, crushing control of the room.
Arts (press the skill key, scroll to change): Winter Chant, Frost Mantle, Winter's Breath, Fimbulvetr's Hush, Whiteout Drag, Glacier Lane, Frost Aegis, Spreading Rime, Snowburst, Fimbulvetr: Long Winter, Wall of White Silence.
While switched on: Winter Spirit, Ice-Edged Bearing, Rooted in the Frost, Hush of Snow, Winter-Born, Chill Aura, Snowfall Mantle, Frostbite, Hoarfrost Thorns, Thaw Recovery, Foe of Flame.

nusmp.skill.legacy.description: A magic that was removed from this world. It does nothing and is forgotten when you next log in.
item.nusmp.spirit_king_sceptre: Sceptre of the Celestial Spirit King
message.nusmp.celestial.already_bound: You already hold a contract with %s.
message.nusmp.celestial.closing: The Spirit World is closing: %s s.

message.nusmp.celestial.enter: The Gate closes behind you. The Celestial Spirit King waits in the middle of the stars.
message.nusmp.celestial.found: A key answers your hand: %s. (%s of 12 gold keys)
message.nusmp.celestial.full: Every cell of the Spirit World is in use. Wait a little.
message.nusmp.celestial.gate: The Celestial Gate opens. The twelve keys sing. Choose:
message.nusmp.celestial.gate.bound: Every one of the twelve keys needs a sealed contract.

message.nusmp.celestial.gate.keys: The Gate needs all twelve Gold Zodiac keys on you (%s of 12).
message.nusmp.celestial.gate.nokey: You need the key of the Gate.
message.nusmp.celestial.gate.open: The Gate is already open: choose.
message.nusmp.celestial.king.death: "You kept faith with every one of them. Go, keeper of the stars."
message.nusmp.celestial.king.judgement: The King raises his sceptre: stand in the golden circle!

message.nusmp.celestial.learned: The stars answer: Celestial Spirit Magic is yours.
message.nusmp.celestial.no_magicules: Not enough magicules for the contract.
message.nusmp.celestial.not_yours: This key keeps a contract with someone else.

message.nusmp.celestial.released: The contract with %s is broken. The key is free.
message.nusmp.celestial.reward.again: The King nods. He has already given you all he has.
message.nusmp.celestial.reward.helper: The King thanks you and mends you. His gifts are for the keeper of all twelve keys.
message.nusmp.celestial.reward.mode: New modes: the Spirit King's Blessing and the Summon of the Spirit King.
message.nusmp.celestial.reward.mode2: New mode: the Spirit King's Blessing.
nusmp.skill.celestial_spirit_magic.descr: Unique. Call the spirits of the stars with their golden and silver keys, wear their power as Star Dress forms, and open the Celestial Gate when all twelve Gold Zodiac keys are yours.
nusmp.skill.msg.celestial.dress_closed: The %s is not open to you yet.
nusmp.skill.msg.celestial.king_closed: The Spirit King has not given you this.
nusmp.skill.msg.celestial.no_key: You do not carry the %s key.
nusmp.skill.msg.celestial.not_bound: No contract with %s yet: hold the key's use button to seal one.
nusmp.skill.msg.celestial.not_yours: That key keeps a contract with someone else.
nusmp.skill.msg.celestial.too_many: Your mastery lets you keep fewer spirits at once.
tooltip.nusmp.celestial.book: Teaches the Unique skill Celestial Spirit Magic.
tooltip.nusmp.celestial.book2: Call the spirits of the zodiac with their keys; Star Dress forms open with mastery.
tooltip.nusmp.celestial.gate_key: The key of the Celestial Gate.
tooltip.nusmp.celestial.gate_key2: Carry all twelve Gold Zodiac keys, each with its contract, and use it to open the Gate.
tooltip.nusmp.celestial.sceptre: Starlight Mend: heals you and your allies within 8 blocks (30 s cooldown).
tooltip.nusmp.celestial.sceptre2: Left to the one who bested the Celestial Spirit King.
tooltip.nusmp.celestial.slot: Carry it, or wear it in the Celestial Key slot, to call the spirit with Celestial Spirit Magic.
tooltip.nusmp.celestial.unbound: No contract. Hold use to seal one (sneak + use breaks it).
enchantment.nusmp.legacy_of_the_wizard_k: Each Black Clover magic among Elsdocia's owners becomes one ability of the sword, kept for good.
item.nusmp.vorpal_sword.desc: A long blade so keen that it is hardly there. Whatever it meets near its end, it finishes. 60% more damage against a foe under 30% of its health. Use: Snicker-Snack and Severing Arc.
item.nusmp.vorpal_sword.card:
Legend Grade longsword (152.5 damage, 1.7 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 60% more damage against a foe under 30% of its health.
While held: +0.2 attack speed, +2 luck.
Snicker-Snack (use; cooldown 30 s, 3% magicules): One great blow at the foe in your sights within 5 blocks; below 30% of its health it takes 2.4 times as much (a boss only 1.5 times). A foe that falls is a clean cut.
Severing Arc (sneak + use; cooldown 12 s, 2% magicules): A wide arc of air in front: every foe in a 150 degree cone within 6.5 blocks takes a cut.
Tensura engravings: severance, barrier piercing, swift.
item.nusmp.holy_avenger.desc: A paladin's sword with winged guards. Fiends and the undead fear its light; friends stand taller beside it. 60% more damage against the undead, demons and other fiends. Use: Smite and Sacred Oath.
item.nusmp.holy_avenger.card:
Legend Grade longsword (152.5 damage, 1.5 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 60% more damage against the undead, demons and other fiends.
While held: +4 armour, 25% less magic damage, the lent skill holy attack resistance.
Smite (use; cooldown 18 s, 3% magicules): A lance of holy light along your sight (9 blocks, through every foe on it) that also makes them glow.
Sacred Oath (sneak + use; cooldown 90 s, 5% magicules): Allies within 10 blocks gain Resistance and Regeneration for 20 seconds; you mend a little.
Tensura engravings: holy weapon, magic interference, magic protection.
item.nusmp.luck_blade.desc: A green-steel shortsword with a four-leaf guard. One blow in seven is blessed, and the blade never seems to miss on the days it matters. 50% more damage on every blow (a 15% chance on each blow). Use: Fortune's Strike and Lucky Break.
item.nusmp.luck_blade.card:
Legend Grade short sword (143.5 damage, 1.9 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 50% more damage on every blow (a 15% chance on each blow).
While held: +4 luck.
Fortune's Strike (use; cooldown 14 s, 2% magicules): A quick sweep: foes in front within 4.5 blocks take a cut and a weakening.
Lucky Break (sneak + use; cooldown 2 min, 4% magicules): For 30 seconds you are Lucky (luck 4) and quick; you mend a little.
Tensura engravings: swift, vigor, sturdy.
item.nusmp.frostbrand.desc: A curved blade of blue ice-steel that smokes in warm air. It chills what it cuts, and burns the creatures of fire worst of all. 15% more damage on every blow; slowness for 4 seconds on the foe. Use: Rime Cleave and Winter's Grip.
item.nusmp.frostbrand.card:
Legend Grade sabre (146 damage, 1.7 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 15% more damage on every blow; slowness for 4 seconds on the foe.
While held: 85% less freezing damage, the lent skill cold resistance.
Rime Cleave (use; cooldown 14 s, 3% magicules): A frozen arc: foes in front within 6 blocks take cold damage and are slowed for 5 seconds.
Winter's Grip (sneak + use; cooldown 70 s, 5% magicules): Drags foes within 9 blocks to you in a freezing gale, damages and binds them with deep slowness.
Tensura engravings: elemental boost, enervation, sturdy.
item.nusmp.dragon_slayer.desc: A slab of dark steel, red at the tang, notched by the teeth of things much larger than a man. Dragons, serpents and wyrms take twice the blow. 100% more damage against dragons, wyrms, serpents and hydras. Use: Wyrm Cleave and Dragon's Bane.
item.nusmp.dragon_slayer.card:
Legend Grade greatsword (175 damage, 1 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 100% more damage against dragons, wyrms, serpents and hydras.
While held: +0.3 knockback resistance, 50% less dragon breath damage, 30% less fire damage.
Wyrm Cleave (use; cooldown 22 s, 3% magicules): A mighty sweep: every foe in a 160 degree cone within 7.5 blocks takes the blow and is weakened.
Dragon's Bane (sneak + use; cooldown 75 s, 5% magicules): The blade slams down: a shock wave throws every foe within 7 blocks back and slows it.
Tensura engravings: severance, crushing, sturdy.
item.nusmp.sunsword.desc: A plain hilt that wakes a blade of sunlight when it is gripped. By day it burns brighter; by night it is a lantern in your hand. 40% more damage in open daylight. Use: Sunbeam and Dawn Burst.
item.nusmp.sunsword.card:
Legend Grade longsword (152.5 damage, 1.6 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 40% more damage in open daylight.
While held: the lent skill light attack resistance.
Sunbeam (use; cooldown 25 s, 3% magicules): A beam of sunlight (15 blocks, through every foe on it); those it strikes glow.
Dawn Burst (sneak + use; cooldown 80 s, 5% magicules): A flare of dawn light round you: every foe within 8 blocks takes holy damage and is pushed back.
Tensura engravings: holy weapon, elemental boost, magic weapon.
item.nusmp.crimson_lions_flame_lance.des: The lance of a captain of the Crimson Lion Kings: a red shaft, a lion's mane at the socket and a head that is always a little on fire. 15% more damage on every blow; sets the foe alight for 5 seconds. Use: Lion Thrust and Salamander Rise.
item.nusmp.crimson_lions_flame_lance.car:
Legend Grade spear (155 damage, 1.3 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 15% more damage on every blow; sets the foe alight for 5 seconds.
While held: +1 reach, 60% less fire damage, the lent skill flame attack resistance.
Lion Thrust (use; cooldown 20 s, 3% magicules): Dash 9 blocks through your foes in a thrust of flame; each takes fire damage.
Salamander Rise (sneak + use; cooldown 75 s, 5% magicules): A pillar of flame round you: foes within 7 blocks take fire damage, are shoved back and burn for 6 seconds.
Tensura engravings: elemental boost, severance, sturdy.
item.nusmp.silver_eagles_galewing_bow.de: A bow of silver feathers and green wind-glass for the Silver Eagles. What flies is shot down at a stroke. 60% more damage against a foe in the air. Use: Gale Volley and Eagle Dive.
item.nusmp.silver_eagles_galewing_bow.ca:
Legend Grade bow (152.5 damage, 1.3 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 60% more damage against a foe in the air.
While held: +5% movement speed, +6 safe fall distance, the lent skill wind attack resistance.
Gale Volley (sneak + use; cooldown 30 s, 3% magicules): Five gale arrows at the nearest foes in front, within 28 blocks.
Eagle Dive (the worn-relic key; cooldown 60 s, 4% magicules): Dive 12 blocks along your sight and burst where you land.
Tensura engravings: swift, barrier piercing, elemental boost.
item.nusmp.starlight_whip.desc: A whip of woven light that unspools from a golden key-handle. It is longer than it looks and hits harder by night. 40% more damage at night. Use: Star Lash and Constellation Bind.
item.nusmp.starlight_whip.card:
Legend Grade whip (139 damage, 1.5 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 40% more damage at night.
While held: +2 reach, the lent skill farsight.
Star Lash (use; cooldown 15 s, 2% magicules): A lash along your sight (11 blocks, through every foe on it), slowing them.
Constellation Bind (sneak + use; cooldown 75 s, 4% magicules): Threads of starlight drag foes within 10 blocks in and bind them.
Tensura engravings: swift, magic weapon, enervation.
item.nusmp.fairy_heart_gauntlets.desc: Heavy gauntlets in the red and gold of a guild that fights for its friends. Every blow carries a little of the heart that throws it. 10% more damage on every blow; 5% of the damage comes back to you as life. Use: Fairy Smash and Friends' Rally.
item.nusmp.fairy_heart_gauntlets.card:
Legend Grade pair of gauntlets (155 damage, 1.8 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 10% more damage on every blow; 5% of the damage comes back to you as life.
While held: +4 armour, +6 maximum health.
Fairy Smash (use; cooldown 18 s, 3% magicules): A ground-shaking punch: foes within 4.5 blocks take the blow, are thrown back and weakened.
Friends' Rally (sneak + use; cooldown 2 min, 5% magicules): Allies within 10 blocks gain Strength and Resistance for 20 seconds; you mend a little.
Tensura engravings: crushing, vitality, sturdy.
item.nusmp.tidebreaker_chakram.desc: A ring of blue steel with a wave-crest edge, the throwing weapon of those who hunt in the Waves. It strikes wet foes harder. 50% more damage against a foe in water or rain. Use: Spinning Cut and Tidal Return.
item.nusmp.tidebreaker_chakram.card:
Legend Grade chakram (148 damage, 1.8 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 50% more damage against a foe in water or rain.
While held: +30% swim speed, the lent skill water breathing.
Spinning Cut (use; cooldown 20 s, 3% magicules): The chakram flies from foe to foe, four of them, a little weaker at each.
Tidal Return (sneak + use; cooldown 70 s, 4% magicules): A wave breaks round you: foes within 8 blocks take water damage and are shoved back.
Tensura engravings: severance, elemental boost, swift.
item.nusmp.noon_cleaver.desc: A broad golden axe that is pride made steel. The wielder who has not been touched is a sun that cannot be looked at. 50% more damage while you are at full health. Use: Zenith Cleave and Sunrise Wall.
item.nusmp.noon_cleaver.card:
Legend Grade great axe (170.5 damage, 0.9 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 50% more damage while you are at full health.
While held: +8 maximum health, 40% less fire damage.
Zenith Cleave (use; cooldown 27 s, 4% magicules): A huge sweep: every foe in a 170 degree cone within 7.5 blocks takes the blow.
Sunrise Wall (sneak + use; cooldown 90 s, 5% magicules): A wall of morning light: a shield that absorbs damage for 10 seconds, Strength, and a shove that clears foes within 5 blocks.
Tensura engravings: crushing, severance, vigor.
item.nusmp.calamity_scythe.desc: The scythe of a demon lord's reaper: a violet crescent on a black pole. It gathers what is left in the wounded. 40% more damage against a foe under 30% of its health; 5% of the damage comes back to you as life. Use: Soul Reap and Lord's Decree.
item.nusmp.calamity_scythe.card:
Legend Grade scythe (170.5 damage, 1.1 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 40% more damage against a foe under 30% of its health; 5% of the damage comes back to you as life.
While held: 30% less curse damage, the lent skill darkness attack resistance.
Soul Reap (use; cooldown 30 s, 4% magicules): A reaping circle: every foe within 8 blocks takes damage and part of it comes back to you as life.
Lord's Decree (sneak + use; cooldown 2 min, 6% magicules): Brands every foe within 14 blocks: they glow for 8 seconds, are weakened and take a blow.
Tensura engravings: soul eater, ruination, enervation.
item.nusmp.staff_of_the_magi.desc: The master staff of a great mage: a twisted violet shaft bound in gold, topped with a floating crystal. Magic bends to it and, struck at it, turns back. 20% more damage on every blow. Use: Retributive Strike, Spell Turning and Arcane Tempest.
item.nusmp.staff_of_the_magi.card:
God Grade staff (212.5 damage, 1.4 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 20% more damage on every blow.
While held: +25% maximum magicules, +2 luck, 50% less magic damage, the lent skill magic resistance.
Retributive Strike (use; cooldown 40 s, 6% magicules): The staff's power breaks outward: every foe within 10 blocks takes magic damage and is weakened.
Spell Turning (sneak + use; cooldown 100 s, 8% magicules): A glimmering ward: a shield that absorbs damage for 12 seconds, Resistance III and a shove that clears foes within 6 blocks.
Arcane Tempest (the worn-relic key; cooldown 4 min, 12% magicules, 3 a day): Bolts of raw magic fall on up to eight foes within 16 blocks.
Tensura engravings: magic interference, magicule absorption, magic capacity, magic weapon.
item.nusmp.hammer_of_thunderbolts.desc: A giant's hammer of blue-grey metal, gold-bound, that rings like a storm. In the wielder's hands it hits wet things as lightning does. 60% more damage against a foe in water or rain (a 50% chance on each blow); weakness for 6 seconds on the foe against a foe in water or rain. Use: Thunderclap, Hurled Bolt and Tempest.
item.nusmp.hammer_of_thunderbolts.card:
God Grade hammer (227.5 damage, 0.9 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 60% more damage against a foe in water or rain (a 50% chance on each blow); weakness for 6 seconds on the foe against a foe in water or rain.
While held: +0.4 knockback resistance, 70% less lightning damage, the lent skill electricity resistance.
Thunderclap (use; cooldown 40 s, 6% magicules): The hammer rings: every foe within 8 blocks takes lightning damage and is thrown back.
Hurled Bolt (sneak + use; cooldown 70 s, 8% magicules): A bolt along your sight (20 blocks, through every foe on it).
Tempest (the worn-relic key; cooldown 4 min, 12% magicules, 3 a day): Lightning leaps through up to eight foes, each hit a little weaker.
Tensura engravings: crushing, elemental boost, sturdy, barrier piercing.
item.nusmp.kusanagi_the_grass_cutter.des: The sword found in the tail of the eight-headed serpent. It parts grass, wind and wyrm alike, and the wind comes when it is drawn. 70% more damage against dragons, wyrms, serpents and hydras. Use: Wind Cut, Cloud Step and Eightfold Cut.
item.nusmp.kusanagi_the_grass_cutter.car:
God Grade katana (212.5 damage, 1.8 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 70% more damage against dragons, wyrms, serpents and hydras.
While held: +8% movement speed, 30% less curse damage, the lent skill wind attack resistance.
Wind Cut (use; cooldown 20 s, 5% magicules): A wind-blade in front: every foe in a 100 degree cone within 10 blocks takes a cut.
Cloud Step (sneak + use; cooldown 55 s, 7% magicules): Step 14 blocks along your sight on a gust and cut everything where you land.
Eightfold Cut (the worn-relic key; cooldown 4 min, 10% magicules, 3 a day): Eight cuts in one breath, from foe to foe.
Tensura engravings: severance, swift, barrier piercing, elemental boost.
item.nusmp.gungnir_the_unerring.desc: The spear that never misses its mark and is never turned from it. Its oaths are not broken, and neither are the foes it names. 20% more damage on every blow; glowing for 10 seconds on the foe. Use: Unerring Cast, Allfather's Pledge and Valhalla Rain.
item.nusmp.gungnir_the_unerring.card:
God Grade spear (217.5 damage, 1.3 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 20% more damage on every blow; glowing for 10 seconds on the foe.
While held: +1.5 reach, +3 luck, the lent skill eye of truth.
Unerring Cast (use; cooldown 35 s, 7% magicules): The spear flies down your sight (32 blocks, through every foe on it) and marks them.
Allfather's Pledge (sneak + use; cooldown 2 min, 8% magicules): Allies within 14 blocks gain Strength II and Speed II for 24 seconds.

item.nusmp.wand_of_the_wisdom_king.desc: A crystal wand that thinks faster than its wielder and says so. It reads the foe, answers the spell and finishes the sum. 40% more damage against a boss. Use: Sagely Barrage, Absolute Defence and Accelerated Thought.

item.nusmp.dragon_force_twin_fangs.desc: Two curved fangs of a dragon, bound in red cord. They bite hardest from the shadows, and when the Force wakes they roar. 80% more damage while you sneak. Use: Twin Fang Flurry, Dragon Force and Dragon's Roar.

item.nusmp.calamity_wave_aegis.desc: A shield of the sea-blue steel the Waves are said to break on. It takes the blow, keeps it and sends it back as a wave. 10% more damage on every blow; slowness for 3 seconds on the foe. Use: Wave Guard, Retaliating Surge and Aegis Anthem.
