God Grade greatsword (240 damage, 1 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 15% more damage on every blow; slowness for 4 seconds on the foe.
While held: +4 armour, 90% less freezing damage, the lent skill cold resistance.
Glacier Cleave (use; cooldown 24 s, 4% magicules): A frozen sweep: every foe in a 170 degree cone within 8 blocks takes cold damage and is slowed hard.
Heart of Winter (sneak + use; cooldown 80 s, 6% magicules): The cold bursts out of the blade: every foe within 9 blocks takes cold damage, is shoved back and nearly stopped.
Tensura engravings: elemental boost, severance, magicule absorption.
item.nusmp.rimeheart_greatblade.desc: Frozen from the heart of the Archon, a slab of living ice that the cold has not finished shaping. Everything it cuts remembers winter. 15% more damage on every blow; slowness for 4 seconds on the foe. Use: Glacier Cleave and Heart of Winter.
item.nusmp.sanguine_wardens_cleaver.card:
God Grade cleaver (210 damage, 1.1 attacks a second). Needs attunement.

While held: +8 maximum health, the lent skill self regeneration.
Butcher's Chop (use; cooldown 26 s, 4% magicules): One great blow at the foe in your sights within 5 blocks; below 35% of its health it takes 2.2 times as much (a boss only 1.5 times).

Tensura engravings: severance, energy steal, enervation.
item.nusmp.sanguine_wardens_cleaver.desc: A butcher's cleaver the size of a door, notched with the count of a cult's offerings. Whatever it wounds bleeds into its wielder. 60% more damage against a foe under 30% of its health; 7% of the damage comes back to you as life. Use: Butcher's Chop and Blood Rite.
item.nusmp.silent_winter_mantle.card: God Grade. A mantle of woven hoarfrost from the Archon's cathedral. It is never cold to the one who wears it, and it makes every sound in a room go quiet.

Tensura engravings: swift, barrier piercing, vitality.
item.nusmp.thornmothers_briar_bow.desc: Grown, not made: a bow of living briar that Yselde wore for a spine. Its arrows leave thorns in what they hit, and the thorns do not stop. 20% more damage on every blow; poison for 3 seconds on the foe. Use: Briar Volley and Thorn Snare.
item.nusmp.valkarins_stormlance.card:
God Grade spear (217.5 damage, 1.2 attacks a second). Needs attunement.

item.nusmp.valkarins_stormlance.desc: A sky-rider's lance with a conical head wound in lightning coils and swept fins. What flies, it brings down; what stands, it charges through. 60% more damage against a foe in the air. Use: Stormcharge and Thunderhead.

pocket.nusmp.clockwork_vault.boss.death: The Chronarch winds down, and for one breath every clock in the Vault shows the same, true hour.
pocket.nusmp.clockwork_vault.boss.intro: Every clock in the Vault strikes the same second. The Chronarch unwinds from the centre of the hall.
pocket.nusmp.clockwork_vault.lore: Artificers who tried to build a vault that no thief could outwait. They succeeded: the Vault still ticks, and it will wait for you, and wait, and wait.
pocket.nusmp.clockwork_vault.name: Clockwork Vault of Hours
pocket.nusmp.crimson_abattoir.boss.death: Vorgrim laughs once, wetly, and the arena is quiet.
pocket.nusmp.crimson_abattoir.boss.intro: The red rivers slow on the ceiling. Vorgrim steps out of the shadow behind the dais, already smiling.
pocket.nusmp.crimson_abattoir.lore: A cult's arena where every wound was an offering. The rivers on its ceilings are not water, and the floors remember every one who bled on them.
pocket.nusmp.crimson_abattoir.name: Crimson Abattoir
pocket.nusmp.drowned_observatory.boss.de: The tide pulls back from the Leviathan and does not return.
pocket.nusmp.drowned_observatory.boss.in: Every river on the ceiling turns once, as if the sea were looking down. The Leviathan unfolds out of the dark water.
pocket.nusmp.drowned_observatory.lore: Astronomers read the stars through the sea until the sea rose to read them back. Rivers run along the ceilings of its halls, as if the tide had forgotten which way is down.
pocket.nusmp.drowned_observatory.name: Drowned Observatory
pocket.nusmp.ember_sanctum.boss.death: The furnace-light goes out of the Smith-King's eyes.
pocket.nusmp.ember_sanctum.boss.intro: The anvils fall silent. Something vast stands up from the forge.
pocket.nusmp.ember_sanctum.lore: A smith-kingdom that fed its furnaces with its own sun-stone, buried with its king still at the anvil. The air tastes of cold iron and old coals.
pocket.nusmp.ember_sanctum.name: Sanctum of the Ashen Forge
pocket.nusmp.frozen_cathedral.boss.death: The Archon's heart, a lump of blue ice, cracks and runs like water.
pocket.nusmp.frozen_cathedral.boss.intro: The frozen bells ring once. The Archon rises from the choir stalls with a sound like ice splitting.
pocket.nusmp.frozen_cathedral.lore: A choir sang the winter in and never sang it out. The nave is still full of kneeling frost, and the bells hang, frozen mid-note, over a vault no thaw has touched.
pocket.nusmp.frozen_cathedral.name: Cathedral of the Silent Winter
pocket.nusmp.gilded_crypt.boss.death: Anhetep's mouth opens one last time, and the sun he swallowed comes out of it, and goes.
pocket.nusmp.gilded_crypt.boss.intro: The gold in the walls dims, all at once. Something very old unwraps itself on the dais.
pocket.nusmp.gilded_crypt.lore: A desert dynasty swallowed the sun to keep its dead from rotting, and was in turn swallowed by the dunes. The gold is all still here. So is the patience of whatever swallowed the sun.
pocket.nusmp.gilded_crypt.name: Gilded Crypt of the Sun-Eater
pocket.nusmp.mirrored_halls.boss.death: The mirrors go dark one by one. The last one shows only you.
pocket.nusmp.mirrored_halls.boss.intro: A hundred mirrors show a hundred kings. One of them is not a reflection, and he is looking at you.
pocket.nusmp.mirrored_halls.lore: A court that ruled by showing every visitor a better version of themselves, until no one could tell the visitors from the reflections. The King is whichever one is not you.
pocket.nusmp.mirrored_halls.name: Halls of the Reflected King
pocket.nusmp.radiant_basilica.boss.death: Auriel bows her head, and the light she wore settles on the floor like snow.
pocket.nusmp.radiant_basilica.boss.intro: Every lamp in the Basilica burns white at once. Auriel looks at you with eyes that have never closed, and does not yet decide.
pocket.nusmp.radiant_basilica.lore: A basilica that kept its lamps lit for a thousand years after its congregation was gone. Its seraph never fell, and has been waiting ever since for someone to be worthy of the vault.
pocket.nusmp.radiant_basilica.name: Radiant Basilica of the Unfallen
pocket.nusmp.starfall_archive.boss.death: The eyes of the Archivist close, one after another, and the last page is written.
pocket.nusmp.starfall_archive.boss.intro: Every book in the Archive turns its pages at once. Oriel opens, one eye after another, to read you.
pocket.nusmp.starfall_archive.lore: A library built where a star fell, by scribes who copied the star's light onto paper until the paper burned. Gravity is a suggestion here; the books float, and so do you.
pocket.nusmp.starfall_archive.name: Starfall Archive
pocket.nusmp.stormspire_aerie.boss.death: The storm leaves Valkarin all at once, and the spire is very quiet.
pocket.nusmp.stormspire_aerie.boss.intro: Lightning walks along the spire. Valkarin lowers himself from the roof of the world.
pocket.nusmp.stormspire_aerie.lore: The sky riders built their roost on a spire of stone that no longer remembers the ground. Their halls have forgotten weight; their guardians have not forgotten their lances.
pocket.nusmp.stormspire_aerie.name: Stormspire Aerie
pocket.nusmp.umbral_catacombs.boss.death: The pact tears itself in two, and Nekrathul is the thing between the halves.
pocket.nusmp.umbral_catacombs.boss.intro: The floor and the ceiling trade places in your mind. A voice that has not spoken in a thousand years says: another contract.
pocket.nusmp.umbral_catacombs.lore: A house that bargained with a devil and kept the bargain too well. Its catacombs run upside down in places, because the devil asked for a floor and was given a ceiling.
pocket.nusmp.umbral_catacombs.name: Umbral Catacombs of the Pact
pocket.nusmp.venom_hive.boss: Vess, Queen of the Hollow Hive
pocket.nusmp.venom_hive.boss.death: The hum goes out of the hive, a note at a time, until there is only silence.
pocket.nusmp.venom_hive.boss.intro: The hive stops humming. Something very large shifts in the wax, and many small things turn to face you.
pocket.nusmp.venom_hive.lore: An empire of insects that outlived its builders and its own queen's patience. The hive's rivers are sweet and wrong, its floors are wax, and it is always, always listening.
pocket.nusmp.venom_hive.name: Venom Hive of the Hollow Queen
pocket.nusmp.verdant_reliquary.boss.deat: The Thornmother's leaves fall, one by one, and do not grow back.
pocket.nusmp.verdant_reliquary.boss.intr: The roots of the reliquary draw tight. A voice like creaking timber says: you may take nothing.
pocket.nusmp.verdant_reliquary.lore: The elves who raised this house of relics let the forest grow over them rather than leave. Roots have become its corridors, and the garden still guards what the gardeners buried.
pocket.nusmp.verdant_reliquary.name: Verdant Reliquary

nusmp.white_square_fix.body: Every glow, halo card, flare and light shaft of the spell circles, relics and upgraded weapons now blends by its own transparency, so no white box is drawn behind them. If you still see one, set vfx.safeBlend = true in config/nusmp-vfx-client.toml.

enchantment.nusmp.fr_grimoire_surge.desc: A grimoire answers a clear call. A spell cast returns 1.2% of your maximum magicule (once every 5 s). +5% damage on what your spell hits within 3 s of the cast. Works while the item is in either hand. Effects are capped; stronger items carry a higher level (+25% per level).

Works while the item is in your main hand. Effects are capped; stronger items carry a higher level (+25% per level).
enchantment.nusmp.fr_wizard_kings_reserv: A deep well of mana that fills itself. Returns 0.4% of your maximum magicule every 5 seconds. Works while the item is held, worn as armour or worn as a Curio. Effects are capped; stronger items carry a higher level (+25% per level).

enchantment.nusmp.fr_predator_harvest.de: What is defeated feeds the one who defeated it. A kill heals 1.5 (once every 3 s). Works while the item is in your main hand. Effects are capped; stronger items carry a higher level (+25% per level).
enchantment.nusmp.fr_magoi_overflow.desc: Magoi returns to the one who spent it well. A spell cast returns 1% of your maximum magicule (once every 6 s). Works while the item is in either hand. Effects are capped; stronger items carry a higher level (+25% per level).
enchantment.nusmp.fr_rukh_wings.desc: The Rukh carry you out of the way. 5% chance to take no damage from a hit (once every 20 s). Works while the item is held, worn as armour or worn as a Curio. Effects are capped; stronger items carry a higher level (+25% per level).

enchantment.nusmp.fr_guild_bond.desc: Comrades fight better beside each other. Other players within 8 blocks gain a faint regeneration (4 s, refreshed every 2 s). Works while the item is held, worn as armour or worn as a Curio. Effects are capped; stronger items carry a higher level (+25% per level).

item.nusmp.ea_sword_of_rupture.card:
Genesis Grade longsword (305 damage, 1.5 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 60% more damage against a foe with 100 health or more.
While held: +4 attack damage, +12 maximum health, 30% less magic damage, the lent skill spatial attack resistance.
Rupture Slash (use; cooldown 22 s; 8% magicules): A wide cut of rupture: every foe in a 160 degree cone within 9 blocks takes 90% of Ea's damage and Weakness II for 8 seconds.
Space-Cut Wind (sneak + use; cooldown 60 s; 12% magicules): The sundered space: a line 36 blocks long, every foe on it takes 130% of Ea's damage and Slowness IV for 8 seconds.
Enuma Elish (use; cooldown 5 min; 14% magicules; 2 a day): The rupture of heaven and earth: every foe within 16 blocks takes 140% of Ea's damage and Weakness III for 10 seconds and is thrown back.
Tensura engravings: severance, barrier piercing, transcendence, ruination, magic interference.
item.nusmp.ea_sword_of_rupture.desc: The sword of rupture, three cylinders of black and gold that turn against each other: it was forged before the earth and heaven were parted, and it is the one that parted them. 60% more damage against a foe with 100 health or more. Use: Rupture Slash, Space-Cut Wind and Enuma Elish.
Genesis Grade relic, worn in the Charm slot. Needs attunement.
While worn: +5 luck, +8 maximum health, +20% maximum magicules, the lent skill analytical appraisal.
Spell Card: Leave (use; cooldown 30 s; 4% magicules): You step 32 blocks along your sight.
Spell Card: Reflection (use; cooldown 2 min; 10% magicules): A shield (about 100 health), Resistance II for 6 seconds, and every foe within 8 blocks is pushed away.
Spell Card: Magnetic Force (sneak + use; cooldown 2.5 min; 10% magicules): Every foe within 18 blocks is pulled to you and takes a 100 magic blow and Slowness IV for 8 seconds.

The binder of the game that was built to be won: a green book with forty slots for cards, and a pocket of spells that cannot be bought. Use: Spell Card Leave, Spell Card Reflection and Spell Card Magnetic Force.
item.nusmp.hogyoku_of_the_crystal_dissol:
Genesis Grade relic, worn in the Charm slot. Needs attunement.
While worn: +35% maximum magicules, +12 maximum health, 45% less magic damage, 30% less curse damage, the lent skills magic resistance, self regeneration.
Fusion (use; cooldown 90 s; 10% magicules): The crystal fuses with you: Strength III and Regeneration III for 20 seconds, a shield and some life.
Boundary Dissolution (sneak + use; cooldown 3 min; 12% magicules): The boundary between things dissolves: every foe within 12 blocks takes a 130 magic blow and Weakness III for 8 seconds and is pushed back.
Transcendence (use; cooldown 10 min; 14% magicules; 1 a day): The crystal gives what you were about to become: Strength IV and Resistance III for 25 seconds, a great shield and 100 health back.
A crystal that dissolves the line between a soul and what it is meant to be, and gives to the one who holds it what it was about to become. Use: Fusion, Boundary Dissolution and Transcendence.
item.nusmp.law_of_cycles_gown.card:
Genesis Grade relic, worn as a chestplate. Needs attunement.

item.nusmp.selection_hopefuls_bokken.car:
Normal Grade katana (24.5 damage, 1.7 attacks a second).
Oak Cut (use; cooldown 25 s, 1% magicules): You cut the way you were drilled, and the line is clean.
Tensura engravings: swift.
item.nusmp.genin_academy_kunai.desc: The plain black kunai handed to every graduate of the leaf academy with a lecture about not throwing it at friends. It is balanced for throwing and fine for peeling fruit. Use: Kunai Throw.
item.nusmp.genin_academy_kunai.card:
Normal Grade dagger (20 damage, 2.2 attacks a second).
Kunai Throw (use; cooldown 20 s, 1% magicules): You flick the kunai and it bites.
Tensura engravings: swift.

Normal Grade sabre (23.5 damage, 1.7 attacks a second).
Deck Slash (use; cooldown 25 s, 1% magicules): A wide cut across the deck, and the nearest ones step back.
Tensura engravings: sturdy.

Normal Grade club (25.5 damage, 1.3 attacks a second).
Frontier Bash (use; cooldown 30 s, 1% magicules): A heavy swing that leaves the nearest ones dazed.
Tensura engravings: crushing.

Normal Grade wand (20.5 damage, 1.5 attacks a second).
Petal Spark (use; cooldown 20 s, 1% magicules): A pale green spark leaps from the tip.
Tensura engravings: magic weapon.

Normal Grade cleaver (24 damage, 1.6 attacks a second).
Brush Cut (use; cooldown 25 s, 1% magicules): You hack a wide arc through the undergrowth and whatever hides in it.
Tensura engravings: sturdy.

Normal Grade shortsword (23 damage, 1.6 attacks a second).

Tensura engravings: crushing.

Normal Grade handaxe (24 damage, 1.4 attacks a second).

Normal Grade hammer (27.5 damage, 1.1 attacks a second).

item.nusmp.desert_dancers_veil_cape.desc: A thin veil-cape from the dancers of the desert palaces, cut so that it will not catch on a blade. It billows when the wearer turns, and the blade is not where it was.
item.nusmp.d_rank_raiders_mantle.card: Special Grade. A heavy mantle for raiders who have cleared enough low gates to be trusted with a middle one. It has the faint smell of dungeon dust.
item.nusmp.d_rank_raiders_mantle.desc: A heavy mantle for raiders who have cleared enough low gates to be trusted with a middle one. It has the faint smell of dungeon dust.
item.nusmp.adventurers_mana_flask_belt.c: Special Grade. A belt with five loops of small glass flasks for the explosion-minded. A sip of the right one puts a bit of power back.
item.nusmp.adventurers_mana_flask_belt.d: A belt with five loops of small glass flasks for the explosion-minded. A sip of the right one puts a bit of power back.
item.nusmp.guild_veterans_sash.card: Special Grade. A faded sash worn by mercenaries of the northern guild who have survived ten contracts. Its colour is not what it was, and neither is its owner's.
item.nusmp.guild_veterans_sash.desc: A faded sash worn by mercenaries of the northern guild who have survived ten contracts. Its colour is not what it was, and neither is its owner's.
item.nusmp.gate_raider_grip_gloves.card: Special Grade. Gloves with a slip-proof palm, worn by raiders who climb out of gates by the skin of their teeth. They hold their grip when the rest of the body will not.
item.nusmp.gate_raider_grip_gloves.desc: Gloves with a slip-proof palm, worn by raiders who climb out of gates by the skin of their teeth. They hold their grip when the rest of the body will not.
item.nusmp.mana_skin_wrap.card: Special Grade. A violet wrap drawn through a loop of mana and shaped into a thin skin on the forearm. It is a first step toward the mana skin of a real knight.
item.nusmp.mana_skin_wrap.desc: A violet wrap drawn through a loop of mana and shaped into a thin skin on the forearm. It is a first step toward the mana skin of a real knight.
item.nusmp.dragon_slayer_apprentice_brac: Special Grade. Scarred bracers of those who study the old lost magic from a guild elder who never finishes a lesson. They feel warm and a bit dangerous.
Scarred bracers of those who study the old lost magic from a guild elder who never finishes a lesson. They feel warm and a bit dangerous.
item.nusmp.spirit_whisper_bell.card: Special Grade. A little glass bell that rings only when a spirit is near. It is a sweet note, and the owner is more at ease for hearing it.
item.nusmp.spirit_whisper_bell.desc: A little glass bell that rings only when a spirit is near. It is a sweet note, and the owner is more at ease for hearing it.
item.nusmp.compass_of_true_north.card: Special Grade. A brass compass that points always north, and never tells a lie about it. In a maze it is worth ten lanterns.
item.nusmp.compass_of_true_north.desc: A brass compass that points always north, and never tells a lie about it. In a maze it is worth ten lanterns.
item.nusmp.hi_potion_vial_bandolier.card: Special Grade. A bandolier of green vials sold at the Guild stalls for a lot more than they should. The top one never seems to run dry.
item.nusmp.hi_potion_vial_bandolier.desc: A bandolier of green vials sold at the Guild stalls for a lot more than they should. The top one never seems to run dry.
item.nusmp.quiet_mages_flower_locket.car: Special Grade. A locket of a quiet mage's habit, holding a faded flower that is never replaced. It dulls the edge of a strange spell.
item.nusmp.quiet_mages_flower_locket.des: A locket of a quiet mage's habit, holding a faded flower that is never replaced. It dulls the edge of a strange spell.
item.nusmp.apprentices_training_sword.de: A blunt-edged practice sword handed to every recruit of a Magic Knights squad before the squad lets them near a real fight. It is plain, and it is well balanced. Use: Practice Cut.
item.nusmp.apprentices_training_sword.ca:
Normal Grade longsword (25 damage, 1.6 attacks a second).
Practice Cut (use; cooldown 25 s, 1% magicules): You swing the way you were taught, and it is almost clean.
Tensura engravings: sturdy.
item.nusmp.gate_scavengers_knife.desc: A cheap black knife issued to the clean-up crews of the Hunters Association, sharp enough to cut a pouch from a dead monster and not much else. Use: Quick Stab.
item.nusmp.gate_scavengers_knife.card:
Normal Grade dagger (20 damage, 2.2 attacks a second).
Quick Stab (use; cooldown 20 s, 1% magicules): You jab fast, before the thing can turn.
Tensura engravings: swift.
item.nusmp.adventurers_handaxe.desc: A one-handed axe that chops firewood in the evening and orcs in the morning. It is thrown only by those who mean to pick it up again. Use: Throw Axe.
item.nusmp.adventurers_handaxe.card:
Normal Grade handaxe (24 damage, 1.4 attacks a second).
Throw Axe (use; cooldown 30 s, 1% magicules): The axe spins out and bites.
Tensura engravings: crushing.
item.nusmp.lizardman_scouts_spear.desc: A long-reach spear of the lizardmen who scout the marshes, light enough to carry for a day and long enough to keep a wolf at arm's length. Use: Marsh Thrust.
item.nusmp.lizardman_scouts_spear.card:
Normal Grade spear (25.5 damage, 1.3 attacks a second).
Marsh Thrust (use; cooldown 30 s, 1% magicules): You lunge from far out of reach.
Tensura engravings: swift.
item.nusmp.hedge_wizards_oak_staff.desc: A knotted oak staff cut from a hedge by a mage who wanted to look the part. It does not do much, but a crack of magic does come out of the end when it is struck on the ground. Use: Hedge Spark.
item.nusmp.hedge_wizards_oak_staff.card:
Normal Grade staff (24.5 damage, 1.4 attacks a second).
Hedge Spark (use; cooldown 25 s, 1% magicules): A spark of green light jumps off the knot.
Tensura engravings: magic weapon.
item.nusmp.silvered_shortsword.desc: A shortsword coated with a thin layer of silver, the answer a careful adventurer has to things that bleed and do not stay dead. It cuts clean and it shines in the dark. Use: Silver Flash and Warding Cut.
item.nusmp.silvered_shortsword.card:
Special Grade shortsword (41 damage, 1.8 attacks a second).
Silver Flash (use; cooldown 30 s, 2% magicules): A bright arc of silver, and the dark gives up what it was hiding.
Warding Cut (sneak + use; cooldown 60 s, 2% magicules): You cross the blade before you and it holds.
Tensura engravings: holy weapon, swift.
item.nusmp.hakurou_school_practice_katan: A katana in a plain black sheath, given to the students of an old swordmaster who takes the swing of one clean cut more seriously than the number of cuts. It is balanced to a hair. Use: Iaido Cut and Calm Mind.

Special Grade katana (44 damage, 1.7 attacks a second).
Iaido Cut (use; cooldown 35 s, 2% magicules): You draw and cut in one movement.
Calm Mind (sneak + use; cooldown 70 s, 2% magicules): You breathe and settle your blade.
Tensura engravings: severance, swift.
item.nusmp.familia_smiths_mace.desc: A flanged iron mace from the forge of a smith's Familia, hammered by apprentices who were told it would be sold to somebody important. It breaks bones and keeps its shape. Use: Forge Bash and Anvil Guard.
item.nusmp.familia_smiths_mace.card:
Special Grade hammer (50 damage, 1.1 attacks a second).
Forge Bash (use; cooldown 35 s, 2% magicules): A heavy blow that makes the ground ring.
Anvil Guard (sneak + use; cooldown 60 s, 2% magicules): You hold the mace across and let the blow break on it.
Tensura engravings: crushing, sturdy.
nusmp.compass3d.title: Compass Magic in 3D
nusmp.compass3d.body: Compass Magic is one floating 3D compass beside you: a thick bronze rim, a green dial, a raised cream and gold compass rose, a gold needle and a glass dome, with a spiky yellow aura behind it. It appears when you cast or hold a Compass page, its needle swings to your target and it fades a few seconds later. Every Compass spell comes out of it as 3D models: arrow-needles that leave the compass, seal discs that fly to your foes' feet, a route of dashes to the charted foe, and a turn disc where Willful Compass bends a shot back.
nusmp.compass3d.config: Draw Compass Magic as one 3D compass with 3D spell models (visual.compass3d in config/nusmp-compass3d-client.toml). Off draws the old flat compasses, needle and lock sigil instead.
nusmp.compass3d.aura: The spiky yellow aura behind the 3D compass and the glint that runs round its rim (visual.compass3d_aura).
nusmp.page.book_light.bright_judgment_wh: Bright Judgment Whip (裁きの光鞭, Sabaki no Kōben) - three long curling whips of light lash out from your hand in a fan, each hitting everything along 13 blocks and dragging what it catches a little towards you. Patolli's Creation-style light spell.
nusmp.page.book_light.heaven_splitting_f: Heaven-Splitting Flash (裂天の閃光, Retten no Senkō) - after a short charge a huge beam of light with bright points along it pierces everything in a straight line up to 30 blocks, hurting and pushing each foe (up to 12). Rhya copied it from Patolli.
nusmp.page.book_light.arrows_of_judgment: Arrows of Judgment (審判の矢, Shinpan no Ya) - a ring marks where you aim (or the foe you look at) and 12 to 20 arrows of light rain down over a crowd within 8 blocks, each bursting where it lands (at most 24 foes touched per cast). Patolli's area spell.
nusmp.page.book_light.avior_lamp: Lamp of Avior (アヴィオールの灯, Aviōru no Tomoshibi) - light gathers round your raised hand, then the concentrated orb is thrown and goes off in a blinding spiky starburst: 6 blocks, light damage, blindness and a push. The lesser form of the Lamp of Avior Gloria.
nusmp.page.book_light.absolute_monarch: Absolute Monarch of Divine Brilliance (神聖なる光輝の絶対君主, Shinsei naru Kōki no Zettai Kunshu) - a giant of golden light with a yellow rim stands behind you for 12 seconds: it shelters you and the allies near you (a little resistance, a trickle of healing) and strikes the nearest foe within 14 blocks every 1.5 seconds. One giant at a time. A supplementary spell.
nusmp.page.book_bone.demon_sword_dainsle: Demon Sword Dainsleif (魔剣ダーインスレイヴ, Maken Dāinsureivu) - a bone sword coated in offensive Spatial Magic cuts three close-range arcs in front of you; space itself is cut, so nearly all armour is ignored. Zenon Zogratis' union of Bone and Spatial Magic.
nusmp.page.book_bone.spatial_rupture: Spatial Rupture (空間断裂, Kūkan Danretsu) - you swing the Demon Sword Dainsleif and 1 to 3 flying slashes of cut space leave it, piercing everything in their way for 15 blocks and ignoring nearly all armour. Zenon Zogratis' Bone and Spatial Magic.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.corpse_jimmy: No.4 - Jimmy: a bandaged, crouching undead with big golden spiral eyes rises beside you for three minutes. The fast brawler of Rades Spirito's undead: light, quick and hits often. Rades Spirito's grimoire only.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.corpse_david: No.3 - David: a huge hunched giant sewn together from blue-grey and brown patches rises beside you for about two minutes. The slowest and the heaviest of Rades Spirito's undead, a wall of health and armour; every eight seconds, with a foe at his feet, he slams the ground (foes within four blocks are hurt, thrown back and slowed). Rades Spirito's grimoire only.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.corpse_alfre: No.2 - Alfredo: a tall, armoured, hooded undead bound in straps and chains, wrapped in a blue-white spirit aura, rises beside you for three minutes. Slow and hard to hurt; every twenty seconds in a fight he raises a soul barrier: you, your pact's people, your other undead and he himself get Absorption II for eight seconds. Rades Spirito's grimoire only.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.corpse_carl: No.1 - Carl: a tall, thin undead in long white ornate robes and a white mitre, a dark wild-haired body inside the robe, rises beside you for three minutes. He keeps his distance and throws bone shards and Soul Corpse bolts. He never heals anyone. Rades Spirito's grimoire only.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.corpse_micha: No.0 - Michael Caesal: the strongest of Rades Spirito's undead, a lean figure in a white featureless mask with a grey ponytail, a red sash and his arms spread wide, answers your call for ninety seconds. The hardest blow and the fastest feet; every ten seconds he looses a soul barrage of six bolts at the foe he sees. Only one at a time, and a long cooldown. Rades Spirito's grimoire only.
item.nusmp.stormcaller_staff.lore: A staff of storm cloud and lightning rod. Storm Magic does not come from a book: it comes from the staff.

nusmp.storm.spell.gathering_clouds.desc: A storm cell gathers over the place you look at: a dark cloud rolls in, rain curtains fall and forked bolts strike from it. It drifts slowly the way you faced.
nusmp.storm.spell.downpour.desc: A heavy rain falls on the area: foes are soaked, slowed and weakened, fires are put out, friends are cooled.
nusmp.storm.spell.hailstorm.desc: Hail stones as big as fists fall in volleys on the area; every stone that lands hurts what stands there.
nusmp.storm.spell.thunderhead.desc: A tall black thunderhead builds and throws bolt after bolt at the foes under it, each bolt leaping to the foes standing near its mark.
nusmp.storm.spell.gale_front.desc: A wall of storm wind sweeps out in front of you and shoves everything on its line before it, rain streaming in its wake.
nusmp.storm.spell.storm_surge.desc: A roll of storm water breaks from a low cloud and runs along the ground, throwing foes back and soaking them.
nusmp.storm.spell.twister.desc: A funnel drops from the cloud and walks across the ground, drawing in and lifting what it meets, then throws it out.
nusmp.storm.spell.eye_of_the_storm.desc: The whole sky turns on the place you stand: rain, hail, bolts and gust rings in a wide cell, and in its middle a calm eye where you and your friends are looked after.

item.nusmp.magnas_soul_bat.use: Hold it in the main hand to cast the Fire pages of Magna's grimoire.

gui_move.title: Move GUIs
gui_move.hint: Drag a GUI to move it. Wheel or + / -: size. Arrows: nudge (Shift: 8 px). R: reset it. H or right click: hide / show. Tab: next. Alt: no snapping. Esc or Done: save and close.
gui_move.hint2: Dimmed: not on screen right now. For the panel of a screen (codex, forge ...) turn Panels on and press Tab: it takes its place when that screen opens.
gui_move.cmd.reset: Every GUI is back in its normal place.

nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_greet_: Peace be with you. I am here.
The light remembers you. I rise at your side.
Be not afraid. I am your light.
I answer. Walk, and I will go before you.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_farewe: Rest now. I will keep the light for you.
Until you call me again, be well.
I return to the light. Peace.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_rise_1: Behold. The light takes its true form.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_rise_2: Many eyes open, that you may not be alone.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_rise_3: Stand firm. The heavens are with you.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_settle: The vision fades. I am still near.
I fold my wings, but I do not leave.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_beam_3: A ray of mercy, swift and straight.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_beam_5: Nothing hidden can stand before it.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_pulse_: I see them. Now, so do you.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_damage: I am hurt, but I endure.
The light flickers, yet it does not fail.
Do not mind me. Keep your eyes forward.
Ah... this pain is a small thing.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_low_1: Your strength is failing. Hold on, I am with you.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_low_2: Do not yield. The light is not done with you.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_win_1: Well done. The dark gives way.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_win_2: Justice is done. Rejoice, but gently.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_death_: No... not yet. Rise again, my friend.
Sleep, bright one. The light will find you.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_idle_1: All is calm. The light is with us.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_idle_2: Walk on. I am watching the way.

subtitles.nusmp.voice.sylph_link_2: Sylph: "I'm here! I'm here! Where are we flying to?"

subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_farewell_3: Undine: “Rest well. I will be listening.”

enchantment.nusmp.fr_teachers_insight.de: A sword that appraises its foe sees the first opening. +8% damage on the first hit against a foe you have not hit for 10 s. Works while the item is in your main hand. Effects are capped; stronger items carry a higher level (+25% per level).
enchantment.nusmp.fr_devoured_power.desc: What the sword defeats makes it stronger for a while. Each kill adds +1.2% damage, up to 6 times; the growth fades 60 s after the last kill. Works while the item is in your main hand. Effects are capped; stronger items carry a higher level (+25% per level).

shishou.tooltip.keys: Skills: the Ultimate skill Shishou (Tensura skill screen: mode key, skill key). No keys of his own.
shishou.false.name: Rusty Sword
shishou.theft.line: Let go of me, you aren't my wielder.
shishou.storage.title: Shishou: Stomach

shishou.msg.exists: There is only one Shishou in this world.
shishou.msg.copy: A copy of me cannot exist.
shishou.msg.torn_away: He tears himself out of your hands.

shishou.line.shishou_claim_1: So you are my wielder. Try not to bore me.
shishou.line.shishou_claim_2: I will teach you what a sword can be.
shishou.line.shishou_claim_3: Hold me properly. We have a great deal to learn.
shishou.line.shishou_throw_1: Leave the fighting to me for a moment.
shishou.line.shishou_throw_2: Fly, then. I will hold the line.
shishou.line.shishou_levelup_1: I have grown. Another step, wielder.
shishou.line.shishou_levelup_2: I grow stronger, as I intended.
shishou.line.shishou_levelup_3: Power gathers in me. Use it well.
shishou.line.shishou_skill_utility_2: This will make your life easier, wielder.
shishou.line.shishou_skill_magic_1: I have eaten a new spell. Delicious.
shishou.line.shishou_skill_magic_2: Magic, absorbed. Let us put it to use.
shishou.line.shishou_skill_combat_1: A new edge for the blade.
shishou.line.shishou_skill_space_1: Space bends a little easier now.
shishou.line.shishou_skill_space_2: A new way to move. Do not waste it.
shishou.line.shishou_eat_3: Do not look away. This is how a sword grows.
shishou.line.shishou_lowmana_1: My mana is running low, wielder.
shishou.line.shishou_lowmana_2: I need rest. Do not draw on me now.
shishou.line.shishou_dormant_1: I must sleep for a while. Find me again.
shishou.line.shishou_dormant_2: My strength is spent. I will wait.
shishou.line.shishou_danger_3: Your health is failing. Retreat, or let me fight.
shishou.line.shishou_thief_1: Let go of me, you aren't my wielder.
shishou.line.shishou_thief_2: Hands off. I do not serve you.
shishou.line.shishou_appraise_1: I have looked at it. Listen carefully.
shishou.line.shishou_appraise_2: It is weak to something. Find out what.
shishou.line.shishou_appraise_3: An ordinary thing, but it may be eaten.
shishou.line.shishou_barrier_off_1: The barrier is broken. Be careful.
shishou.line.shishou_victory_2: As expected. Nothing could stand against us.
shishou.line.shishou_idle_1: A sword should never stop learning.
shishou.line.shishou_idle_2: You swing me well enough, for a beginner.
shishou.line.shishou_idle_3: Every battle is a lesson, wielder.
shishou.line.shishou_idle_4: Quiet today. I do not trust quiet.
nusmp.skill.shishou.description: Ultimate. The talking sword's abilities as one skill: switch modes (Telekinesis, Sensory, Defence, Offence, Storage, Magic, Counsel) with the mode key, press the skill key to use the mode, sneak and press to pick the next ability of a mode. Hold him in your hand to cast; his own mana pays.
shishou.skill_msg.granted: Shishou answers: the Ultimate skill Shishou is yours.
shishou.skill_msg.revoked: Shishou is no longer yours: the skill fades.
shishou.msg.counsel: Shishou, level %s (%s%% to the next), mana %s / %s, %s skills eaten.
shishou.msg.mode_locked: Nothing in %s is open to me yet.
shishou.tooltip.feed: Click a stack of monster drops or magic stones on me in your inventory to feed me.
shishou.feed.own_inventory: Feed me from your own inventory.
shishou.feed.valuable: That is too precious to eat.
shishou.feed.off: Feeding is switched off on this server.
shishou.feed.full: I can grow no more. Keep it.
nusmp.page.book_fire.shining_flame_cross: Shining Flame Cross - a cluster of small blasts that together form a large cross where you aim (Theresa Rapual, who taught the Vermillion children). Two 6-block lines cross at the aim point: up to 8 foes on them take 8 base damage and burn for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_fire.combo_eruption: Combo Eruption - the arms spread wide and a series of fireballs flies at the target (Dmitri Brint). Four fireballs, three ticks apart, each swelling and exploding on contact: up to 8 foes within 2.4 blocks of each take 6 base damage and burn for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_water.aqua_curtain: Aqua Curtain - a large volume of water covers you and puts out the fire on your body (Rhya). Four seconds in which fire is put out again and again and what flies at you within 3.5 blocks is turned aside, then fire resistance and four hearts of absorption for 15 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_water.cascade_destroyer: Cascade Destroyer - several balls of water are thrown at the opponents (Selena Silva). Four homing balls two ticks apart, 6 base damage each.
nusmp.page.book_water.holy_water_assassi: Holy Water Assassination Bullet - one bullet of holy water that passes through everything in a line (Solid Silva, who used it on the soul corpses). 13 base damage to up to 8 foes in 34 blocks, 22 to the undead.
nusmp.page.book_wind.slicing_wind_empero: Slicing Wind Emperor: Wintry Wind - several swords of wind are made and sent at the opponents (Fanzell Kruger). Four homing blades, 6 base damage each and a small push.
Slicing Wind Emperor: Gale - a plunge at the opponent with great force, surrounded by wind (Fanzell Kruger). A dash of up to 9 blocks through everything on the way: 9 base damage.
Slicing Wind Emperor: Mountain Retreat - a very strong gust of wind sends the opponents flying a great distance (Fanzell Kruger). A cone of 8 blocks: 4 base damage and a heavy push.

Slicing Wind Emperor: Whirlwind - the sword is swung and whirlwinds bind the opponent's limbs and hold it in the air (Fanzell Kruger; Wind Restraining Magic). One foe within 14 blocks is held and lifted for a moment; shares the control lock of the other binding spells.
nusmp.page.book_wind.killing_kakara_blad: Killing Kakara Blade - you fly past the opponent and wind blades slash it from several angles (Jozou Hanegatsuji). A dash of up to 10 blocks: 8 base damage to everything on the way.
nusmp.page.book_wind.piercing_tornado_ne: Piercing Tornado Needle - a thin needle of wind, wind-based Creation Magic (George of the Eye of the Midnight Sun). It goes through everything in a line of 20 blocks: 10 base damage; a small tornado stands where it ends.
nusmp.page.book_dark.black_star: Black Star - a small black sphere is made where you aim and pulls the opponents in (Ichika Yami). For a second everything within 4.5 blocks is dragged to it: up to 8 foes take 5.5 base damage and are thrown off balance.
nusmp.page.book_ice.heavenly_ice_fang: Heavenly Ice Fang - a large icicle rises from the ground and strikes the target, with more blunt and cutting than piercing force (Heath Graice). One foe within 24 blocks: 11 base damage, frost and a lift.
nusmp.page.book_ice.icicle_bridge: Icicle Bridge - a large chunk of jagged ice is made and, once released, extends towards the target. A line of 16 blocks: 7 base damage, slowness and frost.
nusmp.page.book_ice.dissolve: Dissolve - you raise a hand and melt any ice at once, whether real or magical, so it can be used against an enemy's ice spells and against your own when they are reflected (Heath Graice). The frost on you and your allies within 6 blocks is gone, you stop burning, and up to 6 spells flying at you are undone.
nusmp.page.book_ice.crystal_ice_shield: Crystal Ice Shield - a shield of crystal ice stands round you (Heath Graice). Ten seconds of absorption (six hearts) and a little damage resistance.
nusmp.page.book_beast.bear_claw: Bear Claw - the arms are wrapped in an aura shaped like a bear's paws that greatly raises the strength of the punch; it can be extended and enlarged (Vetto). A cone of 3.6 blocks: 13 base damage and a push.
nusmp.page.book_beast.cheetah_charge: Cheetah Charge - the legs are wrapped in an aura shaped like a cheetah's, a close-range burst of speed (Vetto). A dash of up to 11 blocks through everything on the way (8 base damage) and three seconds of speed.
nusmp.page.book_beast.rhinoceros_armor: Rhinoceros Armor - an aura shaped like a rhinoceros that can stop powerful impacts (Vetto). Twelve seconds of absorption (six hearts) and a little damage resistance.
nusmp.page.book_wind.tornado_fang: Tornado Fang - the Towering Tornado laid on its side. A rolling drill of wind runs 16 blocks ahead, tears spells out of the air and drags up to 8 foes along the lane for 11 base damage each.
nusmp.page.book_wind.sylphs_breath: Sylph's Breath - the wind spirit exhales a great volume of air. A wide cone of 14 blocks throws up to 8 foes back for 12 base damage each and shreds the spells in it. Yuno's first spirit technique.
nusmp.page.book_wind.spirits_hushed_danc: Spirit's Hushed Dance - you read the flow of mana and move before it does. For 10 seconds (15 inside a Spirit Dive, and quicker) you run, jump and fall like a feather, and every hostile spell that comes within 3.5 blocks is turned aside.
nusmp.page.book_wind.liable_tempest: Liable Tempest - a tempest that will not let go. For 5 seconds a storm of 6 blocks radius where you aim pulls up to 8 foes in, spins them and tears at them for 5 base damage a second, and swallows hostile spells.
nusmp.page.book_wind.gale_white_bow: Gale White Bow - a great bow of wind is drawn and the Sylph's breath looses a white arrow. It flies 40 blocks, pierces everything for 16 base damage and pushes foes back.
nusmp.page.book_wind.swift_white_hawk: Swift White Hawk - a hawk of wind carries you up to 16 blocks ahead in one dive. Up to 8 foes on the way take 9 base damage. Needs room to land.
nusmp.page.book_wind.heavenly_wind_ark: Heavenly Wind Ark - a ship of wind lifts you and up to 8 allies within 8 blocks: Slow Falling and Speed II for 15 seconds and a push forward.
nusmp.page.book_wind.wind_blades_shower: Wind Blades Shower - wind swords rain down where you look: four volleys over 1.6 seconds across 5 blocks radius, each hitting up to 8 foes for 5 base damage and a little more each time.
nusmp.page.book_wind.spirit_of_boreas: Spirit of Boreas - the north wind in a close-range strike. A freezing cyclone around you bites everything within 6 blocks for 22 base damage, chills and slows it and throws it away. Saint Stage only.
nusmp.page.book_water.point_blank_roar: Point-Blank Sea Dragon's Roar - the Roar fired from the hand into the target's body. No flight: a crash of water at the spot you face (up to 7 blocks) hits everything within 3.5 blocks for 24 base damage and throws it back.
nusmp.page.book_fire.leo_parma: Leo Palma - a giant paw of flame closes on the foe you look at (up to 18 blocks). 8 base damage, it burns and cannot move for 3 seconds, taking 4 more every second.
nusmp.page.book_fire.salamanders_breath: Salamander's Breath - the fire spirit's breath, a huge flame spat in a wide cone of 14 blocks. Up to 8 foes take 16 base damage (20 inside a Spirit Dive) and burn for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_dark.deep_black_blade: Dark Cloaked Deep Black Blade - the Black Blade grown deeper. For 20 seconds your sword reaches 4 blocks further and you gain Strength II.
nusmp.page.book_dark.black_crescent_moon: Black Crescent Moon - a wide crescent of darkness cuts 22 blocks ahead for 24 base damage, half as much again while Black Moon is up, and cuts the spells in its way.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.fluffy_sheep_cush: Fluffy Sheep Cushion - a huge sheep of cotton appears and its wool catches everyone nearby. You and up to 8 allies within 6 blocks float down softly and are padded (slow fall, resistance and absorption); foes in the circle are bounced away without a scratch. Charmy's cushion.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunderclap_cr: Thunderclap Crumbling Orb - lightning gathered in the claws is thrown as a ball. It flies up to 22 blocks, bursts on the first thing it meets and shocks up to 8 foes within 3 blocks for 13 base damage and a short slow. Cheap enough to throw again and again.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunder_gods_g: Thunder God's Gloves - lightning gauntlets on both hands for 20 seconds: haste II and strength, and once a second a shock arcs from you to the nearest foe within 3 blocks for 3 base damage. The pair of the Thunder God's Boots.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.keraunos: Keraunos - the true lightning of the Heart Kingdom training. You are fired as a bolt of lightning up to 20 blocks forward and strike up to 8 foes on the line for 15 base damage each. Needs room to land.
nusmp.page.book_fire.exploding_buckshot: Exploding Buckshot - the throw splits into a spray of small fireballs: a cone of 11 blocks that hits up to 8 foes for 9 base damage and sets them alight. Cast it with the Soul Bat like every Fire page of Magna.
nusmp.page.book_fire.grand_slam: Grand Slam - the bat of swirling flames sends out three fireballs in a fan. Each flies up to 28 blocks and bursts on the first foe it meets, 8 base damage in 2.6 blocks and burning. Cast it with the Soul Bat.
nusmp.page.book_fire.soul_chain_deathmat: Soul Chain Tag Deathmatch - Magna's hidden spell. A fireball hits one foe within 16 blocks (10 base damage, burning) and a chain made of two souls binds you together for 8 seconds: the foe is pulled back when it strays beyond 7 blocks, it hits weaker (weakness II) and you hit harder (strength II). The power split of the series is not modelled.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.double_reflect_re: Double Reflect Refrain - after a Real Double, twice the mirrors of the Reflect Refrain. The light bounces down a lane of 18 blocks twice and cuts up to 8 foes between the mirrors for 16 base damage in all.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.mirrors_brigade: Mirrors Brigade - a wall of large square mirrors stands round you for 8 seconds. Up to 6 hostile projectiles at a time that come within 5 blocks are turned back on their casters.
nusmp.page.book_poison.verbotenes_obst: Verbotenes Obst - a big mass of liquid poison made between the hands and thrown. It flies up to 27 blocks, bursts where it lands and poisons up to 8 foes within 3.6 blocks for 14 base damage and poison II.
nusmp.page.book_poison.poison_clouds_abo: Poison Cloud's Abode - a cloud of poison spreads where you look and lingers for 8 seconds, 6 blocks in radius. Up to 8 foes inside take 3 base damage and poison every second.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_snare_trap: Ash Snare Trap - a quick trap of ash drawn where you look. For 8 seconds it waits; the first foes that step in take 6 base damage and are held for 4 seconds (weak and almost unable to move).
nusmp.page.book_ash.counter_trap_magic: Counter Trap Magic - Zora's best trap. For 10 seconds a circle under your feet swallows up to 3 hostile spells that enter it; each one comes back at the nearest foe within 18 blocks as 14 base damage (the series returns a trapped spell with twice its power).
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.transforma: Transformation: Borrowed Form - Grey takes another shape. For 15 seconds you are invisible and quick, and mobs within 16 blocks that were hunting you lose you. The mod cannot change a skin, so the disguise is a vanishing act.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.mana_rocke: Mana Rocket Punch - the fist of the hideout tears off and flies on mana: a heavy piercing bolt of 24 blocks that hits everything on its way for 14 base damage and throws it aside.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.mini_bull: The Mini Bull - a small bull cut from the hideout charges 12 blocks ahead, tramples up to 8 foes for 10 base damage and throws them forward.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.fallen_angel_win: Fallen Angel Wingbeat - a sphere of space hits one foe within 18 blocks (6 base damage) and throws it to another place 12 to 20 blocks away. It needs somewhere solid to land the foe.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.dark_hunting_grou: Dark Hunting Ground - the Canis state's spell. A great shadow wraps everyone within 8 blocks for 6 seconds: 5 base damage a second to up to 8 foes, blindness and slowness.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.atonement_monumen: Atonement Monument - the foes within 6 blocks (up to 4) are drawn down into the shadows and buried in an empty world: 22 base damage, held for 4 seconds in darkness. You are not harmed.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.inverse_release: Inverse Release - the open hand forces what is shut to open. You and up to 8 allies within 8 blocks are freed of slowness, weakness, blindness, darkness, mining fatigue, levitation and nausea, and of a sealed grimoire.
nusmp.page.book_fire.mereoleona_brachium: Calidus Brachium Barrage (灼熱腕 連撃) - with the Mana Zone read, the flames of her fist come at the target from every side: four blasts in 16 ticks, 5 base damage each to everything within 2.4 blocks of it, burning them. Mereoleona's fist style.
nusmp.page.book_fire.mereoleona_purgator: Calidus Brachium Purgatory (灼熱腕 煉獄) - she becomes the flame. For 20 seconds: Strength II, fire immunity and a ring of fire that burns up to 8 foes within 3.5 blocks for 3 base damage every second.

Calidus Brachium Purgatory: Abyss (灼熱腕 煉獄・深淵) - the deeper form. A shock of flame throws everything within 7 blocks back for 14 base damage, then 15 seconds of Strength III, Speed I and a wider, hotter ring (4.5 blocks, 5 base damage a second).
nusmp.page.book_fire.mereoleona_hellfire: Hellfire Incarnate (業火の化身) - her whole body turns to mana and flame. An eruption within 9 blocks (20 base damage, burning 8 seconds, thrown back), then 12 seconds of Strength III, Speed II, absorption and a ring of 6 blocks that burns up to 8 foes for 6 base damage a second.
nusmp.page.book_fire.leopold_deep_spiral: Deep Spiral Flame (深炎螺旋焔) - spirals of flame leave him in four directions at once, 9 blocks each: up to 8 foes burn and take 10 base damage. Leopold's own formula from the Heart Kingdom.
nusmp.page.book_fire.leopold_crimson_eru: True Flame Magic: Crimson Eruption (真炎魔法「紅蓮噴火」) - a formula is written over 7 blocks of ground where you aim; a second later the whole circle erupts: 22 base damage to up to 8 foes, burning 6 seconds, thrown up.
nusmp.page.book_plant.mimosa_magic_flowe: Magic Flower Cannon - a giant flower opens in front of you and fires a laser of pure mana up to 24 blocks: 14 base damage to up to 8 foes on the line, pushed back.
nusmp.page.book_plant.mimosa_dream_heali: Dream-Healing Flower Cradle - a cradle of vines and flowers closes round the ally you look at (or you): four pulses of 12 percent of their maximum health in 1.6 seconds and poison and wither taken out. The healing law still applies.
nusmp.page.book_plant.mimosa_princess_he: Princess-Healing Flower Robe - a robe of flowers on the ally you look at (or you) for 20 seconds: Regeneration II, absorption and a little toughness.
nusmp.page.book_plant.mimosa_flower_prin: Flower Princess Utopia - a garden of flowers opens round you for 14 seconds (8 blocks): up to 8 allies mend 8 percent of their health a second, a fatal wound is closed once per ally (40 percent), and foes inside are slowed.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.william_magic: Magic Warding Ash - a great ash tree stands over you for 8 seconds: a little toughness, and its branches take the enemy spells that fly within 6 blocks out of the air (up to 4 a step).
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.william_great: Great Tree Mistilteinn - world-tree roots spread 9 blocks round you for 6 seconds: up to 8 foes are held in them (slowed, 3 base damage a second) and their mana is drunk for you; the last pulse roots them.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.william_misti: Mistilteinn Blade - a blade of world-tree wood cuts a wide arc 8 blocks long: 11 base damage to up to 8 foes, and the sap that is cut mends you a little. The effect is the mod's reading: the wiki gave only the name.
nusmp.page.book_steel.klaus_piercing_lan: Blazing Piercing Lance (施貫の烈槍) - a lance of steel flies up to 29 blocks through everything in its line: 14 base damage, pushed back.
nusmp.page.book_steel.klaus_castle_wall: Steel Castle's Armored Wall (鋼城の鎧壁) - a wall of steel rises round you for 7 seconds: Resistance II, absorption, and the enemy spells that come within 4.5 blocks are stopped (up to 4 a step).
nusmp.page.book_steel.klaus_spiral_lance: Violent Spiral Lance (旋貫の激槍) - a drill of steel turns through everything on a line of 22 blocks: 16 base damage, thrown up and held for a moment.
nusmp.page.book_steel.klaus_thunder_arro: Thunder Arrow (神鳴の矢) - the union arrow of steel, lightning and wings: it crosses 40 blocks at once, pierces up to 8 foes for 20 base damage, stuns them for 1.5 seconds and cuts spells on its line. It cannot be steered, and you are slowed for 2 seconds after the shot.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.langris_archange: Archangel's Crash (大天使の撃墜) - a stroke of space that removes whatever it touches together with the space: 18 blocks, 16 base damage to up to 8 foes, and enemy spells on the line are cut away.
Archangel's Annihilation (大天使の撃滅) - three strokes of space fan out over 12 ticks, 20 blocks each, 12 base damage each to up to 8 foes per stroke. The effect is inferred from the name.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.langris_spatial_: Spatial Auto-Guard (空間魔法のオートガード) - for 12 seconds space guards you by itself: a little toughness and the enemy spells that come within 5 blocks are removed (up to 4 a step).
nusmp.page.book_light.karna_crescent_cut: Crescent Cut - three crescents of moonlight fan out from your hand, 14 blocks each, 7 base damage each. Moonlight Magic.
nusmp.page.book_light.karna_bewitching_m: Bewitching Moonlight - the moonlight settles on the one you look at and up to two foes beside it and takes hold of the body: held for 3 seconds, weakened for 6.
nusmp.page.book_light.karna_full_moon_sh: Full Moon Shell - a sphere of dark moon-mana closes round you for 6 seconds: foes within 3.8 blocks are knocked away every half second, enemy spells are stopped and you take a little less damage.
nusmp.page.book_light.karna_crescent_cut: Crescent Cut Full Moon - the shell closes and fires crescents erratically from every side: five of them over 2 seconds, 12 blocks each, 6 base damage each to up to 8 foes.
nusmp.page.book_light.karna_lunatic_cris: Lunatic Crisis - you gather the mana round the red moon for 1.5 seconds and let it go as one enormous ray of moonlight, 40 blocks long: 26 base damage to up to 8 foes, thrown back; enemy spells on the line are cut.
nusmp.page.book_storm.kaiser_area_helix: Vortex Magic: Area Helix (螺旋結界) - a huge spherical vortex turns where you aim for 8 seconds (8 blocks): up to 8 foes are dragged to its middle, slowed and cut for 3 base damage a second, and enemy spells are swallowed.
nusmp.page.book_briar.blue_rose_paradise: Blue Rose Paradise - two concentric magic circles grow briars at the spot you aim at (22 blocks). For 5 s everything within 5 blocks is tangled (3 damage a second, slowed, weakened) and a curse on it is drawn into the blue roses. Charlotte's spell from the years of her curse.
nusmp.page.book_briar.scarlet_braided_sp: Scarlet-Braided Beautiful Battle Spear - red briars braid into a spear that runs 16 blocks through everything on its line for 13 base damage and a poisonous bite. Named in the True Briar list; the effect is inferred from the name.
nusmp.page.book_painting.souterrain_grou: Souterrain Groundswell - painted figures ride a wave of dirt 13 blocks ahead and bury what they hit: 9 base damage, slowed and blinded for a moment, pushed back.
nusmp.page.book_painting.sirenes_game: Sirene's Game - painted mermaids of water crash into what you aim at, 13 blocks ahead: 9 base damage, flames put out, slowed, pushed back.
nusmp.page.book_painting.four_headed_lin: Four-Headed Lindworm - a four-headed serpent is painted in the air and each head breathes an element in a 14 block fan: 8 base damage to up to 8 foes, and one of burning, chill, a lift or weakness each.
nusmp.page.book_painting.vouivres_shout: Phantom Dragon Vouivre's Shout - a winged serpent-woman is painted under you (you fall slowly for 5 s) and shouts a magical blast where the brush points: 15 base damage in 3.5 blocks, thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_painting.souterrain_gian: Souterrain Giant - the upper body of a giant of dense earth rises where you aim and slams the ground three times in 3 s: 7 base damage in 4.5 blocks each, pushed away.
nusmp.page.book_painting.twilight_of_val: Twilight of Valhalla - a many-storeyed hall and winged shield-maidens are painted around you. After 3 s its secondary effect begins: for 8 s you and your allies within 6 blocks gain Regeneration, Resistance and Absorption. The delay is its weakness.
nusmp.page.book_blood.red_beast: Red Beast - costs 3 health. A giant monster of blood stays attached to you for 8 s and rakes everything within 5 blocks every half second (up to 6 foes, 3 base damage each) and feeds you a little of it.
nusmp.page.book_blood.herd_of_red_beasts: Herd of Red Beasts - costs 4 health. A lot of blood is shaped into several smaller beasts, not attached to you, that run through 7 blocks around the spot you aim at for 5 s: 3.5 base damage a half second, slowed.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.tenjiolia: Tenjiolia - lightning shot at great speed from the held-out palm, 30 blocks, bending toward what you look at: 14 base damage and a slow to everything on the line.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.apocalypra_ast: Apocalypra Astrauza - Ultimate Magic. Costs 4 hearts of life force (it will not cast if you cannot afford them). Interconnected mana arrays gather before the hand for 0.6 s, then a beam of lightning runs 40 blocks: 34 base damage to up to 8 foes, thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.laevateinn: Laevateinn - a great sword of ore is made and swung over a 7 block cone: 22 base damage to up to 8 foes, weakened and thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_song.heal_lullaby: Heal Lullaby - a gentle song that closes wounds: you and your allies within 8 blocks heal a quarter of their health (the usual healing decay applies).
nusmp.page.book_song.mother_lullaby: Mother Lullaby - a lullaby sung at one target within 16 blocks puts it to sleep for about 4 s (held still, blind, weak). A hard control: it shares the 12 s control lock.
nusmp.page.book_water.mermaid_form: Mermaid Form - the armour turns into a tail of sea-blue scales with twin tails of hair, fin ears and a shell top, and a trident of ice-water hovers at your hand. You breathe water, swim fast and mend slowly in the sea; on land the tail slows you. Cast it again to end it. Any Water mage may use it; Noelle's grimoire draws the full form.
nusmp.page.book_water.sea_dragon_god_for: Sea Dragon God Form - the contract with the sea god Leviathan: horned, winged armour of dragon scales, a dragon-head cannon on your arm and a tail that sweeps the ground. A roar at the start hits foes within six blocks. Strength, Resistance and speed for up to five minutes; cast it again to end it. Only Noelle Silva's grimoire holds this page.
nusmp.page.book_water.black_dragon_form: Black Dragon Form - the dark side of the dragon: black scales veined with blue flame, torn wings, red eyes. A shockwave at the start hits foes within eight blocks. Strong Strength, Resistance and speed, but it lasts only ninety seconds and leaves you exhausted for three minutes (slowness and weakness, never hunger). It will not close over a devil's pact. Only Noelle Silva's grimoire holds this page.
nusmp.noelle.black_exhausted: The black scales crumble. The dragon leaves you hollow.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.true_soul_co: True Soul Corpse Magic: Rades Spirito's pact. Arms a ten minute pact (sneak and use on up to three players to bind them), re-raises the pets and summons that fell a moment ago as Soul Zombies, and a bound ally who would die is brought back at a price. Rades Spirito's grimoire only.
nusmp.spirit_control.combat_off: Spirit combat mode is switched off on this server.
nusmp.spirit_control.combat_on: Spirit combat mode ON: your spirits cast with their mana and yours.
nusmp.spirit_control.spirit_dry: %s has no mana left to cast.
nusmp.spirit_control.user_dry: %s waits: you have no mana to spare.
nusmp.spirit_control.severed: Your spirit is severed from you for a moment.
nusmp.spirit_control.wont: Your spirit will not answer you.
nusmp.spirit_control.nobody: %s has no body yet. Earn its full trust and give it a True Name (Spirit Charm).
nusmp.spiritdive.tier.yuno: The wind spirit's crown rises: Yuno's Spirit Dive.
nusmp.spiritdive.tier.fuegoleon: The Salamander's flame cloaks you: Fuegoleon's Spirit Dive.
nusmp.spiritdive.tier.noelle: The water spirit's dress unfolds: Noelle's Spirit Dive.
nusmp.spiritdive.arm.on: The Salamander's flame runs down your right arm.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.blast_step: A small blast under your heels throws you up to 7 blocks forward; everything you pass through is hit and shoved. Damage scales with the book's mastery and size.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.flash_bang: A bright burst around you hits up to four foes within 4 blocks and blinds them for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.powder_burst: Black powder goes off in front of you: a 6 block cone of small blasts that shoves every foe in it back.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.delayed_charge: Plants a charge where you aim; two seconds later it goes off in 4.5 blocks for about a third more than a normal mid hit, burning and throwing foes back.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.shockwave_ring: A pressure wave rolls out 6 blocks from you, hitting up to six foes and throwing them back and up.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.cluster_bomb: Four small bombs fan out from your hand; each one that lands blows up on its target and sets it alight for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.blast_ward: Wraps you in reactive plates for 10 seconds: two extra hearts of absorption, and anything that hits you in melee is hurt by the backblast.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.blast_leap: You detonate the ground under your feet, hurting foes within 3.5 blocks, and ride the blast high and forward, then float down softly for two seconds.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.carpet_blast: Five blasts walk away from you in a straight line, three blocks apart and five ticks between them, shoving whatever stands in their path.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.volatile_groun: The ground where you aim turns to powder for 5 seconds: every 1.25 seconds it blows up under everything in 5.5 blocks.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.megaton_crater: The book's heaviest charge: one huge blast at the aim point, 7 blocks wide, that burns and hurls up to ten foes. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_storm.gust_jab: A hard gust punches out in a 5 block cone and shoves up to four foes back.
nusmp.page.book_storm.static_snap: A crackling spark flies where you look and snaps on impact, hitting everything within 2.5 blocks and slowing it for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_storm.squall_step: You ride a squall 8 blocks forward and knock aside everything on the way.
nusmp.page.book_storm.rain_curtain: A curtain of rain falls around you for 10 seconds: it douses fire (fire resistance) and soaks two hearts of damage.
nusmp.page.book_storm.thunderhead_strike: Calls a bolt out of the cloud deck onto the foe under your crosshair (28 blocks), hurting it for a bit more than a normal mid hit and slowing it.
nusmp.page.book_storm.hailstone_volley: Five hailstones fan out ahead of you; each one slows its target for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_storm.squall_front: A wall of gale rolls 14 blocks ahead of you, 2.5 blocks wide, and drives everything in it back.
nusmp.page.book_storm.downburst: A column of cold air slams down at the aim point, hitting foes within 5 blocks and pinning them with heavy slowness for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_storm.thundercloud: A small thundercloud follows you for 5 seconds and pelts everything within 6 blocks every second, lifting and pushing it.
nusmp.page.book_storm.tempest_barrage: Calls a bolt down on each of up to eight foes within 12 blocks, one after another four ticks apart.
nusmp.page.book_storm.storm_maelstrom: The whole storm collapses into one great whirl at the aim point, 8 blocks wide, that hurls up to ten foes into the air. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_thread.thread_whip: Snaps a bundle of threads 8 blocks ahead; everything it lashes is dragged toward you. The name echoes the Black Clover M game list, not the series.
nusmp.page.book_thread.tripwire_snare: Hidden trip threads spring up across a 5 block cone and tangle up to four foes, slowing them hard for 3 seconds (Vanessa's Trap Magic style).
nusmp.page.book_thread.thread_needle: A single hard-spun thread flies straight and pins its target: a small hit and weakness for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_thread.thread_cocoon: You wrap yourself in a cocoon of threads for 8 seconds: resistance, an absorption heart and a sting of thorns for whoever hits you. The name echoes the game lists, not the series.
nusmp.page.book_thread.puppet_strings: Strings settle on the foe under your crosshair (16 blocks): it is held in place for a few seconds, takes a small hit and is weakened.
nusmp.page.book_thread.silk_swing: You shoot a thread ahead and swing along it, covering up to 10 blocks at once without hitting anything: a pure move.
nusmp.page.book_thread.razor_weave: A wide net of sharpened threads sweeps a 7 block cone, cutting up to six foes and slowing them for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_thread.stitching_threads: Fine threads stitch wounds shut: you and every ally within 6 blocks recover 15 percent of their health (the healing decay applies). Grows out of her mending of clothes.
nusmp.page.book_thread.thousand_threads: Five homing threads leave your hands, each seeking a foe and hauling it a little toward you as it cuts.
nusmp.page.book_thread.thread_cage: Threads rise in a ring of 5 blocks at the aim point and close over up to eight foes: damage, heavy slowness and weakness for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_thread.crimson_loom: A great red web is woven at the aim point, 8 blocks wide: up to ten foes are hurt, hauled toward its centre and slowed for 4 seconds. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_magma.ember_splash: A spray of molten droplets across a 5 block cone burns every foe it touches for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_magma.lava_whip: A lash of liquid rock cracks 9 blocks ahead and sets whatever it strikes alight.
nusmp.page.book_magma.molten_stride: You skate 6 blocks on a slick of lava, burning anything you pass through.
nusmp.page.book_magma.obsidian_crust: Your skin cools to black glass for 10 seconds: resistance, fire resistance and a burn for those who strike you.
nusmp.page.book_magma.magma_geyser: A geyser of magma bursts at the aim point, lifting up to six foes within 4 blocks and burning them for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_magma.slag_shower: Five clots of slag fly out in a fan; each one that lands burns its target for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_magma.molten_fist: Your fist glows white-hot: a narrow, short blow that burns for 5 seconds and drives the foe back hard.
nusmp.page.book_magma.lava_flow: The ground splits and a river of lava runs 14 blocks ahead, 2.5 blocks wide, burning and slowing up to eight foes.
nusmp.page.book_magma.pyroclastic_surge: A rolling cloud of hot ash and gas pours across a wide 9 block cone, burning and shoving everything in it.
nusmp.page.book_magma.supervolcano: The land around you erupts in an 8 block ring: up to ten foes are burned for 6 seconds, thrown up and pushed away. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_sword.blade_flurry: A quick fan of summoned blades cuts across a 4 block cone in front of you.
nusmp.page.book_sword.sword_step: You vanish into a lunge of 6 blocks, cutting every foe on the line.
nusmp.page.book_sword.light_edge: Throws a single blade of pure light that flies straight and cuts the first foe it meets.
nusmp.page.book_sword.crescent_wave: Releases a wide crescent of cutting force that bursts in 2.5 blocks where it lands, hurting up to six foes.
nusmp.page.book_sword.light_thrust: A needle-thin thrust of light 9 blocks long that runs through everything in a line.
nusmp.page.book_sword.blade_ward: Spectral blades circle you for 10 seconds: a little resistance, and anything that strikes you takes a cut in return.
nusmp.page.book_sword.rising_cleave: An upward cleave that cuts a 4.5 block cone and throws the foes it catches into the air.
nusmp.page.book_sword.sword_storm: A ring of summoned swords whirls around you for 5 seconds and cuts everything within 5 blocks every second.
nusmp.page.book_sword.skyfall_blades: Swords fall out of a rift above the aim point in five places around it, four ticks apart, each cutting the foes beneath it.
nusmp.page.book_sword.sovereign_blade: One enormous blade of light cuts a lane 20 blocks long and 2.5 wide through up to ten foes. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.leg_streng: Reinforces your legs for 8 seconds: Speed II and Jump Boost II, and your next blows hit a little harder.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.rushing_fi: You close 5 blocks in one reinforced step and drive a fist through whoever is in the way.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.reinforced: Hardens your whole body for 5 seconds: Resistance II.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.arm_streng: Reinforces your arms for 10 seconds: Strength II and a bonus on every melee blow. Named after the Leg Strength Boost; not a wiki page.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.shoulder_c: You barge 8 blocks forward shoulder first, hurting and throwing aside everything on the way.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.rising_kic: A reinforced kick from below that lifts every foe in a short 3.5 block cone off the ground.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.ironclad_b: Your skin turns hard as iron for 11 seconds: resistance, an absorption heart and thorns against whoever hits you.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.fist_barra: Six punches in under a second on the foe in front of you (within 5 blocks); together they hit for about one and a half zone hits.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.skyfall_sm: You jump high, then crash down fist first: foes within 5.5 blocks of the landing are hurt and thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.titan_body: Reinforces every muscle for 14 seconds: Strength II, Resistance II, Speed I and a large bonus on every melee blow. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_fire.flame_rope_binding_: A rope of flame ties up the foe under your crosshair (14 blocks): a small burning hit and a short hold.
nusmp.page.book_fire.gamblers_base_run: Flame around your legs launches you 8 blocks forward in a straight sprint that scorches whatever you pass.
nusmp.page.book_fire.cinder_jab: A short burning jab at close range: a narrow 4 block cone that scorches and shoves.
nusmp.page.book_fire.prison_kill_bucksho: Five exploding fireballs seek out separate foes and strike from different angles, burning each for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_fire.smoulder_veil: A veil of embers wraps you for 10 seconds: fire resistance and a burn for anyone who strikes you in melee.
nusmp.page.book_fire.purgatory_cremation: The flames around you burn hotter and hotter for 5 seconds: every second they sear everything within 5 blocks and set it alight for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_fire.flame_lightning_exp: Flame and lightning fused into one beam 18 blocks long that burns and throws back up to eight foes. Played alone it is the flame half of the union.
nusmp.page.book_fire.excelitius_leonum: The spirits of fallen comrades rise as four lions of flame that run down separate foes and burn them for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_fire.purgatory_flame_bur: Coats your body in the fiercest flame for 15 seconds: fire resistance, Strength I, thorns and a large bonus on every melee blow. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_star.quartile_flagellum: A line of starlight joins four stars and is swung like a whip across an 8 block cone, lighting up every foe it touches.
nusmp.page.book_star.twinkle_dart: One bright star-dart that flies straight and marks its target with a glow for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_star.star_conjunction: You step to the point beneath one of your stars, up to 12 blocks ahead, without hitting anything.
nusmp.page.book_star.never_never_land: A field of starlight over 8 blocks makes you faster and stronger for 10 seconds while the foes inside are weakened and slowed. A solo reading of a union spell.
nusmp.page.book_star.star_beam: A beam of starlight 16 blocks long that hurts everything in a line and makes it glow for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_star.star_chain: A chain of stars binds the foe under your crosshair (18 blocks): a small hit, a short hold and a glow for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_star.orbit_barrage: Five small stars leave your orbit and home in on separate foes, making each glow for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_star.stardust_field: Stardust drifts down over the aim point for 5 seconds; everything within 5 blocks is hurt every second, slowed and lit up.
nusmp.page.book_star.meteor_swarm: Six meteors fall around the aim point, six ticks apart, each blasting the foes beneath it. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.spark_shot: A condensed bolt flies where you look and bursts in 2 blocks, slowing what it hits for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.volt_step: You turn into a streak of lightning for 7 blocks and shock everything on the line.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunder_arrow: A single arrow of lightning crosses 22 blocks in an instant and goes through everything in a line.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.lightning_stom: You stamp the ground and lightning runs out through it: foes within 4 blocks are shocked, shoved and slowed for 2 seconds. The name echoes a Black Clover M skill.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.static_aegis: Arcs of static coil round you for 10 seconds: Speed I and a shock for whoever strikes you.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.volt_barrage: Five homing bolts leap from your hands, each seeking a different foe and slowing it for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunderstorm_f: A storm crackles over the aim point for 5 seconds, striking everything within 6 blocks every second and slowing it.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.judgment_bolt: One vast bolt tears a lane 24 blocks long and 2.5 wide, hurting up to ten foes and slowing them for 3 seconds. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.cinder_lash: A lash of black flame cracks across a 6 block cone, burning for 4 seconds and sapping strength.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.soul_brand: A bolt of demon fire burns a brand into whatever it hits: a 3 block burst, 6 seconds of burning and Weakness II.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.inferno_gate: A gate of black flame opens at the aim point for 5 seconds and scorches everything within 5 blocks every second.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_crystal: You create a shell of crystal from your own mana: Resistance and a few absorption hearts for ten seconds.
nusmp.page.book_creation.wind_hawk: Two hawks made of wind streams are created and hunt the nearest foes, striking from the air. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_creation.climbing_coelac: A coelacanth made of mana swims up through the air in a line, hitting what it passes and lifting it off the ground. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_spear: A long spear of mana is thrust forward and pierces everything on its line. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_shield: A created shield orbits you for ten seconds: your melee hits deal more and whoever strikes you is struck back.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_arrows: Four created arrows leave your hand and curve toward the nearest foes. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_chains: Chains made of mana wrap one foe: it is held in place and weakened (the shared control lock applies). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_hammer: A giant hammer is created at the aim point and slams down, knocking everything near it back. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_steed: You create a steed of mana and ride it forward in one rush (a pure move, no damage).
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_cage: Bars of mana close in a cage at the aim point: foes inside take a little damage and are slowed hard for four seconds. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_repairs: A workshop of mana mends you and your allies nearby for a fifth of their health.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_colossu: A colossus of mana rises around you and crashes down: a heavy blast that knocks foes back and leaves them slowed. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mist.mist_doubles: Mist takes your shape while you slip away: mobs hunting you lose your trail and you turn invisible for three seconds.
nusmp.page.book_mist.mist_bullets: Mist is condensed into four water bullets that home in on the nearest foes. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mist.concealing_fog: A thick fog follows you for five seconds: foes inside cannot see you and are blinded, taking light damage. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mist.dew_needles: Three needles of condensed dew fly in a narrow fan. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mist.rolling_fog: A wave of cold fog rolls out in front of you, damaging and slowing foes in the cone. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mist.chilling_haze: A haze closes round you: nearby foes are chilled, slowed and weakened. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mist.vapor_lance: Steam is drawn into a lance and fired in a straight line through every foe on it. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mist.morning_mist: A soft morning mist settles on you and your allies nearby and restores a part of their health.
nusmp.page.book_mist.mist_ambush: You dissolve into mist and re-form behind your target, striking everything on the way. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mist.mist_cloak: A cloak of mist hides you for three seconds and quickens your steps for five.
nusmp.page.book_mist.sea_of_fog: The whole area is drowned in a sea of fog for five seconds: foes inside are blinded, slowed and wounded again and again. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_painting.heat_infused_ic: A circle opens and pours ice over one foe: it is held in place and left brittle (weakened). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_painting.color_splash: A bucket of paint bursts at the aim point: foes in it are hit and blinded for a moment. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_painting.ink_darts: Three darts of wet ink fly from the brush and slow what they hit. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_painting.canvas_screen: You paint a screen before yourself: Resistance and an absorption heart for six seconds.
