nusmp.page.book_painting.gloss_slide: You paint a glossy track under your feet and slide along it (a pure move, no damage).
nusmp.page.book_painting.wet_paint: A patch of wet paint is brushed on the ground: foes standing in it are slowed and take a little damage. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_painting.vague_azur: A wave of azure paint is swept across the field, hitting everything in a wide line and pushing it back. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_painting.etincelle_rouge: A streak of red paint becomes a spark that bursts on impact and sets foes alight. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_painting.verdure_embrace: You paint a green meadow beneath your allies: it restores a fifth of their health.
nusmp.page.book_painting.pigment_storm: A storm of flying pigments rages at the aim point for four seconds, wounding and blinding foes. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_painting.gallery_of_gian: Giants painted on the wall step out of the canvas and stamp down: a heavy blast that knocks foes back and slows them. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_snow.miniature_snow_gard: A tiny garden of drifting snow grows at the aim point: foes inside grow drowsy, slowed and clumsy for a few seconds. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_snow.snow_barrier: A barrier of whirling snow hides the area round you: foes inside cannot see and take a little cold damage. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_snow.snow_binding: Snow piles up and shapes itself round one foe, holding it still (the shared control lock applies). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_snow.snow_powder_burst: A burst of powder snow explodes round you and pushes nearby foes away. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_snow.snowball_barrage: Four hard-packed snowballs are thrown in a fan and slow what they hit. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_snow.frostbite_wind: A freezing wind full of snow sweeps a cone before you: foes are cut, slowed and weakened. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_snow.snow_avalanche: A wall of snow is brought down on the aim point: a heavy blast that buries foes, pushes them back and slows them. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_ice.ice_funeral: Ice closes round you in a crown of spikes: a signature blast on every foe nearby. The ice also holds you, slowing you for three seconds (the canon spell kills the user too; here it only costs you your footing). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_ice.ice_slicer: A sharp icicle rises from the ground and flies at your target, slicing and freezing it in place. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_ice.ice_needle: Two thin needles of ice fly at the foes in front of you. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_ice.jotunns_ice_floe: A ball of ice forms in the air above the aim point and is smashed down half a second later, hitting and slowing everything under it. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_ice.cage_of_infinite_hai: Hail falls without end inside a cage of ice and mist at the aim point: foes in it are pelted and slowed for five seconds. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_ice.endless_ice_fangs: A row of ice fangs bursts out of the ground in a wide line, hitting and throwing foes into the air. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_water.sea_dragon_god_vor: A whirlpool opens at the aim point and drags every foe in it toward its centre, hitting and slowing them. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_water.sea_dragon_god_tai: A tail of water sweeps round in a wide arc and throws back everything it hits. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_water.riptide_undertow: A current seizes one foe by the legs and holds it in place (the shared control lock applies). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_water.riptide_dash: You ride a wave forward, hitting and pushing aside everything on the way. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_water.tidal_geyser: A geyser bursts up under the aim point and throws the foes above it into the air. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.brine_lash: A whip of black brine cracks along a line and slows what it hits. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.drowned_chai: Chains of black water hold one foe in place and sap its strength (the shared control lock applies). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.abyssal_ambu: You sink into the dark water and rise behind your target, striking everything on the way. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.black_deluge: A deluge of black water floods the aim point for five seconds: foes in it are battered and slowed. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.depth_pressu: The pressure of the deep crushes round you: nearby foes are hurt, pushed away and left dizzy. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.mucus_spit: You spit a spray of sticky mucus in a cone: foes are hit and slowed. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.mucus_siphon: A blob of mucus flies at one foe, soaks up a little of its magicule and feeds a part of it to you as health. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.mucus_cocoon: You wrap yourself in a cocoon of mucus: Resistance II and absorption hearts for eight seconds.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.glob_slam: A huge glob of mucus is dropped on the aim point: foes under it are hit, pushed and slowed. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.mucus_whirl: Mucus swirls into a whirlpool at the aim point and drags foes toward its centre, slowing them. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mud.mud_splash: Mud splashes up round you and into the eyes of the foes nearby. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mud.mud_slide: You slide forward on a rush of mud, bumping aside what is in the way. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mud.grasping_mud: A hand of mud grabs one foe and drags it to you. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mud.mud_armor: A hard crust of mud covers you for twelve seconds: your melee hits deal more, you take less, and attackers are struck back.
nusmp.page.book_mud.quagmire: The ground at the aim point turns into a quagmire for five seconds: foes sink in it, are hurt and are slowed hard. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_food.mana_munch: You bite the mana out of one foe: a little damage, a part of its magicule is taken, and you recover some health. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_food.restoring_plate: A plate of warm food restores a part of the health of you and your allies nearby.
nusmp.page.book_food.spice_burst: A cloud of burning spice explodes round you and sets nearby foes alight. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_food.syrup_flood: A flood of sticky syrup spreads at the aim point for four seconds: foes in it are slowed and hurt. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_eye.hypnotic_gaze: Your eyes catch one foe: it is held where it stands, dazed and hurt (the shared control lock applies). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_eye.dazzle_sweep: You sweep your gaze across a wide cone: foes in it are dazzled and blinded for two seconds. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_eye.silencing_gaze: A narrow gaze lands on the foes in front of you and shuts their magic for three seconds. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_eye.watchful_circle: Eyes open round you for four seconds: foes in the circle are hurt, weakened and made visible through walls. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_fang: Three fangs of black ice fly from your hand and slow what they bite. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_chai: Chains of black ice freeze one foe solid for a moment (the shared control lock applies). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_come: A comet of black ice is called down on the aim point and lands a second later, hurting and badly slowing everything under it. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_bubble.soap_slide: You slide forward on a track of soap bubbles (a pure move, no damage).
nusmp.page.book_bubble.bubble_whirl: Bubbles whirl at the aim point and draw the foes into a lifting current. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_bubble.bubble_bath: A warm bath of bubbles rises under you and your allies nearby and restores a fifth of their health.
nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.wedge_anchor: A wedge of ice is driven in beside one foe and anchors it to the spot (the shared control lock applies). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.wedge_spiral: A spiral of wedges drills forward in a line, hitting everything on it and slowing it. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.wedge_cataclys: Giant wedges are called down on the aim point and land three quarters of a second later, hurting and pushing back everything under them. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_gel.gel_whip: A whip of gel wraps one foe and drags it toward you. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_gel.gel_mortar: A lump of gel is lobbed and bursts on impact, splattering and slowing foes round the point. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_gel.gel_flood: A flood of gel covers the aim point for five seconds: foes in it are hurt and held down. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.oil_spray: A spray of black oil washes over the foes in front of you and blights them for two seconds. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.tar_chains: Chains of thick tar hold one foe in place while it is blighted (the shared control lock applies). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.oil_geyser: Oil seeps into the ground at the aim point and erupts in a geyser a second later, hurting, lifting and blighting foes above it. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.eyeball_volley: Three eyeballs are shot from your hand and home in on the nearest foes. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.optic_beam: Your eyeballs line up and fire one beam along a line, hurting and blinding everything on it. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.eyeball_storm: A storm of eyeballs circles you for five seconds: foes near you are hurt, weakened and made visible through walls. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_dream.drowsy_mist: Drowsy Mist - a pastel mist rolls out in front of you; every foe in the cone takes a small hit and grows drowsy (Slowness II and Weakness for 4 seconds). Damage scales with your EP like the rest of the book.
nusmp.page.book_dream.counting_sheep: Counting Sheep - three dream-woolly bolts leap out and home in on the nearest foes, each one slowing what it hits for 1.5 seconds. The tier's damage is shared between the three.
nusmp.page.book_dream.pillow_burst: Pillow Burst - an imagined pillow bursts around you in a cloud of stars and feathers: foes within 3.5 blocks take a light hit and are shoved back.
nusmp.page.book_dream.lucid_step: Lucid Step - you know you are dreaming and simply walk 8 blocks forward through the dream, then keep a burst of Speed II for 3 seconds. A pure move, no damage.
nusmp.page.book_dream.dreamcatcher_ward: Dreamcatcher Ward - a woven ward catches the bad dreams of you and up to five allies within 7 blocks: harmful effects are shaken off and everyone gains Absorption II and Resistance for 10 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_dream.mind_read: Mind Read - you listen to the thoughts of every foe within 12 blocks (up to six): they glow for 8 seconds so you can follow them, and the strain leaves them weakened for 5. No damage.
nusmp.page.book_dream.dream_nightmare_se: Nightmare Seed - a seed of bad dream flies to where you aim and blooms: foes within 2.5 blocks take a hit and are plunged into Darkness and Weakness for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_dream.slumber_field: Slumber Field - a field of drifting dream mist where you aim, 5 blocks wide for 4 seconds: every second foes inside take a pulse and are heavily slowed (Slowness III) and weakened.
nusmp.page.book_dream.pastel_garden: Pastel Garden - a garden of sweets and flowers blooms where you aim for 4 seconds: you and your allies in it are healed a little every second and gain Regeneration, foes in it are slowed.
nusmp.page.book_dream.sleepwalker: Sleepwalker - you drift on through the dream unnoticed: mobs within 16 blocks that hunt you lose you, and you turn invisible and quick (Speed II) for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_dream.eternal_slumber: Eternal Slumber - the whole room falls asleep: up to ten foes within 9 blocks take a heavy hit, then Slowness IV, Weakness and Darkness; if the shared control lock is free they are also frozen (3 seconds on a player, 1 on a boss).
nusmp.page.book_illusion.mirage_prism_ra: Prism Ray - a ray bent through a false mirror runs 10 blocks: every foe along it takes a hit and is slowed for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.afterimage_bolt: Afterimage Bolt - three afterimages of a bolt fan out; whichever is real hits, and anything it touches is dizzied (Nausea) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.vertigo_ring: Vertigo Ring - the floor seems to turn: foes within 3.5 blocks take a light hit, are pushed off balance and left dizzy for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.illusion_mirage: Mirage Walk - you flicker through 9 blocks as a heat-haze double, cutting everyone on the way and blinding them for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.illusory_visage: Illusory Visage - you wear the face of your foes' worst fear: everything in a wide 7 block cone takes a hit, is shoved back, weakened (II) and slowed (II).
nusmp.page.book_illusion.phantom_host: Phantom Host - five phantoms of you rush out and home in on your foes, each blinding what it strikes for a second. The mid-tier damage is shared out between the five.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.paralyzing_illu: Paralyzing Illusion - the foe under your crosshair believes it is bound hand and foot and stops moving (the shared control lock and diminishing returns apply), dizzy for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.endless_corrido: Endless Corridor - the ground where you aim becomes a corridor with no end: for 4 seconds foes within 5.5 blocks keep being drawn back to its middle, slowed, and take a pulse every two seconds.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.curtain_of_lies: Curtain of Lies - a shimmering curtain hides you and up to five allies within 8 blocks (Invisibility for 8 seconds, Speed) and every mob within 18 blocks that hunted you loses the trail.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.illusion_realit: Reality Break - the lie shatters all at once: up to ten foes within 7 blocks take a heavy hit, are thrown back, dizzied for 6 seconds and blinded for 3.
nusmp.page.book_air.air_gust_jab: Gust Jab - a short jab of compressed air in a narrow cone, 4 blocks long: a light hit and a hard shove.
nusmp.page.book_air.air_needles: Air Needles - four thin needles of air fan out; the starter damage is shared between them, so a close foe takes most of them.
nusmp.page.book_air.featherfall_gift: Featherfall Gift - the air thickens under you and up to five allies within 8 blocks: Slow Falling for 20 seconds and a short burst of Speed. Utility, no damage.
nusmp.page.book_air.air_updraft: Updraft - a column of air shoots up around you: foes within 3.5 blocks take a hit and are thrown into the air.
nusmp.page.book_air.compression_lance: Compression Lance - air squeezed into a needle-thin lance that runs 14 blocks and hits everyone on its line.
nusmp.page.book_air.air_pressure_wall: Pressure Wall - a wall of dense air stands in front of you: up to eight enemy projectiles in it are swatted away and foes at it take a hit and a shove.
nusmp.page.book_air.pressure_rampart: Pressure Rampart - a ring of hard air follows you for 4 seconds: whatever comes within 4 blocks is shoved away again and again and takes a small pulse.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.smoke_bomb: Smoke Bomb - a ball of smoke flies to where you aim and bursts: foes within 3 blocks take a light hit and are blinded for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.hermits_thick_smok: Hermit's Thick Smoke - you wrap yourself in a thick cloud: foes within 5 blocks are blinded for 4 seconds and slowed, and you turn invisible for 3. No damage.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.smoke_double: Smoke Double - a puff of smoke takes your place: mobs within 16 blocks that hunted you lose you, and you turn invisible and quick (Speed II) for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.smoke_choking_fume: Choking Fumes - a gout of acrid smoke fills a 7 block cone: foes take a hit, are poisoned and slowed for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.degenerate_kings_s: Degenerate King's Smoke Prison - the foe under your crosshair is walled in by smoke and cannot move (shared control lock, diminishing returns) and cannot see for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.billowing_wall: Billowing Wall - a rolling wall of smoke surrounds you for 4 seconds: foes within 4 blocks are pulsed, blinded and slowed (Slowness II).
nusmp.page.book_smoke.smoke_garden_of_us: Smoke Garden of Usurpation - a garden of poison smoke where you aim, 5 blocks wide for 5 seconds. It never touches you or your allies; foes in it take a pulse every second and are poisoned, weakened and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.eddy_bolt: Eddy Bolt - a spinning bolt that bursts on impact and drags the foes within 2 blocks back toward you.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.swirl_kick: Swirl Kick - a spinning kick sends a whorl of wind through a 4 block cone: a light hit that throws foes aside and a little up.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.vortex_centrifuge: Centrifuge - you spin and fling everything off you: foes within 3.5 blocks take a light hit and are hurled outwards.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.vortex_undertow: Undertow - the air around you turns inwards: foes within 6 blocks take a hit and are dragged toward you (a boss only a third as far).
nusmp.page.book_vortex.vortex_whirlpool_: Whirlpool Snare - a small whirlpool of air closes around the foe under your crosshair and holds it still (shared control lock), dragging it a little toward you.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.vortex_cyclone_la: Cyclone Lance - a corkscrew of wind runs 14 blocks, hitting everything on its line and winding the foes in toward you.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.vortex_maelstrom_: Maelstrom Ring - a ring of turning wind follows you for 4 seconds: foes within 5 blocks are drawn in and pulsed every half second.
nusmp.page.book_wing.feather_flick: Feather Flick - you flick a razor feather that bursts into a puff of down where it lands: a light hit within 1.5 blocks.
nusmp.page.book_wing.wing_downbeat: Downbeat - one great beat of your wings flattens the air around you: foes within 3.5 blocks take a light hit and are pushed back.
nusmp.page.book_wing.glide_grace: Glide Grace - wings of light lift you and up to five allies within 7 blocks: Slow Falling for 20 seconds and Jump Boost II for 10. Utility, no damage.
nusmp.page.book_wing.wing_soaring_leap: Soaring Leap - you beat your wings once and leap high and far forward, with Slow Falling for 6 seconds so the landing is soft. A mobility page, no damage.
nusmp.page.book_wing.wing_talon_rake: Talon Rake - claws of feathers rake a 5 block cone: a mid-tier hit, a push and a short slow.
nusmp.page.book_wing.feather_mantle: Feather Mantle - a mantle of feathers wraps you for 10 seconds: your melee blows hit harder, attackers are pricked, and you gain Resistance and Slow Falling.
nusmp.page.book_wing.skyward_gale: Skyward Gale - a gale lifts off your wings for 3 seconds: foes within 5 blocks are pulsed every second and thrown up and away.
nusmp.page.book_wind.cutting_breeze: Cutting Breeze - three thin crescents of wind fly out in a fan; the starter damage is shared between them.
nusmp.page.book_wind.thiefs_wind_cloud: Thief's Wind Cloud - you gather the wind streams into a cloud and ride it 12 blocks forward, then keep Speed II for 4 seconds and Slow Falling for 5. A mobility page, no damage.
nusmp.page.book_wind.wind_veil: Wind Veil - a veil of wind wraps you for 10 seconds: your melee blows hit harder, attackers are cut by the wind, and you gain Speed II and Slow Falling.
nusmp.page.book_wind.spirit_of_euros: Spirit of Euros - the east wind of Sylph's sister spirit runs 16 blocks along your sight: everything on the line takes a hit, is shoved hard and weakened for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_wind.spirit_of_notos: Spirit of Notos - a shield of wind stands around you for 3 seconds: enemy projectiles within 5 blocks are blown away (up to six per half second), foes are pushed back, and you and your allies there gain Resistance. No damage.
nusmp.page.book_wind.saint_spirit_of_zep: Saint Spirit of Zephyr - Sylph's saint power: a tornado bursts around you (up to ten foes within 6 blocks take a heavy hit and are thrown back) and you gain Speed III, Resistance II, Strength and Slow Falling for 10-15 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sound.tuning_fork_strike: Sound: Tuning Fork Strike - a struck tuning fork throws a ringing bolt that bursts where it lands: a light hit within 1.5 blocks and Weakness for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sound.piercing_shriek: Sound: Piercing Shriek - a high note in a wide 6 block cone: a light hit that leaves foes dizzy for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sound.sonic_echolocation: Sound: Echolocation - a ping rolls out 16 blocks and every foe it finds (up to six) glows for 10 seconds, through walls. No damage.
nusmp.page.book_sound.bass_drop: Sound: Bass Drop - a low note shakes the ground: foes within 5 blocks take a hit, are thrown back and slowed for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sound.subsonic_lance: Sound: Subsonic Lance - a beam of sound too low to hear runs 16 blocks: everything on the line takes a hit and is weakened for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sound.sound_barrier: Sound: Sound Barrier - a wall of standing sound surrounds you for 3 seconds: enemy projectiles within 4.5 blocks are shattered, foes are pushed back and take a small pulse every second.
nusmp.page.book_memory.memory_flashback: Memory: Flashback - foes in a 5 block cone are thrown into a memory so vivid they cannot see the present: a light hit, Blindness and Nausea for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_memory.blank_stare: Memory: Blank Stare - foes within 3.5 blocks of where you aim forget what they were doing: mobs among them drop their target, and all are slowed and weakened for 3 seconds. No damage.
nusmp.page.book_memory.mind_probe: Memory: Mind Probe - you reach into the mind of the living thing under your crosshair (up to 20 blocks): it glows for 10 seconds and is weakened for 5, so you can learn what it does next. No damage.
nusmp.page.book_memory.oblivion_azusa_ar: Memory: Oblivion's Azusa Arrow - Marx's arrow of mana flies true and hits the first foe: a mid-tier hit that wipes its recent memory (a mob drops its target) and leaves it dizzy and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_memory.shared_memory: Memory: Shared Memory - what you know passes to you and up to five allies within 12 blocks as if remembered: Speed, Night Vision and Resistance for 10-15 seconds. Utility, no damage.
nusmp.page.book_memory.memory_labyrinth: Memory: Labyrinth of Recollection - a maze of half-remembered rooms where you aim, 5 blocks wide for 4 seconds: foes in it are pulsed, weakened, slowed, lit up, and mobs keep forgetting whom they hunt.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.magic_slip: Permeation: Magic Slip - for a moment magic and arrows slide through you: enemy projectiles within 4 blocks are removed (up to eight) and you gain Resistance III for 3 seconds. No damage.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.seeping_touch: Permeation: Seeping Touch - your hand passes into the foe in front of you (3 blocks, narrow): a light hit that saps its strength (Weakness II for 4 seconds) and slows it.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.vanish_from_s: Permeation: Vanish from Sight - you slip out of everyone's sight: mobs within 16 blocks that hunted you lose you, and you are invisible and quick (Speed II) for 7 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.unseen_creati: Permeation: Unseen Creation - three invisible creatures you made lunge at the nearest foes: the mid-tier damage is shared between them and none can be seen coming.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.seepage_trap: Permeation: Seepage Trap - the floor under the foe at your crosshair loses its hold, and it sinks, held still (shared control lock) and weakened for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.permeation_ho: Permeation: Hollow Beam - a beam that passes through everything runs 18 blocks: up to eight foes along it take a heavy hit, Weakness II and Slowness II.
nusmp.page.book_soul.soul_chill: Soul: Soul Chill - a cold touch on the soul in a 5 block cone: a light hit, Weakness for 4 seconds and a short slow.
nusmp.page.book_soul.soul_spirit_drain: Soul: Spirit Drain - a wisp of soul flies out and bursts: a light hit within 1.5 blocks, and for each foe hit you recover a little health (healing decay applies).
nusmp.page.book_soul.soul_ward: Soul: Soul Ward - you wrap the souls of you and up to five allies within 8 blocks in a guard: Absorption II for 15 seconds and Resistance for 10. No damage.
nusmp.page.book_soul.soul_mend: Soul: Soul Mend - you set the souls of you and up to five allies within 8 blocks back in order: harmful effects are removed and each heals 18 percent of their health (healing decay applies).
nusmp.page.book_soul.imprint_of_ideals: Soul: Imprint of Ideals - you press an idea on the soul under your crosshair: it stops moving for a moment (shared control lock), forgets whom it hunted and is left weakened and dizzy.
nusmp.page.book_soul.grimoire_tower_link: Soul: Grimoire Tower Link - you tap the stored magic of the towers: up to eight foes within 6 blocks take a heavy hit and lose a beneficial effect, while you and your allies within 8 blocks gain Absorption for 10 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.grasping_dea: Soul Corpse: Grasping Dead - dead hands claw out of the ground where you aim: foes within 3.5 blocks take a light hit and are held by Slowness III for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.corpse_bone_: Soul Corpse: Bone Rattle - three rattling shards of the dead fly out in a fan, weakening what they strike for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.corpse_puppe: Soul Corpse: Puppet Strings - strings of mana lash out along a 12 block line, hit everything on it and reel the foes in toward you.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.corpse_death: Soul Corpse: Death Rattle - the dead around you scream at once: foes within 5 blocks take a hit, are shoved back and withered for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.corpse_reven: Soul Corpse: Revenant Rush - your corpse-puppet body rushes 8 blocks and cuts through everything on the way, withering what it touches for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.soul_abducto: Soul Corpse: Soul Abductor - you call the souls of you and up to five allies within 9 blocks back into their bodies: harmful effects are removed, each heals 25 percent of their health (healing decay applies) and gains Regeneration for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_song.song_forte_bubbles: Song: Forte Bubbles - a bubble filled with Song Magic floats out and bursts where it lands: foes within 2.5 blocks take a light hit and are weakened for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_song.song_silver_spiral: Song: Silver Spiral - a spiral of silver notes runs 14 blocks: everything on it takes a hit, a push and a short slow.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.quicksilver_pool: Quicksilver Pool - a puddle of liquid mercury spreads where you aim (up to 24 blocks). For 3 seconds it pulses once a second in a 3.5 block radius, hurting foes and slowing them heavily; damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_needles: Silver Needles - four needle-fine slivers of mercury fan out from the grimoire; each hit poisons the target for 3 seconds (the attribute page notes mercury is toxic). Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.mercury_whip: Mercury Whip - a lash of liquid silver cracks 9 blocks along your line of sight, hitting everything on it and pushing it back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_skate: Silver Skate - you glide up to 9 blocks forward on a film of mercury without hurting anyone; a pure move to close a gap or get out of one.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_dome: Silver Dome - a flowing dome of mercury closes round you for 6 seconds: Resistance II and two absorption hearts. The dome is the one the Silver Guardian's armour is poured from.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_shackles: Silver Shackles - mercury wraps one target within 18 blocks and sets hard, holding it in place and weakening it. The shared control lock applies; bosses resist it.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_wave: Silver Wave - a breaking wave of mercury rolls 8 blocks in front of you and shoves everything in the cone back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.toxic_quicksilve: Toxic Quicksilver - one dense drop of mercury flies at the target and lodges in the wound: strong poison for 5 seconds and Weakness. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.liquid_metal_tid: Liquid Metal Tide - a wide tide of mercury surges 14 blocks forward, hitting up to 8 foes, throwing them back and slowing them for 3 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.mercury_vortex: Mercury Vortex - a whirlpool of silver opens where you aim (up to 18 blocks) and drags every foe within 5 blocks toward its centre, hurting and slowing them.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_wing_barr: Silver Wing Barrage - five homing spears of mercury, thrown like the beat of the Silver Eagle's wings, seek the nearest foes and poison what they strike. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sand.sand_bullets: Sand Bullets - three packed pellets of sand fly in a short fan. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sand.dust_veil: Dust Veil - a ring of fine dust bursts round you, blinding every foe within 4 blocks for 3 seconds and hurting them a little. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sand.dune_step: Dune Step - you slide up to 9 blocks forward on a wave of sand without hurting anyone, a quick reposition.
nusmp.page.book_sand.sand_whip: Sand Whip - a lash of packed sand cracks 9 blocks forward, hitting everything on the line and pushing it back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sand.sand_wall: Sand Wall - sand rises and sets into a wall of sandstone in front of you (4 wide, 3 high) that crumbles away after 8 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sand.sand_mirage: Sand Mirage - a shimmering double of sand draws the gaze of hunting mobs within 16 blocks, which lose your trail, and you turn invisible for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sand.scouring_sand: Scouring Sand - a cutting gale of grit sweeps 7 blocks in front of you, blinding and slowing everything in the cone. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sand.sinking_dune: Sinking Dune - the ground where you aim turns to loose sand for 4 seconds: foes in a 5 block radius are dragged down (heavy Slowness, Mining Fatigue) and hurt every half second.
nusmp.page.book_sand.sand_cyclone: Sand Cyclone - a cyclone of sand spins up where you aim (up to 18 blocks) and pulls every foe within 5 blocks toward its eye, blinding and hurting them.
nusmp.page.book_sand.dune_collapse: Dune Collapse - a whole dune caves in on the spot you aim at: a 7 block blast throws foes aside, blinds them for 3 seconds and slows them for 4. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_steel.steel_needle: Steel Needle - a hair-thin needle of steel is fired along your line of sight (16 blocks) and pierces everything on it. Damage scales with EP. (Name seen in a game guide, not the manga.)
nusmp.page.book_steel.steel_strike: Steel Strike - a steel-clad blow lands in a short cone in front of you and knocks foes back. Damage scales with EP. (Name seen in a game guide, not the manga.)
nusmp.page.book_steel.lance_vault: Lance Vault - you plant a steel lance and vault up to 8 blocks forward; where you land, foes within 3.5 blocks are hurt and shoved back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_steel.steel_chariot: Steel Chariot - a chariot of steel carries you up to 12 blocks forward, running down everything on the way and shoving it aside. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_steel.steel_coffin: Steel Coffin - plates of steel close round one target within 16 blocks, holding it still and weakening it. The shared control lock applies.
nusmp.page.book_steel.restraining_steel: Restraining Steel - steel bars rise from the ground where you aim for 3 seconds; foes in a 4 block radius are hurt once a second and almost rooted.
nusmp.page.book_steel.steel_plating: Steel Plating - plates of steel fold over you for 10 seconds: Resistance II and two absorption hearts.
nusmp.page.book_steel.lance_downpour: Lance Downpour - a rain of steel lances falls on the spot you aim at for 3 seconds, hitting foes in a 5 block radius every 0.6 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_steel.steel_blade_storm: Steel Blade Storm - a wide fan of spinning steel blades sweeps 9 blocks in front of you, cutting every foe in the cone and pushing it back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_steel.thousand_lances: Thousand Lances - the grimoire sheds lance after lance of steel; five homing lances seek the nearest foes and drive them back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_rock.gravel_spray: Gravel Spray - a handful of gravel is flung in a cone 5 blocks long, stinging and slowing everything it hits. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_rock.flint_shards: Flint Shards - four sharp flakes of flint fly in a fan. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_rock.rockslide_skate: Rockslide Skate - you ride a sliding sheet of rock up to 8 blocks forward without hurting anyone.
nusmp.page.book_rock.rock_fortress: Rock Fortress - a wall of rock studded with spikes rises in front of you (4 wide, 3 high) for 8 seconds; anyone who strikes you meanwhile is cut by thorns.
nusmp.page.book_rock.rolling_boulder: Rolling Boulder - a boulder rolls 12 blocks along your line of sight, hitting everything in its 2 block width and throwing it aside. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_rock.rock_hide: Rock Hide - your skin hardens to rock for 10 seconds: Resistance, stronger melee hits and thorns for whoever strikes you.
nusmp.page.book_rock.avalanche_crush: Avalanche Crush - an avalanche of rock pours over the spot you aim at for 3 seconds: foes in a 6 block radius are hit every half second, pushed and slowed. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_rock.mountain_fall: Mountain Fall - a whole crag drops where you aim: an 8 block blast hurls foes away and leaves them slowed for 4 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.ochre_dust: Ochre Dust - a cloud of red pigment bursts round you; foes within 4 blocks are hurt a little and weakened for 4 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.pigment_darts: Pigment Darts - three darts dipped in red ochre fly in a fan and mark whoever they hit (Glowing for 5 seconds). Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.red_handprint: Red Handprint - a hand of wet ochre is slapped on one target: it glows for 6 seconds and is weakened for 4. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.ancestral_danc: Ancestral Dance - a painted dance calls the ancestors: you and your allies within 8 blocks recover 15 percent of their health (healing decay applies).
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.ochre_spear: Ochre Spear - a spear of hardened red clay is thrown and bursts on impact in a 2.5 block radius, pushing foes back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.ochre_wall: Ochre Wall - baked red clay rises in front of you as a wall (4 wide, 3 high) that crumbles after 8 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.ochre_mire: Ochre Mire - the ground where you aim turns to red mud for 4 seconds: foes in a 5 block radius are bogged down and weakened, and hurt every half second.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.red_earth_rite: Red Earth Rite - the full ritual: red earth erupts round you in a 7 block circle, weakening foes for 6 seconds, slowing them and pushing them back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_stone.pebble_shot: Pebble Shot - three stones are flicked from the grimoire in a short fan. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_stone.stone_fist: Stone Fist - your fist is wrapped in stone and the blow lands in a short cone, knocking foes back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_stone.stone_skin: Stone Skin - your skin turns to stone for 8 seconds: Resistance and a stronger melee hit.
nusmp.page.book_stone.granite_lance: Granite Lance - a row of granite spikes tears up the ground for 14 blocks and tosses what it hits into the air. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_stone.pillar_burst: Pillar Burst - pillars of stone burst up at the spot you aim at, lifting every foe within 4 blocks. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_stone.boulder_drop: Boulder Drop - a shadow marks the ground where you aim; a second later a boulder lands there and hurts every foe within 3.5 blocks. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_stone.quarry_collapse: Quarry Collapse - the ground where you aim caves in with falling stone for 4 seconds: foes in a 6 block radius are hit every half second and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_stone.colossus_stampede: Colossus Stampede - a colossus of stone charges 22 blocks forward, trampling everything in a 3 block lane and flinging it up and aside. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.ore_shard_shot: Ore Shard Shot - one sharp shard of ore is fired at the target. Damage scales with EP. (Inspired by the Mineral Fragment skill of a mobile game, not the manga.)
nusmp.page.book_mineral.mineral_assault: Mineral Assault - ore thrusts up out of the ground along 8 blocks of your line of sight and tosses foes on it. Damage scales with EP. (Name seen in a mobile game, not the manga.)
nusmp.page.book_mineral.ore_sight: Ore Sight - the grimoire hums at the veins of living things: every foe within 5 blocks is hurt a little and shown Glowing for 8 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.talos_doll: Talos Doll - a doll of ore in your image stands where you were: mobs within 16 blocks lose your trail and you turn invisible for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.heavy_armored_ti: Heavy Armored Titan - heavy ore armour grows over you for 12 seconds: Resistance II, two absorption hearts, stronger melee hits and thorns for whoever strikes you.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.geode_burst: Geode Burst - a geode is thrown and cracks open on impact, spraying shards over 3.5 blocks and pushing foes back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.talos_doll_army: Talos Doll Army - a troop of ore dolls rises round you for 4 seconds and strikes every foe within 5 blocks twice a second while it holds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.colossal_ore_fis: Colossal Ore Fist - a fist of solid ore as big as a house drives 16 blocks forward, smashing through a 3 block lane and hurling foes away. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.grit_slash: Grit Slash - a blade of sandstone grit cuts a cone 4.5 blocks long, blinding what it touches for 2 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.sandstone_hurl: Sandstone Hurl - a lump of sandstone is thrown and bursts on impact in a 2 block radius. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.sandstone_leap: Sandstone Leap - a sandstone block flings you up to 7 blocks forward; where you land, foes within 3 blocks are hurt and slowed. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.rock_fall: Rock Fall - rocks come down where you aim after a short warning (1.2 seconds), hurting every foe within 4 blocks and pushing them back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.sandstone_shel: Sandstone Shell - sandstone hardens over you for 10 seconds: Resistance, stronger melee hits and thorns for whoever strikes you.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.quarry_sweep: Quarry Sweep - a slab of sandstone is swept along 12 blocks of ground, hitting everything in its 2 block width and pushing it aside. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.rock_storm: Rock Storm - a storm of rock whirls over the spot you aim at for 4 seconds: foes in a 6 block radius are battered every half second, pushed and slowed. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_earth.rising_ground: Rising Ground - the earth under the spot you aim at heaves up and throws every foe within 3.5 blocks into the air. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_earth.ground_wall: Ground Wall - a wall of earth stands between you and the blow: for 5 seconds you have Resistance II and one absorption heart.
nusmp.page.book_earth.mud_wall_cliff: Mud Wall Cliff - a cliff of packed mud rises in front of you (4 wide, 3 high) and slumps away after 8 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_earth.dirt_clod_seal: Dirt Clod Seal - clods of earth cling to one target within 14 blocks and set, sealing it in place and weakening it. The shared control lock applies.
nusmp.page.book_earth.giant_king_of_wisd: Giant King of Wisdom - a giant of earth rises round you for 4 seconds and stamps every foe within 6 blocks twice a second, pushing them away. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_earth.march_of_holy_fool: March of Holy Fools - a procession of earthen figures marches 18 blocks forward, trampling everything in a 2.5 block lane, pushing it back and slowing it. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.gilded_darts: Gilded Darts - three darts of gilded black alloy fly in a fan. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.patina_step: Patina Step - you slip up to 8 blocks forward behind a dark sheen of patina without hurting anyone.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.inlay_snare: Inlay Snare - gold wire inlays itself round one target within 16 blocks and pulls tight, holding and weakening it. The shared control lock applies.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.black_gold_wave: Black Gold Wave - a wave of molten black gold rolls 8 blocks in front of you and shoves foes back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.gilded_kiln: Gilded Kiln - the grimoire becomes a kiln: for 4 seconds a ring of glowing alloy round you scorches every foe within 5 blocks twice a second. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.refraction_veil: Refraction Veil - light bends round you: mobs within 16 blocks lose your trail and you turn invisible for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.geode_trap: Geode Trap - a geode is buried where you aim; after 1.2 seconds it cracks and sprays crystal over every foe within 3.5 blocks, hurting and slowing them. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.crystal_tide: Crystal Tide - a wave of growing crystal surges 16 blocks forward in a 3 block lane, pushing foes back and slowing them for 3 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_glass.lens_flare: Lens Flare - the grimoire focuses a sudden glare: foes within 4 blocks are hurt a little and blinded for 3 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_glass.glass_wall: Glass Wall - a wall of clear glass appears in front of you (4 wide, 3 high) and shatters away after 8 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_glass.stained_glass_fiel: Stained Glass Field - coloured panes rise round the spot you aim at for 4 seconds; foes in a 5 block radius are cut every half second, slowed and dazzled. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_filings: Iron Filings - a gust of iron filings blasts 5 blocks in front of you, scouring, blinding and slowing what it hits. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_iron.magnetic_pull: Magnetic Pull - the grimoire turns into a lodestone at the spot you aim at (up to 16 blocks) and drags every foe within 4 blocks toward it, hurting them.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_curtain: Iron Curtain - a curtain of iron drops round you for 8 seconds: Resistance II and three absorption hearts.
nusmp.page.book_copper.spark_coil: Spark Coil - a coil of copper throws a ball of sparks that bursts over 2 blocks and jolts foes (brief Slowness). Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_copper.voltaic_pulse: Voltaic Pulse - a pulse runs through the copper round you: foes within 5 blocks are shocked, shoved back and slowed. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_copper.lightning_rod: Lightning Rod - a copper rod is driven in where you aim; one second later the charge discharges and hits every foe within 4.5 blocks, slowing them. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.ruby_flare: Ruby Flare - a ruby flares red round you: foes within 3.5 blocks are hurt and set alight for 2 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.sapphire_salve: Sapphire Salve - a calm blue light spreads from the grimoire: you and your allies within 8 blocks recover 15 percent of their health (healing decay applies).
nusmp.page.book_bronze.bronze_gong: Bronze Gong - the grimoire rings like a great gong: the shockwave hurts foes within 5 blocks, shoves them away and weakens them for 4 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_sprout: Bone Sprout - bones sprout from the ground in a straight row ahead of you and throw the foes standing on it into the air. A 6-block line: up to 4 foes take a starter hit and are lifted.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_blade: Bone Blade - the user shapes a bone into a sword and cuts a wide arc in front of them (the wiki: bones can be shaped into weapons like swords). A 3.5-block cone: up to 4 foes take a starter hit.
nusmp.page.book_bone.branching_bone: Branching Bone - the bone splits and branches into several sharpened points that fly out in a fan (the wiki: bones branch in multiple directions and end in points). Four bone points, about 1.2 starter hits shared between them.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_thicket: Bone Thicket - a bed of short bone spikes grows where you aim and cuts and slows whoever crosses it. A 3.5-block field for 3 seconds: a small hit every 0.6 seconds and slowness.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_extension: Extending Bone - a bone grows out of the hand to a great length and runs the foes in front of you through (the wiki: bones can extend to great lengths). A 14-block line: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and are knocked back.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_wall: Ossuary Wall - a wall of fused bone rises in front of you and crumbles again after 8 seconds. A 4 wide, 3 high wall of temporary bone blocks; nothing is damaged.
nusmp.page.book_bone.splinter_burst: Splinter Burst - bones burst out of the body in every direction in a ring of splinters. A 4.5-block ring around you: up to 6 foes take a mid hit, are thrown back and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_regrowth: Bone Regrowth - the user's own bone grows back over torn flesh and mends the wound (the wiki: with Soul, Body and Blood Magic bone gives recovery far beyond Healing Magic; here the bone alone gives a smaller version). Heals 30 percent of your health.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_forest: Bone Forest - a stand of tall bones grows where you aim and spears whatever is inside it. A 5-block field for 5 seconds: a zone hit every half second to up to 8 foes, each lifted a little.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_cage: Bone Cage - ribs of bone close around the foes at the aim point and hold them in place. A 5-block burst where you aim: up to 8 foes take a zone hit and are slowed heavily for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_bone.thousand_bone_grave: Thousand Bone Grave - a mound of bone erupts where you aim, over and over, and buries everything inside it. A 7-block field for 5 seconds: up to 10 foes take a heavy pulse every half second and are slowed.
nusmp.page.book_dark.dark_cloaked_afteri: Dark Cloaked Afterimage - Yami blurs forward in a straight cut and leaves a black afterimage behind (an extension page after the Iai Slash). You dash up to 6 blocks and hit up to 4 foes on the way.
nusmp.page.book_dark.umbral_lance: Umbral Lance - a thrown spear of darkness that slows the foe it pierces (an extension page after Death Thrust). One bolt: a starter hit and slowness for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_dark.gloom_cloak: Gloom Cloak - darkness wraps the body and makes it quick and hard to hit in the dim. For 10 seconds you are faster and your melee hits deal a little extra.
nusmp.page.book_dark.void_snare: Void Snare - a tiny black hole closes round the foe you look at and holds it for a moment (a small cousin of Black Hole). One target within 14 blocks takes a small hit and is held slow.
nusmp.page.book_dark.dark_cloaked_crossi: Dark Cloaked Crossing Slash - a flurry of crossed cuts of darkness in a wide arc (a tamer sister of the Avidya Wild Slash). A 5-block cone: up to 6 foes take a mid hit.
nusmp.page.book_dark.midnight_wave: Midnight Wave - a wide crescent of darkness sweeps down a long lane and shoves the foes in it back. A 14-block lane: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and are knocked back.
nusmp.page.book_dark.devouring_shade: Devouring Shade - the shadow of the blade swallows the magic on the foes in front of you, as the Avidya Slash swallows spells, and feeds you a little. A 6-block cone: up to 6 foes lose one beneficial effect and you heal for each hit.
nusmp.page.book_dark.crescent_barrage: Dark Cloaked Crescent Barrage - five blades of darkness seek the nearest foes. About 1.2 mid hits shared between the five blades.
nusmp.page.book_dark.abyssal_pit: Abyssal Pit - the ground at the aim point turns to a pit of darkness that drags at everything inside. A 5-block field for 4 seconds: a zone hit every half second to up to 8 foes and slowness.
nusmp.page.book_dark.eclipse_fall: Eclipse Fall - a dark moon drops on the aim point and blots out the light of everyone beneath it. A 6-block burst where you aim: up to 8 foes take a zone hit and are plunged into darkness for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_dark.avidya_blunt_strike: Dark Cloaked Avidya Blunt Strike - Yami strikes with the dull back of the darkness-coated blade, a blow that knocks the wind out of the foe instead of cutting. A 3.5-block cone: a starter hit, strong knockback and a short daze.
nusmp.page.book_dark.black_cocoon: Dark Cloaked Black Cocoon - Yami wraps himself in a shell of darkness against an attack of Light Magic. For 5 seconds you take far less damage and have two hearts of absorption.
nusmp.page.book_dark.dusk: Dark Cloaked Dusk - the light fails around Yami and the foes lose sight of him. Foes within 7 blocks are plunged into darkness and slowed, and you move faster for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_dark.black_blade_shadow_: Black Blade Shadow Strike - Yami slips into the foe's shadow and cuts from behind with the lengthened black blade. You blink behind the target you look at and hit up to 6 foes on the way.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.shadow_needles: Shadow Needles - needles of shadow shoot out of the user's own shadow. Three needles in a fan share about 1.2 starter hits.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.grasping_hands: Grasping Hands - hands of shadow rise from the foe's own shadow and hold it, as they do in the Dark Garden Invitation. One target within 14 blocks takes a small hit and is held slow.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.shadow_slip: Shadow Slip - the user sinks into their own shadow and rises a few steps ahead (a short cousin of the Shadow Corridor). You move up to 8 blocks forward; nothing is hit.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.umbral_shroud: Umbral Shroud - shadow clothes the user like a ninja's garb and hides them from sight. For 8 seconds you are invisible and quicker, and your melee hits deal a little extra.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.doppelganger: Doppelganger - the user slips into a shadow and comes out behind the foe, striking as one with a mirrored cut. You blink behind the target you look at and hit up to 6 foes on the way.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.shadow_eruption: Shadow Eruption - a pool of shadow opens under the user and throws everything near up in a burst of black hands. A 4.5-block ring: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and are lifted.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.veil_of_night: Veil of Night - a sheet of night is thrown over the foes in front of the user and blinds them. A 7-block cone: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and are blinded for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.shadow_double: Shadow Double - a double of shadow draws the eyes of the hunters while the user melts away. Mobs that hunt you within 16 blocks lose you and you turn invisible for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.unite_canis_equus: Unite Mode: Canis x Equus - Nacht takes Gimodelo and Slotos into himself at once and his power leaps to a high devil's. For 15 seconds you are stronger and tougher, your melee hits deal extra and strike back at attackers.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.endless_night: Endless Night - the night spreads over the aim point and does not lift. A 6-block field for 5 seconds: a zone hit every half second to up to 8 foes, who are weakened and kept in darkness.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.shadow_prison: Shadow Prison - the shadows of the foes at the aim point turn solid and pin them where they stand. A 5-block burst: up to 8 foes take a zone hit and are slowed to a crawl for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.walpurgis_night: Walpurgis Night - Nacht joins all four devils with the two Dark Magic users and the shadows rise as one. A 8-block field around you for 5 seconds: up to 10 foes take a heavy pulse every half second and are slowed.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_lash: Ash Lash - a whip of ash cracks down a lane and leaves the foes withering. An 8-block lane: up to 4 foes take a starter hit and wither for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_ash.pitfall_trap: Pitfall Trap - Zora draws an ash circle where the foe will step and the ground gives way under it. An ash trap lies at the aim point for 5 seconds: the first foe to step within 2 blocks springs it, and up to 4 foes within 2.5 blocks take a starter hit and are rooted.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_step: Ash Step - the user turns to a puff of ash and drifts a few steps ahead. You move up to 8 blocks forward; nothing is hit.
nusmp.page.book_ash.mine_trap: Mine Trap - a circle of ash that bursts when it is stepped on. An ash mine lies at the aim point for 5 seconds: the first foe within 1.8 blocks springs it and up to 6 foes within 3.5 blocks take a mid hit and are thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_ash.smothering_ash: Smothering Ash - a heavy cloud of ash is blown into the foes' faces. A 6-block cone: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and are blinded and slowed for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_barricade: Ash Barricade - ash packs into a dark wall in front of you and blows away again after 8 seconds. A 4 wide, 3 high wall of temporary blocks; nothing is damaged.
nusmp.page.book_ash.cinder_rain: Cinder Rain - glowing cinders from the ash fall in a spray (Ash Magic is derived from Flame). Five cinders in a fan share about 1.2 mid hits and set the foes alight for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_ash.smoldering_ground: Smoldering Ground - the ground at the aim point turns to hot ash that withers whatever stands on it. A 5-block field for 5 seconds: a zone hit every half second to up to 8 foes, who wither.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_sentinels: Ash Sentinels - ash rises into guards round the user and strikes whatever steps close. A 3.5-block field that follows you for 5 seconds: up to 8 foes in it take a zone hit every half second and are pushed off.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_storm: Ash Storm - the ash round the user whirls up into one great gust. A 6-block ring around you: up to 8 foes take a zone hit, are thrown back and are blinded for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_blood.jets_of_blood: Jets of Blood - the user releases high-pressure streams of blood from the body (the wiki: they can also speed up projectiles). A 9-block lane: up to 4 foes take a starter hit and are pushed back.
nusmp.page.book_blood.blood_spikes: Blood Spikes - blood hardens into spikes that skewer the foes in front of you (Vanica skewers Charlotte's limbs with spikes of blood in the manga, but the series gives the move no name). A 7-block lane: up to 4 foes take a starter hit.
nusmp.page.book_blood.blood_surge: Blood Surge - the user rides a rush of their own blood forward and drinks a little from what they cut. You dash up to 7 blocks, hit up to 4 foes on the way and heal a little for each.
nusmp.page.book_blood.scaffold_of_fresh_: Scaffold of Fresh Blood - a flood of blood soaks the ground and crosses of blood rise and hold whoever stands there. A 4-block burst where you aim: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and are held almost still for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_blood.puppet_bloodflow: Puppet Bloodflow - the user takes hold of the blood in the foe's own body and steers it like a puppet. One target within 16 blocks takes a hit and is held slow.
nusmp.page.book_blood.curse_breaking_blo: Curse-Breaking Blood Cocoon - veins of blood wrap the wounded part in a dark orb, heal it and strengthen the body (the wiki). You heal 25 percent of your health and every harmful effect on you is lifted.
nusmp.page.book_blood.lifeblood_scythe: Lifeblood Scythe - the user shapes a great deal of blood into a giant scythe and swings it by hand (the wiki, Blood Creation Magic). A 5-block half-circle sweep: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and you heal a little for each.
nusmp.page.book_blood.blood_frenzy: Blood Frenzy - the blood runs hot and the body moves past its limit. For 12 seconds you are stronger and faster and your melee hits deal extra.
nusmp.page.book_blood.thorn_sigil: Crimson Thorn Sigil - a sigil of blood is drawn on the ground and thorns rise from it again and again (the picture of Vanica's blood sigil). A 5-block field for 4 seconds: a zone hit every half second to up to 8 foes, and you heal a little for each hit.
nusmp.page.book_blood.sanguine_eruption: Sanguine Eruption - blood bursts up out of the ground at the aim point like a geyser. A 5-block burst where you aim: up to 8 foes take a zone hit, are thrown up and back.
nusmp.page.book_light.photon_lance: Photon Lance - a needle of light thrown in one flash (the fast, thin cousin of the Light Sword of Judgment). One bolt: a starter hit that ends in a flash.
nusmp.page.book_light.radiant_flare: Radiant Flare - the user bursts into a flash too bright to look at. A 5-block ring around you: up to 4 foes take a starter hit and are blinded for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_light.radiant_ward: Radiant Ward - a skin of light closes round the user and takes the force out of blows. For 6 seconds you take much less damage and have two hearts of absorption.
nusmp.page.book_light.dawn_beam: Dawn Beam - a straight beam of light across the field at the speed of light. An 18-block beam: up to 6 foes on it take a mid hit.
nusmp.page.book_light.protecting_light: Demon-Dweller Sword: Protecting Light - Light Magic is passed through the sword to the allies, who are quickened and shielded. You and up to 5 allies within 8 blocks get speed and damage resistance for 8 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_light.storm_of_light_imp: Storm of Light Imperial Swords of Conviction - a rain of light swords that find their foes (Patolli with Drowa's mirrors). Five homing swords share about 1.2 zone hits.
nusmp.page.book_light.quintet_sword_of_j: Light Magic: Elemental Quintet - a giant Light Sword of Judgment is launched while the streams of four other magics swirl round it (the wiki; the other four mages are not needed here). A 22-block, wide lane: up to 10 foes take a heavy hit and are thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_light.karna_gibbous_ray: Moonlight Magic: Gibbous Ray - a swelling ray of moonlight that bursts where it lands. One bolt that bursts in a 4-block ball: up to 6 foes take a mid hit.
nusmp.page.book_light.karna_moon_trap: Moonlight Magic: Moon Trap - a circle of moonlight lies in wait and snaps shut on whoever steps in. A moon trap lies at the aim point for 5 seconds: the first foe within 2 blocks springs it and up to 6 foes within 3.5 blocks take a mid hit and are held slow.
nusmp.page.book_curse.hex_needle: Hex Needle - a needle of curse that saps the strength of what it pricks (the wiki: curse magic adds lasting negative effects). One bolt: a starter hit and weakness for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_curse.wasting_touch: Wasting Touch - a curse laid on at arm's length that wastes the body and the appetite. A short 3-block cone: up to 4 foes take a starter hit, wither for 4 seconds and go hungry.
nusmp.page.book_curse.jinx: Jinx - ill luck is hung on the foes at the aim point (the dulled senses and misfortune of the wiki's curses). A 3-block burst where you aim: up to 4 foes take a starter hit, are unlucky for 10 seconds and stumble.
nusmp.page.book_curse.plague_wind: Plague Wind - a wind of sickness blown over the foes in front of you (the wiki: curses range from dulled senses to debilitating sickness). An 8-block cone: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and are poisoned and weakened for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_curse.effigy_curse: Effigy Curse - a doll takes the foe's name and whatever is done to it, the foe feels. One target within 16 blocks takes a hit, is held slow and is weakened for 6 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_curse.hex_swarm: Hex Swarm - a swarm of small curses homes in on the nearest foes. Five homing hexes share about 1.2 mid hits and poison for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_curse.rotting_ground: Rotting Ground - the ground at the aim point is cursed and eats whatever stands on it. A 5-block field for 5 seconds: a zone hit every half second to up to 8 foes, who wither.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.spell_seve: Spell-Severing Curse - a curse that cuts the magic off a foe (the wiki: curses can weaken and disable enemy spells). One bolt: a starter hit, one beneficial effect stripped and weakness for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.quickening: Quickening Curse - a beneficial curse laid on oneself that mends the body at speed (the wiki: curses can give high-speed regeneration). For 8 seconds you regenerate quickly and your melee hits deal extra.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.detonation: Detonation Hex - a curse that makes the power inside the foes burst (the wiki: curses can detonate a person's magic power; Exploding Life is the great form). A 3.5-block burst where you aim: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and are thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.rune_field: Rune Field - warding runes are laid over the aim point and burn whoever walks them. A 5-block field for 5 seconds: a zone hit every half second to up to 8 foes and slowness.
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.black_light_: Black Light Ray - a thin beam of black light, faster and denser than its Light Magic counterpart (the wiki). A 16-block beam: up to 4 foes take a starter hit.
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.demon_arrows: Demon Light Magic: Arrows of Judgment - the black-light form of the Light Magic spell of blades that rain on the target (the spell is Light Magic's on the wiki; the black version is this mod's). Five homing arrows share about 1.2 mid hits.
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.demon_heaven: Demon Light Magic: Heaven-Splitting Flash - the black-light form of the Light Magic flash that splits the sky (the spell is Light Magic's on the wiki; the black version is this mod's). A 6-block burst where you aim: up to 8 foes take a zone hit and are blinded for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.dispelling_th: Dispelling Thrust - a short thrust of the demon sword that tears the magic off what it hits. A 3.5-block cone with a greatsword in hand: up to 4 foes take a starter hit and lose one beneficial effect.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_sweep: Black Sweep - one wide flat swing of the demon sword that clears the space round Asta. A 5-block half-circle with a greatsword in hand: up to 4 foes take a starter hit and are knocked back.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_guard: Black Guard - Asta holds the blade across his body and cuts whatever magic flies at him. Projectiles within 4.5 blocks that are not yours are cut down and you take much less damage for 2.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.causality_bre: Demon-Destroyer Sword: Causality Break - the sword's tendrils cut the link between a spell and its effects, so the effect is undone. Every harmful effect on you is lifted and up to 6 foes in the 6-block cone lose a beneficial effect and take a hit.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_slash_b: Black Slash Barrage - the Black Slash fired five times in a fan. About 1.2 mid hits shared by five slashes; needs a greatsword in hand.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.dweller_fligh: Demon-Dweller Sword: Flight - Asta rides the light Demon-Dweller Sword on his Anti-Magic and shoots forward. You move up to 12 blocks forward; nothing is hit.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.magic_negatin: Magic-Negating Barrier - a dome of Anti-Magic that cancels what the enemy throws at it (the wiki: the Demon-Destroyer Sword makes a barrier that negates Atmosphere Magic). For 4 seconds every projectile within 5 blocks that is not yours is cut down and you take less damage.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.devils_claw: Devil's Claw - the devil's own claw rakes out of the dark and the wounds do not close. A 4.5-block cone: up to 4 foes take a starter hit and wither for 3 seconds. Pays the forbidden price (health) and announces itself.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.contract_bolt: Contract Bolt - the written contract flares and flies as a bolt of hellfire. One bolt that bursts in a 2.5-block ball: a starter hit and 3 seconds of fire. Pays the forbidden price and announces itself.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.soul_siphon: Soul Siphon - a thread is pulled from the foes' souls into the devil's host and pays back part of the price. A 10-block lane: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and you heal for each. Pays the forbidden price and announces itself.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.devils_bargai: Devil's Bargain - power now, paid for in blood: the devil lends its strength for a short time. For 10 seconds you are much stronger and faster and your melee hits deal extra. Pays the forbidden price and announces itself.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.damned_cry: Cry of the Damned - a scream from the underworld that throws back everything near and saps it. A 5-block ring around you: up to 6 foes take a mid hit, are thrown back and weakened for 4 seconds. Pays the forbidden price and announces itself.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.condemned_vol: Condemned Volley - four dark marks of the contract hunt down their foes. Four homing marks share about 1.2 mid hits. Pays the forbidden price and announces itself.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.abyssal_chain: Abyssal Chains - chains from the pit close on whatever stands at the aim point. A 5-block field for 5 seconds: a zone hit every half second to up to 8 foes and slowness. Pays the forbidden price and announces itself.
nusmp.page.book_compass.needle_flick: Flicks one golden compass needle straight ahead; the first foe it touches takes a light hit.
nusmp.page.book_compass.bearing_step: Takes a bearing and steps up to 8 blocks forward along it, a short move without a hit.
nusmp.page.book_compass.magnet_draw: Draws the foe under your crosshair in towards you with a magnetic tug and hits it lightly on the way.
nusmp.page.book_compass.true_heading: The compass settles on true north: you run faster for ten seconds and your melee hits carry a little extra weight.
nusmp.page.book_compass.lodestone_snare: A lodestone needle pins one foe in place: heavy slowness for a few seconds and a small hit (shares the control cooldown).
nusmp.page.book_compass.cardinal_volley: Four homing needles, one for each cardinal point, each seeking a different foe.
nusmp.page.book_compass.declination_wave: A wave of bent magnetic force in front of you that hurts and shoves foes far off their line.
nusmp.page.book_compass.dead_reckoning: Plots a straight course and drives a long needle along it, hitting everything on the line.
nusmp.page.book_compass.safe_bearing: The compass points the way to safety: you and your allies nearby regain a part of their health.
nusmp.page.book_compass.magnetic_storm: A storm of scattered needles at the aim point for four seconds: foes inside are hit every half second and dragged slow.
nusmp.page.book_compass.meridian_lance: A huge needle along the meridian: a long, wide line that hits hard and shoves foes along it.
nusmp.page.book_compass.cardinal_burst: All four points of the compass fire at once in a ring around you, hurting and knocking back everything close.
nusmp.page.book_copy.borrowed_strike: A copied swing: a short narrow sweep in front of you that hurts and nudges foes back.
nusmp.page.book_copy.echo_step: You step 7 blocks forward and leave an echo of yourself behind; a plain move, no hit.
nusmp.page.book_copy.touch_and_learn: Touching foes close to you copies a little of their vigour: a small burst that hurts them and heals you slightly.
nusmp.page.book_copy.returned_blow: For six seconds you copy every blow aimed at you: attackers take a little of it back and your own hits are stronger.
nusmp.page.book_copy.delayed_echo: Hits one foe, then the copy of the strike lands again about a second later for a smaller hit.
nusmp.page.book_copy.mimic_fan: A fan of copied force in front of you; foes it touches are hurt and weakened for four seconds.
nusmp.page.book_copy.imitated_fetters: Copies the bindings of other mages and wraps one foe in them: heavy slowness and a small hit (shares the control cooldown).
nusmp.page.book_copy.copycat_pounce: You blink behind the foe you look at and strike it in the back as you pass.
nusmp.page.book_copy.hall_of_echoes: Echoes of every blow fill the aimed spot for four seconds: foes inside are hit every half second and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_copy.chorus_of_copies: A choir of your copies sings at the aimed spot and blasts everything round it away.
nusmp.page.book_copy.perfect_reproductio: The strongest copy: a huge burst around you that shoves foes away and strips one beneficial effect from each, copying it for the moment.
nusmp.page.book_dice.snake_eyes: Throws a pair of dice that burst in a small blast where they land and slow the foes they hit.
nusmp.page.book_dice.pip_toss: Three dice tumble out in a fan, each stinging the first foe it meets.
nusmp.page.book_dice.lucky_seven: The dice come up seven: ten seconds of speed and luck, and your blows hit a little harder.
nusmp.page.book_dice.dice_cup_shake: Shakes a cup of dice in front of you and spills them: a short cone that hurts and knocks foes back.
nusmp.page.book_dice.critical_roll: Rolls a d20 against the foe you look at: a natural 20 hits for half again as much, a natural 1 barely scratches, anything else scales with the roll.
nusmp.page.book_dice.double_or_nothing: Rolls two dice: seven or more and a burst round you hits hard, otherwise it is only a small hit.
nusmp.page.book_dice.bowling_roll: Rolls a heavy die along the ground in a line that hits everything on it and knocks foes aside.
nusmp.page.book_dice.snare_roll: Throws a d20 at one foe and pins it where it lands: heavy slowness for a few seconds (shares the control cooldown).
nusmp.page.book_dice.reroll: Throws the bad result away: clears up to four harmful effects from you and gives a few seconds of regeneration.
nusmp.page.book_dice.craps_table: A table of tumbling dice at the aimed spot for four seconds: foes inside are hit every half second and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_dice.rain_of_dice: Five homing dice rain out over your foes and knock them about.
nusmp.page.book_slash.rending_cut: A quick narrow cut of mana blades in front of you that rends whatever it meets.
nusmp.page.book_slash.cross_slash: Two crescents fly out one after the other, crossing in front of you like an X.
nusmp.page.book_slash.razor_flurry: A spinning flurry of short cuts all round you that hits every foe within arm's reach.
nusmp.page.book_slash.edge_guard: Blades along your forearms turn every blow aimed at you: for six seconds attackers are cut back and your own hits are stronger.
nusmp.page.book_slash.crescent_salvo: Five projected crescents fan out in front of you.
nusmp.page.book_slash.severing_line: One long straight cut that slices everything on a 14 block line.
nusmp.page.book_slash.blade_cyclone: A cyclone of blades round you that cuts nearby foes and lifts them off the ground.
nusmp.page.book_slash.hamstring_cut: A low slash that flies straight and cuts the legs of the foe it hits: heavy slowness for four seconds.
nusmp.page.book_slash.parrying_blades: For three seconds your blades cut arrows and magic bolts out of the air before they reach you (at most three per step).
nusmp.page.book_slash.final_slash: The last cut: a long, wide slash that severs everything on its line and throws foes aside.
nusmp.page.book_slash.reaper_field: Blades dance round you for three seconds, hitting every foe that comes close, every half second.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.gravity_jab: A short heavy jab in front of you: foes it hits are hurt and weighed down, slowed for two seconds.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.ground_slam: You bring your own weight down on the ground: a burst of crushing force that hurts and slows foes within reach.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.featherfall: Lets go of your own weight for ten seconds: no fall damage and a higher jump, and your blows stay a little heavier.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.pressure_lane: Presses a lane of heavy air along the ground in front of you: foes on it are hit and pinned down by slowness for three seconds.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.inward_pull: Draws every foe around the aimed point into a tight knot and hits them for half a blow.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.anchor_weight: Hangs an anchor of weight on the foe you look at: heavy slowness for a few seconds (shares the control cooldown).
nusmp.page.book_gravity.weightless_burst: Takes the weight from foes round you for a moment: they are hit and thrown up into the air.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.gravity_singular: A small black hole at the aimed point drags foes in for two seconds, then collapses and crushes everything it holds.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.falling_weight: Drops a huge weight on the aimed spot: foes under it are hit, shoved away and slowed for three seconds.
nusmp.page.book_game.health_potion: Drinks a potion and shares it: you and your allies close to you regain a part of their health.
nusmp.page.book_game.warp_tile: A warp tile under your feet throws you 8 blocks forward; a plain move, no hit.
nusmp.page.book_game.button_mash: Four quick d20 shots in a row, each stinging the first foe it meets.
nusmp.page.book_game.skip_turn: The foe you look at loses its turn: frozen in place for a few seconds (shares the control cooldown).
nusmp.page.book_game.fog_of_war: Covers the map round you in fog: foes close to you are hit and blinded for three seconds.
nusmp.page.book_game.combo_chain: A rush of hits as you move 9 blocks forward: everything on the way is struck.
nusmp.page.book_game.loot_drop: Foes close to you drop their loot in a burst: they are hurt and you regain a little health.
nusmp.page.book_game.boss_arena: Locks an arena round the aimed spot for five seconds: foes inside are hit every half second and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_game.random_encounter: A game board opens under the foes at the aimed spot and each rolls its own d20: low rolls take a heavy hit, high rolls nearly dodge it.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.archangel_shootd: Launches a sphere of spatial force that bursts where it lands and erases one beneficial effect from every foe it catches.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.rift_step: Steps through a rift 8 blocks ahead; a plain move, no hit.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.crevice_men: Opens a crack in space along a line in front of you: foes on it are hit and slowed for two seconds.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.blackout: Black matter carries you and up to three allies within five blocks to the point you aim at (20 blocks at most).
nusmp.page.book_spatial.rift_burst: Tears space open at the aimed point: a burst that hurts and throws foes away (the wiki's Spatial Rupture is already a page of the Bone book, so this one has its own name).
nusmp.page.book_spatial.archangel_destru: Five homing spheres of erasing force seek your foes and strip a beneficial effect from each.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.different_dimens: Seals one foe in a sphere of another dimension: held still for a few seconds (shares the control cooldown).
nusmp.page.book_mirror.shard_shot: A shard of mirror glass flies straight and shatters on the first foe it meets.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.glint_flash: A blinding flash off a mirror round you: foes close to you are hurt and blinded for two seconds.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.silver_backing: A silver backing on your skin for eight seconds: damage taken is reduced and attackers are hit back.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.prism_split: A beam is split by a prism into three homing rays.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.large_reflect_ref: Large mirrors bounce magical light between them and destroy what is in the way: a wide, long beam that shoves foes aside.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.hall_of_mirrors: A hall of mirrors at the aimed spot for four seconds: foes inside are hit every half second and slowed as they lose their way.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.mirrors_meteor_dr: A dragon of mirror light runs 22 blocks along your aim and lands as a meteor at its end: everything on the line is hit, foes at the end take half a blow more.
nusmp.page.book_time.stopwatch_strike: Starts a stopwatch on the foe you look at: a quick hit and a second of slowness as its time runs back.
nusmp.page.book_time.borrowed_second: Borrows a second from tomorrow: you heal a little and move faster for three seconds.
nusmp.page.book_time.frozen_instant: Catches the foe you look at in a frozen instant: a hit, then two seconds in which it can hardly move or strike.
nusmp.page.book_time.dial_back: Turns the dial back on everything round you: foes are hit, pushed back where they stood a moment ago and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_time.slow_hour: Five slow hours over the aimed spot: a clock face hangs there and foes inside are dragged slow and hurt every half second.
nusmp.page.book_legion.bishops_reach: The bishop strikes along a long straight line: everything on it is hit.
nusmp.page.book_legion.queens_charge: The queen charges 9 blocks forward, striking and knocking back everything on her path.
nusmp.page.book_legion.checkmate_field: A board of checks at the aimed spot for four seconds: foes inside are hit every half second and kept from running.
nusmp.page.book_key.lock_pick: A thin pick flies straight and springs the lock on the first foe it meets: it takes a hit and loses one beneficial effect.
