nusmp.page.book_world_tree.dracaena_form: Dracaena Formation - roots of the world tree burst up in a ring 4.5 blocks wide where you aim (up to 24 blocks): up to 6 foes take 12 base damage, are lifted a little and slowed (Slowness IV, 3.5 seconds). The wiki names the spell without a description, so the ring is the mod's reading; Root Bind stays the single-target version.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.sapling_lance: Sapling Lance - a lance of living sapling wood flies up to 38 blocks and bursts 1.5 blocks wide: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes, and the sap mends you 1 health for each foe it hits.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.mana_root_sip: Mana Root Sip - a thin root drinks from the foe you look at (16 blocks): 7 base damage, and 2 percent of its magicules flow to you.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.mistilteinn_t: Mistilteinn Thorn Barrage - four homing thorns of Mistilteinn wood fan out from the page, together about 8.4 base damage (2.1 each), and each hit slows for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.branch_sweep: Branch Sweep - a great branch sweeps a wide cone 6 blocks long in front of you: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and a shove back.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.root_spring: Root Spring - roots spring you forward up to 8 blocks; up to 4 foes on the way take 7 base damage and are shoved aside.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.canopy_shelte: Canopy Shelter - a canopy of branches opens over you and up to 7 allied players within 6 blocks for 8 seconds: Resistance I and Absorption II.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.heartroot_men: Heartroot Mending - the sap of the heartroot mends you and allied players within 7 blocks for 15 percent of their maximum health (the healing decay of the law applies).
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.warding_root_: Warding Root Net - a net of roots closes 4 blocks wide at the point you aim at (24 blocks): up to 6 foes take 12 base damage, Slowness V and Weakness for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.living_root_w: Living Root Wall - mangrove roots knit a wall four blocks wide and three high 2.5 blocks in front of you for 8 seconds; it stops charges and shots.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.spirit_light_: Spirit Light Tree - a tree of shining branches ties you to your allies: for 5 seconds, every second you and up to 7 allied players within 8 blocks mend 4 percent of their health and keep Regeneration I and Speed I. The wiki's union spell shares magic through the tree; the sword half is not built, only the sharing.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.root_eruption: Great Root Eruption - great roots erupt round you in a ring 6 blocks wide: up to 8 foes take 16 base damage, are thrown up and slowed (Slowness IV, 3 seconds).
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.mana_drinking: Mana-Drinking Field - for 4 seconds a field of drinking roots pulses round you every second: up to 8 foes within 6 blocks take 5 base damage, are slowed and lose 1.5 percent of their magicules to you.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.world_tree_aw: World Tree Awakening - the whole world tree wakes round you: for 5 seconds, every second up to 10 foes within 8 blocks take 7 base damage, are held in Slowness V and lose 2 percent of their magicules, while you and your allies mend 5 percent of your health and keep Regeneration II.
nusmp.page.book_poison.venom_needle_voll: Venom Needle Volley - four poison needles fan out from the page, together about 8.4 base damage (2.1 each); every hit poisons for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_poison.blight_spit: Blight Spit - a glob of blight flies up to 38 blocks and bursts 1.5 blocks wide: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and Poison II for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_poison.badger_burrow: Poison Badger Burrow - in the manner of Aufwachen Dachs a poison badger tunnels you forward up to 7 blocks; up to 4 foes on the way take 7 base damage and Poison I for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_poison.withering_touch: Withering Touch - a close cone of rotting breath 3.5 blocks long: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and Wither I for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_poison.miasma_mantle: Miasma Mantle - for 10 seconds a mantle of miasma clings to you: Resistance I, 6 extra base damage on your melee blows, and whoever strikes you is pricked for 2.
nusmp.page.book_poison.antidote_draught: Antidote Draught - a poisoner knows the cure: you and up to 7 allied players within 6 blocks lose every harmful effect, mend 10 percent of their health and keep Regeneration I for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_poison.paralytic_sting: Paralytic Sting - one foe within 14 blocks is stung and held (hard control, shares the 12 second control lock, short on players and bosses): 6 base damage and Poison II.
nusmp.page.book_poison.poison_fog_bomb: Poison Fog Bomb - a bomb of poison fog bursts 4 blocks wide at the point you aim at (24 blocks): up to 6 foes take 12 base damage, Poison II and Blindness for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_poison.venom_rain: Venom Rain - a rain of venom falls 5 blocks wide at the point you aim at for 4 seconds: every second up to 8 foes take 5 base damage and Poison II.
nusmp.page.book_poison.pestilence_stream: Pestilence Stream - a stream of plague breath runs 14 blocks along your sight, 2.5 wide: up to 8 foes take 16 base damage, Poison II and Weakness for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_poison.deluge_of_venom: Deluge of Venom - a flood of venom pours over the point you aim at (20 blocks) for 5 seconds: every second up to 10 foes within 8 blocks take 7 base damage, Poison II and Weakness.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.cotton_ball_toss: Cotton Ball Toss - a fist of cotton is tossed up to 38 blocks and bursts 1.5 blocks wide: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and a soft shove.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.lamb_charge: Lamb Charge - a woolly lamb carries you forward up to 8 blocks; up to 4 foes on the way take 7 base damage and are knocked aside.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.wool_volley: Wool Volley - five homing tufts of wool, together about 8.4 base damage (1.7 each); every hit slows for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.cotton_spring: Cotton Spring - a sheep of cotton springs you about 6 blocks forward and up, and you drift down softly (slow falling for 2 seconds); no fall damage.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.cotton_candy_snac: Cotton Candy Snack - a sweet puff of spun cotton: you and up to 7 allied players within 4 blocks mend 6 percent of their health and are fed.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.wool_wall: Wool Wall - a wall of fluffy wool four blocks wide and three high rises 2.5 blocks in front of you for 8 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.drowsy_wool_mist: Drowsy Wool Mist - a mist of drifting wool fluff settles 4 blocks wide at the point you aim at (24 blocks): up to 6 foes take 12 base damage and grow drowsy (Slowness IV and Weakness II for 5 seconds).
nusmp.page.book_cotton.warm_wool_blanket: Warm Wool Blanket - a warm blanket of wool wraps you and up to 7 allied players within 6 blocks: 8 percent of their health mended, Regeneration I for 5 seconds and Absorption I for 10.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.sheep_stampede: Sheep Stampede - a flock of cotton sheep thunders 14 blocks along your sight, 3 wide: up to 8 foes take 16 base damage, are thrown back and slowed for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.cotton_meadow: Cotton Meadow - a meadow of soft cotton spreads 6 blocks wide at the point you aim at for 5 seconds: every second you and your allies there mend 4 percent and keep Regeneration I, while foes sink in it (Slowness III).
nusmp.page.book_cotton.sleepy_sheep_para: Sleepy Sheep Parade - five great sheep march out of the page and home in on the foes: together about 31 base damage (6.2 each), and every hit leaves Slowness V for 4 seconds and Weakness II for 5.
nusmp.page.book_plant.magic_flower_bulle: Magic Flower Bullet - a small bud of mana is fired up to 38 blocks and blooms 1 block wide where it lands: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes. The small cousin of the Magic Flower Cannon; the effect is the mod's reading.
nusmp.page.book_plant.pollen_puff: Pollen Puff - a cloud of pollen puffs out in a cone 5 blocks long: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes, Weakness for 4 seconds and Slowness II for 3.
nusmp.page.book_plant.bloom_leap: Bloom Leap - a flower bursts under your feet and flings you about 6 blocks forward and up; when you land the petals burst 3.5 blocks wide for 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and a short slow.
nusmp.page.book_plant.sunflower_beam: Sunflower Beam - a sunflower turns its face and fires a beam of light 16 blocks along your sight: 12 base damage to up to 6 foes, who also glow for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_plant.wisteria_ward: Wisteria Ward - hanging wisteria shields you and up to 7 allied players within 5 blocks: Absorption II for 10 seconds and Resistance I for 5.
nusmp.page.book_plant.lullaby_blossom: Lullaby Blossom - a blossom sings one foe within 16 blocks into a stupor (hard control, shares the 12 second control lock, short on players and bosses): 6 base damage and Weakness II.
nusmp.page.book_plant.princess_healing_f: Princess Healing Flower Garden - a garden of healing flowers blooms round you for 5 seconds: every second you and up to 7 allied players within 7 blocks mend 5 percent of their health and keep Regeneration I. The lesser sister of Flower Princess Utopia; the effect is the mod's reading.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.petal_bur: Petal Burst - the petals round you burst outward 3.5 blocks: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and a shove back.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.blossom_s: Blossom Spring - a gust of blossoms springs you about 5 blocks forward and up and lets you drift down softly (slow falling for 2 seconds); no fall damage.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.sakura_la: Sakura Lance - petals braid into a lance that runs 16 blocks along your sight: 12 base damage to up to 6 foes and Blindness for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.petal_cyc: Petal Cyclone - a cyclone of petals whirls round you, 5 blocks wide: up to 6 foes take 12 base damage, are blinded for 2.5 seconds and thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.scent_of_: Scent of Spring - the scent of spring blossoms lifts you and up to 7 allied players within 6 blocks: 8 percent of their health mended, Speed II and Regeneration I for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.falling_p: Falling Petal Rain - petals fall like rain 6 blocks wide at the point you aim at for 4 seconds: every second up to 8 foes take 5 base damage and Blindness for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_briar.thorn_spike_row: Thorn Spike Row - a row of thorned briars shoots up along the ground 10 blocks ahead: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and Poison I for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_briar.thorn_javelin: Thorn Javelin - a javelin of braided thorns flies up to 38 blocks and pricks the first foe it meets: 7 base damage and Poison I for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_briar.bramble_cage: Bramble Cage - brambles close round one foe within 16 blocks (hard control, shares the 12 second control lock, short on players and bosses): 6 base damage and Poison I.
nusmp.page.book_briar.briar_whirl: Briar Whirl - briars whirl out from you in a ring 4.5 blocks wide: up to 6 foes take 12 base damage, are thrown back and poisoned for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_briar.healing_rose: Healing Rose - a rose blooms at your feet: you and up to 7 allied players within 5 blocks lose every harmful effect, mend 10 percent of their health and keep Regeneration I for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_briar.wild_rose_thicket: Wild Rose Thicket - a thicket of wild roses fills 6 blocks at the point you aim at for 5 seconds: every second up to 8 foes take 5 base damage, Poison I and Slowness III.
nusmp.page.book_tree.acorn_barrage: Acorn Barrage - four hard acorns fan out from the page, together about 8.4 base damage (2.1 each), each with a small knock back.
nusmp.page.book_tree.branch_snap: Branch Snap - a branch snaps across a cone 5 blocks long: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and a shove back.
nusmp.page.book_tree.sap_trap: Sap Trap - sticky sap glues one foe within 16 blocks in place (hard control, shares the 12 second control lock, short on players and bosses): 6 base damage and Weakness.
nusmp.page.book_tree.rooted_stance: Rooted Stance - for 10 seconds you stand like an old trunk: Resistance II, 6 extra base damage on your melee blows, and whoever strikes you is pricked for 2.
nusmp.page.book_tree.whirling_leaf_storm: Whirling Leaf Storm - a storm of leaves whirls round you for 5 seconds: every second up to 8 foes within 6 blocks take 5 base damage, Blindness and Slowness II.
nusmp.page.book_vine.hooking_vine: Hooking Vine - a hooked vine snags the foes at the point you aim at (16 blocks, 2.5 blocks wide) and hauls them toward you: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes.
nusmp.page.book_vine.thrashing_vines: Thrashing Vines - vines thrash across a cone 5 blocks long: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and Slowness II for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_vine.vine_whirl: Vine Whirl - vines whirl out from you in a ring 4.5 blocks wide: up to 6 foes take 12 base damage, are thrown back and slowed for 2.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_vine.sapping_vine: Sapping Vine - a vine shoots up to 38 blocks and bursts 2 blocks wide: 12 base damage to up to 6 foes, and it feeds you 2 health for each foe it hits.
nusmp.page.book_vine.creeping_overgrowth: Creeping Overgrowth - the ground at the point you aim at is overgrown for 5 seconds: every second up to 8 foes within 6 blocks take 5 base damage and Slowness IV.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.nightshade_: Nightshade Dart - a dart tipped with nightshade flies up to 38 blocks and pricks the first foe it meets: 7 base damage and Poison II for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.stinging_ne: Stinging Nettle Whip - a whip of stinging nettle runs 8 blocks along your sight: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes, Poison I for 3 seconds and Slowness II for 2.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.venom_pod_b: Venom Pod Burst - a venom pod bursts 3.5 blocks wide at the point you aim at (24 blocks): up to 6 foes take 12 base damage, Poison II for 5 seconds and Wither I for 2.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.foxglove_se: Foxglove Seize - foxglove closes round one foe within 14 blocks and slows its heart (hard control, shares the 12 second control lock, short on players and bosses): 6 base damage and Poison II.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.hemlock_haz: Hemlock Haze - a haze of hemlock spores hangs 6 blocks wide at the point you aim at for 5 seconds: every second up to 8 foes take 5 base damage, Poison II and Blindness.
nusmp.page.book_beast.tiger_pounce: Tiger Pounce - the legs coil like a tiger's and you pounce about 7 blocks forward; where you land, up to 4 foes within 3.5 blocks take 7 base damage and a short slow.
nusmp.page.book_beast.hawk_eye: Hawk Eye - the eyes sharpen like a hawk's: up to 4 foes within 14 blocks glow for 8 seconds, so they can be seen through cover.
nusmp.page.book_beast.holy_hunting: Holy Hunting - the hunt: you flash up to 12 blocks to the foe you look at (16 blocks) and land behind it, hitting everything on the way for 12 base damage (up to 6 foes) and marking them with Glowing for 5 seconds. Needs a target.
nusmp.page.book_beast.bogeyman: Bogeyman - a monstrous shape looms round you, 5 blocks wide: up to 6 foes take 12 base damage, are blinded for 3 seconds and left in Weakness II for 5.
nusmp.page.book_beast.holy_howling: Holy Howling - a howl rolls out in a wide cone 10 blocks long: up to 8 foes take 16 base damage, are thrown back hard and weakened for 5 seconds. Yrul's howl calls a dragon in the manga; the mod keeps the shock wave.
nusmp.page.book_body.shoulder_tackle: Shoulder Tackle - you drive forward up to 6 blocks with a shoulder; up to 4 foes on the way take 7 base damage and are thrown aside.
nusmp.page.book_body.pressure_point_jab: Pressure Point Jab - a finger into the right spot on the foe you look at (5 blocks): 7 base damage and Weakness for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_body.adrenaline_surge: Adrenaline Surge - the body floods itself with adrenaline: for 8 seconds you gain Speed II, Strength I and Jump Boost I.
nusmp.page.book_body.second_wind: Second Wind - the body finds a second wind: you and up to 7 allied players within 4 blocks lose every harmful effect and mend 15 percent of their health (the healing decay of the law applies).
nusmp.page.book_body.titan_shockwave: Titan Shockwave - you slam both fists down and a shock wave runs out 6 blocks: up to 8 foes take 16 base damage and are thrown up and back.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.mushroom_cap_boun: Mushroom Cap Bounce - a giant cap sprouts under your feet and bounces you about 5 blocks forward and up; where you land the spores burst 3.5 blocks wide for 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and Poison I.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.puffball_barrage: Puffball Barrage - five homing puffballs burst on the foes, together about 14 base damage (2.9 each); every hit poisons for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.deathcap_garden: Deathcap Garden - a garden of deathcaps springs up 5 blocks wide at the point you aim at for 5 seconds: every second up to 8 foes take 5 base damage, Poison II and Weakness.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.chimera_tail: Chimera Tail Lash - the chimera's serpent tail lashes 7 blocks along your sight: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and Weakness for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.cerberus_tri: Cerberus Triple Bite - three spectral heads of Cerberus snap at the nearest foes, together about 14 base damage (4.8 each); each bite mends you 1 health.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.underworld_s: Underworld Stampede - a stampede of underworld beasts thunders 14 blocks along your sight, 3 wide: up to 8 foes take 16 base damage, are thrown back and weakened (Weakness II, 4 seconds).
nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal_stamp: Seal Magic: Sealing Stamp - a small seal is thrown at the first foe it meets and bursts there: the foes in 1.5 blocks take a light hit, a mage among them finds the grimoire shut for two seconds (a boss for one), and all are slowed. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.sealing_needles: Seal Magic: Sealing Needles - four needles of sealing light fly out and seek the nearest foes; each hit is small but cuts the foe's casting for one and a half seconds (Magic Jamming). Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal_ward_mark: Seal Magic: Ward Mark - a ward is sealed onto your own skin: a seal laid on you by another mage breaks at once, and for eight seconds you have Absorption II and Resistance I.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal_rune_lattic: Seal Magic: Rune Lattice - a lattice of runes unfolds in a wide cone ahead of you: every foe in it takes a hit, is slowed (Slowness III, 2.5 s) and cannot cast for two seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal_gate_closin: Seal Magic: Closing Gate - the seal that shuts what is open is thrown down a 14 block line: every foe on it is hit, shoved back and has its casting shut for 2.5 seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.protective_seal: Seal Magic: Protective Seal - a ward seal on you and up to five allies within eight blocks: Absorption II and Resistance I for ten seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal_sigil_burst: Seal Magic: Sigil Burst - a sigil is laid where you look and bursts: foes within 4.5 blocks are hit, pushed away and cannot cast for two seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal_sigil_field: Seal Magic: Sigil Field - a field of sigils lies for four seconds where you look; every half second the foes inside take a pulse, are slowed and cannot cast. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal_pillars: Seal Magic: Pillars of Seal - six pillars of sealing light rise one after another along a 12 block line ahead of you: every foe on it is hit, thrown up a little, slowed and cannot cast for two seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.forbidden_seal_a: Seal Magic: Forbidden Seal Art - the art that sealed a devil, aimed at the foe in your crosshair (18 blocks): it and the foes within five blocks of it are struck hard, rooted (hard control: shares the twelve-second lock, shortened for players and bosses), their grimoires shut for up to eight seconds and their casting cut. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_skin.skin_leather_lash: Skin Magic: Leather Lash - the skin of your arm is stretched and cracked like a whip across a four block cone: foes in it are hit and shoved back. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_skin.skin_hardened_hide: Skin Magic: Hardened Hide - your skin hardens for five seconds: Resistance II, but you are stiff (Slowness I). Meant for the blow you can see coming.
nusmp.page.book_skin.soft_skin: Skin Magic: Soft Skin - your skin goes soft as rubber for eight seconds: Absorption III soaks the next blows and you fall slowly. The other half of the hide: it takes what a hard skin would turn.
nusmp.page.book_skin.peeling_skin: Skin Magic: Peeling Skin - four flaps of your own skin peel off and fly after the nearest foes; each hit weakens its target for three seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_skin.skin_bristling_hide: Skin Magic: Bristling Hide - for ten seconds your skin bristles with hard scales of skin: your melee hits deal extra damage and whoever strikes you is pricked back. Bonus scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_skin.skin_graft: Skin Magic: Skin Graft - fresh skin is grafted over every wound: all harmful effects leave you, a broken seal on you is undone and a fifth of your health returns (the heal decays if you were healed a moment ago).
nusmp.page.book_skin.skin_stretch: Skin Magic: Stretching Skin - your skin is pulled out like a sling and snaps you nine blocks forward; everything you pass through is hit and shoved aside. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_skin.skin_wrap: Skin Magic: Skin Wrap - a sheet of skin wraps the foe in your crosshair and holds it still (hard control: shares the twelve-second lock, three seconds on a player, a boss for one) and weakens it. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_skin.skin_blistering_fie: Skin Magic: Blistering Field - the ground you point at becomes a field of raw, blistering skin for four seconds; every half second the foes in it take a pulse, are slowed and weakened. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_skin.skin_cast_off: Skin Magic: Cast-Off Skin - you shed your whole skin in a blast: foes within six blocks are hit hard, thrown back and weakened. The empty skin draws every hunter off you while you slip away unseen for four seconds with Speed II and Absorption II. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_lash: Tongue Magic: Tongue Lash - your tongue shoots eight blocks ahead and lashes every foe on the line, slowing it for a second and a half. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_snatch: Tongue Magic: Tongue Snatch - the tongue hooks the foe in your crosshair (14 blocks), hits it and reels it to you (hard control: shares the twelve-second lock; a boss is hit but not pulled). Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_acid_spit: Tongue Magic: Acid Spit - a gob of acid spat at the first foe or wall it meets; the foes in 1.5 blocks are hit and poisoned for three seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_whip_crack: Tongue Magic: Whip Crack - the tongue is swung round in a wide arc and cracks across a six block cone: every foe in it is hit and thrown back hard. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_swing: Tongue Magic: Tongue Swing - the tongue sticks to the block or foe you aim at (3 to 22 blocks) and drags you across, with Slow Falling for 2.5 seconds. A way across, not a weapon.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_savouring_: Tongue Magic: Savouring Lick - a long wet lick across a short cone: foes in it are hit and a little of their life flows to you (the heal decays like every heal). Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_numbing_sa: Tongue Magic: Numbing Saliva - a glob of numbing saliva flies to the first foe or wall and bursts over three blocks: foes in it are hit, slowed (Slowness III) and weakened for three seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.wrapping_tongue: Tongue Magic: Wrapping Tongue - the tongue winds round the foe in your crosshair (16 blocks) and holds it fast (hard control: shares the twelve-second lock, three seconds on a player, a boss for one). Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_lashing_ba: Tongue Magic: Lashing Barrage - five lashes in a row on the foe in your crosshair, a quarter of a second apart, each a little shove; together they hit for a bit more than one big blow. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_great_swal: Tongue Magic: Great Swallow - the tongue snares the foe in your crosshair (14 blocks), drags it to your feet and hits it hard; two thirds of a second later the maw closes on it again for half as much, and you are healed a little (hard control: shares the twelve-second lock; a boss is bitten but not dragged). Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_switching.switching_plac: Switching Magic: Place Swap - you and the foe in your crosshair (16 blocks) trade places in the blink of an eye, and it is slowed for a second and a half. Fails if either spot would be inside a wall.
nusmp.page.book_switching.blink_switch: Switching Magic: Blink Switch - you swap your place with an empty spot seven blocks ahead (the furthest free one, never inside a wall). A pure move, no damage.
nusmp.page.book_switching.switching_inve: Switching Magic: Inversion Pulse - the push is switched for a pull: foes within 4.5 blocks are hit and dragged in towards you instead of thrown away. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_switching.ailment_swap: Switching Magic: Ailment Swap - up to three harmful effects on you (poison, slowness, weakness ...) are switched onto the foe in your crosshair, for at most five seconds and the second level; it also takes a light hit. Fails if you carry none.
nusmp.page.book_switching.aggro_switch: Switching Magic: Aggro Switch - the hatred of up to six creatures within ten blocks is switched: each turns on the next one instead of on you, and is dizzy for two seconds. Players and bosses are not switched. Needs two creatures.
nusmp.page.book_switching.foe_swap: Switching Magic: Foe Swap - two foes near the point you look at trade places and are dizzy for two and a half seconds, each taking a hit: the archer stands in the front line and the brute behind it. Needs two foes and room for both.
nusmp.page.book_switching.up_down_switch: Switching Magic: Up-Down Switch - up and down trade places for the foes within four blocks of the point you look at: they are hit and float up for a second. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_switching.switching_tang: Switching Magic: Tangle Field - left and right are switched in a field you lay where you look for four seconds: every half second the foes inside take a pulse, are dizzy and stumble towards the middle. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_switching.shuffling_barr: Switching Magic: Shuffling Barrage - five switch-marks fly after the nearest foes; each hit drags its target a step towards you instead of away. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_switching.grand_reversal: Switching Magic: Grand Reversal - everything within eight blocks is switched: every foe (up to ten) takes the place of the next one, whatever it was doing, and is hit and dizzy for four seconds. Needs two foes; a foe whose new place is inside a wall stays where it was. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_door: Recombination: Door Slam - a door of the magic house swings out of nowhere and slams across a four block cone: foes in it are hit and thrown back. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_plan: Recombination: Plank Volley - three planks torn from the house fly out in a fan 14 blocks long; a foe on any of them is hit once. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_stai: Recombination: Stair Leap - a flight of stairs forms under your feet and throws you up and forward; you fall slowly for two seconds. A way up a ledge or over a gap.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_chim: Recombination: Chimney Cannon - a chimney of the house is turned on its side and fires a beam of mana 18 blocks: every foe on the line is hit and thrown back. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_trap: Recombination: Trapdoor - the floor under the point you look at is recombined into a trapdoor: foes within 3.5 blocks drop, are hit and slowed (Slowness IV, 3 s). Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_scaf: Recombination: Scaffold Span - scaffolding is built under you and up to five allies within eight blocks: Speed I, Jump Boost II and Slow Falling for eight seconds.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_roof: Recombination: Roof Slam - a roof tears off the house and comes down on the point you look at: foes within five blocks are hit hard, slowed and thrown outward. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_hall: Recombination: Hallway Maze - the rooms of the house are shuffled into a maze at the point you look at for four seconds: every half second the foes in it take a pulse, are slowed and lose their way (dizzy). Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_coll: Recombination: House Collapse - the magic house is pulled apart over the point you look at and drops: after a warning of under a second everything within seven blocks is hit very hard, slowed and thrown up and out. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemic_c: Transmutation: Copper Bolts - a bolt of transmuted copper flies to the first foe or wall and bursts; the foes in 1.2 blocks are hit and weakened for two seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemic_s: Transmutation: Sand Shower - the air ahead is turned to a spray of sand across a five block cone: foes in it are hit and blinded for two seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemic_r: Transmutation: Rubber Spring - the ground under you is turned to rubber and throws you high into the air; you fall slowly for four seconds, so the landing is soft.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemic_l: Transmutation: Lead Weights - the foe in your crosshair is turned heavy as lead: it is held in place (hard control: shares the twelve-second lock, three seconds on a player, a boss for one) and weakened. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemic_b: Transmutation: Brass Whips - a wide band of air is turned to brass and cracked down a ten block line: every foe on it is hit and thrown back. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemic_s: Transmutation: Salt Flats - the ground you look at is turned to salt for five seconds; every half second the foes on it take a pulse, are slowed and wither. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemic_i: Transmutation: Iron Rain - the sky above the point you look at is turned to iron and falls for four seconds: every third of a second the foes in 4.5 blocks take a pulse and are jolted. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.living_sta: Transformation: Living Statue - everything within five blocks of the point you look at is changed to stone: the foes there are hit very hard and stand frozen, weak and clumsy (hard control: shares the twelve-second lock, four seconds on a mob, three on a player, a boss for one). Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_hand_sway: A hand drawn across the air in a slow arc: the flow leaves it as a cone of water four and a half blocks long, hits every foe in it and slows it for a second and a half. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_heel_stamp: The heel comes down once and the floor answers: a ring of water bursts round you, hits the foes within three and a half blocks and pushes them away. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_mirror_step: The dancer steps through the foe like a reflection and comes out behind it: you blink behind the foe in your crosshair (16 blocks), hitting everything on the way. Fails with no foe in sight or no room behind it. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_serpent_arm: The arm winds out nine blocks like a snake of water and coils back: every foe on the line is hit and drawn in towards you. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_echo_step: The dancer leaves an ink afterimage where they stood and is gone: mobs hunting you lose your trail, you are unseen for three seconds and quick (Speed I).
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_crescendo: The dance builds beat by beat round you for four seconds: every half second the foes within five blocks (the field moves with you) take a pulse, lose their rhythm (Magic Jamming) and are slowed. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_modification.modificatio: Modification: Scalpel Cut - a clean cut of edited flesh across a six block line: every foe on it is hit and its wound will not close (Wither for two seconds). Damage scales with your EP.
Modification: Adrenal Edit - your own body is rewritten for six seconds: Speed II and Strength I.

Modification: Nerve Edit - the nerves of the foe in your crosshair are cut for a moment: it is held (hard control: shares the twelve-second lock, three seconds on a player, a boss for one) and weakened. Damage scales with your EP.

Modification: Cell Regrowth - your cells are told to grow back: every harmful effect leaves you, a broken seal on you is undone and a quarter of your health returns (the heal decays if you were healed a moment ago).
Modification: Mutagen Field - a field of mutagen laid where you look for four seconds: every half second the foes in it take a pulse, are poisoned and weakened. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_hair.hair_reach: Hair Reach: your hair shoots out sixteen blocks and lashes every foe on the line, slowing it for a second and a half. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_hair.hair_needles: Hair Needles: five strands of hair stiffen into needles and fly after the nearest foes, thin enough to slip through a guard. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_hair.hair_wall: Hair Wall: hair is woven into a wall round you for three seconds: spells and arrows that come within four blocks are unravelled (at most four at a time), and you gain Absorption I.
nusmp.page.book_hair.hair_spear: Hair Spear: your hair is braided into a spear and thrust twelve blocks ahead: every foe on the line is hit, shoved back and weakened for two seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_hair.hair_forest: Hair Forest: hair grows up out of the ground where you look and tangles round every ankle for four seconds: the foes in it take a pulse every half second and are slowed (Slowness III). Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_nail.nail_claws: Elongated Nails: your fingernails grow into claws and rake a short cone ahead: foes in it are hit and wither for two seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_nail.nail_hook: Nail Hook: a nail is shot at the block or foe you aim at (3 to 18 blocks) and you are pulled across on it, with Slow Falling for 2.5 seconds. A way across, not a weapon.
nusmp.page.book_nail.nail_lance: Nail Lance: the nails of one hand are fused into a lance and driven twelve blocks ahead: every foe on the line is hit, slowed and nudged back. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_nail.nail_hardening: Hardened Nails: your nails harden to steel for twelve seconds: your melee hits deal extra damage. Bonus scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_nail.nail_thicket: Nail Thicket: nails sprout from the ground where you look for four seconds: every half second the foes within four and a half blocks take a pulse, are slowed and wither. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_scale.scale_dart: Scale Dart: a single sharp scale is flicked at the first foe or wall it meets and bursts there; foes within 1.2 blocks are hit and weakened for two seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_scale.scale_slide: Scale Slide: the scales under your feet lie flat and you slide eight blocks forward in a moment (the furthest free spot, never inside a wall). A pure move, no damage.
nusmp.page.book_scale.scale_cyclone: Scale Cyclone: your scales spin off you in a ring: foes within four and a half blocks are hit and flung outward. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_scale.scale_dragon_tail: Dragon Tail Sweep: a tail of scales lashes eight blocks ahead in a broad band: every foe in it is hit and thrown aside. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_scale.scale_reef: Scale Reef: a reef of scales rises where you look for four seconds: every half second the foes in it take a pulse, are slowed and weakened. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_spike.spike_jab: Spike Jab: spikes jut from your arm in a narrow cone three and a half blocks long: foes in it are hit and slowed for a second and a half. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_spike.spike_vault: Spike Vault: a spike thrust under you vaults you up and forward; you fall slowly for two seconds.
nusmp.page.book_spike.spike_lance: Spike Lance: one great spike is thrust twelve blocks ahead and pierces every foe on the line, nudging it back. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_spike.spike_snare: Spike Snare: spikes close round the foe in your crosshair like a cage and hold it (hard control: shares the twelve-second lock, three seconds on a player, a boss for one); it is weakened. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_spike.spike_garden: Spike Garden: a garden of spikes grows where you look for five seconds: every half second the foes in it take a pulse and are slowed. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_chain.chain_hook_throw: A hooked chain is thrown at the first foe it meets: it is hit, slowed for a second and a half and dragged a step towards you. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_chain.chain_whirl: You spin with the chains out like a lasso: foes within five blocks are hit, knocked back and slowed for two seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_chain.chain_downpour: Chains rain down on the point you look at for four seconds: every half second the foes within five blocks take a pulse, are slowed and jolted. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.barrier_shove: Barrier Shove - a wide pane of barrier is pushed out in front of you: foes in a short cone are hit and shoved hard away. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.barrier_stairs: Barrier Stairs - hexagons of barrier stack up under your feet like steps and throw you up and forward; you fall slowly for four seconds.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.barrier_lattice: Barrier Lattice - a honeycomb of barrier is laid over the ground where you look for five seconds: every half second the foes in it take a pulse, are slowed and weakened. Damage scales with your EP.
item.nusmp.spirit_of_zephyr.lore: The long green blade of the Wind Spirit Zephyr: crossed rings turn at its hilt, and a hit scatters wind-green light.
item.nusmp.spirit_of_boreas.lore: The leaf bow of the Wind Spirit Boreas: its arrows leave a short trail of light.
nusmp.page.book_fire.ultimate_fire: Ultimate Flame Magic: Crimson Sun Descent - A false sun of crimson fire is gathered above you and dropped on the whole field (original). Hold the page to cast: a long wind-up (about 6 to 10 seconds) holds you in place; you must be at FULL mana to start and ALL of it is taken at the release; a 16-block area hits up to 24 foes in three pulses and burns every foe for 12 seconds and slows, weakens and starves them. Taking a third of your health in damage, being sealed, dying, leaving or changing dimension breaks the cast (nothing is spent); sneaking lets it go. Opens only at the end of the mastery bar for a Senior 1st Class Magic Knight with 1,000,000 EP; cooldown 15 minutes.
nusmp.page.book_water.ultimate_water: Ultimate Water Magic: Sea God's Deluge - The sea itself is called up and brought down in one crushing flood (original). Mana Method, Flame Rune: a rune array of fire forms before you; after a breath a bolt of flame leaves it and GROWS as it flies, wider and harder the further it goes. Sneak to write both runes (pursue and grow). Who may use it is the server's choice: by default your grimoire's mastery (about Stage 3), or the Rune State page, or the late-game Mana Zone gate. Only a grimoire of this element (or a fused one with it as a parent) writes it, unless the server lets every grimoire write all four.
nusmp.mana_method.page.mana_method_water: Mana Method, Water Rune: a rune array of water forms before you; the bolt that leaves it PURSUES the foe nearest your line of fire, turning toward it as it flies. Sneak to write both runes (pursue and grow). Who may use it is the server's choice: by default your grimoire's mastery (about Stage 3), or the Rune State page, or the late-game Mana Zone gate. Only a grimoire of this element (or a fused one with it as a parent) writes it, unless the server lets every grimoire write all four.
Mana Method, Wind Rune: a rune array of wind forms before you; the gale that leaves it PURSUES the foe nearest your line of fire and lifts what it strikes. Sneak to write both runes (pursue and grow). Who may use it is the server's choice: by default your grimoire's mastery (about Stage 3), or the Rune State page, or the late-game Mana Zone gate. Only a grimoire of this element (or a fused one with it as a parent) writes it, unless the server lets every grimoire write all four.
nusmp.mana_method.page.mana_method_earth: Mana Method, Earth Rune: a rune array of earth forms before you; the stone that leaves it GROWS as it flies and slows what it strikes. Sneak to write both runes (pursue and grow). Who may use it is the server's choice: by default your grimoire's mastery (about Stage 3), or the Rune State page, or the late-game Mana Zone gate. Only a grimoire of this element (or a fused one with it as a parent) writes it, unless the server lets every grimoire write all four.
Mana Method, True Magic: a rune array that makes the REAL element of your natural attribute. The bolt ignores magic resistance, devils are highly susceptible, and where it lands it leaves real blocks for a while (water sources, a stone mound, fire, moss) where you may build. Needs Stage 3 control and a natural attribute; the environment's dense mana pays part of the cost.

nusmp.companion.charmy.sub: Cotton and Food Mage of the Black Bulls
nusmp.companion.charmy.greet: Oh, %s! Did you bring snacks? ...I mean, hello!
nusmp.companion.charmy.q.food: What do you like to eat?
nusmp.companion.charmy.a.self: I'm Charmy Pappitson of the Black Bulls! Cotton Magic and Food Magic, that's me. And if you've got food, you're my favourite person.
nusmp.companion.charmy.a.food: Everything! But cake, pumpkin pie and cookies most of all. Ask me what I like if you want the whole list.
nusmp.companion.charmy.a.magic: Cotton Magic: fluffy, soft and stronger than it looks. And Food Magic, which is the best kind of magic there is.
nusmp.companion.charmy.a.join: Yay, an adventure! Is there food on the way? Lead on!
nusmp.companion.charmy.a.wait: Okay, I'll wait right here. Don't be gone long!
nusmp.companion.charmy.join.need: Share a snack with me first. Then we can talk about walking together.
nusmp.companion.charmy.join.taken: I'm walking with someone else right now.
nusmp.companion.charmy.use: Here, have this %s! You look terrible!
nusmp.companion.charmy.gift.love: %s! For me? You're the best, I love you!
nusmp.companion.charmy.gift.ok: Thanks! %s is not bad at all.
nusmp.companion.charmy.gift.hate: Ugh... %s? Even I won't eat that.
nusmp.companion.charmy.stance.passive: I'll stay out of it. Promise.
nusmp.page.book_star.star_seed: Hangs a star in the air where you look (up to 24 blocks, 3 blocks over the ground). Stars last 40 seconds; you can keep 6 at once (8 for a Grinberryall heir), the oldest goes first. Conjunction and the Quartile pages use them. Nothing is hurt.
nusmp.page.book_star.quartile_scutum: Four of your stars join into a standing barrier of starlight, up to 6 by 5 blocks, for 5 seconds: arrows, fireballs and spell bolts of everyone who is not on your side stop on it until it has taken three hits' worth of damage (a devil's magic counts half). Open to every Star mage. Your stars stay.
nusmp.page.book_star.quartile_hasta: Four stars link and gather their light for a moment, then fire it from their middle as a spear of light with a laser tail along your crosshair (32 blocks, up to 6 foes pierced, a little knockback). The four stars are used up. Open to every Star mage; a Grinberryall heir's spear hits harder.
nusmp.page.book_star.black_neverland: Black Neverland (canon: Yuno's Star Magic joined with the wind spirit Sylph and Asta's anti-magic, manga ch. 381 to 383): six anti-magic stars form a dome 8 blocks wide for 5 seconds. Foes inside are weakened, slowed and lightly hurt, their spell bolts end, and your allies inside are quickened and strengthened. The anti-magic cancels the magic of foes inside: they are silenced, their skills jammed, barriers and stars of others shatter, until the anti-magic fades after 4 seconds. Costs Aura. Needs the Grinberryall heir mark, a bond with Sylph, and a Demon-Dweller sword in hand (or the Anti-Magic Lord); the server setting star.neverlandCanonGate = false asks for the heir mark only.
nusmp.page.book_star.quintile_atrum_scut: Quintile: Atrum Scutum (unverified canon: one source only). Five of your stars form a wider barrier, up to 8 by 6 blocks, for 7 seconds, that can take four and a half hits' worth of damage. Needs five real stars. Open to every Star mage. Your stars stay.
nusmp.page.book_star.quintile_atrum_hast: Quintile: Atrum Hasta (unverified canon: one source only). Five stars gather their light into a heavier spear of light, 1.6 blocks wide, up to 8 foes pierced. All five stars are used up. Needs five real stars. Open to every Star mage; a Grinberryall heir's spear hits harder.
nusmp.page.book_star.quintile_atrum_flag: Quintile: Atrum Flagellum (unverified canon: one source only). A whip of starlight lashes through five of your stars three times; each foe on its path can be hit twice. Needs five real stars. Open to every Star mage. Your stars stay.
item.nusmp.valkyrie_drill_lance.lore: The spiral lance of water of the Valkyrie Dress: its drill turns, and a hit scatters drops.

nusmp.companion.gs.tip.meter.max: All three leaves are lit. She counts you a close friend.

nusmp.companion.gs.tip.follow.off: She is waiting here. Click to ask her to walk with you.

nusmp.mana_method.page.mana_method_air_s: Mana Method, Air Step Rune: a small rune array forms under your feet and holds you up. Walk on air for a few seconds; sneak to drop. Works for any mage with the Mana Zone gate. Who may use it is the server's choice: by default your grimoire's mastery (about Stage 3), or the Rune State page, or the late-game Mana Zone gate.
Mana Method, Dash Rune: a rune array bursts behind you and throws you forward in your look direction, with a short grace for the fall. Short cooldown. Who may use it is the server's choice: by default your grimoire's mastery (about Stage 3), or the Rune State page, or the late-game Mana Zone gate.
nusmp.mana_method.air_step: Air Step Rune: walk on air for %s s (sneak to drop)
Mana Method, Body Rune (Gadjah's way): rune arrays are written on your own body for a while. Small temporary gifts that grow with the hold: a little more speed, attack, jump, step height, a softer fall and knockback resistance; a full hold also lets you glide down slowly for a moment. A full hold also turns away 15% of each hit you take while the runes last. It is not flight. Costs by the hold. Who may use it is the server's choice: by default your grimoire's mastery (about Stage 3), or the Rune State page, or the late-game Mana Zone gate.
nusmp.mana_method.page.mana_method_brush: Mana Method, Brush Rune (Rill's way): paint a rune array on the surface you look at (floor, wall or ceiling, within 5 blocks). It waits for a while, and when a foe steps into it one bolt of your element leaves it toward them and the array is spent. It never hurts you or your allies. A few at a time; costs by the hold. Who may use it is the server's choice: by default your grimoire's mastery (about Stage 3), or the Rune State page, or the late-game Mana Zone gate.
nusmp.mana_method.body: Body Rune: the runes settle on your body for %s s
nusmp.mana_method.brush: Brush Rune: the array is painted (%s s)
nusmp.mana_method.page.mana_method_state: Mana Method, Rune State: call the runes. For a few minutes (8 by default) the Mana Method pages answer you, then they must rest before they can be called again (10 minutes by default). Cast it again to see how long is left. The state ends if you log out, die or change dimension, and then the rest begins. Only listed when the server uses the timed mode.
nusmp.mana_method.state.start: Rune State: ON for %s. The runes answer your call.
nusmp.mana_method.state.warn: Rune State: the runes fade in %s.
nusmp.mana_method.state.end: Rune State: OFF. It can be called again in %s.
nusmp.mana_method.state.cooling: Rune State: the runes have not settled yet (%s left).
nusmp.mana_method.state.cut: Rune State: the runes fade early. It can be called again in %s.
nusmp.configuration.corpse.diagnose.tool: On: a refused numbered summon (No.4 Jimmy, No.3 David, No.2 Alfredo, No.1 Carl, No.0 Michael Caesal) and a numbered body that leaves the world within five seconds each write one line to the server log with the reason, at most one line per player per second. Off: silent.
nusmp.configuration.corpse.noSunBurn: Raised undead never burn in daylight (server)
nusmp.configuration.corpse.noSunBurn.too: On: the zombies and skeletons raised by the older Soul Corpse spells are put out each sweep while their fire resistance lasts, so sunlight cannot burn them away. Soul Zombies and the numbered undead never burn in daylight regardless. Off: only the fire resistance effect protects them.
nusmp.configuration.corpse.fallbackLook: Zombie stand-in for the numbered undead (client)
On: if the model or texture of a numbered undead failed to load, it is drawn as a tinted zombie (and the client log names the file) instead of as nothing. Off: the old behaviour, nothing is drawn.
item.nusmp.star_king_dragon_core.desc: The eye of the Star King Dragon, cut from its heart. A crafting core: it can be socketed into a Grimoire to turn its magic into raw Stardust.
item.nusmp.star_king_dragon_core.card: Dropped by Veldanava (1 per fighter). Combat compatibility: socketed into a Grimoire it would convert all elemental magic into raw, unblockable Stardust magic, and it is the main ingredient of the Aura of the Creator (those two uses are crafted by other systems; this item is the material).
item.nusmp.genesis_fragment.desc: A shard of the moment of creation. Used at an anvil or forge to push a weapon past the enchanting limits.
item.nusmp.genesis_fragment.card: Dropped by Veldanava (3 per fighter). Combat compatibility: used in an anvil or a forge to upgrade weapons beyond the usual enchantment limits, granting Unbreakable and a faster base attack speed (the upgrade recipe is crafted by other systems; this item is the material).
item.nusmp.creators_essence.desc: Use it to refill your health, food and magicules and to clear every cooldown. The panic button of a raid.
item.nusmp.creators_essence.card: Dropped by Veldanava (1 per fighter). Right-click: full health and food, every bad effect removed, Regeneration and Absorption for a while, the magicules full and every item and hero-weapon cooldown cleared. It is used up.
item.nusmp.justice_king_michael_fragment: Consume it to be guarded by an absolute barrier that turns away one fatal blow a day.

Rare drop of Veldanava. Right-click to consume it once: from then on, the first blow each day that would kill you is turned away (the barrier is checked before totems and other saves). Kept in your player data, through death.
Held in the hand it lets you step through space: a dash of up to fourteen blocks with no fall damage.

Rare drop of Veldanava. Right-click to step up to 14 blocks along your look direction to the furthest spot your body fits, with no fall damage (2 second cooldown). It is not used up: a vastly better Ender Pearl that never breaks.
item.nusmp.nihility_fragment.desc: Held in the off hand it coats your blows in void: what you strike cannot heal for five seconds.
item.nusmp.nihility_fragment.card: Rare drop of Veldanava. Keep it in the off hand. Anything you strike with a weapon in the main hand cannot regain health for 5 seconds (the healing-debuff the guide calls Anti-Magic), which answers bosses that regenerate. It is not used up.
item.nusmp.veldanavas_divine_core.desc: A limitless source of power. In the off hand it negates the cost of ultimate spells.
item.nusmp.veldanavas_divine_core.card: Ultra-rare drop of Veldanava (about 1 in 100 per fighter). Combat compatibility: held in the off hand it is meant to negate the mana or stamina cost of any ultimate spell of any anime system in the mod (the hook is in the Ultimate Magic system's cost step; the item itself is the key).
nusmp.skill.sandalphon.description: The Archangel of the Executioner. Four passives (Executioner's Authority, Absolute Severance, Inevitable Demise, Judgment Gaze), five judgments (Judgment Bullet, Condemnation, Supreme Edict, Guillotine Cleave, Verdict of Ruin) and, once mastered, Final Judgment: a held channel that freezes one target in time and detonates all its Temporal Debt at five times its worth. The four passives are one switch: turn the skill ON in Tensura's skill toggle and all four run together; OFF stops them all. Since 3.21.0 the judgments hit harder: the Bullet turns every boon it tears off into a wound, the Supreme Edict is a decree that hurts every hostile creature in reach, the Cleave grows with the Temporal Debt of its target and finishes a sigil-marked creature below a third of its health, and a Verdict of Ruin that runs out tolls once more for a last share of everyone inside.
nusmp.skill.sandalphon.mastered: Sandalphon is mastered: Final Judgment answers you, the judgments cost less, and your passives seal and stutter what they strike.
nusmp.veldanava.skills.title: Will of the Creator
nusmp.veldanava.skills.hint: Choose one ultimate skill. It is yours for good, and it can only be chosen once.
nusmp.veldanava.skills.have: You already hold a skill from the Creator. Take your share of the loot.
nusmp.skill.israfil.description: The Archangel of the Trial. Four passives (Spatial Domination, Trial of Endurance, Labyrinthian Mind, Weight of Consequence), five trials (Dimensional Labyrinth, Weight of Sins, Spatial Collapse, Coordinate Shift, Rift Walk) and, once mastered, The Grand Trumpet: a sound that silences everything within a hundred blocks. The four passives are one switch: turn the skill ON in Tensura's skill toggle and all four run together; OFF stops them all. Since 3.22.0 the trials hit: the Grand Trumpet is a blast that falls off with distance, Coordinate Shift shears the creature it trades places with, and a Spatial Collapse that runs out implodes once more for a last share of everyone inside.
nusmp.skill.israfil.mastered: Israfil is mastered: The Grand Trumpet answers you, the trials cost less and cool down faster, and blows that reach you are bent aside.
nusmp.skill.jibril.description: The Archangel of Law. Four passives (Divine Rigor, Heavenly Presence, Strict Governance, Wings of Revelation), five edicts (Absolute Command, Judgment of Heaven, Heavenly Purge, Holy Shackles, Word of Law) and, once mastered, Kingdom of God: a held sanctuary of fifty blocks where allies cannot fall below 1 HP and enemies are stripped of their blessings and crushed by gravity. The four passives are one switch: turn the skill ON in Tensura's skill toggle and all four run together; OFF stops them all. Since 3.23.0 the judgments smite: Judgment of Heaven hits the unholy (the undead, demons, creatures in Temporal Debt) half as hard again, Heavenly Purge burns the unholy near you, the Holy Shackles bite for every good effect they take, and the Kingdom of God wears its enemies down every second.
nusmp.skill.jibril.mastered: Jibril is mastered: Kingdom of God answers you, the edicts cost less and cool down faster, Divine Rigor shelters your allies, and the parry of Word of Law lasts longer.
nusmp.skill.solomon.description: The Magic King. Four passives (Infinite Grimoire, Omnipotent Magic, Mana Skin, Elemental Sovereignty), five spells of command (Grand Spell Copy, Arcane Convergence, Realm of Magic, Spell Chain, Mana Zone Erasure) and, once mastered, The 72 Pillars: seventy-two pillars of every element that rain on the creatures around you, break the ground and ignore Castle Guard. The four passives are one switch: turn the skill ON in Tensura's skill toggle and all four run together; OFF stops them all.
nusmp.skill.solomon.mastered: Solomon is mastered: The 72 Pillars answer you, every spell costs half, the spells of command cost less and cool down faster, and Infinite Grimoire, Omnipotent Magic and the chant grow stronger.
nusmp.skill.hercules.description: The Lord of Martial Prowess. Four passives (Adamantine Body, God of Strength, Unstoppable Momentum, Colossal Vigor), five feats of arms (Earth-Shattering Tremor, Invictus, Titan's Grip, Devastating Throw, Battle Roar) and, once mastered, World-Breaking Strike: one punch that shatters the barriers of the world, breaks armour and lays a heavy Temporal Debt on what it hits. The four passives are one switch: turn the skill ON in Tensura's skill toggle and all four run together; OFF stops them all. Since 3.20.0 Tremor ends with an aftershock, Titan's Grip crushes what it pulls, Battle Roar thunders on the nearest foes and Invictus gives a second wind when it runs out.
nusmp.skill.hercules.mastered: Hercules is mastered: World-Breaking Strike answers you, every feat costs less and cools down faster, and your blows, your regeneration and your momentum grow stronger.
